plugins.name: wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-mcp-manager
plugins.descEn: 'MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.'
plugins.descZh: 'MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。'

plugins.name: jasen215/dsh-continual-harness
plugins.descEn: 'Continual self-refinement loop: persistent memory, periodic review-and-refine, cross-session shared knowledge, and automatic rollback through a model-callable harness_refine tool.'
plugins.descZh: 持续自我优化闭环：持久记忆、周期评审与自动优化、跨会话共享知识、失败自动回滚，由模型可调用的 harness_refine 工具驱动。

plugins.name: MAXeaglet/dsh-bash-terminal
plugins.descEn: One shell tool for PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL on Windows plus an interactive PTY terminal; the default terminal is chosen by the user in DSH settings.
plugins.descZh: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上统一执行 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL，外加交互式 PTY 终端，默认终端由用户在设置中选择。

plugins.name: Yuer6327/NoLetMe
plugins.descEn: "Real-time 'We need…' and 'Let me…' reasoning-trajectory keyword stats for the DeepSeek Harness web chat."
plugins.descZh: 实时追踪 DeepSeek Harness 网页对话中模型流式推理轨迹关键词统计的 UI 面板。

plugins.name: EternalNight996/dsh-ui-agents-pixe
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 主窗口添加「工作角色」页签 + 像素办公室浮层：内置 508 张角色卡（The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253），支持搜索 / 中英切换 / 分部分类；Canvas 2D 像素小人可站立、打字、踱步，闲聊台词可接 AI。一条命令安装，不改 dsh 源码。

plugins.name: SaiSenBox/dsh-boot-guard
plugins.descEn: Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.
plugins.descZh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

plugins.name: jasonrale/dsh-archive-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Archived-session manager for DSH Web UI: reopen an archived session and keep chatting, unarchive it back in place, or hard-delete a session — grouped panel with message search and native view sync.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web UI 的归档会话管理器：重新打开已归档会话并继续对话、取消归档恢复原位、彻底删除会话，支持分组浏览、消息搜索与原生视图同步。

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-docker
plugins.descEn: 'Docker tools for agents: ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health with JSON output, env-configurable CLI path, approval-gated exec and zero runtime dependencies.'
plugins.descZh: Docker 工具：ps/images/logs/inspect/exec/manage/health 七工具，JSON 输出、DSH_DOCKER_PATH 环境变量、exec 审批门、零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: wingsky-1/dsh-plugin-hub#packages/dsh-lan-proxy
plugins.descEn: 'Access the dsh web UI over LAN: HTTP/HTTPS/WS forwarding plus TLS (self-signed or custom certificates); adaptive Brotli/gzip compression for HTTP and permessage-deflate for WebSocket; half-open WebSocket probing keeps mobile clients from going stale after backgrounding; launch-token auto-injection lets LAN devices connect without copying the token; DNS-rebinding protection + loopback-only upstream allowlist.'
plugins.descZh: 局域网访问 dsh web UI：HTTP/HTTPS/WS 转发 + TLS（自签名/自定义证书）；HTTP 自适应 Brotli/gzip 与 WebSocket permessage-deflate 双压缩；WS 半开探活，移动端切后台不僵死；启动令牌自动注入，LAN 设备免手工拿 token；DNS 重绑定防护 + 回环-only 上游白名单。

plugins.name: timwhitez/dsh-self-evolving#packages/dsh-self-evolving
plugins.descEn: 'Evidence-first self-evolution controller: bounded Cordis candidate generation, one-shot real-Loader admission, Harbor evaluation, and a crash-resumable journaled lineage.'
plugins.descZh: 证据优先的自进化控制器：有界生成 Cordis 候选插件，一次性真实 Loader 准入，Harbor 评测，可崩溃恢复的日志化谱系。

plugins.name: HuiHuitie-zhu/dsh-check-update
plugins.descEn: 'Update checker (npm edition): a settings page comparing local and latest versions of @deepseek-ai/dsh and every installed plugin, with a red-dot nav reminder and ready-made update commands.'
plugins.descZh: 更新检查器（npm 版）：设置页对比 @deepseek-ai/dsh 与已装插件的本地/最新版本，有更新时导航红点提醒，并直接给出更新命令。

plugins.name: AngelosZou/graphlint#integrations/dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents.'
plugins.descZh: 面向 AI 生成代码的死代码检测：graphlint 构建依赖图，定位从任何入口不可达的代码，以实现代码库清理和功能有效性理解，并为 DSH 智能体提供 graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config 工具与 graphlint 技能。

plugins.name: wulun811/LiuHe#bundle
plugins.descEn: 'Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.'
plugins.descZh: 将 LiuHe MCP 代码工具集（44 个工具）桥接进 dsh web：repo_map、符号搜索、带容错匹配的 edit_batch、带撤销日志的事务性编辑，以及确定性质量门禁——由崩溃隔离的 Rust tree-sitter 解析守护进程和 SQLite 索引支撑。

plugins.name: sunxin-ai/dsh-design-qa
plugins.descEn: 'Design-fidelity QA for text-only models: a `deepseek_vision` tool borrows an eye from any OpenAI-compatible vision route, so the model can judge whether an implementation matches its mock — shipped with the benchmark behind that judgement (four fixtures, 23 injected defects, raw transcripts) and the questioning discipline it depends on.'
plugins.descZh: '给纯文本模型的设计稿保真判定：`deepseek_vision` 工具从任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉路由借来一只眼，让模型判断实现与设计稿是否一致——并附上支撑该判定的基准（4 组夹具、23 处注入缺陷、逐格原始输出）与其依赖的提问纪律。'

plugins.name: Edge-Echo/dsh-mcp-bridge
plugins.descEn: "MCP server installer and verifier for DeepSeek Harness: interactive init writes real patch entries into a profile, list and validate inspect them, and a CI-enforced verifier connects to every curated server."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器安装与验证工具：交互式 init 会把真实 patch 条目写进 profile，list 与 validate 检查配置，CI 强制的验证器逐个连接精选服务器。"

plugins.name: Sanqi-normal/dsh-model-picker
plugins.descEn: 'Provider-tabbed model picker for the dsh web composer: left provider column and right model list, both independently scrollable, with cross-provider search.'
plugins.descZh: dsh web 输入栏模型选择面板：左侧提供商栏 + 右侧模型列表，两侧独立滚动，支持跨提供商搜索。

plugins.name: flymysql/dsh-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.'
plugins.descZh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

plugins.name: ZSeven-W/dsh-noema
plugins.descEn: 'Long-term memory for DSH agents — durable, inspectable memories with recall, search, browse and knowledge-graph tools, import from ten other AI coding tools, and a settings page.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DSH Agent 提供长期记忆——可检索、可检视的持久记忆，带回忆、搜索、浏览与知识图谱工具，支持从十个其他 AI 编码工具导入记忆，并附设置页。'

plugins.name: dsh-myrules
plugins.descEn: Edit the host-wide global instructions (~/.dsh/AGENTS.md) from a dedicated Customize page in Settings - every session on this machine applies them.
plugins.descZh: 在设置页的「个性化」页编辑此主机全局指令（~/.dsh/AGENTS.md），此机器上的所有会话都会应用。

plugins.name: qjcnmd/dsh-reasoning-slider
plugins.descEn: Codex-style reasoning-effort slider embedded in the model selector.
plugins.descZh: Codex 风格推理等级滑块，内嵌于模型选择器，拖动切换推理档位。

plugins.name: YuanyuanMa03/cot-lint
plugins.descEn: 'Chain-of-thought leakage linter: zero-dependency CLI that finds AI-session residue in docs and comments (dead design citations, PR vantage, change narration, review choreography), shipping the cot-trim fixing skill as the installable bundle.'
plugins.descZh: 思维链泄漏检测：零依赖 CLI 扫描 AI 留在文档与注释里的会话残留（死设计引用、PR 视角、变更叙述、评审编排），内置 cot-trim 语义修复技能包。

plugins.name: Viger1/dsh-pilot
plugins.descEn: 'Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the session approval stance and is enforced by request interception.'
plugins.descZh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

plugins.name: Walvez/dsh-search-failover
plugins.descEn: 'Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management, custom SearXNG instances, failover/rotate strategy switching and live SerpApi quota.'
plugins.descZh: '原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。'

plugins.name: Ceelog/dsh-plugins#dsh-plugin-scheduled-tasks
plugins.descEn: Per-project scheduled prompts run as fresh headless agent sessions, with one-time, interval, and cron schedules plus durable run history.
plugins.descZh: 按项目调度提示词，在全新的无头 Agent 会话中执行，支持单次、固定间隔和 cron 计划，并持久化运行历史。

plugins.name: jiay98528-dev/dsh-model-sync
plugins.descEn: Writes live provider model lists into DSH settings and shows 5h/7d plan windows or metered balance for the current session model.
plugins.descZh: 把各提供方线上模型列表写进 DSH 设置，输入框圆环显示当前会话模型的 5 小时/7 天窗口或按量剩余余额。

plugins.name: 54xkeee/dsh-vision
plugins.descEn: Vision for text-only DeepSeek via Doubao Web by default (zero-cost, no API key — drives your logged-in Chrome through a Windows CDP bridge), with Antigravity IDE quota (flash/pro) or Gemini fallback; auto detail escalation, vision evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.
plugins.descZh: 纯文本 DeepSeek 的识图插件：默认走豆包 Web（零成本、免 API key，经 Windows CDP 桥接驱动已登录 Chrome），另有反重力额度（flash/pro）与 Gemini 降级通道；档位自动升级、视觉证据记忆与会话压缩恢复、内容哈希缓存、双语客户端面板。

plugins.name: maple-pwn/paperlab
plugins.descEn: 'Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.'
plugins.descZh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

plugins.name: wefio/dsh-cache-miss
plugins.descEn: Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.
plugins.descZh: 提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

plugins.name: Viger1/dsh-design
plugins.descEn: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid drift, palette size, tap targets, and the tells of generated UI such as violet gradients caught by hue angle; ships a design-system skill.
plugins.descZh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

plugins.name: Areium/dsh-fail-logger
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-log failed tool calls across native tools, PTC run_code, and inline invocations: dedup and count root causes into a skill so repeated mistakes fade.'
plugins.descZh: 全模式调用工具失败自动实录：把原生工具 / PTC run_code / 代码内嵌工具调用的失败错因去重计数后写入 skill，越用越少错。

plugins.name: causebefore/dsh-pomodoro
plugins.descEn: Pomodoro focus-and-break timer for DSH Web with configurable cycles, a draggable mini panel, and in-app, sound, and browser notifications.
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 番茄钟：提供可配置专注/休息循环、可拖动迷你面板，以及站内提醒、提示音和浏览器通知。

plugins.name: jiewaigongxing/dsh-jiey-browser
plugins.descEn: 'Drive Jiey Browser from DeepSeek Harness over MCP: navigate, snapshot, act, read, screenshot, and manage tabs in a real Chromium profile.'
plugins.descZh: 通过 MCP 在 DeepSeek Harness 中驱动 Jiey 浏览器：导航、快照、操作、读取、截图与标签页管理，使用真实 Chromium 环境。

plugins.name: dream-num/dsh-univer-office
plugins.descEn: 'Give DeepSeek Harness a real office environment. Univer Office Plugin brings spreadsheets, docs, slides, canvases, relational tables, and more into one runtime — with connected data, validation, versioned changes, and isolated worktrees for multi-agent collaboration.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造一个真正的办公环境。Univer Office 插件将电子表格、文档、幻灯片、画布、多维表格等汇聚到同一个运行时——数据互联、修改经过校验、变更按版本管理，并以隔离工作树支持多 Agent 协作。

plugins.name: izz-BLUE/dsh-devtools
plugins.descEn: 'Metadata-first runtime profiler for DSH agents: turn/step traces, model and tool wall-time timelines, provider usage, retries, errors, and live or historical sessions.'
plugins.descZh: 面向 DSH Agent 的运行时分析器：查看 Turn/Step 轨迹、模型与工具耗时、Provider 用量、重试与错误，实时与历史会话都能看。

plugins.name: Sttrevens/dsh-cost-meter
plugins.descEn: 'Per-turn USD cost badge in the Web UI: session total in the header and per-turn cost in each message footer, with a hover breakdown.'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 美元成本徽标：头部显示会话总成本、每条回复结尾显示该轮成本，悬停看分项。

plugins.name: omicverse/dsh-omicos
plugins.descEn: Runs OmicVerse/OmicOS bioinformatics analyses in a persistent Python kernel, with capability-catalog search, kernel inspection and an account tab.
plugins.descZh: 在持久 Python 内核里跑 OmicVerse/OmicOS 生信分析，附能力目录检索、内核变量查看与账号订阅页签。

plugins.name: dhicoc/dsh-wuyun-liuqi
plugins.descEn: 'Complete wuyun-liuqi (five-evolutions-six-qi / 五运六气) Traditional Chinese Medicine skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: annual and guest-qi calculation, clinical pattern differentiation, and pathogenesis reasoning.'
plugins.descZh: 完整 wuyun-liuqi（五运六气）中医运气学技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness 插件：年度与客气推算、临床辨证、病机推演。

plugins.name: dsh-niao/dsh-niao-quick-open
plugins.descEn: 'UI enhancement suite for DeepSeek Harness: one-click workspace open (copy path, reveal in Finder, open in an auto-discovered editor), DeepSeek-web-style user-message nav rail, session to-do marks, flat-list polish, and a hard-restart button.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 界面增强插件：工作区一键打开（复制路径、访达显示、自动发现编辑器打开）、用户消息导航条、会话待办标记、单列表增强与硬性重启按钮。'

plugins.name: lninghaha/dsh-coding-subscription-oauth
plugins.descEn: "Coding-subscription OAuth for SuperGrok/Grok Build, ChatGPT Plus Codex, Kimi Code and Claude Code, plus an opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway: local login without pasting tokens, AUTH refresh-and-retry, grok-4.6 xhigh, and API-key route coexistence."
plugins.descZh: "编码订阅 OAuth，支持 SuperGrok / Grok Build、ChatGPT Plus Codex、Kimi Code、Claude Code，并提供可选 loopback OpenAI/Anthropic 网关：本地登录无需粘贴 token，支持 AUTH 刷新重试、grok-4.6 xhigh，并可与 API-key 路由共存。"

plugins.name: Isilsolme/dsh-anthropic-fonts
plugins.descEn: Anthropic Sans, Serif, and Mono fonts for the DSH Web UI, with Source Han fallback for CJK.
plugins.descZh: Anthropic Sans/Serif/Mono 字体：界面 Sans、对话 Serif、代码 Mono，中文回退思源字体。

plugins.name: SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-smooth-stream
plugins.descEn: Better streaming text animation for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加入更好的流式文字动画。

plugins.name: kendu76/dsh-music-player
plugins.descEn: 'Music, audiobook, radio and news player for DeepSeek Harness: streams your local music folder over HTTP, reads local .txt/.epub novels aloud with AI voices, plays online QQ/Kugou/Netease music and internet radio (HLS supported), and broadcasts daily news digests — all driven from the UI or by telling the agent through the music_play model tool.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 音乐/小说播放器：在网页里听本地音乐（HTTP 流式）、用 AI 声音朗读本地小说（.txt/.epub）、播放在线 QQ/酷狗/网易云音乐与网络电台（支持 HLS 直播流）、定时播报每日新闻；可在面板操作，也可让 agent 通过 music_play 工具直接点播。'

plugins.name: dsh-niao/dsh-niao-message
plugins.descEn: 'macOS system notifications for DeepSeek Harness: aborted, max-tokens, blocked, interrupted and error events, pending questions and approvals, and completion or subagent-end via terminal-notifier; clicking a banner opens a configured app and returning to the page auto-dismisses them.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的 macOS 系统通知插件：任务中止、超限、阻塞、中断、出错、等待提问或批准、完成或子代理结束等事件通过 terminal-notifier 弹系统横幅；点击横幅打开指定应用，回到页面自动清空。'

plugins.name: sakuraqqq/dsh-auto-paste
plugins.descEn: Auto-saves large pasted text as an attachment file in the DeepSeek Harness web input box; with dsh-better-sidebar installed, the paste pill opens the file in the sidebar editor and saves it back.
plugins.descZh: 在输入框粘贴大段文本时自动保存为附件文件；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，药丸上的「查看」可在侧栏编辑器打开并保存回原文件。

plugins.name: YeqingTang/dsh-session-flow
plugins.descEn: 'Cross-session archive: overview workbench, folded timeline, subagent lineage, full-text search, rule+LLM summaries, ZIP export, live tracking. Native session-page embeds: turn rail, docked right panel (live mode, pinned to original session on switch), rename (official-synced), conclusion digest, health monitoring + persistent header chip (idle / active / tool-wait / stalled). dsh v0.1.2+: fuses with the official TurnNavigatorRail — vector-icon info chips (duration, tool calls, errors, thinking) plus lazy tool distribution inside the official preview card, right-click opens the workbench; the classic piano-key strip is on by default and delegates unloaded-turn jumps to the official auto-load engine; the official rail can be hidden entirely. Settings dialog section with 10 tunable behavior params.'
plugins.descZh: 跨会话档案柜：总览工作台、折叠时间线、子代理血缘、全文检索、双模式摘要、ZIP 导出、实时跟踪。会话流标签页嵌入原生会话页：轮次悬浮条、详情并入右栏（实时模式，切换会话可钉住原会话直播）、会话重命名（对齐官方即时同步）、结论摘要行、健康监控与常驻头部胶囊（空闲 / 活跃 / 工具执行 / 疑似卡死四态）。dsh v0.1.2+ 与官方轮次导航融合：官方预览卡内嵌矢量图标信息段（耗时 / 工具调用 / 错误 / 思考 + 工具分布懒加载），右键唤起会话流工作台；经典钢琴键悬浮条默认开启并存，点击未载入轮次委托官方引擎自动加载跳转；可设置隐藏官方导航只留钢琴键。设置弹窗独立分节，10 项行为参数可调。

plugins.name: MicroHEROX/dsh-koboldcpp-hands
plugins.descEn: Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.

plugins.name: Wine-Red/dsh-prompt-stash

plugins.name: whyihaveyou/dsh-suite#plugin-team-board

plugins.name: zhu168/dsh-save-money#plugin

plugins.name: zhtx2024/dsh-skin-switcher

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-rss

plugins.descZh: RSS/Atom 订阅九工具（管理/校验/抓取解析/跨订阅搜索/增量抓取/OPML 导入导出/健康自检），游标增量抓取，订阅持久化到 settings。

plugins.name: tancheng33/dsh-yogacara
plugins.descEn: Tracks the agent's state as Yogācāra mental factors over a durable seed store, and feeds it back into the prompt as first-person inclination.
plugins.descZh: 以唯识心所与种子藏记录 agent 的状态，并以第一人称倾向写回提示词。

plugins.name: xiaoyangcheng84-svg/dsh-skin-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Skin manager for the DSH web GUI: discovers installed skins and switches the active one from a dedicated Settings page, mutually exclusive, hot-reloaded without restart.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web GUI 皮肤管理器：自动发现已安装皮肤，在独立设置页一键互斥切换，热载入无需重启。

plugins.name: akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger
plugins.descEn: 'Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or blocks repeat attempts until the evidence changes.'
plugins.descZh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-claude-move
plugins.descEn: 'Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).'
plugins.descZh: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

plugins.name: Anionex/dsh-computer-use
plugins.descEn: 'Accessibility-first macOS computer use: fresh observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.'
plugins.descZh: macOS 电脑控制：Accessibility 观测、过期状态拒绝、作用域权限与安全输入。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/mattpocock-skills-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Matt Pocock full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code review, wayfinder, ask-matt router) ported to DSH.'
plugins.descZh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md）的 DSH 移植。

plugins.name: Mu-scorpio/token-usage-counter
plugins.descEn: Persistent provider-reported token usage totals with per-session, per-model, and daily activity statistics.
plugins.descZh: 持久化 provider 上报的 Token 用量统计，支持按会话、按模型和按日活跃度查看。

plugins.name: anweat/dsh-restart
plugins.descEn: 'Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/dsh-ecc
plugins.descEn: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
plugins.descZh: ECC（227k⭐ 操作员系统）273 个技能（95.8%）分四批移植到 DSH。

plugins.name: XiLuovo/dsh-session-timeline
plugins.descEn: 'Session timeline down the left of the conversation: every user message at a glance, current-message tracking, hover preview of the message and its reply, click to jump, collapsible.'
plugins.descZh: 会话左侧的短横线时间轴：整个会话的用户消息一览、当前消息定位、悬停预览消息与回复、点击跳转，可收起展开。

plugins.name: boogoo619/dsh-focus-overlay
plugins.descEn: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
plugins.descZh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

plugins.name: Linjiangxian0203/dsh-remote-tunnel
plugins.descEn: 'Remote host tunnel manager: runs dsh web on a remote Linux server (systemd supervision, no root needed) behind an auto-reconnecting SSH tunnel; allocates and registers remote ports on the server, multi-user safe, with an audit view.'
plugins.descZh: 远程主机隧道管理器：把 dsh web 跑在远程 Linux 服务器上（systemd 守护、免 root），本地经自动重连的 SSH 隧道访问；远程端口自动分配并在服务器登记留档，支持多人共用与 audit 审查。

plugins.name: happpsee/dsh-desktop-app
plugins.descEn: 'Skill for packaging DeepSeek Harness into a Tauri 2 desktop app (macOS + Windows): dual-platform install playbook, China mirror bootstrap with a subagent timeout sentinel, admin-free Windows toolchain recipe (no VS Build Tools), and three-path acceptance checklists.'
plugins.descZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 封装成 Tauri 2 桌面应用（macOS + Windows）的技能包：双平台安装、国内镜像加速（含 subagent 超时哨兵）、无管理员 Windows 工具链方案、三路径验收清单。

plugins.name: THEWOLFWALKER/dsh-coyote
plugins.descEn: 'Agent- and GUI-controlled DG-LAB Coyote e-stim plugin: eight `coyote_*` tools plus a DSH web panel behind one safety envelope (soft limits, asymmetric rate limiter, session cooldown, playback caps, disconnect fail-safe); optional auto-stim layer maps agent events (tool calls, errors, turn end) to bounded pulses; official V3 socket protocol with QR pairing, programmable waveforms. Adults only.'
plugins.descZh: Agent 与网页 GUI 双面控制的 DG-LAB 郊狼（Coyote）电击/电刺激插件：八个 `coyote_*` 工具 + DSH 网页面板，共用同一安全边界（软上限、非对称升速限流、会话冷却、播放硬上限、断连即停）；v0.2 起可选自动电击层，把 agent 事件（工具调用/报错/回合结束）映射为有界脉冲；官方 V3 socket 协议 + 二维码配对、可编程波形。仅限成年人。

plugins.name: 1HelloMan1/dsh-usage-dashboard-plus
plugins.descEn: Shows DeepSeek balance and estimated daily spend, merges external vision-call JSONL records, and adds a per-session dashboard with model statistics, TTFT, cache rate, call logs, cost estimates, filters, and CSV export.
plugins.descZh: 显示 DeepSeek 余额与今日花费估算，合并外部视觉调用 JSONL 记录，并提供含模型统计、TTFT、缓存率、调用日志、费用估算、筛选与 CSV 导出的会话看板。

plugins.name: SamizuHM/dsh-client-ui-theme-xp
plugins.descEn: 'Windows XP Luna desktop for the DSH Web UI: a floating window manager with taskbar and desktop icons, plus the era-accurate Luna skin.'
plugins.descZh: Windows XP Luna 桌面化主题：浮动窗口管理器（任务栏、桌面图标）加上还原度很高的 Luna 皮肤。

plugins.name: webkubor/dsh-bloom-theme
plugins.descEn: 'Bloom Morandi theme: ten variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple, sage, stone, lapis, amber, aurora, lavender) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all 20 foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better.'
plugins.descZh: 'Bloom 莫兰迪主题：十款变体（黛蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、桃夭 petal、天青 ripple、竹青 sage、赭石 stone、青金 lapis、琥珀 amber、落霞 aurora、青莲 lavender）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变，顶栏一键切换，每套配色右侧标出处诗句，20 组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。'

plugins.name: CHplus0/dsh-learning-mode#plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Learning Mode agent preset: a coding agent that teaches while coding — concrete scenario-grounded explanations, Socratic guidance, and TODO(你) practice blanks, modeled on Claude Code''s Learning output style; installable via dsh plugin add (dsh-learning-mode on npm).'
plugins.descZh: 学习模式（Learning Mode）Agent 预设：边做边教的编码 Agent——具体的情景化阐释、苏格拉底式引导、TODO(你) 留白练习，模拟 Claude Code 的 Learning 输出风格；可 `dsh plugin add` 安装（npm 包 dsh-learning-mode）。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-period-report
plugins.descEn: Free-interval session reports with AI-narrated daily/weekly digests over any date range, plus every-N-days scheduled reminders with system notifications (macOS / Linux).
plugins.descZh: 自由周期会话报告：任意日期区间的 AI 叙事日报/周报/月报，支持每隔 N 天定时提醒并弹系统通知（macOS / Linux）。

plugins.name: Luaphes/dsh-web-attention-badge
plugins.descEn: 'Attention reminders: frame badge, tab-title count, and a status-colored whale favicon for sessions waiting for input or finished unopened.'
plugins.descZh: 会话需要你时三处同时亮起：角标、标签页标题计数、按状态换色的鲸鱼 favicon。

plugins.name: pengxuding/dsh-plugin-judge
plugins.descEn: 'Plugin value auditor: pre-install review (source scan + LLM judge) and post-install audit of installed bundles, with model-switch re-audit reminders.'
plugins.descZh: 插件价值裁判：装前审核（源码静态扫描 + LLM 裁判）与装后审计已装插件，模型切换时弹窗提醒复核；判断插件对当前模型是增强还是压制。

plugins.name: liuyuelintop/dsh-conversation-exporter
plugins.descEn: Export the current DSH conversation, or selected turns, as clean readable Markdown.
plugins.descZh: 将当前 DSH 对话或选定轮次导出为干净、易读的 Markdown。

plugins.name: kelearns/dsh-navigation-bar
plugins.descEn: 'Piano-key in-conversation navigation for the Web UI: one key per user message with hover ladder, message-preview tooltip, and active-message highlight; click to smooth-scroll.'
plugins.descZh: 钢琴键风格会话内导航条：一根键锚定一条用户消息，悬停显示消息预览气泡与阶梯展开，点击平滑跳转。

plugins.name: Nwflower/dsh-file-claim
plugins.descEn: File claim/release protection for parallel DSH sessions on the same workspace (heartbeat stale takeover, pending 3-way merge area).
plugins.descZh: 同一工作区并行多会话的文件认领与写入保护（claim/release、心跳 stale 接管、pending 三路合并）。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/dsh-repo-setup
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.'
plugins.descZh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

plugins.name: skr311/dsh-codex-pet#dsh-codex-pet
plugins.descEn: Import Codex-style sprite-sheet pets and render them as a floating shell.overlay with a pet library, interactions, and agent-state linkage.
plugins.descZh: 导入/上传 Codex 风格精灵图序列帧宠物，在 DSH Web GUI 以悬浮浮层渲染，含图库管理、交互与 Agent 状态联动。

plugins.name: Isanti2016/dsh-quicksight
plugins.descEn: 'Two-tier image reading for text-only models: fast local OCR (RapidOCR, offline) first, vision-model fallback (modlens).'
plugins.descZh: 纯文本模型双层识图：优先本地快速 OCR（RapidOCR，离线），不足时回落视觉模型（modlens）。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-flomo
plugins.descEn: Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.
plugins.descZh: 配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

plugins.name: AikenFra/dsh-alive
plugins.descEn: 'Zero-token online status indicator for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: an always-visible online/offline dot in the conversation header, auto-refreshed every 15 seconds with no LLM calls.'
plugins.descZh: 零 token 在线状态指示器：会话头部常驻显示 ● 在线 / ● 离线 状态点，每 15 秒自动检测一次，不调用任何 LLM。

plugins.name: yzke/dsh-icon-theme
plugins.descEn: Automatic and user-customizable Fluent-style icons for DSH Settings and sidebar actions, with offline SVG packs and original-icon preservation.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH 设置和侧边栏自动分配并支持自定义的 Fluent 风格图标，离线内置 SVG，默认保留插件原图标。

plugins.name: Co-Engram/Co-Engram#dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Self-evolving team memory as plain Markdown in git: a native Cordis plugin that registers 38 bare-name memory tools plus a prompt-signals section re-evaluated at every assembly, with RPE reinforcement, decay and sleep consolidation; shares one data repo with its Claude Code (MCP) and OpenClaw hosts; verified against DSH 0.1.0-rc.6.'
plugins.descZh: 自进化团队记忆，以纯 Markdown 存于 Git：原生 Cordis 插件注册 38 个裸名记忆工具，并按每次组装动态注入 prompt-signals 段；含 RPE 强化、衰减与睡眠巩固；与 Claude Code（MCP）、OpenClaw 宿主共享同一数据仓；已对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 实测。

plugins.name: Isilsolme/dsh-splash-launcher
plugins.descEn: Windows one-click launcher with a borderless WPF startup animation (stroke-by-stroke HARNESS lettering) that starts dsh web in the background and fades into the GUI once ready, plus a desktop_launch tool.
plugins.descZh: Windows 一键启动器：无边框 WPF 启动动画（HARNESS 逐笔描边），后台拉起 dsh web 并在 GUI 就绪后淡入，附 desktop_launch 工具。

plugins.name: zhengjy01/dsh-notion-connector
plugins.descEn: 'Notion connector for DeepSeek Harness: search, read, query, create, update, and append Notion pages and databases via six agent tools, with a Web settings page — configured once with an Integration Token.'
plugins.descZh: 配置一次 Notion Integration Token，Agent 即可搜索、读取、查询、创建、更新、追加 Notion 页面与数据库内容，并提供 Web 设置页。

plugins.name: SeverusZh/dsh-plugin-subagent-director
plugins.descEn: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
plugins.descZh: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

plugins.name: iamfromchangsha/dsh-go-balance
plugins.descEn: 'OpenCode Go balance pill at the right end of the composer tool row: rolling/weekly/monthly quota remaining straight from the Zen usage endpoint, with hover detail and warn/danger coloring.'
plugins.descZh: 输入框工具行右侧的 OpenCode Go 余额胶囊：滚动/每周/每月配额剩余百分比（数据直接来自 Zen 用量接口），悬停查看明细，低余额自动变黄/变红。

plugins.name: Elohia/dsh-plugin-image-input
plugins.descEn: 'Image-to-text input for the Web UI: paste or drag an image and it is transcribed into structured text and sent, giving text-only LLMs image-input takeover (OpenAI-compatible vision API).'
plugins.descZh: 图片转文字输入插件：粘贴/拖拽图片自动转为结构化文字描述发送，给纯文本 LLM 提供图片输入接管（OpenAI 兼容视觉 API）。

plugins.name: zhangzhenwen1/qmd-autosearch
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-supplement QMD semantic search when the model greps/globs a knowledge-base directory: zero-dependency DSH plugin, async injection via next-step, no manual invocation.'
plugins.descZh: 模型在知识库目录执行 grep/glob 搜索时自动补充 QMD 语义检索：零依赖 DSH 插件，异步注入下一步上下文，无需手动调用。

plugins.name: 01Virex/dsh-status-rotator
plugins.descEn: 'Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live placeholders and tab-title rotation. Two star packs ship disabled by default; the stargazer pack carries one phrase per stargazer, refreshed weekly by a workflow.'
plugins.descZh: '把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。'

plugins.name: SPYQWER1/dsh-codex-tools
plugins.descEn: Codex-backed `web_search`, `image_gen`, and `image_vision` tools for DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT OAuth login state.
plugins.descZh: 基于 Codex 的 `web_search`、`image_gen` 与 `image_vision` 工具，复用 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索、生图与识图能力。

plugins.name: fredalxin/dsh-solo-thinking
plugins.descEn: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a full tree tab with an optional Better Sidebar view.
plugins.descZh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-test-drive
plugins.descEn: Runs isolated install-and-smoke test drives for DSH plugins in throwaway profiles, returning structured pass/fail records and batch matrices without touching your real profile.
plugins.descZh: 在一次性隔离配置中为 DSH 插件执行安装与冒烟测试，返回结构化的通过/失败记录与批量矩阵，不触碰真实配置。

plugins.name: SoDaZilla-zzz/dsh-liquid-glass-balance-card
plugins.descEn: 'Draggable 3D liquid-glass floating card for the DSH web GUI: DeepSeek API balance, cumulative spend/token stats (today/yesterday/7d/30d/all), adjustable glass/3D/color controls, and one-click top-up.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 网页右上角可拖动 3D 液态玻璃余额卡片：显示 DeepSeek API 余额、累计消费与 Token 统计（今天/昨天/近7天/近30天/全部），玻璃参数/3D 厚度/颜色均可调，内置官方充值入口。

plugins.name: GooodWei/context-vista
plugins.descEn: A right-side floating panel and /context command for DeepSeek Harness — a live donut chart of context token usage, allocation, and estimated cost.
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供右侧悬浮栏以及 /context 命令，用环形图实时展示当前上下文 token 用量与分配及消费估算。

plugins.name: opencues/opencues#integrations-dsh
plugins.descEn: Word alternatives and underscore-gated fill-ins in the composer. End a line with _ and it is filled; misspellings are flagged as you type. Routes through the model dsh is already configured with, so it needs no API key.
plugins.descZh: 在输入框内提供同义词替换与以下划线触发的补全：一行以 _ 结尾即自动补全，拼写错误在输入时即时标出。它走 dsh 已配置好的模型，因此无需额外的 API key。

plugins.name: linhut/gongwen-skill
plugins.descEn: 'Chinese government document processing toolkit: GB/T 9704 format check, auto-fix, content revision (red annotation + strikethrough), template generation, Markdown-to-docx, and document header/footer/page-number injection for 24 official document types.'
plugins.descZh: 中文公文全流程处理工具：GB/T 9704 格式检查、自动修复、内容修订（红色标注+删除线）、模板生成、Markdown 转公文、版头/版记/页码注入，覆盖通知/请示/报告/函/会议纪要等 24 类公文。

plugins.name: ruby1304/dsh-vision-subagent
plugins.descEn: 'Vision for any DSH route: paste images in the Web composer with intent-aware auto-analysis, delegate workspace image reads to a Kimi/MiniMax vision subagent, and materialize pasted originals for editing.'
plugins.descZh: '为任意 DSH 路由装上眼睛：Web 输入框贴图按意图自动聚焦分析，视觉子代理代读工作区图片，原图可随时物化编辑。'

plugins.name: Stylelinzzz/dsh-chat-history
plugins.descEn: Adds a "History" conversation view tab listing the session's user messages as a clickable directory, with auto-paging and click-to-jump back into the chat.
plugins.descZh: 在会话头部新增「目录」tab：把当前会话的用户消息整理成可点击的目录，自动翻页加载全部历史，点击即跳回对话并定位。

plugins.name: 2nd1st/dsh-plugin-open-app
plugins.descEn: 'Runs open-mcp-apps inside DSH: every MCP app gets its own sidebar container with a separate workspace, session, and App mode, an agent status strip under the app, and inline app rendering in ordinary chats.'
plugins.descZh: 把 open-mcp-apps 接进 DSH：每个 MCP app 都是侧边栏里自己的容器，带独立 workspace、会话与 App mode，应用下方是 agent 状态条，普通聊天里也能行内渲染 app。

plugins.name: STARDUSTLC666/dsh-dingtalk
plugins.descEn: DingTalk group-robot notifications (notify/text/health; webhook + HMAC signing, zero runtime dependencies).
plugins.descZh: 钉钉群机器人通知：dingtalk_notify/text/health 三工具，webhook + HMAC 加签，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: jilian-dsh/dsh-rule-engine
plugins.descEn: 'Rules execution engine for dsh: parses AGENTS.md, hard-blocks rule-violating tool calls, text-based B/D rule auditing, /guard command, version-guard for versioned files, and free-zone support (engine skips free-zone sections).'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh 规则执行引擎：解析 AGENTS.md、硬拦违反规则的工具调用、文本纠察与审计、/guard 命令、版本化文件守卫、自由区域支持（引擎跳过自由区内容）。'

plugins.name: lifeodyssey/dsh-compressor#dsh-compressor
plugins.descEn: 'A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model''s context cache or agent performance.'
plugins.descZh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

plugins.name: Mobai-read/dsh-chat-index-rail
plugins.descEn: 'Client-only right-edge chat input index rail: one bar per user message, two-stage hover preview (15 chars, expandable to 40), click-to-jump, and scroll-follow highlight; static npm bundle with no host half.'
plugins.descZh: 纯客户端对话输入目录条：每条用户消息一根横条，两级悬停预览（15 字，移入气泡展开 40 字）、点击跳转、滚动跟随高亮；静态 npm 包，无宿主半。

plugins.name: zp-home/dsh-recommend
plugins.descEn: 'Transparent rankings and recommendations for the DSH plugin ecosystem: daily auto-fetched topic data, an open scoring model, and rank/search/recommend tools with a settings-page leaderboard.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 插件透明排行与推荐：每日自动抓取 `dsh-plugin` 话题生态，公开评分模型，提供 rank/search/recommend 工具与设置页榜单。

plugins.name: ttmouse/dsh-dingtalk-channel
plugins.descEn: 'DingTalk IM channel via Stream-mode WebSocket: each chat drives its own tooled agent; replies stream back as messages, no public callback URL needed.'
plugins.descZh: 钉钉 IM 双向 channel（Stream 模式）：每条单聊/群聊驱动一个 agent，思考与回复通过 WebSocket 长连接回流消息，免公网回调。

plugins.name: TonyDua/dsh-web-search-exa
plugins.descEn: 'Zero-config Exa web search provider for the ctx.web seam: anonymous MCP fallback without an API key, plus keyed REST search.'
plugins.descZh: ctx.web 接缝的零配置 Exa 网页搜索提供方：无 API key 时走匿名 MCP 兜底，配 key 时走 REST 搜索。

plugins.name: Zhangbo-cn/dsh-voice-input-plugin
plugins.descEn: "Composer mic for the Web UI: tap-to-monitor live transcription and hold-to-talk, with host Edge TTS reply reading that streams while the model generates, echo-pause during reading, and tap-to-stop."
plugins.descZh: "输入框麦克风：点击持续监控、按住对话；浏览器语音识别逐字上屏，回复由 host Edge TTS 边生成边朗读，朗读时暂停识别防回声，点击可停止。"

plugins.name: mux9056-bot/dsh-theme
plugins.descEn: 'Theme pack for the DSH Web UI: 30 drop-in CSS themes with light and dark variants, integrated into Settings → General with a programmatic API.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web UI 主题包：30 款即插即用的 CSS 主题，每款含浅色与深色变体，集成于「设置 → 通用」，并提供程序化 API。'

plugins.name: LyaxZ/dsh-quick-toc
plugins.descEn: 'Conversation outline for DeepSeek Harness: whole-session Markdown headings grouped by turn, in a side panel or a full-width curtain; hover previews that pin for side-by-side comparison; title, prompt, full-text and cross-session search with the recent queries kept; multiple jump actions, reading-position follow, adjustable outline density, and a Chinese/English interface; settings one click from the panel toolbar.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 对话大纲：按回合整理整段会话的 Markdown 标题，侧边面板与全屏幕布两种视图；悬停预览可钉住对照；标题、提问、全文与跨会话四档检索，并保留最近搜索过的词；多种跳转、阅读位置跟随、可调大纲密度与中英双语界面；设置卡片从顶栏按钮直达。'

plugins.name: NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-auto-vision
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.'
plugins.descZh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

plugins.name: xxiaoxiong/dsh-prometheus
plugins.descEn: Exposes bounded Prometheus metrics for DSH sessions, agents, LLM calls, tools, approvals, subagents, and jobs, with a Grafana dashboard and a loopback-only endpoint by default.
plugins.descZh: 导出有界的 DSH Session、Agent、LLM、Tool、Approval、Subagent 与 Job Prometheus 指标，附带 Grafana 仪表盘，Endpoint 默认仅监听回环地址。

plugins.name: NormanFxxkingRockwell/dsh-keyboard-history
plugins.descEn: 'Minimal ↑/↓ input history for the DSH web composer: press ↑/↓ to walk back through sent messages. Nothing else.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 会话输入框的极简输入历史：按 ↑/↓ 翻阅发过的消息。只有方向键，别无其他。'

plugins.name: PandaPolo/dsh-voice-call
plugins.descEn: 'Agent-initiated voice calls: `offer_call` rings the human (接听/拒接/稍后再说); accepted calls synthesize and play locally via CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS (9 speakers, 2 Chinese dialects), rejected calls return the decision to the agent.'
plugins.descZh: agent 主动打来的语音电话：`offer_call` 向人类振铃（接听/拒接/稍后再说），接听后由本地 CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS 合成并播放（9 个音色，含 2 个中文方言）；拒接则把决定返回给 agent。

plugins.name: Little-Star888/dsh-pelican
plugins.descEn: 'A pelican riding a bicycle along a seashore in the bottom-right corner: an SVG animation that reflects the agent working state (thinking/done), with a chime and an optional system notification when a reply finishes.'
plugins.descZh: '右下角鹈鹕环海骑行 SVG 动画，随代理状态在思考/完成间切换，回复完成时播放提示音并可选发送系统通知。'

plugins.name: jiezeng2004-design/dsh-chatgpt-bridge
plugins.descEn: MCP bridge that lets ChatGPT Web create, view, continue, and supervise DeepSeek Harness agent sessions and goals while preserving DSH's native approval, sandbox, and workspace security model.
plugins.descZh: 通过 MCP 让 ChatGPT Web 创建、查看、继续和监督 DeepSeek Harness Agent 会话与 Goal，同时保留 DSH 原生的审批、沙箱与工作区安全模型。

plugins.name: zhijun-dai/Solarized-dsh-theme
plugins.descEn: 'Solarized theme plugin: the classic low-contrast, eye-friendly dual palette system — Ethan Schoonover''s Solarized plus Selenized (its refined take), dark and light each, built for long sessions with canonical syntax colors.'
plugins.descZh: Solarized 主题插件：经典低对比护眼配色双体系——Ethan Schoonover 的 Solarized 与 Selenized（改良版）深浅各一套，专为长时间使用设计，遵循经典语法色。

plugins.name: CheshireJCat/blender
plugins.descEn: Blender 3D production plugin with 30 modeling/reconstruction skills, 13 runtime tools, and 26 deterministic helpers for reference fitting, rendering, validation, animation, and portable export; installable as `dsh-blender`.
plugins.descZh: Blender 3D 生产插件：提供 30 个建模/重建 Skill、13 个运行时工具和 26 个确定性 Helper，覆盖参考图拟合、渲染、验证、动画与可移植格式导出；npm 包名 `dsh-blender`。

plugins.name: yabolee-kkk/dsh-streaming-mcp-bridge
plugins.descEn: 'DeepSeek Harness streaming MCP bridge: live session events as MCP progress, plus ACP adapter for cc-connect/Feishu.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 流式 MCP 桥接：将实时会话事件作为 MCP 进度输出，并提供 cc-connect/飞书 ACP 适配器。

plugins.name: apheli0os/deepseek-harness-orchestrate
plugins.descEn: 'Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and propagates failures deterministically.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

plugins.name: WilliamShi666/dsh-wsl-workspace-picker
plugins.descEn: 'Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

plugins.name: Johnny-xuan/dsh-paste-to-path
plugins.descEn: 'A lightweight, general-purpose attachment Dock for DSH: paste, drop, or choose images, PDFs, documents, archives, code, and other files, review and manage them before sending, then pass them to the Agent as local paths. It gives non-image files a consistent attachment entry point.'
plugins.descZh: 一个轻量、通用的 DSH 附件 Dock：支持粘贴、拖入或选择图片、PDF、文档、压缩包、代码等文件，发送前统一查看和管理，再以本地路径交给 Agent；解决非图片文件缺少统一附件入口的问题。

plugins.name: hongyue0721/dsh-kimicode-swarm
plugins.descEn: 'Kimi-Code-style swarm: batch-parallel subagent dispatch with adaptive scheduling, a /swarm command, and in-chat live progress rows.'
plugins.descZh: Kimi Code 风格 swarm：批量并行子 Agent 调度（自适应并发）、/swarm 命令与聊天内实时进度条。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-academic-writing
plugins.descEn: 'Academic writing toolkit for DSH agents: paper outlines, title and abstract skeletons, GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA citations, phrasing QA, and a pre-submission checklist.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH agent 提供学术写作工具包：论文大纲、标题与摘要骨架、GB/T 7714 / APA / MLA 引文格式化、措辞质检与投稿前清单。

plugins.name: eric-song-dev/dsh-ikun-pet
plugins.descEn: 'An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.'
plugins.descZh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

plugins.name: miiaowuwu/dsh-sound-lab
plugins.descEn: 'Event sounds for DSH: plays a chosen sound on session end, options popup, permission request and stop, with AI-generated character voice lines and a manageable sound library.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 声音工坊：在会话结束、弹出选项、请求许可与停止时播放指定音效，支持 AI 角色语音生成与音效库管理。'

plugins.name: Jiyr0119/dsh-service-console
plugins.descEn: 'Local development service console for DSH: lists every listening service on the machine and lets users inspect, safely stop, or restart services that were started during development.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 本地开发服务控制台：列出本机所有监听服务，并让用户查看、以安全方式停止或重启开发过程中启动的服务。'

plugins.name: 030611/dsh-telemetry-redactor
plugins.descEn: Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.
plugins.descZh: 在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

plugins.name: Mombrane/dsh-subagent-monitor
plugins.descEn: 'Live subagent run monitor for the Web UI: a sidebar footer trigger plus a fixed top-right card panel showing each subagent of the current session in real time (running/elapsed, terminal outcomes, tree indent), with one-click jump into the child conversation and a return button, refresh-surviving and mobile-hidden by default.'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 子代理实时监视面板：侧边栏底部入口 + 右上角常驻卡片面板，实时展示当前会话每个子代理的运行状态（运行中/耗时/终态）、树形缩进，一键跳转子代理会话并支持返回主会话，刷新自恢复、移动端默认隐藏。

plugins.name: mrpulor-gh/dsh-nuphus-mcp
plugins.descEn: 'Official DSH plugin for nuphus-mcp (by the nuphus-mcp maintainers): desktop and browser automation (38 tools) with PaddleOCR element perception and Chrome CDP browsing, via a persistent stdio MCP child process.'
plugins.descZh: nuphus-mcp 官方 DSH 插件（由 nuphus-mcp 维护者发布）：桌面 + 浏览器自动化（38 个工具），配 PaddleOCR 元素感知与 Chrome CDP 浏览，经常驻 stdio MCP 子进程接入。

plugins.name: Ri0n72Y/dsh-workspace-scope
plugins.descEn: 'Per-workspace Skill and MCP enablement for DeepSeek Harness: control which skills and MCP servers new sessions load, per project.'
plugins.descZh: 按工作区（工程）启停 Skill 与 MCP：每个项目单独控制新会话加载哪些技能与 MCP 工具。

plugins.name: Lhy723/dsh-agent-canvas
plugins.descEn: Interactive canvas for visualizing Agent, Subagent, Workflow, Phase, and tool relationships in DSH Web.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 提供可交互画布，用于展示 Agent、Subagent、Workflow、Phase 与工具调用之间的关系。

plugins.name: zhaoolee/notes#dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: Export DSH conversations as Smartisan Notes-style PNGs, or create and update Markdown notes in a configured account-scoped workspace.
plugins.descZh: 将 DSH 对话导出为锤子便签风格 PNG，或在配置的账号工作区中新建和更新 Markdown 便签。

plugins.name: Shiye-10Pages/dsh-whale-meter
plugins.descEn: 'Usage tiers and shareable stats cards: 🐟→🐳 ranks by monthly token burn with a locally-computed estimated percentile, precise pricing for 46 models across 6 vendors (including size-tiered Chinese pricing), backfill of pre-install sessions, and old-vs-new comparison across the 2026-08-17 rate change. Local-only, no telemetry.'
plugins.descZh: '用量段位与战绩卡片：按本月 token 消耗评 🐟→🐳 五档段位，分位本地估算（零上报）；6 家厂商 46 个模型精准计价，支持国内厂商按输入长度分档；自动回填安装前的历史会话；8·17 调价前后同一份用量的新旧价对比。数据全在本机，无遥测。'

plugins.name: gezi-wen/sage-mem
plugins.descEn: 'File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code''s CLAUDE.md and memory files, so migrating is a manual file copy.'
plugins.descZh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-poison-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Pre-install supply-chain poison scanner for DSH plugins: AST (JS-X-Ray) + deobfuscation + regex heuristics, exits non-zero on findings for CI gating.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 插件安装前投毒扫描：AST（JS-X-Ray）+ 去混淆解码 + 正则启发式，发现即非零退出，可作 CI 门禁。

plugins.name: anweat/dsh-voice-webspeech
plugins.descEn: 'Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).'
plugins.descZh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-focus
plugins.descEn: 'Focus board for DeepSeek Harness agents: durable, model-maintained notes in the session workspace that pin the objective, constraints, and decisions across compaction and sessions, with automatic context injection, archive on clear, and an optional web panel.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness agent 提供持久化专注板：在会话工作区维护目标、约束与决策笔记，跨压缩与会话存活，支持自动注入上下文、清空归档与可选 Web 面板。

plugins.name: jitengfei/dsh-whale-arcade
plugins.descEn: Floating, browser-local whale arcade with three score games and ocean-themed Gomoku for breaks while waiting on the agent.
plugins.descZh: 浏览器本地运行的悬浮鲸鱼游戏中心，包含三款积分游戏和海洋主题五子棋，适合等待 Agent 时随手游玩。

plugins.name: zylzyqzz/dsh-mobile-pwa
plugins.descEn: 'Complete mobile PWA for DSH, built on dsh-mobile-gate: secure remote-access gateway plus install-to-homescreen (manifest + service worker), offline capability, touch gestures (pull-to-refresh, edge-swipe back, pinch-zoom font), agent-done push notifications, and touch-first layout — desktop unaffected.'
plugins.descZh: 基于 dsh-mobile-gate 的完整移动端 PWA：安全远程访问网关 + 可安装到主屏（manifest + service worker）+ 离线可用 + 触屏手势（下拉刷新/边缘返弹/捏合缩放字体）+ agent 完成推送 + 触屏优先布局，桌面零影响。

plugins.name: DietCokewithSugar/dsh-user-experience
plugins.descEn: 'Finds potential UX issues in your project: automatically reviews React/TypeScript code, pinpoints each problem, and gives concrete suggestions.'
plugins.descZh: 帮你发现项目中可能存在的用户体验问题：自动走查 React/TypeScript 源码，定位问题并给出具体优化建议。

plugins.name: TZHR-invest/dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search-metaso
plugins.descEn: 'Metaso (秘塔AI搜索) search & reader providers for the web seam: web_search returns page summaries, web_fetch reads full-page markdown, multi-scope search (webpage/document/paper/image/video/podcast).'
plugins.descZh: 秘塔AI搜索 providers for ctx.web：web_search 返回网页摘要，web_fetch 读取网页全文 markdown，多范围搜索（网页/文库/论文/图片/视频/播客）。

plugins.name: jiangli07/dsh-deepseek-quota-bar
plugins.descEn: Draggable transparent balance card with a blood-bar of remaining balance vs month-opening, today/month spend (official when the platform token is configured), and session cost.
plugins.descZh: 可拖动透明余额卡片：余额/月初额度血条、今日/本月用量（配置平台 token 后为官方精确数据）、当前对话费用。

plugins.name: Letter2025/dsh-tool-search
plugins.descEn: 'Hermes-style tool search & slimming: progressive disclosure, semantic search, describe, and call long-tail tools on demand while core tools stay eager.'
plugins.descZh: Hermes 风格工具搜索与瘦身：渐进式披露，语义搜索/查看/调用长尾工具，核心工具保持直通。

plugins.name: yugasun/dsh-plugins#dsh-web-search
plugins.descEn: Registers Baidu, Doubao, Tavily, and Exa backends into ctx.web so official web_search can use them, and routes web_fetch through Tavily Extract or Exa Contents when that backend is active.
plugins.descZh: 向 ctx.web 注册百度、豆包、Tavily、Exa 后端供官方 web_search 使用，并在 Tavily 或 Exa 生效时将 web_fetch 转到对应提取接口。

plugins.name: 030611/dsh-verification-receipt
plugins.descEn: Writes local JSONL summaries of per-turn tool counts and coarse verification signals without storing prompts, tool arguments, or result text.
plugins.descZh: 把每轮工具计数与粗粒度验证信号写入本地 JSONL，不保存提示词、工具参数或结果正文。

plugins.name: MicroHEROX/dsh-exa-mcp
plugins.descEn: 'Mounts the hosted Exa search MCP endpoint (https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp) through the in-box @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client bridge: web_search_exa and web_fetch_exa tools, anonymous on the free tier or with your own EXA_API_KEY.'
plugins.descZh: 通过内置的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接接入托管的 Exa 搜索 MCP 端点（mcp.exa.ai）：web_search_exa 与 web_fetch_exa 工具，免费额度匿名可用，设置 EXA_API_KEY 可解锁更高限额。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-finance-data
plugins.descEn: 'Finance data toolkit for DSH agents: number and currency formatting (incl. Chinese wan/yi units), return and CAGR math, valuation and profitability ratios, PV/FV, risk metrics, and a data-quality checklist.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH agent 提供金融数据工具包：数字与货币格式化（含中文万/亿单位）、收益与年化计算、估值与盈利比率、现值/终值、风险指标与数据质量清单。

plugins.name: cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit
plugins.descEn: 'DIT.ai provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness: installs 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models from one DIT_API_KEY, with protocol-specific thinking configuration.'
plugins.descZh: 'DIT.ai 的 DeepSeek Harness 模型接入 bundle：使用一个 DIT_API_KEY 安装 29 个 OpenAI Chat Completions 模型和 10 个 Anthropic Messages 模型，并按协议配置 thinking。'

plugins.name: AbnerAI/dsh-monitor
plugins.descEn: Persistent background watchers that wake the agent on new messages (file inbox or command-output delta) — the harness analog of Claude Code's Monitor tool.
plugins.descZh: 常驻后台监视器：文件收件箱（NDJSON）或命令输出增量一到就唤醒 agent，相当于 Claude Code Monitor 工具的 Harness 实现。

plugins.name: pengzhou267-ai/dsh-shop-assistant
plugins.descEn: 'Ecommerce operator workbench: CSV batch preview with marketplace column adapters, reproducible profit/six-dimension scoring, public product-page snapshots, Chinese skills, and a replaceable store-policy KB.'
plugins.descZh: 电商店主工作台：CSV 批量预览（多平台列适配）、可复算利润与六维评分、公开商品页快照、中文 skills、可替换售后政策知识库。

plugins.name: JAdpp/dsh-whale-galgame
plugins.descEn: Multi-character Galgame conversation view with separate character and reply-model selection, per-character affection, memory, dialogue history, and CG galleries, plus responses informed by task events across Harness sessions.
plugins.descZh: 多角色 Galgame 对话界面：角色与回复模型可独立切换，分角色保存好感度、记忆、对话历史与 CG 图鉴，并根据 Harness 跨会话任务事件做出角色回应。

plugins.name: superagents-lab/dsh-s1
plugins.descEn: 'Native Search1API (s1) web research tools: search, news, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and trending topics as first-class `s1_*` tools, with a bundled s1 skill.'
plugins.descZh: Search1API（s1）原生联网检索工具：网页搜索、新闻、页面抓取、站点地图与趋势榜，以 `s1_*` 一等工具形式提供，并附带 s1 技能。

plugins.name: AngelosZou/dsh-python-env
plugins.descEn: 'Wraps Python virtual environment management commands: reduces the network and permission problems agents hit when managing environments through terminal commands, works across operating systems, and routes installs automatically through mirrors and local proxies. The tools are strictly confined by the granted read/write permissions.'
plugins.descZh: '封装了Python虚拟环境管理指令，减少Agent使用终端指令管理环境时遇到的网络问题和权限问题，兼容不同操作系统，工具内部设置自动网络与镜像路由。工具严格受给定读写权限限制。'

plugins.name: xiaweiliang060035/dsh-opencode-go-usage
plugins.descEn: Floating widget showing real-time OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly) for every API key, with rate-limit alerts and automatic key-pool discovery.

plugins.descEn: 'Vision toolkit for text-only DeepSeek: model-invokable `vision` tool, wrapper adapters for deepseek/opencode-go (v4 flash/pro), Antigravity IDE quota (default, flash/pro) / any OpenAI-compatible VLM / Gemini / local Ollama channels, evidence memory with compaction rehydration, content-hash cache, and a bilingual client panel.'

plugins.name: xczhanjun/lazeword

plugins.name: Darren-Tang/dsh-provenance
plugins.descEn: 'Pre-install supply-chain checks for DeepSeek Harness plugins: verify the tarball you are about to install matches the source you read, before any code runs.'

plugins.name: starslittle/dsh-queue-plus
plugins.descEn: A simple DSH queue panel for editing, removing, steering, reordering, and bulk removal.
plugins.descZh: DSH 排队消息增强面板，支持编辑、删除、插话、排序和批量删除。

plugins.name: PicGo/dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: Upload local images and files to your image host through PicGo's existing configuration (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, COS, Qiniu, or any installed uploader plugin), via a `picgo_upload` tool and a `/picgo` command.
plugins.descZh: 通过 PicGo 已有配置（PicGo Cloud、GitHub、S3、腾讯云 COS、七牛，或任意已安装的上传插件）把本地图片和文件上传到图床，提供 `picgo_upload` 工具与 `/picgo` 命令。

plugins.name: SaiSenBox/dsh-prompt-manager
plugins.descEn: Browser-local prompt library with a composer picker for injecting multiple session-scoped system prompts, branch inheritance, bilingual UI, favorites, and JSON backups.
plugins.descZh: 浏览器本地提示词库：在输入框选择器中同时注入多条会话级系统提示词，支持分支继承、中英界面、收藏与 JSON 备份。

plugins.name: Shiye-10Pages/dsh-memory-porter
plugins.descEn: 'Brings your existing Claude / ChatGPT history into DSH: instant zero-token import of the memories.json inside a Claude export, local Claude Code transcripts with no export needed, and conversations distilled through the model you already configured in DSH. Every memory carries verbatim evidence checked against the source by code — a paraphrase is dropped and counted, and evidence found only in the assistant turns is always routed to review rather than stored.'
plugins.descZh: '把你在 Claude / ChatGPT 里已有的历史搬进 DSH：Claude 导出包里的 memories.json 零 token 瞬时入库，本机 Claude Code 记录免导出直读，历史对话用你在 DSH 里已配好的模型提纯。每条记忆都带由代码回原文核对的逐字证据——转述会被丢弃并计数，只在 AI 回复里找到的证据一律转人工确认而非直接入库。'

plugins.name: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-recall
plugins.descEn: 'Cross-session memory for the model: full-text search all past sessions (SQLite FTS5 via ctx.sessionQuery) and bring the strongest matching excerpts back into the current context.'
plugins.descZh: 跨会话记忆：全文检索所有历史会话（复用 ctx.sessionQuery 的 SQLite FTS5 索引），把最强匹配片段带回当前上下文。

plugins.name: kaziii/dsh-github-connector#github
plugins.descEn: 'GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search, issue and PR read and write.'
plugins.descZh: 'GitHub Device Flow 授权与对话内 PR 工作流：输入框上方的状态条支持创建 / AI 审查 / 合并 PR，另有 github_* 工具用于搜索、Issue 与 PR 读写。'

plugins.name: SodaMem/dsh-plugin-sodamem
plugins.descEn: 'Bi-temporal memory backed by a SodaMem daemon: recall is contributed to the prompt while each turn is assembled and every closed turn is ingested, with no tool call and no model call on the read path; each recalled fact cites the turn it came from and carries validity dates, so superseded facts stop being retrieved.'
plugins.descZh: '基于 SodaMem 守护进程的双时间轴记忆：每轮组装提示词时注入检索结果，回合结束后自动写回，读路径不经工具调用也不额外调用模型；每条召回的事实都标注来源回合并带有效期，失效的事实不再被检索到。'

plugins.name: ZRui-C/dsh-minimal-first-turn
plugins.descEn: 'Minimal-compatible first turn for Web root sessions: starts with persistent bash and str_replace_editor, removes automatic workspace and skill context, then restores the selected preset after the first tool call or reply; includes a persistent composer toggle.'
plugins.descZh: Web 根会话的首轮精简：先使用持久 bash 与 str_replace_editor，移除自动工作区和技能上下文；首次工具调用或回复后恢复所选预设，带持久 composer 开关。

plugins.name: HB00/dsh-llm-failover
plugins.descEn: 'Automatic provider failover on rate limits or quota exhaustion: switch between providers with configurable per-provider models, a cooldown, and a permanent last-entry fallback.'
plugins.descZh: 限流或配额耗尽时自动切换模型提供方：可按提供方配置模型，带冷却机制与永久最终兜底。

plugins.name: ljr282341583/dsh-convo-cost
plugins.descEn: 'Real-time cost tracking for the current DSH conversation: a composer-dock line showing the running token usage and DeepSeek official price estimate (base and peak/valley pricing).'
plugins.descZh: '当前对话实时费用统计：输入框下方一行显示运行中的 token 用量与 DeepSeek 官方价格估算（基础价与峰谷价）。'

plugins.name: SnowAmberX/dsh-role-router
plugins.descEn: Routes agent requests to configurable default, planner, and subagent models, automatically using the planner role in plan mode, with per-role reasoning effort and Web UI configuration.
plugins.descZh: 按 default、planner 和 subagent 角色将代理请求路由到可配置模型，在计划模式下自动使用 planner，并提供逐角色推理强度与 Web UI 配置。

plugins.name: AngLi1997/dsh-plugin-sync
plugins.descEn: Sync the installed DeepSeek Harness plugin manifest to a GitHub Gist (OAuth login, one-click export/import with automatic dependency install).
plugins.descZh: 将已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 插件清单同步到 GitHub Gist（OAuth 登录、一键导出/导入并自动安装依赖）。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-observe
plugins.descEn: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
plugins.descZh: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

plugins.name: nonentity303/dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Plugin manager with a rescue center: grouped enable/disable by necessity, multi update sources (npm / dshfind market / GitHub), browser-first downloads with an auto-install folder, P2P fallback, pre-boot self-check and broken-bundle quarantine.'
plugins.descZh: '插件管理器与救砖中心：按必要程度分组启停、多更新源（npm / 插件超市 / GitHub）、浏览器下载优先与目录自动安装、P2P 兜底、启动前自检与坏包隔离。'

plugins.name: ilharp/dsh-tool-approval

plugins.descZh: 手动审批模式（Manual/Ask Mode）。

plugins.name: gongyijie85/mattpocock-skills-dsh-zh

plugins.name: yushi-xxh/dsh-homepage-skin
plugins.descEn: 'Adds the DeepSeek Harness homepage background to dsh web: WebGL fluid light, dot-line grid and a digital point-cloud whale, with dark and light palettes.'

plugins.name: jeremy9682/dsh-skill-pack

plugins.name: xulelenlp/dsh-web-artifact-designer

plugins.name: ReachGa0/dsh-desktop#plugin
plugins.descEn: 'DSH plugin (dsh-desktop-launcher) that launches the dsh-desktop Windows Electron shell from the conversation: double-click to run the DSH web in a standalone window, region screenshot with GPU-accelerated selection that auto-pastes into the chat (works with vision bridges), system tray, session manager, auto environment setup, configurable port, single-instance lock.'
plugins.descZh: dsh 插件（dsh-desktop-launcher）：在对话中一键启动 dsh-desktop Windows Electron 桌面壳——双击即用、无需终端；支持选区截图提问（GPU 实时框选、自动粘贴到聊天框、配合识图插件 AI 直接看图回答）、系统托盘、会话管理、环境自动引导、可换端口、单实例锁。

plugins.name: sunshaobei/dsh-session-review
plugins.descEn: 'A strip above the composer listing files modified in the current session (collapsed by default), with a Review button opening a per-session change panel showing before/after hunks from the session''s own edit/write tool results, no git required.'
plugins.descZh: '输入框上方的条带列出当前会话修改过的文件（默认折叠），Review 按钮打开会话变更面板，基于会话自身的 edit/write 工具结果展示前后差异块，无需 git。'

plugins.name: ddbj-hub/dsh-wallpaper-skin
plugins.descEn: 'Persistent wallpaper skin for the dsh web profile: static image or muted looping video as the app background, with translucent panels and a floating picker panel.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh Web 界面的持久化壁纸皮肤：静态图片或静音循环视频作为应用背景，面板半透明化，右下角悬浮面板一键换壁纸。'

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-translation
plugins.descEn: 'Translation toolkit for DSH agents: sentence segmentation, term and glossary extraction, source-target QA (numbers, units, brackets), tone guides, and a durable workspace translation memory.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH agent 提供翻译工具包：句子分块、术语与术语表提取、译文质检（数字、单位、括号）、语气指南与工作区持久化翻译记忆。

plugins.name: agentmail-to/dsh-agentmail
plugins.descEn: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness session per email thread, with an approval gate and recipient allowlist on everything outbound.
plugins.descZh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

plugins.name: Cola1018/dsh-aicc-zhunao
plugins.descEn: 'Main-brain orchestration preset: delegation-first persona, root-session execution gate, and portable AI-LAW rule skill.'
plugins.descZh: '主脑编排 preset：委派优先的 persona、根会话执行门禁，以及可移植的 AI-LAW 规则技能。'

plugins.name: starslittle/dsh-blue-whale
plugins.descEn: A DeepSeek Chat-style blue-whale color skin. Light and dark follow the built-in appearance.
plugins.descZh: 复刻 DeepSeek Chat 蓝鲸配色的皮肤，亮色/深色跟随系统外观。

plugins.name: HuiHuitie-zhu/dsh-incognito
plugins.descEn: 'Incognito sessions: a standalone ephemeral sub-agent with its own preset (no parent context) and full toolset, draggable floating window, burned to zero traces on close.'
plugins.descZh: 无痕会话：独立临时子 Agent（独立 preset 不继承父会话、全量工具集），浮窗可拖动，关闭即焚毁、磁盘零痕迹。

plugins.name: jean3690/dsh-devtoolbox
plugins.descEn: 'Local toolbox for the DSH web GUI: 35 pure-client tools (text, encoding, hashing, extraction, conversion, reference tables) in a sidebar view, plus the /toolbox command and config-driven agent tool exposure.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 本地工具箱：侧边栏独立页面内置 35 个纯本地小工具（文本、编码、哈希、提取、转换、速查表），另有 /toolbox 命令与配置驱动的 agent 工具注册。'

plugins.name: zjsthmjialin/commercial-ui-ux-codex-skill#dsh-commercial-ui-ux
plugins.descEn: 'Registers the commercial-ui-ux skill for DSH: task-aware commercial UI/UX/GUI design, review, repair, and implementation (SaaS, dashboards, admin panels, forms, tables, design systems) with a reference-doc system and quality gates.'
plugins.descZh: 注册 commercial-ui-ux 技能：以任务为中心的商业界面 UI/UX/GUI 设计、审查、修复与实现（SaaS、仪表盘、后台、表单、表格、设计系统），带参考文档体系与质量门禁。

plugins.name: Qing45/dsh-feishu-chat
plugins.descEn: 'Two-way Feishu (Lark) chat bridge for DeepSeek Harness over the official WebSocket long connection: messages route to the bound workspace''s latest session and replies return automatically; bot credentials and workspace routing are configurable from the settings page.'
plugins.descZh: 基于飞书官方 WebSocket 长连接的 DSH 双向聊天桥：消息路由到所选工作区的最新会话并自动回复，可在设置页切换机器人凭证与工作区。

plugins.name: weshopai/weshop-dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: Infinite-canvas e-commerce visual workspace for product photography, virtual try-on, background edits, and video, synced live with the Harness conversation.
plugins.descZh: 电商可视化工作区：在无限画布上完成产品图、虚拟试穿、背景处理与视频生成，并与 Harness 对话实时同步。

plugins.name: PwnKY/dsh-session-link
plugins.descEn: Copy and open `dsh://` session deep links, or paste them into another conversation to inject a bounded, read-only snapshot of the referenced session.
plugins.descZh: 复制、打开 `dsh://` 会话深链，或将其粘贴到另一对话中，注入被引用会话的受限只读快照。

plugins.name: wang-bool/visual-review
plugins.descEn: 'Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH Web 聊天界面内联渲染粘贴/上传的图片，并让纯文本模型“看见”图片：visual_review 工具优先调用任意 OpenAI 兼容多模态 API，未配置时回退本机 Qwen3-VL。'

plugins.name: NormanFxxkingRockwell/harmonyos-dev-mcp-for-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Bridges the harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP server into DSH: HarmonyOS device discovery, build/install/run/uninstall, UI automation (click/input/keys/swipe/screenshot), E2E UI-tree inspection, and log/crash analysis as 18 mcp__harmonyos__* tools.'
plugins.descZh: '把 harmonyos-dev-mcp Python MCP 服务桥接进 DSH：鸿蒙设备发现、构建/安装/运行/卸载、UI 自动化（点击/输入/按键/滑动/截图）、E2E 界面树检查、日志与崩溃分析，共 18 个 mcp__harmonyos__* 工具。'

plugins.name: ZaVang/dsh-diorama
plugins.descEn: 'Character skins with an editable decoration board — Yukino warm daily and occult editorial themes, each with dual character sprites + sticker sheets, drag/resize/rotate coordinate editor, custom asset upload, and shareable diorama packs (assets + layout bundled).'
plugins.descZh: '角色皮肤舞台：雪乃·暖阳日常与隐秘年代志双主题，各带双角色立绘与表情贴纸；可视化装饰看板支持拖动/缩放/旋转/坐标精调/锚定切换/上传素材，装饰包（素材+布局）可导出分享、导入后自动打开看板继续调整。'

plugins.name: jean3690/dsh-drawio
plugins.descEn: 'AI-driven drawio: four agent tools (validate, render to SVG/PNG, edit, template) plus a sidebar live board — zero-dependency mxfile-to-SVG preview, embedded diagrams.net editor with save bridge, and auto-open whenever the agent draws.'
plugins.descZh: 'AI 驱动 drawio：四个画图工具（校验 / 渲染 SVG/PNG / 编辑 / 模板）+ 侧栏实时画板——零依赖 mxfile→SVG 预览、内嵌 diagrams.net 官方编辑器、AI 画图时自动弹出跟随。'

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-local-life
plugins.descEn: 'Local-life toolkit for DSH agents: budget planning, bill splitting, unit-price and discount math, common unit conversions (jin/li/chi, C/F, L/gallon), and trip checklists.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH agent 提供本地生活工具包：预算规划、账单分摊、单价与折扣计算、常用单位换算（斤/里/尺、摄氏/华氏、升/加仑）与出行清单。

plugins.name: Winter-And-You-Gone/dsh-turn-fold
plugins.descEn: "A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live metrics (duration, TTFT, token, tok/s, cache hit) — only the final summary stays visible; customizable leading icons with animated poker cards built in (suit-cycling card animation while running, a deck when collapsed, a fan when expanded), a settings row for the official fold mode, compatible with both new and old DSH versions. Zero intrusion into DSH source."
plugins.descZh: "更好的折叠栏：将工具调用与 Think 段自动折叠为步骤折叠栏，回合结束后整回合收拢为带实时指标（耗时/首字/token/tok/s/缓存命中）的回合折叠栏，只保留最终总结正文；前导图标可自定义，内置动态扑克牌（运行中花色循环卡牌动画、收起牌堆、展开扇形），提供官方折叠方式设置行，适配 DSH 新旧版本。零侵入 DSH 源码。"

plugins.name: jack-ranbo/dsh-wsl-expose
plugins.descEn: 'Expose the DSH Web GUI over IPv6 or IPv4 from WSL2 through a reverse proxy (Lucky): /wan up sets up the socat relay, Windows portproxy, firewall, and trusted-host fence, with a Settings card plus commands to configure the domain and ports.'
plugins.descZh: '从 WSL2 走 IPv6/IPv4 经反向代理（Lucky）把 DSH Web GUI 暴露到公网：/wan up 一键建立 socat 中继、Windows portproxy、防火墙与 trusted-host 白名单；域名与端口可在设置卡片或命令中配置。'

plugins.name: Junkrat9527/dsh-autovision
plugins.descEn: 'Vision for text-only dsh models: paste an image and a configured multimodal model transcribes it to text automatically — transparent twin routing, an agent-callable read-image tool, no built-in keys or relay.'
plugins.descZh: 纯文本 dsh 模型的识图插件：粘贴图片自动由你配置的多模态模型转成文字——透明孪生路由、模型可自主调用识图工具、无内置密钥与中转。

plugins.name: sunshaobei/dsh-file-mention
plugins.descEn: 'Codex-style @file/@folder mentions for the DSH web composer: workspace file/folder picker menu, plain-text colored mention tokens via the platform lexicon scan, and a nested-git-aware file index.'
plugins.descZh: 'Codex 式 @文件/@文件夹提及插件：输入框弹出工作区文件与文件夹选择菜单，通过平台词法扫描插入纯文本着色提及 token，内置嵌套 git 感知的文件索引。'

plugins.name: sunshaobei/dsh-input-history
plugins.descEn: 'Standalone arrow-key input history for the DSH web composer: ↑/↓ recalls sent prompts from one global ring shared across all sessions and workspaces, persisted to localStorage with an overridable cap.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 网页版输入框独立输入历史插件：↑/↓ 上下键即时召回已发送的提示词，所有会话与工作区共享一个全局历史环，localStorage 持久化、容量可配。'

plugins.name: heartleo/hn-cli#hacker-news
plugins.descEn: Hacker News tools for feeds, discussion threads, search, and user profiles.
plugins.descZh: 用于获取 Hacker News 榜单、讨论串、搜索和用户资料的工具。

plugins.name: y2zyyr/dsh-token-usage-sidebar
plugins.descEn: Persistent local token-usage accounting for DSH Web with automatic history discovery and compact provider/model details.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 提供自动发现历史记录的本地持久化 Token 用量统计与紧凑的供应商/模型明细。

plugins.name: nyantused-cpun/folio#plugins/folio-tools
plugins.descEn: 'Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools: 15 schema-validated tools (memory + quality gates) plus an L0 guard of the consulting document-generation engine; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-events for the full session protocol.'
plugins.descZh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-tools：咨询/汇报材料生成引擎的 15 个 DSH 原生工具（记忆面 + 质量门禁）+ L0 守卫；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-events 配套使用。

plugins.name: KIDLi1412/dsh-session-cost
plugins.descEn: Session cost estimate in a status bar at the bottom of the conversation (per-model token pricing, CNY) plus the live DeepSeek account balance via the official balance API.
plugins.descZh: 对话底部的会话费用状态栏：按模型逐条计价估算 Token 费用（CNY），并实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额（官方余额接口）。

plugins.name: x2802490130-prog/dsh-lan-pass
plugins.descEn: 'A LAN password gate for the Web UI: phones and tablets on the same network log in with a shared key and see the same sessions in real time, with a built-in randomUUID polyfill for plain-HTTP origins.'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 局域网密码门禁：同网手机/平板输共享密钥登录，会话与电脑实时同步，内置 randomUUID polyfill。

plugins.name: Einskyle/dsh-llm-vision-bridge
plugins.descEn: 'Native LLM-provider vision bridge: images pasted in the chat are described by a vision model (Qwen3-VL via pi-ai/llama.cpp) and the text description is fed to text-only DeepSeek for the reply — image admission, routing and compaction all run through harness-native mechanisms, with an LRU description cache and 503 retry.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek 视觉桥接：注册原生 LLM provider，聊天内粘贴的图片自动由视觉模型（pi-ai/llama.cpp 上的 Qwen3-VL）转成文字描述后交给纯文本 DeepSeek 作答——图片准入、路由与会话压缩全部走 harness 原生机制，带 LRU 描述缓存与 503 重试。

plugins.name: nyantused-cpun/folio#plugins/folio-events
plugins.descEn: 'Folio (兰亭) @nyantused/folio-dsh-events: session-protocol events — auto session-start reminder + auto-save on session close; pair with @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools.'
plugins.descZh: Folio（兰亭）@nyantused/folio-dsh-events：会话协议事件插件——新会话入口提醒 + 会话关闭自动 save；与 @nyantused/folio-dsh-tools 配套使用。

plugins.name: zclDragon/dsh-tool-generate-image
plugins.descEn: 'Model-facing `generate_image` tool for text-only models: the model asks for a picture in natural language, Gemini draws it via the Antigravity CLI, the image is saved to a configurable output directory, and the tool returns the file paths for the model to use in its work.'
plugins.descZh: '给纯文本模型的 `generate_image` 工具：模型用自然语言要一张图，经 Antigravity CLI 让 Gemini 画出，保存到可配置输出目录并返回文件路径，供模型在任务中使用。'

plugins.name: MingoZhou/dsh-replay
plugins.descEn: Replay sessions on a playable timeline with per-step token usage, audit sensitive operations, estimate cost, view fork lineage, compare sessions, and export standalone HTML replays.
plugins.descZh: 在可播放的时间线上回放会话并显示逐步 token 用量，审计敏感操作，估算成本，查看 fork 血缘，对比会话，并可导出独立 HTML 回放。

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-skill-mcp-center
plugins.descEn: 'Skill and MCP management center for DeepSeek Harness: browse and toggle user/project skills, add/edit/remove MCP servers hot without restart, with live per-session status in the sidebar.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 技能与 MCP 管理中心：浏览并启停用户/项目技能，热增删改 MCP 服务器（免重启），侧边栏实时展示各服务器状态。

plugins.name: 314857493/dsh-vision#vision-route
plugins.descEn: 'Registers a `deepseek-vision` provider route: the Web GUI accepts pasted images and transcribes them to text via the free Zhipu GLM vision API before delegating to the DeepSeek adapter.'
plugins.descZh: '注册 `deepseek-vision` 路由：Web GUI 直接粘贴图片，由免费智谱 GLM 视觉模型转译为文字后，再交给 DeepSeek 适配器作答。'

plugins.name: KIDLi1412/dsh-token-heatmap
plugins.descEn: GitHub-style daily token-usage heatmap on the new-session screen with a selectable calendar-year view, green/blue color schemes, and today / this-month / all-time totals.
plugins.descZh: 新建会话页的 GitHub 风格每日 Token 用量热力图：可选日历年度视图、绿/蓝配色与显示开关，并附今日/本月/累计总量。

plugins.name: Neumannzc/dsh-archive-manager#plugin
plugins.descEn: Beautified archive-manager settings section listing archived sessions grouped by workspace, with a hover unarchive action and relative timestamps.
plugins.descZh: 美化版归档管理设置页：按工作区分组展示归档会话，悬停即可取消归档，附相对时间显示。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-plugin-guide
plugins.descEn: 'The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

plugins.name: truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-hooks
plugins.descEn: 'Claude-Code-style lifecycle hooks: configured shell commands run before/after model tool calls with a JSON payload on stdin; a non-zero pre-tool exit blocks the call.'
plugins.descZh: Claude Code 风格生命周期 hooks：工具调用前后自动执行 shell 命令（stdin 收 JSON payload），pre-tool 非零退出即阻断调用。

plugins.name: wikkd/dsh-remote-access-web#remote-access-web
plugins.descEn: 'Reverse tunnel for the DSH Web GUI: exposes a `dsh --profile web` deployment at a public frp URL and switches the directory picker to the in-app browser, so a phone or remote machine can open and manage the workspace.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web GUI 反向隧道：通过 frp 把 `dsh --profile web` 发布到公网地址，目录选择器改用应用内浏览器，手机或远程机器可直接打开并管理工作区。

plugins.name: lmmzss-jk/dsh-plugin-balance
plugins.descEn: 'Balance and live session usage for the DSH web UI: header balance button (left of the Session log), dropdown with account balance, real-time token breakdown (cache miss/hit, cache write, output), cache hit rate, and official-rate cost estimates with peak/off-peak auto-switch.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 余额与会话用量插件：头部余额按钮（Session log 左侧），下拉展示账户余额、实时 token 明细（缓存未命中/命中、缓存写入、输出）、缓存命中率，以及按官方峰谷价自动切换的费用估算。'

plugins.name: SeverusZh/dsh-yolo-mode
plugins.descEn: LLM auto-approval for sandbox escalation requests, with presets and a fail-closed fallback.
plugins.descZh: 沙箱升权申请的 LLM 自动审批：内置预设，fail-closed 兜底。

plugins.name: ldchaowin/dsh-plugin-notify-sound
plugins.descEn: Per-workspace completion ringtones plus attention sounds for approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure events, with built-in synth, voice (TTS), and custom audio.
plugins.descZh: 按工作区定制的任务完成铃声，以及审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败等需要人介入事件的注意提示音，支持内置合成音、语音播报与自定义音频。

plugins.name: fly233338/dsh-overleaf
plugins.descEn: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
plugins.descZh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

plugins.name: JayDong9130/dsh-evolution-lab
plugins.descEn: 'Evidence-backed Skill self-evolution for DeepSeek Harness: redacted trajectory learning, quarantined proposals, arena validation, canary monitoring, automatic rollback.'
plugins.descZh: '带证据的 Skill 自进化：脱敏轨迹学习、隔离提案、竞技场验证、金丝雀监控与自动回滚。'

plugins.name: alvinunreal/openpets#dsh
plugins.descEn: Bridges DeepSeek Harness lifecycle status, errors, and approval requests to a locally running OpenPets desktop companion.
plugins.descZh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的生命周期状态、错误与审批请求，桥接到本地运行的 OpenPets 桌面伙伴。

plugins.name: geml-spec/geml#integrations/dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps.'
plugins.descZh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

plugins.name: aokamoaki/dsh-startup-guard
plugins.descEn: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines crash-causing bundles, so a broken plugin can never brick startup.
plugins.descZh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

plugins.name: ChuanTianML/dsh-chat-tidy
plugins.descEn: 'One stylesheet that retypesets the DSH conversation to measured Codex metrics: 14/22 px body, tighter headings, lists and blocks, a rounded quote bar, and Tidy Tables with a themed header, row/column rules, full-width short tables and contained scrolling for wide tables; no settings or DOM rewriting, with real before/after captures.'
plugins.descZh: 一张样式表，按实测的 Codex 版式重排 DSH 对话页：14/22 px 正文，收紧标题、列表与块级节奏，使用圆角引用条，并把表格补成带主题化表头、行列分隔、短表铺满和宽表容器内滚动的 Tidy Tables；无设置项、不改写 DOM，仓库内附真实前后对比图。

plugins.name: Fectivnfy112357/github-explore

plugins.name: taxueseek/dsh-files

plugins.name: zhaiyateng/dsh-design-skills

plugins.descZh: 设计美学技能包：10 种风格（深色 SaaS、极简白、新拟态、粗野主义、毛玻璃、日式极简、便当盒、赛博朋克、蒸汽波、装饰艺术），每种含 token、组件规则、禁用清单与验收清单，附可运行落地页 demo。

plugins.name: dhicoc/dsh-chinese-traditional-wisdom-skill
plugins.descEn: 'Complete chinese-traditional-wisdom (玄枢 / XuanShu) skill pack as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: bazi, ziwei-doushu, liuyao, meihua, qimen, daliuren, taiyi, wuyun-liuqi, constitution and fengshui calculation, with a local deterministic engine and a visualization dashboard.'
plugins.descZh: 完整中华传统智慧（玄枢 / XuanShu）技能包，封装为 DeepSeek Harness Cordis 插件：八字、紫微斗数、六爻、梅花易数、奇门遁甲、大六壬、太乙、五运六气、中医体质与风水推算，内置本地确定性引擎与可视化 Dashboard。

plugins.name: linenxi-ctrl/dsh-vision
plugins.descEn: 'External vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness: whale-button config panel, image recognition with auto-reply, and agent screenshot/recognize tools.'
plugins.descZh: 外挂识图插件：鲸鱼按钮配置面板、图片识图自动回传、模型自主截图识图工具。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-advisor
plugins.descEn: Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.
plugins.descZh: 搭配一个副模型，每轮被动审查并注入见解。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-security-audit
plugins.descEn: 'Local security audit: config, plugin origins, sessions, network exposure — read-only redacted risk report.'
plugins.descZh: 本机安全审计：配置/插件来源/会话/网络暴露面，只读脱敏风险报告。

plugins.name: pengpengyi92/dsh-quant
plugins.descEn: Quantitative R&D toolkit for DeepSeek Harness — 59 tools across six domains covering market data, indicators, factor evaluation, walk-forward ML validation, risk (VaR/CVaR/drawdown/Beta with Kupiec POF), options, bonds, FICC and fund simulation, with an end-to-end PDAT→PET research pipeline.
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的量化研发工具箱，59 个工具覆盖行情、指标、因子评价、滚动样本外机器学习验证、风险（VaR/CVaR/回撤/Beta 与 Kupiec POF）、期权、债券、FICC 和基金模拟，并提供端到端 PDAT→PET 研究管线。

plugins.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-file-mentions
plugins.descEn: 'Clickable file paths in DSH replies: Codex-style inline open, reveal in file manager, and a mentioned-files chip list at the turn tail.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 回复中的文件路径可点击：Codex 风格行内打开、文件管理器定位、回合尾部文件 chip 列表。

plugins.name: EdgeTypE/dsh-better-deepseek

plugins.descZh: '[Better DeepSeek](https://github.com/EdgeTypE/better-deepseek) Chrome 扩展桥接插件：在 webServer 上提供 HTTP 握手与会话过滤的 SSE 事件流，实现浏览器扩展 UI 与 DeepSeek Harness 的集成。'

plugins.name: fuhefei/dsh-sentinel

plugins.descZh: 条件驱动唤醒：file/command/http/process/webhook 持久监视，触发即唤醒 agent。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-token-usage

plugins.name: MJorgin/dsh-media-skills
