plugins.name: omdsh-dev/plugin-template

plugins.name: xingyingyuzhui/dsh-liquid-glass
plugins.descEn: 'Wallpaper plus optional Liquid Glass islands for the DSH Web UI: Ice/Deepwater presets, import, wallpaper opacity, and per-island blur on official light/dark/system.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 液态玻璃皮肤：冰原/深水壁纸、可导入、壁纸透明度，以及叠在官方浅色/深色/跟随系统上的分岛模糊。

plugins.name: yuezengwu/dsh-explain

plugins.name: AKS1st/dsh-cyber-particle
plugins.descEn: 'Particle-network background overlay for the DSH Web shell: full-screen, click-through, zero runtime dependencies.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供粒子网络动态背景：全屏覆盖、点击穿透、零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: liqichen/dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.descEn: 'GUI in the DSH settings panel: toggle/delete MCP servers, browse and trash skills, and list built-in plugin packages — hot-applied without restart.'
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH 设置面板内嵌的图形化管理器：开关/删除 MCP 服务、浏览并回收 Skills、查看内置插件包，改动热生效无需重启。

plugins.name: memorax-ai/dsh-harmony

plugins.name: Meredith2328/dsh-sticky-note

plugins.descZh: 编辑框工具栏便签，随手记点子和 TODO，自动保存为 Markdown，一键发送到对话。

plugins.name: MutaLucem/dsh-plugin-integration

plugins.descEn: 'LAN mobile gateway: isolated child-process reverse proxy with first-visit approval, per-device token binding, rate limiting, and mobile layout injection (compact composer pills, randomUUID polyfill).'

plugins.name: BiBoyang/dsh-eval-harness
plugins.descEn: 'Evaluation harness for DSH plugins: YAML cases drive real headless agent runs, assert on tool calls, args, results and token usage, with a baseline gate for CI regression.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 插件评测框架：YAML 用例驱动真实 headless agent，断言工具调用/参数/返回与 token 用量，baseline 门禁做 CI 回归。

plugins.name: BillyChen123/qdd
plugins.descEn: Question-Driven Discovery research workflow for DeepSeek Harness with a QDD Agent Preset, durable Human and Auto runs, and an auditable research panel.
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Question-Driven Discovery 科研工作流，提供 QDD Agent Preset、持久化 Human 和 Auto 运行，以及可审计的研究面板。

plugins.name: caoyiwei850/dsh-client-ui-skins
plugins.descEn: 'Skin plugin for the DSH Web UI: 4 built-in skins plus custom image skins with the photo as a full-interface background and the palette following its dominant hue.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 换肤插件：4 套内置皮肤 + 自定义图片皮肤，图片作为全界面背景，配色自动跟随图片主色调。

plugins.name: cerebrixos-org/tuning-engines-cli#tuningengines-dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: Exports metadata-only DSH turn, model, tool, approval, retry, and error events to Tuning Engines for governed traces, policy evaluation, cost analysis, and Work Session review, with a disk-backed retry queue.
plugins.descZh: 将不含原始内容的 DSH 回合、模型、工具、审批、重试和错误事件导出到 Tuning Engines，用于受治理的追踪、策略评估、成本分析和 Work Session 审阅，并提供磁盘持久化重试队列。

plugins.name: dawnliming/dsh-chinese-mode
plugins.descEn: 'Global Chinese mode: a compact pill switch beside the composer that injects a language requirement into any preset''s system prompt (complete personas excepted); reply, thinking and tool output each toggle between Chinese and English, and anchored presets are supported.'
plugins.descZh: 全局中文模式：输入框旁的紧凑胶囊开关，开启后向任意预设（完整 persona 除外）的系统提示注入语言要求；回复、思考、工具区域可分别切换中英文，并兼容锚定预设。

plugins.name: GLFzr/dsh-opencode-go-quota
plugins.descEn: 'OpenCode Go quota ring: click-to-cycle progress ring (5h/weekly/monthly) left of the model selector, colored by urgency, with reset countdowns on hover.'
plugins.descZh: 模型选择器左侧的 OpenCode Go 额度圆环：点击循环切换 5 小时/每周/每月用量窗口，按紧急程度着色（绿/蓝/橙/红），悬停显示百分比与重置倒计时。

plugins.name: LaoYueHanNi/dsh-token-usage
plugins.descEn: 'Detailed model usage and cost analysis, with per-session usage stats and usage queries for GLM, MiniMax, OpenCode Go, DeepSeek and more.'
plugins.descZh: 详细的模型用量、费用分析，支持会话级用量统计，支持GLM、MiniMax、OpenCode Go、DS等用量查询。

plugins.name: leavestring/awesome-dsh-background-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'DSH Web background settings: upload a local image or pick a preset ambiance, with live preview and persistent settings.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DSH Web 设置背景：上传本地图片或选择预设氛围，实时预览且设置持久化。'

plugins.name: leechen298/Code2Skill
plugins.descEn: Generate Functions, MCP tools, workflow Skills, and offline test packages from user-authorized source code.
plugins.descZh: 从用户授权的源码生成 Function、MCP 工具、工作流 Skill 与离线测试包。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-task-dag
plugins.descEn: 'Projection-driven live DAG for a Session''s subagents and durable workflows: status and navigation, deterministic deep-chain layout, fit/pan canvas controls, and current-session node rearrangement.'
plugins.descZh: 由投影驱动的会话子代理与持久工作流实时 DAG：状态与节点导航、深层链路确定性布局、适应/平移画布，以及当前会话内节点拖动重排。

plugins.name: Liu-ZA-81/dsh-theme-firefly
plugins.descEn: 'A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.'
plugins.descZh: '崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。'

plugins.name: madage/dsh-self-improved
plugins.descEn: 'Long-term memory & self-evolving plugin for DSH: L0 capture → L1 memory extraction → L2 scene grouping → L3 user persona, auto recall injection, skill synthesis, fully local (SQLite FTS5 + jieba, optional vector recall).'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 长期记忆与自进化插件：L0 对话捕获 → L1 记忆提取 → L2 场景归纳 → L3 用户画像，自动召回注入 + 技能合成，纯本地（SQLite FTS5 + jieba，可选向量召回）。

plugins.name: mafeis/dsh-net-proxy
plugins.descEn: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
plugins.descZh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

plugins.name: mengyun233/dsh-codex-pet
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-migrate Codex desktop-pet skins into DSH: an animated corner pet that mirrors agent state (thinking, tool use, awaiting approval, failed, done), with per-session frosted-glass dialogs and a full settings panel.'
plugins.descZh: 把 Codex 桌宠皮肤自动迁移到 DSH：右下角动画桌宠随 agent 状态实时变化（思考/工具/等待批准/出错/完成），多会话毛玻璃对话框 + 完整设置面板。

plugins.name: nowledge-co/nowledge-mem-deepseek-harness
plugins.descEn: 'One memory layer for every AI tool and agent: Context Bundle injection, prompt-time recall, MCP tools, and turn-end DSH thread capture.'
plugins.descZh: 给所有 AI 工具和 Agent 共用的一层记忆：注入 Context Bundle、提示时检索、MCP 工具与回合结束 DSH 线程捕获。

plugins.name: sereinmono/dsh-desktop-pet
plugins.descEn: A plugin that adds a desktop pet to your DeepSeek Harness, supporting the Codex pet format, you can use hatch-pet or Petdex to add your pets.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物：完全支持 Codex 桌宠格式，可使用 hatch-pet Skill 创建宠物，或通过 Petdex 导入宠物。

plugins.name: Tisitan/dsh-live2d-companion
plugins.descEn: 'Live2D desk pet for DSH: 8-state AI status lamp, web widget, and always-on-top transparent Electron pet window with expressions, motions, and chat bubbles.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 的 Live2D 桌宠：8 态 AI 状态灯 + 网页挂件 + 置顶透明 Electron 桌宠窗，表情/动作/气泡齐全，换模型自动适配。'

plugins.name: v587d/dsh-opencode-go-usage
plugins.descEn: OpenCode Go subscription usage (rolling/weekly/monthly windows with reset countdowns) in the composer dock, with a built-in credential editor.
plugins.descZh: 在输入框上方 dock 显示 OpenCode Go 订阅用量（5h 滚动/每周/每月窗口与重置倒计时），内置凭据编辑器。

plugins.name: wenzetan/dsh-llm-newapi
plugins.descEn: 'NewAPI (OpenAI-compatible gateway) LLM provider: registers a `newapi` route with chat-only model discovery, auto-fills model parameters (context window, reasoning effort) from models.dev, and adds a Web settings section for the base URL and API key.'
plugins.descZh: NewAPI（OpenAI 兼容网关）模型接入：注册 `newapi` 路由，仅发现聊天类模型，自动从 models.dev 获取模型参数（上下文窗口、思考强度等）并填充，并在 Web 设置页配置 base URL 与 API Key。

plugins.name: WhitePlusMS/dsh-input-plus
plugins.descEn: Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with `@`, plus a `/h` menu for reusing prompts from the current session.
plugins.descZh: 在组合框中使用 `@` 搜索并插入工作区文件和目录路径，并通过 `/h` 菜单复用当前会话的问题。

plugins.name: wz-heng/dsh-feishu-bridge
plugins.descEn: 'Fail-closed Feishu (Lark) channel bridge: chat with a bot, get dsh agent turns back — with opt-in human-in-the-loop tool approval (Allow/Deny cards before every bash call, fail-closed timeout). Official-Python-SDK-only integration (exact-pinned); deny-by-default allowlist, webhook signature/timestamp/replay verification, per-chat sticky sessions; daily latest-SDK compatibility canary; bilingual docs.'
plugins.descZh: Fail-closed 的飞书（Lark）channel 桥：和机器人聊天即驱动 dsh agent turn，可选人在环工具审批（每次 bash 调用前飞书弹 Allow/Deny 卡，超时默认拒绝）。仅经官方 Python SDK 集成（精确锁版）；白名单默认全拒、webhook 验签/时间窗/防重放、按 chat 粘性会话；每日最新 SDK 兼容金丝雀；中英双语文档。

plugins.name: ZichengGurrr/dsh-window#kit
plugins.descEn: 'All-in-one bundle for DSH: the native Windows desktop window (WebView2), DeepEye vision (GLM-4V-Flash), and voice input (mic button) in a single install.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 三件套全家桶：Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）+ DeepEye 视觉（GLM-4V-Flash）+ 语音输入（麦克风按钮），一条命令装齐。

plugins.name: ZichengGurrr/dsh-window#plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 的 Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）：一键安装，自动从 GitHub Releases 下载应用 zip、创建桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

plugins.name: zuoguyoupan2023/adhdgofly-dsh-ext
plugins.descEn: Highlights parts of speech (nouns green, verbs red, adjectives/adverbs purple) in rendered DSH Web Markdown, with light/dark palettes, toggles, and stream-aware updates.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web 已渲染的 Markdown 中做词性高亮：名词绿、动词红、形容/副词紫，支持深/浅色板、词性开关与流式防抖。

plugins.name: 1123762794/dsh-web-restart
plugins.descEn: 'One-click restart button for the DSH Web UI: a sidebar footer button that restarts the dsh web process with a single click and persists across the restart it triggers.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 界面一键重启按钮：侧边栏底部按钮，单击即重启 dsh web 进程，且重启后按钮常驻。

plugins.name: 1624318455/dsh-plugin-tavily
plugins.descEn: Tavily-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool, with a settings card for the API key, result count, and recency window.
plugins.descZh: 基于 Tavily 的网页搜索提供方：替换内置 web_search 的后端，并提供 API Key、结果数量与时间窗口的设置卡片。

plugins.name: AnacondaKC/dsh-douyin
plugins.descEn: 'Short-video sidebar: native player, series navigation, precise history replay.'
plugins.descZh: 侧栏短视频：原生播放器、系列导航、精确历史回放。

plugins.name: AtropinolTT/dsh-guide-dog

plugins.name: BruceLanLan/dsh-tier-router

plugins.name: bujue600-arch/dsh-testgen

plugins.name: bwndlct/dsh-session-audit
plugins.descEn: 'Session execution analytics: steps, tool calls, failures, repeated actions, token usage and verification signals, rendered as text/Markdown/JSON reports.'

plugins.name: CAOGGL/dsh-ding

plugins.descZh: 对话完成提醒：Agent 空闲（idle）时播放提示音并弹 Windows 原生通知，可配 ding.mp3、音量与防抖节流。

plugins.name: Cavan-Ou/dsh-observation-journal

plugins.name: cdxiaodong/dsh-guardian

plugins.name: cindyguyuehu123/dsh-mobile

plugins.descZh: 让 DSH 在 iPhone/iPad 上可用：显式开启的局域网反向代理（改写 Host/Origin 通过回环信任栅栏，含 WebSocket 升级）、iOS PWA 外壳（主屏幕图标、standalone meta、viewport-fit）、触屏/移动端 CSS（安全区、键盘避让、输入框按钮行适配）。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-plugin-toggle

plugins.descZh: 设置→插件开关面板：每个已加载插件的卡片显示简述与运行阶段，支持模糊搜索与运行时启动/关闭（不改写配置文件）。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-aionui-panel
plugins.descEn: 'Right-panel system for the dsh web GUI: a pixel-faithful AionUi Explorer + Preview (file tree, diff view, preview).'

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-git-graph
plugins.descEn: Git branch selector and Git graph in the conversation header of the dsh web GUI.
plugins.descZh: dsh web GUI 会话头部栏的 Git 分支选择器与提交图。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-liangshen
plugins.descEn: 'LiangShen (梁神) agent preset for the dsh web GUI: a two-phase anchored-standard preset.'
plugins.descZh: dsh web GUI 的梁神 agent 预设：两阶段锚定标准预设。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-live-stats
plugins.descEn: Live token estimates and generation throughput for the dsh web GUI.
plugins.descZh: dsh web GUI 实时 token 估算与生成吞吐。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-pet
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-pet companion for the dsh web GUI: a registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity.'
plugins.descZh: dsh web GUI 多桌宠伴侣：注册表驱动的悬浮宠物，随模型活动实时反应。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-remote-web-ui
plugins.descEn: 'Mobile remote control for the dsh web GUI: scan-to-pair QR entry with one-time pairing tokens.'
plugins.descZh: dsh web GUI 移动端远程控制：扫码配对 QR 入口、一次性配对 token。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-ssh
plugins.descEn: 'Remote SSH operations for the dsh web GUI: host config store and persisted sessions.'
plugins.descZh: dsh web GUI 远程 SSH 操作：主机配置存储、持久化会话。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-task-board
plugins.descEn: 'Task board for the dsh web GUI: a sidebar entry plus a multi-column kanban view with local persistence.'
plugins.descZh: dsh web GUI 任务看板：侧边栏入口 + 多列看板视图，本地持久化。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-tool-describe-image
plugins.descEn: 'Gives a text-only model image understanding via a vision-language model, exposed as a `describe_image` tool.'
plugins.descZh: describe_image 模型工具：让纯文本模型通过视觉语言模型获得图像理解能力。

plugins.name: DamonKoy/dsh-web-ui#dsh-web-ui-settings
plugins.descEn: 'Web UI plugin group card in the dsh settings page: enable switches and config for the dsh-web-ui family.'
plugins.descZh: dsh 设置页的 Web UI 插件组卡片：dsh-web-ui 全家插件的开关与配置。

plugins.name: dfycaly98931680/dsh-trajectory-governance

plugins.name: freehul/sgme

plugins.name: godchen520/dsh-web-remote

plugins.descZh: 手机/外网远程访问 DSH：Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 公网链接 + 局域网 HTTP/HTTPS 直连（自动生成自签名证书）、token 鉴权、gzip 压缩、常驻手机图标面板（一键复制/二维码），并内置 NapCat QQ 机器人取链接通道。

plugins.name: guo6x/dsh-pilot

plugins.descZh: 零依赖浏览器操控：agent 通过 CDP 驾驶真实 headless Edge/Chrome（导航/点击/输入/按键/JS/截图，8 个 `pilot_*` 工具），Web GUI 内可拖拽驾驶舱面板实时围观——文本优先快照适配纯文本模型，无需 Playwright、无需 API key。

plugins.name: Hongcheng-LI/dsh-zotero
plugins.descEn: 'Zotero library tools via the local API (no API key): search items/collections, read metadata and abstracts, list attachments, read full text (parses PDFs on the fly when Zotero cache misses), download PDFs, and manage notes.'
plugins.descZh: 通过 Zotero 本地 API（无需 API Key）操作文献库：检索条目/分类、读元数据与摘要、列附件、读全文（缓存未命中时现场解析 PDF）、下载 PDF、管理笔记。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-cowork#dsh
plugins.descEn: Bounded, cell-addressed `doc_read`/`doc_write` for xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb, plus an MCP server and CLI.
plugins.descZh: doc_read/doc_write：以有界、单元格寻址的方式读写 xlsx / pdf / docx / pptx / ipynb，另附 MCP 服务器与 CLI。

plugins.name: JMOKSZ/dsh-lark-bridge
plugins.descEn: 'Feishu (Lark) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: one-command install, streaming progress cards with a tool panel, ask/approval button cards, attachments, and proactive feishu_send pushes.'
plugins.descZh: '飞书入口插件：一条命令安装，流式进度卡片带工具面板、提问/审批按钮卡片、附件处理与 feishu_send 主动推送。'

plugins.name: Jolly-J/dsh-deepseek-billing
plugins.descEn: DeepSeek account balance and per-session cost card in the sidebar foot.
plugins.descZh: 侧边栏底部 DeepSeek 账户余额显示与会话费用估算卡片。

plugins.name: katsos/dsh-claude-cli
plugins.descEn: LLM provider that runs the locally installed Claude Code CLI as the model backend, so requests go through an existing Claude subscription instead of a metered API key; native tool calls are bridged over MCP.
plugins.descZh: LLM 供应商：把本机已安装的 Claude Code CLI 作为模型后端，请求走已订阅的 Claude 账号，无需按量计费的 API key；原生工具调用经 MCP 桥接。

plugins.name: kinoward/dsh-plugin-subhub
plugins.descEn: 'Use third-party subscription accounts in DeepSeek Harness: chat, image understanding, image generation, and image editing with the models your subscription covers, with available models and reasoning levels synced from your account; currently supports OpenAI/ChatGPT subscriptions, more providers planned.'
plugins.descZh: 用第三方订阅账户在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用订阅覆盖的模型：文字对话、图片理解、图片生成与图片编辑，可用模型与推理等级随账户自动同步；当前支持 OpenAI / ChatGPT 订阅，更多订阅服务规划中。

plugins.name: loguhan/dsh-workshop
plugins.descEn: 'Steam Workshop-style plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, and one-click install community plugins with mirror acceleration, progress UI, security checks, and Chinese descriptions.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web UI 的 Steam 创意工坊式插件商店：浏览、搜索并一键安装社区插件，支持镜像加速、进度 UI、安全检测与中文描述。

plugins.name: Luke-Yong/dsh-plugin-knowledge-graph
plugins.descEn: A read_graph tool backed by a codebase knowledge graph (CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL relations).
plugins.descZh: 基于代码库知识图谱的 read_graph 工具（CONTAINS / EXPORTS / IMPORTS / IMPORTS_SYMBOL 关系）。

plugins.name: ly6170/dsh-messager
plugins.descEn: Monitors session state in the DSH web app and sends desktop, browser, and third-party notifications for interactions, completions, and errors.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web 端监控会话状态，为需要交互、任务完成、任务出错发送桌面 / 浏览器 / 第三方通知。

plugins.name: maxiaovivi/dsh-cloak-browser
plugins.descEn: CloakBrowser-powered native browser tools with per-agent isolated sessions, bounded snapshots, ref-based interaction, screenshots, and safe routing.
plugins.descZh: 基于 CloakBrowser 的原生浏览器工具：按 Agent 隔离会话，提供有界快照、ref 交互、截图与安全路由。

plugins.name: MorGogh/widget-dock
plugins.descEn: Draggable grid-aligned workbench of 28 mini-cards in the margins of the conversation (API balance, token usage, cost, context pressure, todos, goal, usage heatmap, GitHub repo, image relay), with S/M/L/XL size tiers.
plugins.descZh: 对话两侧空白区的可拖动卡片工作台，28 个小组件（余额、Token 用量、成本、上下文压力、待办、目标、用量热力图、GitHub 仓库、图片中转等），支持 S/M/L/XL 四档尺寸。

plugins.name: MrWeiCodes/dsh-permgate
plugins.descEn: 'Fine-grained permission gateway: per-category tool-call review (outside-workspace directories, commands, file read/write, subagents, repeated actions) with global & per-project allow/deny exceptions, quick-tool defaults, custom rules, a bilingual approval modal with inline diff details, custom rejection reasons and a sandbox-upgrade flow.'
plugins.descZh: 细粒度权限网关：按分类（工作区外目录/命令/读写文件/子代理/重复操作）逐项审查工具调用，全局/项目双级白黑名单、快捷工具默认值、自定义规则，中英文审批弹窗（内联 diff 详情、自定义拒绝意见）与底层沙箱升级流程。

plugins.name: nanshan1995/DSH-Plugin-Market
plugins.descEn: 'Alternative plugin market for DSH: curated catalog plus live GitHub browsing, zh/en cross-language search, a fail-closed pre-install static security audit with an install-hook block, and per-plugin README viewing with garbled-encoding repair.'
plugins.descZh: 另一款 DSH 插件市场：精选目录 + GitHub 实时浏览、中英互通搜索、安装前 fail-closed 静态安全审计（拦截安装钩子），每个插件可直接查看 README 且乱码自动修复。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-csv
plugins.descEn: Parse/query/aggregate/convert CSV (RFC 4180) with a zero-dependency state-machine parser.
plugins.descZh: CSV 解析/查询/统计/转换（RFC 4180），零依赖状态机解析器。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-diff
plugins.descEn: Structured comparison and unified diffs for text/JSON/CSV/Markdown.
plugins.descZh: 文本/JSON/CSV/Markdown 结构化比较与 unified diff。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-markdown
plugins.descEn: HTML↔Markdown conversion, GFM table normalization, and TOC generation.
plugins.descZh: HTML↔Markdown 转换、GFM 表格规范化、目录生成。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-tool-time
plugins.descEn: Strict ISO 8601 parsing, IANA timezone conversion, and UTC calendar arithmetic.
plugins.descZh: 严格 ISO 8601 解析、IANA 时区转换、UTC 日历运算。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/Qwen-MM-Plugins
plugins.descEn: Qwen multi-modal plugin support.
plugins.descZh: Qwen 多模态插件支持。

plugins.name: OpenTritium/dsh-codex-shim
plugins.descEn: Simulates a Codex environment for selected model routes to improve GPT-family model tool-call success.
plugins.descZh: 为选定的模型路由模拟 Codex 环境，以提升 GPT 系列模型的工具调用成功率。

plugins.name: pitetow/dsh-notify-on-complete
plugins.descEn: Desktop notifications for run completion, model questions, and approval requests with per-platform system sounds, zero runtime dependencies.
plugins.descZh: 系统桌面通知：运行结束、模型提问与审批请求即时提醒，三平台提示音，零运行时依赖。

plugins.name: pzc2004/dsh-frostfin
plugins.descEn: 'Use Kimi Code as the DSH agent loop over ACP, with approvals, slash commands, and local/remote (ssh+tmux) session attach.'
plugins.descZh: '把 DSH 的 agent loop 换成 Kimi Code（ACP 直连）：审批、斜杠命令、本地与远程（ssh+tmux）会话接入。'

plugins.name: 单机游戏内 AI 同伴「小汤圆」
plugins.descEn: 'XiaoTangYuan, an in-game AI companion for single-player games: understands the game screen, chats by text or push-to-talk, and speaks replies aloud; Stardew Valley is supported, with Don''t Starve Together and Oxygen Not Included integrations in progress.'
plugins.descZh: 单机游戏内 AI 同伴「小汤圆」：理解游戏画面，支持文字或按住说话交流并语音回复；现已支持《星露谷物语》，《饥荒联机版》和《缺氧》正在迁移接入。

plugins.name: qyw233/dsh-deeplink
plugins.descEn: 'Deep links: open a specific session or workspace via `?session=` / `?workspace=`.'
plugins.descZh: '`?session=` / `?workspace=` 深链直达指定项目对话。'

plugins.name: radres/dsh-plugin-call-me
plugins.descEn: 'Rings your phone over CallKit: `call_me` and `text_me` tools, plus optional turn-end and approval calls whose spoken answer is transcribed back into the session.'
plugins.descZh: 通过 CallKit 打电话到你的手机：`call_me` 与 `text_me` 工具，并可在回合结束或等待审批时来电，语音回答转写后送回会话。

plugins.name: simon300000/dsh-auto
plugins.descEn: Adds an Auto Approve permission preset to the Web UI, using a fresh restricted Reviewer Agent to allow or deny each approval request.
plugins.descZh: 为 WebUI 增加 Auto Approve 权限档位，由全新且受限的审查 Agent 逐次允许或拒绝审批请求。

plugins.name: tsonglew/dsh-workspace-search
plugins.descEn: 'VS Code-style workspace keyword search tab for dsh-better-sidebar: matches file names and content, grouped by file with line numbers, opens in the sidebar editor.'
plugins.descZh: VS Code 式工作区关键词搜索 Tab（better-sidebar 扩展）：同时匹配文件名与文件内容，结果按文件分组带行号，点击在侧栏编辑器打开。

plugins.name: tuogusa/dsh-skill-manager
plugins.descEn: Browse, search, delete, undo-delete, and update user skills from the Web settings panel; checks GitHub/Gitee Releases for newer skill versions.
plugins.descZh: 在 Web 设置面板中浏览、搜索、删除/撤回并更新用户技能，支持从 GitHub/Gitee Release 检查技能更新。

plugins.name: vinyumao/dsh-opencode-usage
plugins.descEn: 'OpenCode Go plan usage display for the DSH web GUI: a persistent badge under the composer shows rolling/weekly/monthly usage percents with reset countdowns; click to expand a card; agents can query the balance via the `opencode_go_usage` tool.'
plugins.descZh: OpenCode Go 套餐用量显示：输入框下方常驻徽章显示滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，点击展开进度卡片；Agent 可经 `opencode_go_usage` 工具随时查询余额。

plugins.name: vlln/dsh-loop
plugins.descEn: 'Recurring loops: `/loop` command + loop tool + activity status bar.'
plugins.descZh: 定时循环：`/loop` 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条。

plugins.name: wanderer-yk/dsh-xueqiu
plugins.descEn: 'Xueqiu (Snowball) market panel docked above the composer: A-share/HK/US quotes and indices, watchlist, candlestick K-line with volume, MAs and crosshair tooltip, hot list, search, 7x24 news, plus a draggable mini index badge — no login needed.'
plugins.descZh: 雪球行情面板：嵌入输入框上方，免登录查看 A股/港美股行情、指数与自选股，K线蜡烛图（成交量/均线/十字光标）、热榜、搜索、7×24 快讯，另有可拖动迷你指数徽章。

plugins.name: warmwine/dsh-ui-font
plugins.descEn: 'Font engine for the Web GUI: system font enumeration, global and per-component font-size tuning with a Spy++-style picker, settings page.'
plugins.descZh: 网页界面字体引擎：系统字体枚举、准星点选的全局与逐组件字号微调、设置页。老花眼友好，自定义字体和页面部件字体和字体大小，支持SPY模式扫UI和其他插件。

plugins.name: wss534857356/dsh-plugin-codex
plugins.descEn: Codex App Server model provider using a local Codex login, with session reuse, Harness tool bridging, native action traces, and durable generated-image projection.
plugins.descZh: 使用本地 Codex 登录的 Codex App Server 模型提供方，支持会话复用、Harness 工具桥接、原生动作轨迹和生成图片持久化。

plugins.name: xbzbing/dsh-auth-gateway

plugins.name: xiaoshihou514/dsh-weixin
plugins.descEn: Connects dsh to Weixin, with arbitrary file sending support.
plugins.descZh: 通过微信远程控制 DeepSeek Harness，支持任意文件传输。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-article-publish

plugins.descZh: 会话内直接发布文章到 CSDN / 掘金 / 博客园，无外部服务。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-session-export
plugins.descEn: Export sessions to Markdown/JSON for review, replay, and per-session cost summaries.
plugins.descZh: 会话导出为 Markdown/JSON，便于复盘、重放与单会话成本汇总。

plugins.name: zhang787jun/dsh-finance

plugins.descZh: 金融研究工作流与组合风控工具，对当前市场事实强制来源与时间戳边界。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor

plugins.descZh: 'DSH 插件体检：manifest/patch/entry/build/pack/install 校验、可被模型调用的 plugin_check、profile 宿主遮蔽与 BOM 检测、环境诊断、投毒预检。'

plugins.name: ztl34245881-commits/dsh-task-planner
plugins.descEn: 'Task planning with experience muscle-memory: condition-reflex recall of past solutions, LLM capability matching, and auto-persisted lessons.'
plugins.descZh: 带经验肌肉记忆的任务规划：条件反射检索历史方案 + LLM 能力匹配 + 经验自动沉淀。

plugins.name: 117BS/dsh-perlica-ding
plugins.descEn: 'Perlica (Arknights: Endfield) themed tiered sound notifications: plan-ready, task-done, needs-your-input, and error tones; silent for plain chat, system-level playback (works in background), cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux), custom TTS sounds.'
plugins.descZh: 明日方舟终末地佩丽卡主题分级提示音：计划出方案 / 任务完成 / 需要你回应 / 出错四档独立音效，普通问答保持安静；系统级播放（窗口在后台也响），跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），支持自定义 TTS 语音。

plugins.name: 2768651338/dsh-effort-slider

plugins.name: 283Gawin/dsh-heatmap

plugins.name: 3403473060/dsh-inline-images
plugins.descEn: Render local image paths from assistant replies inline in the message body (9 formats, click-to-zoom lightbox, adjustable size).
plugins.descZh: 对话内联图片：LLM 回复中输出的本地图片路径在消息正文直接渲染为图片（9 种格式、点击放大灯箱、可调尺寸）。

plugins.name: 534119219/chicheng-gate

plugins.descZh: DSH Web 插件：局域网/远程访问控制、frpc 内网穿透、面板密码门禁与手机端 UI 适配。

plugins.name: 534119219/chicheng-stats
plugins.descEn: 'Configurable DSH usage statistics: a sidebar text/card widget plus a detail dialog with per-provider and per-model breakdowns, cache-hit rates, token trends, and latency details (TTFT and duration).'
plugins.descZh: 高度可配置的 DSH 用量统计插件：侧边栏文字/卡片组件加统计弹窗，提供按提供方与按模型的请求/Token 统计、缓存命中率、趋势图与首字节/总耗时明细。

plugins.name: 7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-code-reviewer

plugins.descZh: 模板驱动的代码审查技能：五步审查流程、严重/中等/轻微三级分级、四维评分（质量、安全、性能、可维护性），同时输出文本与 HTML 报告，内置按需加载的参考知识库。

plugins.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-plan-switch
plugins.descEn: One-click enter/exit Plan mode for the DSH web input bar, a quick-click shortcut for /plan.
plugins.descZh: 输入框一键进/出 Plan 模式（/plan 的快捷点击），常驻小按钮。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dsh-sysmon
plugins.descEn: 'System status floating widget: live CPU/memory/disk usage in the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web UI with threshold colour warnings.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 右下角系统状态悬浮窗：实时显示 CPU、内存、磁盘占用率，带阈值变色告警。

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-custom-brand
plugins.descEn: 'Customizable brand area for the Web UI: replace the whale logo and DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text (double-click to change, right-click to reset).'

plugins.name: Bcy2020/dsh-cc-ecosystem

Six installable packages: loader, skills, permissions, agents, hooks, mcp.'

plugins.name: beijingwahw/dsh-companion

plugins.name: BeiZi6/dsh-theme-plugin

plugins.name: bill9109/dsh-webbridge
plugins.descEn: DSH meets Kimi WebBridge.
plugins.descZh: DSH 结合 Kimi WebBridge。

plugins.name: Bing-Bryan/dsh-unread-dot

plugins.name: BotonJ/dsh-remote-link

plugins.descZh: 官方 Web UI 的安全远程接入：带认证的局域网/隧道网关，QR + HMAC 一次性配对、按设备吊销，mDNS 发现，附 fork_session 会话分叉工具。

plugins.name: buhuikongpan/dsh-win-gitbash
