plugins.name: 534119219/chicheng-push
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-channel push for DeepSeek Harness: Server酱, PushPlus, Bark, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Feishu, ntfy, custom webhooks and more, configurable from the settings panel and callable by other plugins via the pushNotifier service.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 多渠道消息推送插件：支持 Server酱、PushPlus、Bark、钉钉、企业微信、Telegram、飞书、ntfy、自定义 Webhook 等，可在设置面板配置多个渠道，并通过 pushNotifier 服务供其他插件调用。'

plugins.name: 534119219/dsh-messaging#messaging-core
plugins.descEn: 'Unified messaging gateway for DeepSeek Harness: 27 IM platforms (Telegram, QQ, WeChat, Discord, WhatsApp, Feishu and more) in one plugin, with QR scan-to-authorize, per-platform workspaces, slash commands, and a web setup dialog.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的统一消息网关：一个插件接入 27 个 IM 平台（Telegram、QQ、微信、Discord、WhatsApp、飞书等），支持扫码授权、每平台独立工作区、斜杠命令与 Web 配置弹窗。

plugins.name: a1073097082/dsh-model-search
plugins.descEn: Adds searchable filtering to the model selector by provider, model name, and model ID; spaces act as wildcards.
plugins.descZh: 为模型选择器增加按提供方、模型名称和模型 ID 搜索的筛选框，空格表示任意字符。

plugins.name: a179-sanae/dsh-code-check
plugins.descEn: 'Automatic type-check diagnostics: after the model edits or creates TS files, runs `tsc --noEmit` in the background (debounced per project) and reports errors via the `code_check` tool — grouped by file with line/column, severity and TS error codes, closing the "edit → check → fix" loop.'
plugins.descZh: 自动类型检查诊断：模型编辑/创建 TS 文件后后台防抖运行 `tsc --noEmit`，经 `code_check` 工具按文件分组汇报错误（行列号 + 严重级别 + TS 错误码），形成「改 → 查 → 修」闭环。

plugins.name: aerince/dsh-models-dev-reasoning
plugins.descEn: Adds models.dev reasoning levels to unconfigured third-party DeepSeek Harness models.
plugins.descZh: 为未配置的第三方 DeepSeek Harness 模型添加 models.dev 推理级别支持。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dsh-skill-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Skill Manager page in the DSH settings panel: browse system / user / workspace / preset skills, expand a skill to its file tree, view and edit files, import skills from a zip, and export or delete them (system skills read-only).'
plugins.descZh: DSH 设置面板内的「技能管理」页面：按系统 / 用户 / 工作区 / 预设浏览技能，展开技能查看文件树、查看和编辑文件，支持从 zip 导入技能，以及导出、删除（系统技能只读）。

plugins.name: alex04130/dsh-forge
plugins.descEn: 'Runtime extension suite for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session mailbox with wake cold-start, agent teams (captain + members + dependency task board + team_wait), subagent spawn policy with escalation approval, task-aware routing preset, plugin market, skill manager and runtime injector.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 扩展套件：跨会话邮箱与 wake 冷启动、代理团队（队长 + 成员 + 依赖任务板 + team_wait）、子代理派发策略（提权自动审批）、任务感知路由 preset、插件市场、技能管理器与运行时注入器。

plugins.name: AmeKrance/anan-thermal-monitor
plugins.descEn: Purple-white desktop pet that docks to the screen edge and shows real-time CPU, RAM, GPU and NVMe temperatures with hardware info.
plugins.descZh: 紫白桌宠悬浮球，贴边停靠实时显示 CPU/内存/GPU/NVMe 温度与硬件信息。

plugins.name: arrow949/dsh-turn-approval
plugins.descEn: 'Turn-scoped “Allow for this task” approvals: automatically allow matching `danger-full-access` escalations only for the current task, then expire.'
plugins.descZh: DSH「允许本次任务」临时授权：仅在当前任务内自动放行同类 `danger-full-access` 请求，任务结束自动失效。

plugins.name: baconbao/dsh-mermaid-image-preview
plugins.descEn: Preview Mermaid diagrams as images via local rendering in DSH Web when the chat message contains a Mermaid fenced code block, and also allow integration with external rendering servers.
plugins.descZh: 当 DSH Web 中的消息包含 Mermaid 语法时，通过本地渲染以图像形式预览 Mermaid Diagrams，并允许接入外部渲染服务器。

plugins.name: Boliban/dsh-enter-customizer
plugins.descEn: Take over the system input shortcuts for the chat input box and configure behavior independently for each shortcut.
plugins.descZh: 接管聊天输入框的回车等快捷键，每个快捷键的行为都能单独配置。

plugins.name: BotonJ/dsh-windtunnel
plugins.descEn: 'Contract regression harness for plugin authors: a scripted LLM adapter drives the real pipeline in isolated child processes with session-event assertions (load/contract/behavior/fault layers); zero API key, CI-ready.'
plugins.descZh: 插件作者的契约回归风洞：剧本适配器在隔离子进程中驱动真实管线，会话事件断言覆盖加载/契约/行为/故障四层；零 API key，可进 CI。

plugins.name: br1nosense/dsh-wxauto-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'WeChat automation for DSH: push task progress to WeChat, listen for messages with keyword auto-reply, and a WeChat ↔ DSH two-way bridge controllable from the settings page, built on wxauto4.'
plugins.descZh: '基于 wxauto4 的微信自动化插件：任务进度微信推送、消息监听（关键词自动回复）、微信⇄DSH 双向桥，设置页开关与配置。'

plugins.name: BrambleXu/dsh-revdiff
plugins.descEn: Native interactive Git diff review for DeepSeek Harness with structured annotations sent back to the current Agent session.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 原生交互式 Git diff 审查，支持结构化批注并回传当前 Agent 会话。

plugins.name: caoqinnan-web/organize-workspace-sessions
plugins.descEn: Organize DeepSeek Harness workspace sessions by renaming them as 类别｜主题 and reporting archive, rename, and review suggestions.
plugins.descZh: 整理 DeepSeek Harness 工作区会话，按 类别｜主题 重命名并给出归档、改名与待判断建议。

plugins.name: ChenLaoshiYF/dsh-mcpguard
plugins.descEn: Scans skills and MCP configs for prompt injection, homoglyphs, hidden Unicode, dangerous shell, and credential leaks.
plugins.descZh: 扫描 skill 与 MCP 配置中的提示注入、同形字、Unicode 隐形字符、危险 shell 与凭据泄露。

plugins.name: ChrisZhangWG/dsh-codex-meter
plugins.descEn: Adds a Settings Usage dashboard for DeepSeek API balance, official token and cost analysis, trends, context warnings, and live API activity.
plugins.descZh: 在设置中添加 DeepSeek API 用量仪表板，显示余额、官方 Token 与费用分析、趋势、上下文警告及实时 API 活动。

plugins.name: CWNU-Open-Source-Community/dsh-webgate
plugins.descEn: 'Remote access for the DSH Web GUI: LAN QR access, cloudflared quick tunnels, and frp reverse proxying via your own server, with a built-in auth portal.'
plugins.descZh: Web GUI 远程访问：局域网二维码直连、cloudflared 快速隧道、frp 自有服务器反代，内置登录门户，并放行设置接口。

plugins.name: Dariandai/dsh-starter-pack
plugins.descEn: 'A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.'
plugins.descZh: 精选插件启动包：从设置页或 /setup 命令一键批量安装并配置 4 组共 15 个经过筛选的社区插件。

plugins.name: duyanta123/dsh-data-insight
plugins.descEn: 'Turn raw data (CSV / pasted table / SQL results / DuckDB) into a structured Markdown report with business conclusions, metrics and charts.'
plugins.descZh: 把原始数据（CSV / 粘贴表格 / SQL 结果 / DuckDB）转成带业务结论、指标与图表的结构化 Markdown 报告。

plugins.name: dylan121322/llm-adaptive
plugins.descEn: 'Adaptive model routing: per-request complexity classification with automatic provider routing.'
plugins.descZh: 自适应模型路由：请求级复杂度分类，按配置链自动选择后端 provider。

plugins.name: Dylan37670/dsh-plugin-panel
plugins.descEn: In-app DSH plugin marketplace panel with curated and full catalogs, keyword and semantic search, Chinese translation, favorites, installed-state tracking, and install/update/uninstall via the official CLI.
plugins.descZh: DSH 内置插件市场面板：精选与全量目录、关键词与语义搜索、中文翻译、收藏、已安装状态，以及通过官方命令安装、更新和卸载。

plugins.name: Elohia/dsh-genome
plugins.descEn: 'Capability transform & assembly engine (Qian Xuesen cybernetics/systems framework): static resident layer manages the skill/MCP/plugin registries, auto-absorbs skills and tool metrics, and drives a negative-feedback evolution loop (scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select promote/reject → 30s rollback); includes a Web UI panel and a GitHub dsh-plugin store bridge.'
plugins.descZh: 能力转化与组装引擎（钱学森工程控制论/系统论框架）：静态常驻层管理 skill/MCP/插件三库、自动吸收技能与工具度量，驱动负反馈进化闭环（scan Sick/Weak → mutate → select 晋升/淘汰 → 30s 回滚）；含 Web UI 面板与 GitHub dsh-plugin 商店桥。

plugins.name: Eve-146T/DSH-CODEX-SUBSCRIPTION-POOL
plugins.descEn: Use your ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions in DSH, with image generation and web search support.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH 中使用你的 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，并支持图像生成和 Web 搜索。

plugins.name: FeatherHunter/dsh-prompt
plugins.descEn: 'Save every repetitive, tiresome templated prompt — one mouse click injects it into the composer and spares you the effort. 🌹'
plugins.descZh: '将一切重复、烦躁的模板化提示词保存下来，只需要鼠标点击就注入对话框，节省您的精力损耗🌹'

plugins.name: genius-alray/dsh-model-picker
plugins.descEn: 'Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.2+. Dialog-style model picker for the DSH Web UI: fuzzy search, collapsible provider groups, favorites with a favorites-only filter, and a thinking-level dropdown, replacing the built-in model selector with official UI primitives and DSW tokens.'
plugins.descZh: '需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2+。Web UI 模型选择器替换插件：对话框式选择，支持模糊搜索、供应商折叠分组、收藏与只看收藏过滤，以及思考档位下拉，复用官方组件库与 DSW 设计 token。'

plugins.name: GooodWei/arcana
plugins.descEn: A floating command deck that lists every slash command in DeepSeek Harness as runnable buttons, sorted by usage.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的悬浮命令甲板：把所有斜杠命令列成可执行按钮，悬停看介绍，按使用次数排序。

plugins.name: Han-1413141/dsh-ui-hub
plugins.descEn: 'UI butler for every plugin UI: official/plugin categories, per-widget toggles, drag move/resize, collision avoidance and one-click auto arrange.'
plugins.descZh: UI 管家：官方/插件 UI 分区折叠、逐条开关，拖拽移动/改大小，碰撞避让与一键自动排布。

plugins.name: hellosky983/dsh-fabric
plugins.descEn: 'Unifies every DSH extensibility seam behind one declarative DSL: a runtime `fabric` service, `fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` tools, and a capability-graph settings page.'
plugins.descZh: 用一套声明式 DSL 统一 DSH 的所有可扩展接缝：提供 `fabric` 运行时服务、`fabric_extend`/`fabric_inspect` 工具，以及能力图谱设置页。

plugins.name: hellosky983/dsh-foundry
plugins.descEn: Plugin compiler with a blueprint registry (scaffold → validate → deploy) exposed as a runtime service, three model tools, and a blueprint-gallery settings page.
plugins.descZh: 插件编译器：以运行时服务提供蓝图注册表（脚手架 → 校验 → 部署），配三个模型工具和一个蓝图画廊设置页。

plugins.name: hg1048596-pixel/dsh-recall-unread
plugins.descEn: Adds a strip above the composer to recall sent-but-unread (steering) text messages before the model reads them.
plugins.descZh: 在输入框上方提供「未读消息」条带，可在模型读取前撤回已发送但尚未被读取的文字消息。

plugins.name: hyper-dsh-plugins/dsh-open-eyes
plugins.descEn: Vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek routes that analyzes attached and local images through configurable OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, or Anthropic Messages endpoints while leaving image-capable routes native.
plugins.descZh: 为纯文本 DeepSeek 路由提供视觉桥接：通过可配置的 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions 或 Anthropic Messages 端点分析附件与本地图片，同时保持支持图片的路由走原生路径。

plugins.name: isheng-eqi/dsh-hermes-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 上 hermes-agent 记忆机制的忠实移植（MEMORY.md / USER.md）：有界双记忆库（2200/1375 字符）、单个 memory 工具（add/replace/remove/batch 全有或全无）、每会话冻结快照注入与 nudge 提醒、DSH 原生 JSON 存储——零外部依赖、零 LLM 成本。'

plugins.name: ishuowang/dsh-sideband
plugins.descEn: 'Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available.'
plugins.descZh: 无需等待或打断正在工作的 Agent：即时冻结有界 Session 快照，由隔离且无工具的 LLM 异步总结，再将带来源信息的上下文胶囊投递到另一 Session 或已授权 Room；对 Session 默认 quiet，也可显式 wakeup。

plugins.name: itr-del/dsh-feishu
plugins.descEn: Feishu (Lark) IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness via `dsh plugin add`; one DM user to one persistent dsh session, with full debugging docs.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的飞书/Lark 私聊桥接插件，支持 `dsh plugin add` 一键安装，配套完整调试文档。

plugins.name: izwarm195/dsh-net-tools
plugins.descEn: 'Lets sandboxed agents reach the web through your local proxy: net_fetch fetches pages, net_proxy_status reports proxy status.'
plugins.descZh: '让沙箱里的 agent 通过你的本地代理联网：net_fetch 抓取网页，net_proxy_status 查看代理状态。'

plugins.name: izz-BLUE/dsh-deepseek-usage-dashboard
plugins.descEn: 'DeepSeek API usage dashboard for DSH Web: daily cache-hit/miss and output token statistics from session logs, per-model cost estimates, account balance, 7-day trends, and a composer usage summary.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 的 DeepSeek API 用量仪表盘：基于会话日志统计每日缓存命中/未命中输入与输出 Token，并展示分模型费用估算、账户余额、7 日趋势和 composer 用量摘要。

plugins.name: jasondu/dsh-ui-mobile
plugins.descEn: Mobile-first DeepSeek Harness UI with an installable PWA, responsive navigation, and Web Push notifications when an agent completes successfully.
plugins.descZh: 面向手机的 DeepSeek Harness 界面，提供可安装 PWA、响应式导航，以及 Agent 成功完成时的 Web Push 通知。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-crosstalk
plugins.descEn: 'Cross-session messaging for DSH: any session on the machine can list and message any other, Claude Code-style, via a local heartbeat registry and inbox.'
plugins.descZh: 跨会话消息：本机任意会话都可像 Claude Code 一样列出并互发消息，基于本地心跳注册表与收件箱。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Cited memory over DSH''s lossless session log: distilled facts carry `(sessionId, eventRange)` citations that expand back to the exact original log excerpt.'
plugins.descZh: 基于 DSH 无损会话日志的引用式记忆：蒸馏出的事实带 `(sessionId, eventRange)` 引用，可随时展开回原始日志片段。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-skillport
plugins.descEn: 'Bring your existing Agent Skills (SKILL.md) library to DSH: discover skills across Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini paths, inject a progressive-disclosure index, and load bodies on demand.'
plugins.descZh: 把已有的 Agent Skills（SKILL.md）技能库带进 DSH：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录、注入渐进式索引，按需加载技能正文。

plugins.name: jilian-dsh/dsh-rules-manager#dsh-rules-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Rules, commands & skills manager for dsh: /rules slash command, settings panel with visual rule editing (add/edit/disable/delete, free-zone support), user-defined custom commands with {input} arguments, skill management, and automatic backup & one-click restore of AGENTS.md.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh 规则、命令与技能管理：/rules 斜杠命令、设置面板可视化编辑规则（增改禁用删除、自由区域支持）、带参数的自定义命令、技能管理、AGENTS.md 自动备份与一键恢复。'

plugins.name: jinhuoooo/dsh-prompt-polish
plugins.descEn: 'One-click ✨ polish button for the composer: rewrites prompts and drafts with WorkBuddy humanizer-style rules (kills AI-flavored phrasing, varies rhythm, mode-aware for instructions/questions/prose) via free Zhipu GLM-4.5-Flash or any OpenAI-compatible API, falling back to offline local rules.'
plugins.descZh: '输入框 ✨ 一键润色按钮：参考 WorkBuddy 润色（humanizer-zh）规则改写提示词与草稿（去除 AI 写作痕迹、调整句式节奏，按指令/提问/普通文本分类处理），默认使用免费的智谱 GLM-4.5-Flash，也支持任意 OpenAI 兼容 API，断网时回退到本地规则引擎。'

plugins.name: Kaixxrua/dsh-aigc-radar
plugins.descEn: 'Search AIGC Radar''s curated GitHub AI project library (500-star admission, bilingual zh/en tags, star-growth snapshots) over its MCP endpoint with native result cards; an agent/pre-step listener proactively suggests a reuse check before the agent writes code.'
plugins.descZh: '检索 AIGC Radar 精选 GitHub AI 项目库（500 Stars 准入、中英双语标签、星标增长快照），经其 MCP 端点调用并以原生结果卡片展示；agent/pre-step 监听器在 agent 动手写代码前主动建议复用检查。'

plugins.name: kam74515-boop/dsh-everything-oauth
plugins.descEn: Import local Codex, Grok, Claude, OpenCode, and CC Switch logins into DSH; pick sources and enable models in Settings.
plugins.descZh: 把本机 Codex / Grok / Claude / OpenCode / CC Switch 登录态导入 DSH，在设置里自选来源并启用模型。

plugins.name: KanoNoUta/dsh-captain
plugins.descEn: GPT plans dependency DAGs, DeepSeek workers execute tasks with adaptive parallelism, and an optional GPT reviewer audits incremental Git diffs and drives repair rounds.
plugins.descZh: GPT 规划依赖 DAG，DeepSeek Worker 自适应并行执行任务，可选 GPT Reviewer 审核增量 Git Diff 并驱动返工轮次。

plugins.name: kkkkkklze/dsh-plugin-manager
plugins.descEn: 'In-web plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: categorized plugin list, preset bundles with one-click switching, import/export and failure auto-rollback, plugin market with one-click install.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DeepSeek Harness 网页内管理插件：分类列表、预设整合包一键切换与导入导出、失败自动回退、插件市场一键安装。'

plugins.name: KLRSL/dsh-biomemory
plugins.descEn: 'Biomimetic memory system for DeepSeek Harness: a single SQLite store (node:sqlite, WAL) whose Markdown tree is kept as a read-only mirror; memory tools, frozen-snapshot injection at session start, graded approval gating, on-demand extraction of the current session, near-duplicate merging, an archive and supersede lifecycle, memory metabolism (dream), memory pins, semantic recall over local embeddings, and the /memory command.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的生物仿生记忆系统：以单一 SQLite 库为唯一事实来源（node:sqlite，WAL），Markdown 树仅作只读镜像；含 memory 工具、会话启动时的冻结快照注入、分级审批门、按需把当前会话抽取成记忆、近重复合并、归档与取代生命周期、记忆代谢（dream）、记忆钉、基于本地嵌入的语义检索，以及 /memory 命令。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-agent-preset-recommender
plugins.descEn: 'Bounded, privacy-safe local scanner for Codex, Claude Code, WorkBuddy, and CodeBuddy metadata: atomically aggregates keyed evidence and deterministically advises built-in DSH presets and optional capabilities—without content retention, network access, or preset mutation.'
plugins.descZh: 有界、隐私安全的本地扫描器：汇总 Codex、Claude Code、WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy 元数据，原子保存密钥化聚合证据，并确定性推荐 DSH 内置 preset 与可选能力；不保留正文、不联网、不修改 preset。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-image-gen
plugins.descEn: 'GPT Image 2 `image_gen` with Codex subscription OAuth by default or explicit API-key mode: developing card, up to three live API partials, durable attachment replay/lightbox/download, text-only model output, and bounded credential-safe requests.'
plugins.descZh: GPT Image 2 `image_gen`：默认复用 Codex 订阅 OAuth，也可显式使用 API Key；显影卡片、最多 3 张 API 实时局部图、持久附件回放/灯箱/下载、纯文本模型输出和受限的凭据安全请求。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-md-preview
plugins.descEn: 'Render Markdown to a standalone, self-contained HTML page: an `md_html_render` tool that works in a headless profile, plus a web drawer to browse, preview, edit and export local `.md` files; both share one renderer, with no runtime dependencies.'
plugins.descZh: 把 Markdown 渲染为自包含的独立 HTML 页面：提供在 headless 配置下同样可用的 `md_html_render` 工具，以及在网页端浏览、预览、编辑并导出本地 `.md` 文件的抽屉；两个入口共用同一个渲染器，无运行时依赖。

plugins.name: Limitinfinitude/DSH-Right-Sidebar
plugins.descEn: 'DSH Web right-side output dock: session-scoped tabs for reports, images, data, video, and audio, with inline previews, output quality checks, and a searchable per-turn history.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 原生右侧产物栏：按会话管理报告、图片、数据、视频与音频，提供内联预览、产物质检和可按轮次检索的历史目录。

plugins.name: linhx1999/dsh-writing-pad
plugins.descEn: Session-scoped Markdown writing pad docked beside the conversation, with edit/preview modes, selection-based AI rewrites, diff review, undo, and draft recovery.
plugins.descZh: 停靠在对话旁的会话级 Markdown 写作板，支持编辑/预览、选区 AI 改写、Diff 审核、撤销与草稿恢复。

plugins.name: linxichen/dsh-rigorquant
plugins.descEn: 'RigorQuant preset + skill pack: unattended walled multi-agent research for empirical and computational mathematics (economics, finance, portfolio), with a four-part pre-implementation check battery and a jacobian/Lean escalation lane.'
plugins.descZh: RigorQuant 预设与技能包：面向实证与计算数学（经济学、金融、组合）的无人值守隔离多智能体研究，内置四重实现前校验与 jacobian/Lean 升级通道。

plugins.name: litestartup-com/dsh-api-gateway
plugins.descEn: 'REST + SSE gateway exposing running Harness sessions to third-party clients: API-key auth, token streaming, workspace grouping, and adopting GUI sessions to keep chatting.'
plugins.descZh: 为第三方客户端提供 REST + SSE 网关：API 密钥鉴权、token 流式回包、会话工作区分组，并可接管 GUI 会话继续对话。

plugins.name: lonelymoon87/dsh-gitflow
plugins.descEn: Adds approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
plugins.descZh: 增加需要审批的 Git 状态、diff、日志、提交、分支和可选检查点工具。

plugins.name: lonelymoon87/dsh-specflow
plugins.descEn: Adds specification artifacts, skills, commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
plugins.descZh: 增加规格工件、技能、命令、由 goal 驱动的实施流程和任务进度上下文。

plugins.name: lovezi0/dsh-memory-palace
plugins.descEn: 'Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.'
plugins.descZh: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

plugins.name: lsz-asd/dsh-chameleon#bundle
plugins.descEn: 'Self-editing desktop workbench for DeepSeek Harness: a full dsh web replica with an edit mode in which the agent modifies the workbench (patch layers, plugins, UI) with hot reload.'
plugins.descZh: 可自修改的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面工作台：完整 dsh web 副本 + 编辑模式，agent 在对话中实时修改工作台（补丁层、插件、UI）并热更新生效。

plugins.name: lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-device-info
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only Windows device information tools: one agent tool per Win32 device category (time, system, cpu, memory, disk, gpu, network, battery, processes, usb, audio, printers) via WMI/CIM and Node os collectors.'
plugins.descZh: 只读的 Windows 设备信息工具：每个 Win32 设备类别一个 agent 工具（时间、系统、CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、网络、电池、进程、USB、音频、打印机），基于 WMI/CIM 与 Node os 采集。

plugins.name: lucky8197/dsh-git-hygiene
plugins.descEn: 'Git hygiene checker: read-only scan of merged and stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files and uncommitted work, with cleanup suggestions (it never deletes anything).'
plugins.descZh: Git 卫生巡检：只读扫描已合并/过期分支、大文件、未跟踪文件与未提交修改，输出体检报告与清理建议，不自动删除任何东西。

plugins.name: lucky8197/dsh-weekly-digest
plugins.descEn: 'Weekly digest generator: aggregates git commits, DSH session activity and daily memory entries into a Markdown weekly report, read-only.'
plugins.descZh: 周报生成器：聚合最近 N 天的 git 提交、会话活动与每日记忆，自动生成 Markdown 周报，全程只读。

plugins.name: luumod/dsh-achievements
plugins.descEn: 'Achievement and gamification plugin: unlock badges for turns, tool calls, sessions, daily streaks and coding behavior (edits/reads/tests), with a badge wall, unlock toasts and a ctx.achievements SDK.'
plugins.descZh: 成就与游戏化插件：按回合、工具调用、会话、连续天数与编码行为（编辑/读取/测试）解锁徽章，带徽章墙、解锁 toast 与 ctx.achievements SDK。

plugins.name: lynx-gt/dsh-subagent-tools
plugins.descEn: 'Per-call model, provider, persona, and toolFilter overrides for subagent delegation, with @preset: references and provider/model composite ids.'
plugins.descZh: '子代理委派的按调用覆盖：model/provider/persona/toolFilter、@preset: 引用与 provider/model 组合 id。'

plugins.name: mayf3/dsh-session-doctor
plugins.descEn: 'Diagnose, unstick, and read DSH sessions: list sessions with agent status, read conversations, diagnose stuck agents, recover them with cancel+keepInbox, and send messages to other sessions.'
plugins.descZh: 会话医生：列出会话（含 agent 运行状态）、读取会话记录、诊断卡死的 agent、解卡（cancel + keepInbox 保留排队消息）、向其他会话发送消息。

plugins.name: MicroHEROX/dsh-Kimi-WebBridge
plugins.descEn: 'Drive the user''s real browser through the local Kimi WebBridge daemon: navigate, find-tab, snapshot, click, fill, evaluate, CDP, screenshot, network, upload, PDF export and tab-management tools that reuse existing login sessions.'
plugins.descZh: 通过本地 Kimi WebBridge 守护进程驱动用户的真实浏览器：navigate、find-tab、snapshot、click、fill、evaluate、CDP、screenshot、network、upload、PDF 导出与标签管理工具，复用浏览器已登录会话。

plugins.name: MiraculousGarfield/dsh-ops-health
plugins.descEn: 'One-click health check for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar button runs the ops kit''s check-health.ps1 through a plain HTTP route (independent of the tool registry) and renders a structured report card; colors follow the active theme, Windows/PowerShell.'
plugins.descZh: 一键健康检查：侧边栏按钮经纯 HTTP 路由（独立于工具注册表）调用 check-health.ps1 并渲染结构化报告卡片；配色跟随当前主题，Windows/PowerShell。

plugins.name: moononnn/DeepSeek-Harness-biaoqingbao
plugins.descEn: 'Sticker/emoji expression for assistants: emotion-driven auto-matching, library management, AI image tagging, dialects, style mimicry, and chat-based tag refinement.'
plugins.descZh: 表情包表达插件：让助手用表情包表达情绪，按情绪自动配图，含图库管理、AI 识图打标、方言口音、学我说话，还能点「和助手聊聊」直接调教标签。

plugins.name: NagasakiSoyo-ui/dsh-llm-deepseek-vision
plugins.descEn: 'Vision-augmented DeepSeek adapter: a vision-capable model describes image input, then a text-only DeepSeek model reasons over the description.'
plugins.descZh: 视觉增强的 DeepSeek 适配器：由视觉模型把图片描述成文字，纯文本 DeepSeek 模型再基于描述推理。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-codex
plugins.descEn: 'ChatGPT Codex subscription chat: official OAuth, a Sol/Terra/Luna catalog with Fast rows, live usage limits, and optional search and view_image tools.'
plugins.descZh: ChatGPT Codex 订阅聊天：官方 OAuth 登录，Sol/Terra/Luna 目录含 Fast 行，实时额度，以及可选的搜索与 view_image 工具。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-usage-monitor
plugins.descEn: 'Settings usage dashboard: tokens, requests, output tokens, and cache-hit rate from session logs, with a stacked chart and a breakdown table by provider, model, or workspace.'
plugins.descZh: 设置页用量仪表盘：从会话日志汇总 token、请求、输出 token 与缓存命中率，含堆叠图，并按供应商、模型或工作区分组列表。

plugins.name: Nothree-code/folder-tree-sh
plugins.descEn: 'Workspace file tree for the Web UI: multi-tab preview (text/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/images), inline Markdown editing, a Git changes panel, and file operations (rename/delete/copy/move/create) via context menu.'
plugins.descZh: 工作区文件树插件：多标签预览（文本/DOCX/PDF/Markdown/CSV/图片）、Markdown 内联编辑、Git 变更面板与右键文件操作（重命名/删除/复制/移动/新建）。

plugins.name: Nothree-code/voco-input-sh
plugins.descEn: 'Voice input for the Web UI: a mic button that drives local VocoType offline speech recognition and auto-inserts recognized text into the composer (auto-deploy, dedupe, continuous dictation).'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框麦克风按钮驱动本地 VocoType 离线识别，识别结果自动插入输入框（自动部署/防重复/持续输入）。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/dsh-kb-sieve
plugins.descEn: Build auditable KB packs (SQLite FTS5) from md/txt/docx/pdf with deterministic retrieval and original-text reading.
plugins.descZh: 从 md/txt/docx/pdf 构建可审计知识库包（SQLite FTS5），确定性检索与原文阅读。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/ex-setting
plugins.descEn: Settings extensions for DSH.
plugins.descZh: DSH 的设置扩展。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/sandbox-mxc
plugins.descEn: Microsoft cross-platform sandbox support.
plugins.descZh: 微软跨平台沙盒支持。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/web-components
plugins.descEn: Web Components support.
plugins.descZh: Web Components 支持。

plugins.name: ook826092-cloud/dsh-mobile-css
plugins.descEn: 'Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: compact typography, full-width composer with caret fix, drawer sidebar with overlay-close, two-page settings flow, responsive tables and stats, safe touch targets.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：紧凑排版、全宽输入卡（含光标修复）、抽屉式侧边栏（点击遮罩关闭）、两页式设置流程、响应式表格与统计、安全触控目标。

plugins.name: p2coder/dsh-task-control
plugins.descEn: 'Pause / resume / cancel the in-flight conversation task from the composer area: forced pause interrupts immediately and remembers the interrupted tool, safe pause lands after the tool or reasoning finishes, resume asks for confirmation, and the default pause granularity is configurable in the settings.'
plugins.descZh: 在输入区暂停/恢复/取消正在运行的对话任务：强制暂停立即中断并记住被中断的工具，安全暂停等工具/推理完成后再落地，恢复时需确认；默认暂停粒度可在设置中配置（出厂 safe wait）。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-session-pin
plugins.descEn: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
plugins.descZh: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-skill-pack-security
plugins.descEn: 'Security-audit methodology skill pack plus the plugin_vet supply-chain gate: eight agent skills (secret scan, dependency audit, supply-chain review, prompt-injection review, audit orchestration, threat modeling, vuln intel, incident response) in Chinese and English editions, with an npm provider bundle that mounts the skills and registers the automated plugin_vet pre-install scanner.'
plugins.descZh: 安全审计方法论技能包 + plugin_vet 供应链门禁：八个 agent 技能（密钥扫描、依赖审计、供应链评审、提示注入审查、审计总编排、威胁建模、漏洞情报、事件响应），中英双版本，附 npm provider 包一键挂载并注册自动化 plugin_vet 安装前扫描。

plugins.name: PocketSWPU/dsh-serendipity
plugins.descEn: 'Turns the user into an RPG protagonist: after each finished user turn a random "adventure" may trigger, drawn from 700+ events across 7 themed pools (sci-fi, fantasy, ancient, anime, novels, wuxia, urban), growing six persistent attributes (strength, intelligence, agility, charisma, luck, vitality) with XP, levels and attribute-weighted story branches, configured via a settings-page UI.'
plugins.descZh: 把用户本人当作 RPG 主角：每轮对话结束后有几率触发随机「奇遇」，事件库 700+，覆盖科幻/玄幻/远古/动漫/小说/武侠/都市七大主题，增减力量/智力/敏捷/魅力/幸运/体魄六维属性，积累经验升级并随等级解锁更宏大的事件，含属性加权分支与设置页可视化配置。

plugins.name: polaris-smart/dsh-devices
plugins.descEn: 'Decentralized multi-device fleet: mDNS LAN discovery, key pairing, and SSH direct execution across networks.'
plugins.descZh: 去中心化多设备舰队：mDNS 同网发现、密钥配对、SSH 跨网直连指挥。

plugins.name: pyf2818/dsh-bili-widget
plugins.descEn: Floating Bilibili video mini-player for DSH — always-on-top window with discover/search/follow-UP channels, auto-playlist, mini & focus modes, persisted watch history and window minimize-to-ball.
plugins.descZh: DSH 里的 B站悬浮看片小窗：置顶窗口，含推荐/热门/排行/精选/关注/AI 频道与搜索，自动连播、迷你专注模式、历史持久化与最小化悬浮球。

plugins.name: Q1hangL/dsh-ask-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Cooperative timeout guard for ask_user_question: lost or unanswered questions resolve as a structured ASK_TIMEOUT instead of hanging the turn forever.'
plugins.descZh: 为 ask_user_question 提供协作式超时守卫：提问卡片丢失或用户未答复时以结构化 ASK_TIMEOUT 结束调用，避免回合无限挂起。

plugins.name: RexCue/dsh-wallpaper
plugins.descEn: 'Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: image background with opacity, mask and blur controls.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：图片背景，可调透明度、压暗遮罩与模糊。

plugins.name: Ricketts-Guo/dsh-shortcuts
plugins.descEn: 'Fully customizable keyboard shortcuts for the Web UI: 34 pre-registered features (sessions, views, clipboard, models, silent permission cycling, settings), one-click recording to bind your own, and a shortcut cheatsheet with built-in diagnostics.'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 可自定义键盘快捷键：34 个预置功能（会话、视图、剪贴板、模型、静默权限切换、设置），一键录制自定义组合键，内置快捷键速查表与诊断面板。

plugins.name: SamurAIGPT/dsh-plugin-muapi
plugins.descEn: 'MuApi media-generation tool: a muapi_generate tool that submits and polls jobs against any of MuApi''s 100+ image, video, audio, and 3D models through one x-api-key.'
plugins.descZh: MuApi 媒体生成工具：muapi_generate 工具通过一个 x-api-key 提交并轮询 MuApi 100 多个图片、视频、音频与 3D 模型的生成任务。

plugins.name: SamXiaBing/dsh-adb
plugins.descEn: 'ADB device & bench operations for DSH: device discovery, structured logcat (background streaming), apk install, file pull/push, and dumpsys performance snapshots.'
plugins.descZh: ADB 设备·台架运维工具集：设备发现、结构化 logcat（后台采集）、apk 安装、文件 pull/push、性能快照。

plugins.name: Semidia/dsh-session-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Right-click session menu and sidebar session manager: pin, rename, archive, fork, export, copy cwd/id/deep link, and open in explorer or a new window.'
plugins.descZh: 会话行右键菜单与侧边栏会话管理：置顶、重命名、归档、分叉、导出、复制工作目录/会话 ID/深链，在资源管理器或新窗口打开。

plugins.name: Sev7een/dsh-plugin-automations
plugins.descEn: Settings-based scheduled tasks that run on time or during DeepSeek off-peak hours, with one-time and daily schedules backed by durable task state.
plugins.descZh: 设置页定时任务：支持准点或 DeepSeek 谷时段执行、单次/每日重复，并持久化任务状态。

plugins.name: SingleOne/dsh-notify-center
plugins.descEn: Native desktop and webhook notifications for turn completions, failures, and approval requests, with outcome filters, content rules, privacy controls, and retrying delivery.
plugins.descZh: 回合完成、失败和待审批时发送跨平台本机通知与 Webhook，支持结果过滤、内容规则、隐私控制和失败重试。

plugins.name: songoao25/dsh-chatgpt-subscription
plugins.descEn: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH, using your Plus/Pro subscription quota.
plugins.descZh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定你的 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内直接使用 ChatGPT 模型对话，消耗 Plus/Pro 订阅额度。

plugins.name: superboy911/dsh-model-router
plugins.descEn: Deterministic keyword routing, allowlisted model switching, and an isolated image_gen channel for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descZh: DSH 关键词路由与隔离生图插件：确定性关键词路由、白名单模型切换与隔离的 image_gen 生图通道。

plugins.name: suuuuuu-1/dsh-discord
plugins.descEn: 'Discord-native remote controller for DeepSeek Harness: drive persisted coding-agent sessions from DMs, mention-gated guild channels, and threads, with slash commands, progress updates, approvals, structured questions, and image and text attachments.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Discord 原生远程控制器：通过私信、需提及机器人的服务器频道及 Thread 操作持久化的编程 Agent Session，并支持斜杠命令、进度更新、工具审批、结构化问题、图片和文本附件。

plugins.name: swaylq/dsh-digipet
plugins.descEn: 'Digimon-style raising game: hatch an egg that feeds on real work (turns, tool calls, errors) and evolves along four branching lines shaped by how you work; zero tokens, invisible to the model.'
plugins.descZh: 数码宝贝式养成：孵一颗吃真实工作长大的蛋（回合、工具调用、报错都是营养），按你的工作方式走四条进化分支；零 token，模型完全看不见。

plugins.name: Tlyer233/dsh-vscode-review#dsh-review
plugins.descEn: Records every agent write, edit and shell `rm` into a shadow git repository, then reviews them hunk by hunk in VS Code — accept or revert each one. Needs the companion dsh-review-vscode extension; the panel only appears inside VS Code's webview.
plugins.descZh: 把 agent 的每次写入、编辑和 shell `rm` 删除记录进一个 shadow git 仓库，然后在 VS Code 里逐 hunk 接受或撤回。需要配合 dsh-review-vscode 扩展；面板只出现在 VS Code 的 webview 里，独立浏览器中的对话界面不变。

plugins.name: txlznbzsdj-collab/dsh-deepseek-pet
plugins.descEn: 'Animated DeepSeek blue-whale desktop pet floating on the DSH Web page: draggable with speech bubbles and mood poses, a pet_say tool for the model to make it talk, and turn-start/end thinking and celebrating states.'
plugins.descZh: 浮动在 DSH Web 页面上的 DeepSeek 蓝色小鲸鱼桌宠：可拖拽，说话气泡与心情姿势随互动切换，模型可调用 pet_say 工具让它开口，对话开始/结束时自动进入思考与庆祝状态。

plugins.name: v587d/capital-generation
plugins.descEn: 'China A-share financial data MCP server for the harness: 11 fin_data__* tools (quotes/K-lines/financials/calendar/special-data/announcements/EDB/reconcile/funds/indices) over THS free official REST (primary) + AKShare (fallback) + Wind (exclusive domains), with observable degradation, context-budget compression (result-side -72.2% measured), and an offline 10-year market-data lake; BYOK.'
plugins.descZh: 中国 A 股金融数据 MCP server：11 个 fin_data__* 工具（行情/K线/财务/日历/特色数据/公告/EDB/对账/基金/指数），同花顺免费官方 REST 主干 + AKShare 兜底 + Wind 独家域，降级全程可观测；上下文压缩（实测结果侧 -72.2%）；离线 10 年数据湖；BYOK 零平台密钥。

plugins.name: vibeinging/dsh-agent-budget
plugins.descEn: Agent-tree token budget management.
plugins.descZh: agent 树 token 预算管理。

plugins.name: vibeinging/dsh-tool-search
plugins.descEn: Per-agent on-demand tool discovery and progressive schema disclosure.
plugins.descZh: 按 agent 的按需工具发现与渐进式 schema 披露。

plugins.name: vibeinging/dsh-trace
plugins.descEn: Telemetry backend exporting turns, model steps, and tool calls to yiTrace.
plugins.descZh: 遥测后端：把 turns、model steps、tool calls 导出到 yiTrace。

plugins.name: vibeinging/dsh-turn-navigator
plugins.descEn: Turn navigation for the DSH Web UI.
plugins.descZh: 对话轮次导航。

plugins.name: victorzhong0110/dsh-code-reference
plugins.descEn: Surveys local code and GitHub/npm for reusable implementations before development, evaluates reuse versus rewrite, and checks architecture coupling.
plugins.descZh: 在开发前检索本地代码与 GitHub/npm 的可复用实现，评估复用与重写成本，并检查架构耦合。

plugins.name: whitefirer/dsh-browser-fs
plugins.descEn: 'Give agents access to files on the machine where the browser runs: user authorizes a local directory via File System Access, tool calls relay over the plugin''s own WebSocket; read-only compat mode for mobile/insecure contexts.'
plugins.descZh: 让 agent 读写浏览器所在电脑上的文件：浏览器授权本地目录（File System Access），工具调用经插件自建 WebSocket 中继；移动端/非安全上下文自动降级只读兼容模式。

plugins.name: WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph
plugins.descEn: 'Dedicated read-only Git Graph view beside Chat and Trajectory: commit topology, local/remote/tag refs, HEAD and working-tree status, search, filtering, first-parent mode, refresh, and load more.'
plugins.descZh: Chat 和 Trajectory 旁的独立 Git Graph 视图：提交拓扑、本地/远程/tag 引用、HEAD 与工作区状态、搜索、筛选、首父模式、刷新和加载更多。

plugins.name: WJNCT55555/dsh-web-preview-float
plugins.descEn: 'Google AI Studio-style floating preview for the Web UI: a draggable/resizable iframe preview with aspect-ratio and resolution presets, plus a VS Code-style code window with direct editing, confirmed writes, and session-log recording.'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 悬浮预览与代码窗口：Google AI Studio 风格的 iframe 预览（宽幅比/分辨率预设、一键放大），VS Code 风格代码窗支持直接编辑，保存需确认并写入会话日志。

plugins.name: wqx-txdsyl/dsh-ds-attach
plugins.descEn: '**DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) same-style attachments**: paperclip upload button, 240×64 DS-style file cards with official colored doc icons (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPT/IMG extracted from the DS frontend bundle), drag-and-drop, text extraction (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT) injected into the message, and real attachment cards rendered in the transcript (custom user renderer) with the model reading full content.'
plugins.descZh: '**DeepSeek Chat（chat.deepseek.com）同款附件**：回形针上传按钮、240×64 DS 风格文件卡片（官方彩色文档图标，从 DS 前端 bundle 提取）、拖拽上传、文本提取（PDF/DOCX/XLSX/TXT）注入消息、对话流中渲染真实附件卡片（自定义 user 渲染器）且模型读取完整内容。'

plugins.name: wuxiangru915/dsh-review-loop
plugins.descEn: 'Incremental diff reviewer for DSH: after approving a batch, only new changes since the checkpoint are shown, with a Web review panel and `/review` command that inject feedback back to the agent.'
plugins.descZh: 增量代码审查插件：批准一批改动后只审查检查点之后的新改动，提供 Web 审查面板与 `/review` 命令，并把审查意见注入回 agent。

plugins.name: xiaoshihou514/dsh-tui
plugins.descEn: Clean and simple TUI.
plugins.descZh: 干净简单的终端交互式界面。

plugins.name: xiaozhe7772222/dsh-draw-router
plugins.descEn: 'Unified image generation router for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): auto-discovers image models from any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, provides draw_image and draw_list_sources tools, supports SenseNova, StepFun, Agnes, Qwen, Flux, SD, Imagen and more.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 统一绘图路由器：自动识别任意 OpenAI 兼容接口的绘图模型，提供 draw_image 和 draw_list_sources 工具，支持商汤、阶跃、Agnes、千问、Flux、SD、Imagen 等。'

plugins.name: xingyingyuzhui/dsh-session-actions
plugins.descEn: 'Session row menu extras for DeepSeek Harness: pin sessions, copy session id, export structured Markdown, and permanently delete sessions.'
plugins.descZh: 会话行菜单增强：置顶会话、复制会话 ID、导出结构化 Markdown、弹窗确认后永久删除会话。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-notify
plugins.descEn: Task-completion notifications via ServerChan / DingTalk / Feishu / generic webhooks.
plugins.descZh: 任务完成通知：ServerChan / 钉钉 / 飞书 / 通用 Webhook。

plugins.name: yangyongzhen/dsh-session-report
plugins.descEn: 'Per-session cost & usage report cards: tokens, cache hits, duration.'
plugins.descZh: 会话成本与耗时报表：tokens / 缓存命中 / 耗时。

plugins.name: YooRarely/dsh-open-explorer
plugins.descEn: 'Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH 会话标题和工作区菜单中添加按钮，用系统文件管理器打开当前 Workspace 根目录。'

plugins.name: Yvesgao/dsh-shortcut-creator
plugins.descEn: 'Create a one-click Windows desktop shortcut from the Settings page: a .cmd launcher + desktop icon for DeepSeek Harness or any local server, auto-opens the browser, with taskbar pin hints.'
plugins.descZh: 在设置页一键创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式：为 DeepSeek Harness 或任意本地服务生成 .cmd 启动器与桌面图标，自动打开浏览器、可固定任务栏。

plugins.name: YZz-S/dsh-token-cost-meter
plugins.descEn: Real-time session token usage and estimated cost in the composer stats row, with pricing fetched from DeepSeek official pricing page.
plugins.descZh: 在输入框下方统计行实时显示当前会话累计 token 消耗与估算费用（人民币），价格从 DeepSeek 官方价格页动态获取。

plugins.name: zimai233/dsh-exam-countdown
plugins.descEn: Query 64 Chinese exams (高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…) with rule-aware date math (2nd-Saturday, 1st-Sunday) and countdowns.
plugins.descZh: 查询 64 场中国考试（高考/考研/四六级/CPA/法考…）的规则日期（第二个周六、第一个周日）与倒计时。

plugins.name: zoahdev/dsh-github-release-radar
plugins.descEn: Track releases and stars of any public GitHub repository from inside dsh agents — no API key needed.
plugins.descZh: 让 dsh agent 直接查询任意 GitHub 公开仓库的 Release 与星标变化，无需 API Key。

plugins.name: zsxh1990/pr-genius
plugins.descEn: 'PR evaluation and improvement consultant: assesses PR success probability based on historical anti-patterns and success patterns, with one-click scoring and actionable suggestions.'
plugins.descZh: PR 评估和改进顾问：基于历史反模式和成功模式评估 PR 成功率，一键评分并提供可操作的改进建议。

plugins.name: 2008924/dsh-progress-viz#plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Real-time stage, ETA & cost dashboard for headless dsh tasks: turns the black-box session event stream into a live multi-task grid (cordis plugin + standalone local dashboard, no API calls).'
plugins.descZh: headless dsh 任务的实时阶段、ETA 与成本看板：把黑盒会话事件流变成实时多任务网格（cordis 插件 + 本地独立看板，零 API 调用）。

plugins.name: 777-Zen/dsh-capability-index
plugins.descEn: 'Pre-flight plugin-library index for DSH agents: injects per-step trigger-table hints into the runtime context so suitable installed plugins get used predictably instead of opportunistically.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH agent 的插件库起飞检查：向运行时上下文注入按步骤触发的提示，让合适的已装插件从「碰巧想起」变成「可预期使用」。'

plugins.name: 7dgroup-ai/dsh-skill-7d-git-commit
plugins.descEn: 'Checks git commit messages against the 7DGroup convention (Chinese type tags, length and punctuation rules) before committing, as a client-side guard before GitLab pre-receive hooks.'
plugins.descZh: '提交前按 7DGroup 规范校验 git commit message（中文类型标签、长度与标点规则），作为 GitLab pre-receive 钩子的客户端前置校验。'

plugins.name: 82c86b8z86-stack/dsh-engineering-workflow
plugins.descEn: 'Engineering workflow agent preset for dsh: five gated phases (requirements clarification, plan approval, TDD, parallel subagents, verified finishing) with six workflow skills adapted from obra/superpowers.'
plugins.descZh: 工程化工作流 agent preset：五阶段硬门禁（需求澄清、计划审批、TDD、子 Agent 并行、验证收尾），附 6 个改编自 obra/superpowers 的工作流技能。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-audit
plugins.descEn: 'Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.'
plugins.descZh: 插件生态体检：将 dsh-plugin 话题同步为本地评分目录（维护/文档/npm+周下载/生态四维，0-100 分 A-D 级），静态安全扫描高危一票否决，支持 star 历史快照、Web 榜单与 Agent 工具。

plugins.name: aerince/dsh-active-context-pruning
plugins.descEn: Model-authored context pruning for DeepSeek Harness through the official compaction API.
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的模型驱动上下文裁剪插件，通过官方 compaction API 释放上下文空间。

plugins.name: ai-eks/dsh-auth-tunnel
plugins.descEn: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
plugins.descZh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

plugins.name: AI-Galaxy-GPU/dsh-sound
plugins.descEn: 'Per-event sound notifications: turn completion, approval, question, plan-review, goal-blocked, and task-failure each get their own sound and volume, configurable in the Web UI (built-in synth, mute, or local audio file).'
plugins.descZh: 六类事件独立提示音：回合完成、审批、提问、计划评审、目标受阻、任务失败各有独立声音与音量，可在 Web 设置面板配置（内置合成音 / 静音 / 本地音频文件）。

plugins.name: aokamoaki/dsh-notify
plugins.descEn: 'Conversation-completion notifications for DeepSeek Harness: Windows toast + sound on turn done / error / goal, plus ask & approval alerts - background-only, with a volume-adjustable bell in the conversation header.'
plugins.descZh: 对话完成通知：回合完成/出错/目标完成/提问/审批时弹出 Windows toast 与提示音，仅后台提醒，会话头部铃铛即控制中心。

plugins.name: asdf17128/dsh-doctor
plugins.descEn: 'Registers a `config_doctor` tool that checks the harness''s own configuration for problems that boot silently: fields a patch dropped by whole-config replacement, patches targeting missing entry ids, and tool-name collisions. Read-only.'
plugins.descZh: 注册 `config_doctor` 工具，检查 harness 自身配置里那些会静默通过启动的问题：patch 整体替换 config 而丢失的字段、指向不存在 entry id 的 patch、工具重名冲突。只读。

plugins.name: asdf17128/dshp
plugins.descEn: Registers `list_profiles` and `export_profile`, so the agent can show what setups exist and hand back a whole profile — bundle order, plugin versions and patch — as one portable file to share. Read-only.
plugins.descZh: 注册 `list_profiles` 与 `export_profile`：让 agent 列出本机有哪些配置，并把整套 profile（bundle 顺序、插件版本、patch）导出成一个可直接分享的文件。只读。

plugins.name: Awesome-AI-Pedia/Awesome-DSH-Pet
plugins.descEn: Extensible desktop-pet plugin for the DSH Web GUI, with feed / play / character-switch menus and Codex 8x9 spritesheet characters.
plugins.descZh: DSH Web GUI 的可扩展桌面宠物插件，支持投喂、玩耍、切换角色，并使用 Codex 8x9 spritesheet 添加自定义角色。

plugins.name: ayahunter/dsh-plugin-clinic
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only health clinic for the installed DSH plugin set: loader health, dependency integrity, version compatibility, install-script risk, duplicates and patch integrity, delivered as a model tool, a Settings dashboard and JSON reports.'
plugins.descZh: 已安装 DSH 插件集合的只读体检诊所：加载健康、依赖完整、版本兼容、安装脚本风险、重复与 patch 引用，交付模型工具、设置面板与 JSON 报告。

plugins.name: ayingQAQ/dsh-web-launcher
plugins.descEn: Windows desktop launcher bundle for DSH Web that creates a managed shortcut, then restarts DSH in the background and refreshes the existing browser page.
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 的 Windows 桌面启动器插件，创建受管理的快捷方式，后续启动会在后台重启 DSH 并刷新已有浏览器页面。

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-galgame-generator
plugins.descEn: 'Galgame generator: give it a script document plus character/background/BGM/animation assets in the workspace (img_human/, img_bg/, audio/, img_cg/) and it builds a playable visual-novel web page with configurable save slots (`[存档 N]`, default 9), speaker-following sprites with multi-pose variant switching (`[表情]`), opening/ending/CG animations (`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`), BGM play/stop/volume control, and if-line branching.'
plugins.descZh: 'Galgame 生成器：提供剧本文档与立绘/背景/音乐/动画素材（工作区 img_human/、img_bg/、audio/、img_cg/）即可生成可玩视觉小说网页，支持可配置存档槽位（`[存档 N]`，默认 9）、立绘自动跟随说话人并切换多表情立绘（`[表情]`）、开局/结束/CG 动画（`[op]`/`[ed]`/`[cg]`）、BGM 播放/停止/音量控制与 if 条件线分支。'

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-omni-bridge
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-channel IM bridge for DeepSeek Harness: route WeChat (ClawBot/iLink), QQ, and Feishu (Lark) chat messages to a DSH agent and relay its replies back, with per-channel sessions and reply dedup.'
plugins.descZh: 多通道消息桥接插件：将微信 ClawBot / QQ / 飞书的消息接入 DSH agent，并把回复回传给发送者，按通道独立会话、回复去重。

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-session-mover
plugins.descEn: "Move a session to another workspace by dragging it onto the target workspace header in the sidebar: the session is cloned with full history into the target workspace and the original is archived."
plugins.descZh: "在侧边栏把会话直接拖到其他工作区的标题行即可移动：目标工作区生成携带完整历史的新会话，原会话归档。"

plugins.name: baisama-cloud/dsh-stt-input
plugins.descEn: 'Speech-to-text voice input for the web UI: a mic button in the composer transcribes speech into the draft via the browser Web Speech API (zero-config) or an OpenAI-compatible Whisper API (OpenAI / Groq), with a selectable model and language in Settings.'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 语音输入：输入框旁麦克风按钮语音转文字填入输入框；支持浏览器 Web Speech API 本地识别（零配置、无需密钥）与 OpenAI 兼容 Whisper API（OpenAI/Groq），模型与语言可在设置中选择。

plugins.name: bill9109/dsh-conversation-share
plugins.descEn: Share any excerpt of a conversation.
plugins.descZh: 分享任意段落的对话。

plugins.name: Bob-Bo1/dsh-stock-watch
plugins.descEn: 'Local-first A-share portfolio and watchlist monitor for DSH: sidebar quotes, holdings P&L, browser add/edit/delete, and JSON persistence.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 本地优先的 A 股持仓与自选监控：侧栏行情、持仓盈亏，以及网页添加、修改、删除和 JSON 保存。'

plugins.name: bpc-oss/chrome-faithful#dsh-plugin-chrome-faithful
plugins.descEn: 'Exact-profile control of your real logged-in Chrome browser: an MCP server plus MV3 extension and authenticated localhost bridge for tabs, locators, file injection, media export, and durable scroll capture, with no debug profile or remote-debugging port.'
plugins.descZh: 按精确 Profile 名控制你真实已登录的 Chrome 浏览器：MCP 服务器 + MV3 扩展 + 认证本地桥接，提供标签页、定位器、文件注入、媒体导出与持久滚动采集，不使用调试 Profile 或远程调试端口。

plugins.name: BrambleXu/dsh-prompt-profile
plugins.descEn: Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness with per-turn model selection, argument substitution, and state restoration.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 可复用 Markdown Prompt Profile，支持单轮模型选择、参数替换和状态恢复。

plugins.name: bx33661/dsh-omv
plugins.descEn: 'Evidence-first vulnerability research workbench for DeepSeek Harness: native audit views, 29 OMV tools, Evidence.v1 findings, reproducible runs, Campaign workflows, and isolated PoC evidence.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先漏洞研究工作台：原生审计视图、29 个 OMV 工具、Evidence.v1 Finding、可复现 Run、Campaign 工作流和隔离 PoC 证据。'

plugins.name: caisiyang123/dsh-tick-rail
plugins.descEn: 'Tick-rail conversation navigator: one tick per message you sent, a lit peak that follows the mouse with an even falloff, hover previews, click or keyboard to jump.'
plugins.descZh: '会话刻度线导航条：你发的每条消息一格刻度，点亮峰值随鼠标移动、两侧均匀衰减，悬停预览消息摘要，点击或键盘跳转到对应位置。'

plugins.name: changingwang/dsh-stage-gate
plugins.descEn: 'Stage-gate governance tools: model-callable gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close for in-memory, per-session acceptance checks with PASS/BLOCK conclusions.'
plugins.descZh: '阶段门治理工具：模型可直接调用的 gate_open / gate_check / gate_list / gate_close，为多阶段工作提供内存态、按会话隔离的验收核对与通过/阻塞结论。'

plugins.name: Cheng-cheng9669/dsh-deepseek-vision
plugins.descEn: 'Reuses DeepSeek web''s built-in vision mode for text-only models: the deepseek_vision tool drives the local deepseek-vision-cli browser automation (manual login helper, deep-think enabled, auto-closes browser) and returns image descriptions as text.'
plugins.descZh: 复用 DeepSeek 网页端识图模式给纯文本模型补上看图能力：deepseek_vision 工具调用本地 deepseek-vision-cli 浏览器自动化（手动登录助手、自动开启深度思考、用后自动关窗），把图片描述以文字返回给模型。

plugins.name: ChengxiuCDP/dsh-plugin-advisor
plugins.descEn: 'Quality-aware in-agent plugin discovery: a find_dsh_plugins tool that ranks the whole dsh-plugin topic through a daily quality-scored index (installable manifest, curated listing, license, activity) merged with a live gh search — zero LLM API cost, risk flags and exact install commands in every result.'
plugins.descZh: 质量感知的会话内插件发现：find_dsh_plugins 工具基于每日更新的质量评分索引（可安装声明 / 精选收录 / 许可证 / 活跃度）对 dsh-plugin topic 全量排序，并叠加实时 gh 搜索——零 LLM API 成本，每条结果附风险徽章与精确安装命令。

plugins.name: chengzhi43/dsh-file
plugins.descEn: 'VS Code-style file manager: browse the conversation workspace in a sidebar tree and edit files in the center column with Monaco, with theme import/export and Markdown preview.'
plugins.descZh: VS Code 风格文件管理器：侧边栏文件树浏览当前对话工作区，中间列用 Monaco 编辑文件，支持主题导入导出与 Markdown 预览。

plugins.name: Chhlafiu4312/dsh-mcp-bridge
plugins.descEn: Zero-dependency MCP client bridge that connects stdio and HTTP MCP servers and registers their tools as mcp_<server>_<tool> for the agent.
plugins.descZh: 零依赖 MCP 客户端桥接，连接 stdio 与 HTTP MCP server，把其工具注册为 mcp_<server>_<tool> 供 agent 调用。

plugins.name: ClaireXi99/dsh-data-insight
plugins.descEn: 'Data analysis toolkit: CSV/TSV/JSON profiling, IQR and z-score anomaly detection, structured summarization with quality issues, and code-free filter/group/aggregate queries.'
plugins.descZh: 数据分析工具包：CSV/TSV/JSON 数据画像、IQR 与 z-score 异常检测、带质量问题提示的结构化摘要、以及无需写代码的筛选/分组/聚合查询。

plugins.name: CN-Leo/dsh-deepseek-balance
plugins.descEn: Real-time DeepSeek account balance in the composer dock, auto-refreshing every 15 seconds with hover details.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web 输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，每 15 秒自动刷新，悬停查看总额、赠送与充值明细。

plugins.name: cookiesheep/whale-on-desk
plugins.descEn: Pixel-art whale desktop companion with 29 frame-audited states — taps the glass and flashes the tab title when an approval waits, speaks a completion report when a turn ends, and adds a slash-command palette to the web client.
plugins.descZh: 像素鲸鱼桌宠,29 个逐帧验收状态:等批准时贴屏敲玻璃并让标签页标题闪烁,任务完成开口汇报,并为 web 端提供斜杠命令面板。

plugins.name: Coprexist/dsh-session-recovery
plugins.descEn: Recover deleted or corrupted dsh sessions (session.jsonl.zstd) and memory (memory.db) from the raw disk, and repair rebuilt sessions that fail to resume via the /session-repair command in the web UI.
plugins.descZh: 从原始磁盘恢复被删除或损坏的 dsh 会话（session.jsonl.zstd）与记忆库（memory.db），并通过 web 界面中的 /session-repair 命令修复重建后无法续接的会话。

plugins.name: DeLightor/dsh-depguard
plugins.descEn: 'Dependency-topology guard: pre-install conflict prediction and post-install detection of duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-* copies, version drift, and vendored core services that cause Symbol-key crashes like "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading ''prepare'')".'
plugins.descZh: 依赖拓扑安全：装前预测 + 装后检测 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 多副本、版本漂移与插件私包，防 Symbol 键冲突崩溃（Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')）。

plugins.name: Dely0/dsh-personal-workbench
plugins.descEn: 'Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.'
plugins.descZh: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

plugins.name: dhb861832993-star/pbr-render
plugins.descEn: 'PBR 3D model preview for game art: GLB/GLTF with textures, IBL environment lighting, orbit controls, and a material channel inspector (baseColor/normal/roughness/metallic/AO/emissive/wireframe); scalar channels shown as grayscale per PBR spec, via the pbr3d fence and pbr_render tool.'
plugins.descZh: 游戏美术 PBR 3D 模型预览：GLB/GLTF 带贴图纹理、IBL 环境光照、轨道控制，以及材质通道检查器（基础色/法线/粗糙度/金属度/AO/自发光/线框），标量通道按 PBR 规范以灰度显示，通过 pbr3d 围栏与 pbr_render 工具使用。

plugins.name: doncelee229-cmyk/dsh-plugin-approval-alert
plugins.descEn: 'Native OS notifications for approval and question/plan prompts: the toast names the workspace, click jumps to it, bilingual (zh-CN/zh-TW/en), with chime.'
plugins.descZh: 审批与选择方案的系统级桌面通知：通知显示所属工作区、点击跳转到对应工作区，多语言（简中/繁中/英文），附提示音。

plugins.name: Elohia/dsh-plugin-mm-vision
plugins.descEn: 'Synesthesia Encoder for DSH: a vision model translates images into compact structured spatial text (canvas/elements/percentage coordinates), giving text-only LLMs pixel-level image understanding via the `mm_vision` tool.'
plugins.descZh: 通感编码器（Synesthesia Encoder）：调用视觉模型把图片翻译成紧凑的结构化空间文字（画布/元素/百分比坐标），让纯文本 LLM 获得像素级看图能力（`mm_vision` 工具）。

plugins.name: EvilIrving/dsh-proof
plugins.descEn: 'Independent read-only acceptance layer: spawns a read-only verifier before each top-level turn closes and steers non-pass gaps back into the agent.'
plugins.descZh: 独立只读验收层：顶层 turn 收尾前 spawn 只读 verifier，未通过时把缺口注回主 agent。

plugins.name: EvilIrving/dsh-repro
plugins.descEn: '/repro exports a minimal, secret-scrubbed, replayable problem bundle: the session log, failed commands, and Git diff.'
plugins.descZh: /repro 导出最小可复现问题包：去 secret 的会话日志、失败命令与 git diff。

plugins.name: falser101/dsh-mascot
plugins.descEn: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
plugins.descZh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

plugins.name: february2015/dsh-taskswarm
plugins.descEn: 'DSH port of TaskPlane: dependency-ordered waves run in parallel git-worktree lanes, with task packets, cross-model review, and crash recovery.'
plugins.descZh: TaskPlane 的 DSH 移植版：按依赖分波、多 lane 并行执行（git worktree 隔离），任务包 + 跨模型评审 + 崩溃可恢复。

plugins.name: fengMax1997/dsh-line-select
plugins.descEn: 'Line-range selection: browse workspace files, preview code with line numbers, visually select a line range, and write a `@path:start-end` reference into the composer; the agent receives the exact selected lines on send.'
plugins.descZh: 行选区：浏览工作区文件、带行号预览代码、可视化选中行范围，一键把 `@path:start-end` 引用写入输入框，agent 发送时自动收到所选行原文，精准修改指定行。

plugins.name: fieldnote-ops/keyringseam
plugins.descEn: macOS Keychain credential provider that replaces the local-file provider and uses a signed, notarized universal helper.
plugins.descZh: macOS Keychain 凭据提供器：替换本地文件提供器，并使用已签名、公证的通用二进制辅助程序。

plugins.name: fire-disposal/dsh-mojibake-interceptor
plugins.descEn: 'Mojibake guard bundle for DSH: feature-based garbled-text detection before writes with review-then-release (an identical retry passes), plus pre-execution pwsh encoding audit (ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/Default), Windows and Chinese first.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 乱码拦截器 bundle：写入前特征值/编码回环检测乱码并复查放行（原样重试即通过），pwsh 写入编码执行前审计（ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/默认编码），Windows 与中文场景优先。

plugins.name: FleetingEcho/dsh-handoff
plugins.descEn: 'Self-maintaining handoff memory per working directory and git branch: records turns, folds them into concise Markdown, and injects the result into future sessions from ~/.agent/agent-handoff, byte-compatible with pi-handoff.'
plugins.descZh: 每个工作目录与 git 分支自动维护 handoff.md：记录回合、折叠为简洁 Markdown 并注入后续会话，存储于 ~/.agent/agent-handoff，与 pi-handoff 字节级兼容。

plugins.name: FleetingEcho/dsh-powerdesk
plugins.descEn: 'A dockable IDE workbench for the DSH web UI: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer over a Rust PTY), a CodeMirror editor, a file explorer, notes, a sandboxed browser, and ripgrep content search.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 界面的可停靠 IDE 工作台：GPU 加速终端（restty 渲染器 + Rust PTY）、CodeMirror 编辑器、文件浏览器、笔记、沙箱浏览器，以及基于 ripgrep 的内容搜索。'

plugins.name: FuncWei/dsh-wechat-mp-studio
plugins.descEn: "WeChat Official Account content studio: anti-homogenization rotation writing, low-creativity remediation playbook, blessing-image visual baseline, gpt-image pipeline with OCR acceptance, and the measured xiaolvshu draft web API."
plugins.descZh: "微信公众号内容生产工作台：防低创作度结构轮换写作法、低创作度整改实战、祝福图视觉基线、gpt-image 配图管线与 OCR 验收、小绿书草稿网页接口实测参数。"

plugins.name: genius-alray/dsh-mermaid-render
plugins.descEn: 'Mermaid diagram renderer for the Web UI conversation: renders mermaid code blocks into interactive cards (zoom, fit-width, fullscreen viewer, preview/code toggle) with official UI primitives, and keeps the original code block with an inline error banner when rendering fails.'
plugins.descZh: Web UI 对话 mermaid 渲染插件：将消息中的 mermaid 代码块渲染为可交互图表卡片（缩放 / 适应宽度 / 全屏查看 / 预览代码切换），复用官方组件原语，渲染失败时保留原代码块并内联展示错误。

plugins.name: gloryxpnv/dsh-tool-vision
plugins.descEn: 'Local-first structured vision for text-only agents: images go to a local OpenAI-compatible VLM and come back as JSON evidence (summary, verbatim OCR, layout regions, entities/relations, colors, explicit uncertainty), with anti-hallucination fallback and an optional paste/upload bridge; zero cloud cost, images never leave the machine.'
plugins.descZh: 本地优先的结构化视觉插件：图片交给本地 OpenAI 兼容 VLM，返回 JSON 证据（摘要、逐字 OCR、版面区域、实体/关系、配色、显式不确定项），带反幻觉回退与可选粘贴/上传桥；零云端成本，图片不出本机。

plugins.name: GPIOX/dsh-api-balance
plugins.descEn: 'Floating API-balance badge for DeepSeek Harness: live balance for DeepSeek, Moonshot, OpenAI and custom endpoints; draggable, resizable, frosted-glass look, with text color adapting to the content beneath.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 悬浮 API 余额徽章：实时显示 DeepSeek / Moonshot / OpenAI / 自定义接口余额；可拖动缩放、亚克力质感、文字颜色随下方内容明暗自适应。

plugins.name: guo6x/dsh-housekeeper
plugins.descEn: 'Environment housekeeper for the agent: toolchain inventory (node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/browsers), scratch/cache scan with whitelist-guarded one-click cleanup, and the machine rules file (AGENTS.md) editor - all in the Web GUI settings.'
plugins.descZh: agent 的环境管家：工具链台账（node/pnpm/git/gh/ffmpeg/浏览器）、缓存与临时目录扫描 + 白名单安全一键清理、机器规则（AGENTS.md）编辑，全在 Web GUI 设置面板。

plugins.name: hajimimaodie8/DSH-Session-Sync
plugins.descEn: Bidirectionally synchronize sessions, workspaces, settings and plugins between the DSH web instance and the DSH Desktop instance.
plugins.descZh: 双向同步网页版与 DSH Desktop 桌面版之间的会话、工作区、设置与插件。

plugins.name: Hua1Q1nG/dsh-prompt-self
plugins.descEn: Rewrites each request against a learned prompt profile and automatically updates habits, anti-hallucination rules, and learning records.
plugins.descZh: 按学习到的 Prompt 画像改写每个请求，并自动更新习惯清单、防幻觉规则与学习记录。

plugins.name: huasheng33991/dsh-power-button
plugins.descEn: 'One-click start/stop button pinned to the window bottom-right corner: restarts DeepSeek Harness in place via a detached helper that relaunches the exact boot invocation (loopback same-origin guarded), with an optional stop-only action.'
plugins.descZh: 固定在窗口右下角的一键启停按钮：通过脱离终端的辅助进程按原始启动命令重启 DeepSeek Harness（仅本机同源可调），附「仅停止」小按钮。

plugins.name: huxint/dsh-team
plugins.descEn: 'Agent teams: spawn named long-lived teammates, coordinate them with a shared task list, member mailbox, and virtual workspaces, and watch the team live in a team-room tab.'
plugins.descZh: 'Agent 团队：派生具名常驻队友，用共享任务列表、成员邮箱与虚拟工作区协作，并在协作室页签里实时观察团队。'

plugins.name: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#rss
plugins.descEn: 'Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。'

plugins.name: hyzyn/dsh-plugin-kit#search
plugins.descEn: 'Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。'

plugins.name: ICCuse/dsh-knowledge
plugins.descEn: 'Bridge into a global Markdown knowledge base shared with the Codex kb.cmd CLI: kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline tools with byte-compatible frontmatter.'
plugins.descZh: 全局知识库桥：kb_add/kb_search/kb_show/kb_timeline 读写与 Codex 共享的 D:\knowledge（格式逐字节兼容）。

plugins.name: ICCuse/dsh-pain-point-check
plugins.descEn: 'Enforced pain-point gate: after two non-converged experiments it injects the three questions, denies non-investigative tool calls until answered, and blocks same-direction retries.'
plugins.descZh: 强制痛点检查：同一问题连续 2 个实验未收敛后注入三问、拦截非调查类工具调用直到答出、阻止同方向重试。

plugins.name: jackma5477001/dsh-system-monitor
plugins.descEn: Displays real-time CPU and memory usage for the machine running the DSH Web server.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web 界面右上角实时显示运行 DSH 服务端机器的 CPU 与内存使用情况。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-docker
plugins.descEn: 'Typed, guarded container control: ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop and compose up/down with JSON output, project-aware targeting, and approval-gated destructive ops.'
plugins.descZh: 类型安全、带护栏的容器控制：ps/logs/inspect/exec/start/stop 与 compose up/down，JSON 输出、项目感知定位、破坏性操作需审批。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-plugin-manager#cli
plugins.descEn: 'The `dsh pm` plugin manager: multi-source search (awesome list + GitHub + npm), install/remove/update per profile, and a doctor audit of manifests, bundle patches, and version drift.'
plugins.descZh: '`dsh pm` 插件管理器：多源搜索（awesome 列表 + GitHub + npm）、按 profile 安装/移除/更新，以及 doctor 审计（清单、bundle patch、版本漂移）。'

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-routines
plugins.descEn: 'Scheduled agents on a cron: run a prompt on a schedule and get the digest where you already are, with overlap/missed-run/timeout safety defaults.'
plugins.descZh: 定时 Agent：按 cron 计划运行 prompt，把摘要送到你已有的地方，内置重叠/漏跑/超时安全策略。

plugins.name: Jesse-njx/dsh-voice
plugins.descEn: 'Voice notes in, spoken answers out: dictate audio that becomes user messages (transcribe), have the agent read replies aloud (speak), local-first under ~/.dsh/voice.'
plugins.descZh: 语音输入、语音输出：把口述音频转写为用户消息（transcribe），让 agent 朗读回复（speak），本地优先，音频存于 ~/.dsh/voice。

plugins.name: jiayan-xu/dsh-memoria
plugins.descEn: 'Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.'
plugins.descZh: 向量+图记忆后端：observe/remember/search/recall 四个工具对接本地 memoria 服务，HNSW 语义召回 + FTS5 关键词 + 知识图谱信号经 RRF 融合排序，回合结束自动写入，按 Agent 命名空间隔离。

plugins.name: jihongboo/dsh-apple-mode
plugins.descEn: 'Xcode AI integration for DSH: 26 Xcode MCP tools (mcpbridge) + Apple platform skills + Xcode Intelligence-style persona (agent preset or global bundle).'
plugins.descZh: DSH 的 Xcode AI 集成：26 个 Xcode MCP 工具（mcpbridge）+ Apple 平台技能 + Xcode Intelligence 风格 persona（agent preset 或全局 bundle）。

plugins.name: jingzhao-l/iterate-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Turns the iterate skill into an autonomous closed-loop harness — plan, parallel review, atomic fixes, validate, loop, auto-stop — plus a dry-run review-only mode and a meta-review that audits the report and emits a final review report.'
plugins.descZh: '把 iterate 技能跑成自主闭环：规划、并行审查、原子修复、验证、循环、自动停止，并支持纯评审的 dry-run 模式与元评审最终报告。'

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/spec-driven
plugins.descEn: 'Spec-driven development discipline for dsh: five keel skills (anchor/spec/probe/build/audit), three review tools and six spec templates enforce specs-before-code, assumption verification and scope control.'
plugins.descZh: '规格驱动开发纪律技能包（keel）：五个技能（锚定/立规/探针/建造/审计）、三个审查工具与六个规格模板，强制先规格后代码、假设先行验证并约束范围蔓延。'

plugins.name: JohnXu22786/worktree-mgr
plugins.descEn: "Per-task isolated git worktrees with a full create/sync/finish lifecycle: task names auto-derive branches, merge targets are double-checked, and batch cleanup is built in — zero manual git operations."
plugins.descZh: "按任务隔离的 git worktree 工作区，覆盖创建/同步/收尾全生命周期：任务名自动派生分支、合并目标双重校验、内置批量清理——全程零手工 git 操作。"

plugins.name: JonyChan1350/dsh-llm-balance
plugins.descEn: Multi-provider LLM API balances under the chat input, with presets for DeepSeek, OpenRouter and SiliconFlow.
plugins.descZh: 聊天输入框下方显示多个 LLM API 账户余额，内置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、SiliconFlow 预设。

plugins.name: jorinyang/dsh-clawshell
plugins.descEn: 'Self-healing runtime layer: a resource control loop with strategy switching and repair escalation, error-storm and fiber-failure insight, cross-session knowledge carry-over, a self-healing dashboard and 7 tools.'
plugins.descZh: 运行时自愈层：资源控制闭环（策略切换 + 修复升级链）、错误风暴与 fiber 失败洞察、跨会话知识传承，附自愈可视化面板与 7 个工具。

plugins.name: Juryorca/dsh-custom-theme-import
plugins.descEn: 'DSH Web skin manager for mainstream DSH skin packages: import local paths or GitHub collections, scan installed skins from the web profile, preview/use/disable/refresh/delete, with host-side persistence.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 皮肤管理器：支持主流 DSH 皮肤包本地/GitHub 导入、扫描已安装皮肤、预览/使用/禁用/刷新/删除，宿主持久化。'

plugins.name: kanchengw/dsh-mindseye
plugins.descEn: 'Plug-in vision for text-only models on DSH, with native interaction for image understanding and generation, GUI automation, through layered evidence memory and cache.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH 上的纯文本模型提供视觉插件：通过分层证据记忆与缓存，实现图片理解与生成的原生交互及 GUI 自动化。

plugins.name: keke050/dsh-wallpaper
plugins.descEn: 'Wallpaper skin for the DSH Web UI: presets, image URL or upload, and an opacity slider that fades the interface to reveal the wallpaper.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 壁纸皮肤：预设 / 图片 URL / 本地上传，透明度滑块让整面界面透出壁纸。

plugins.name: kelearns/dsh-token-usage
plugins.descEn: 'Token usage heatmap for the Web UI: daily/weekly/cumulative views over a 12-month window with light/dark themes.'
plugins.descZh: Token 用量热力图：日/周/累计视图，12 个月窗口，支持深浅色主题。

plugins.name: kexuejin/dsh-zhihu-dashboard
plugins.descEn: 'Zhihu (知乎) dashboard: hot list with trend arrows, follow feed (favorites/creations/followees), post tracking (question/keyword/person) with auto-briefs, and five agent tools (zhihu_search/hot/answer/global_search/followees).'
plugins.descZh: 知乎面板：热榜（带趋势标记）、关注动态（收藏/创作/关注的人）、帖子追踪（问题/关键词/关注的人，支持自动创意简报），并提供 5 个对话工具（zhihu_search / hot / answer / global_search / followees）。

plugins.name: keyiadiannao/dsh-power-button
plugins.descEn: 'A small self-contained power control for DSH: sidebar power button with an upward restart/shutdown menu and a Windows-shutdown-style overlay. Own restart & shutdown engine (no dependency on other plugins), dynamic-port aware.'
plugins.descZh: 一个小而自洽的 DSH 电源控制插件：侧边栏电源按钮 + 上拉「重启/关机」菜单 + Windows 关机风格过渡遮罩。自带重启/关机引擎（不依赖其它插件），动态端口适配。

plugins.name: kimiya1010/dsh-plugin-market
plugins.descEn: 'A plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: search and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugin plugins straight from the web GUI.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：在 Web 界面里搜索并一键安装 GitHub 上的 dsh-plugin 插件。

plugins.name: kinmat-A/dsh-theme-switch
plugins.descEn: 'One-click skin switching for DSH Web settings: auto-detects installed themes, keeps exactly one active at a time, and falls back to the official look when all are off. Changes apply instantly and survive restarts.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 主题切换：自动检测已安装的皮肤/主题，在设置页一键互斥切换，全部停用时回退官方默认外观，切换即时生效并跨重启保留。

plugins.name: KLRSL/dsh-packer
plugins.descEn: 'Agent config packer for DeepSeek Harness: pack local agent assets (skills/sessions/profiles/settings/memory) into a zip for migration or sharing, with privacy scanning, diff-based restore, pack management, and a settings UI; memory ships as a read-only Markdown mirror, not the live database.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Agent 配置打包器：把本地 Agent 资产（Skills/会话/Profile/全局设置/记忆）打包成 zip，用于迁移或分享；带隐私安全扫描、差异恢复、包管理与设置 UI；记忆以只读 Markdown 镜像入包，不含运行时数据库。

plugins.name: kouyichi/dsh-tui-app
plugins.descEn: 'Interactive terminal chat app for dsh: streaming conversation, tool cards, jobs panel, full-text search, trajectory replay, multi-session tabs, and A2A dispatch (Ink-based).'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh 交互式终端聊天应用：流式对话、工具卡片、任务面板、全文搜索、轨迹回放、多会话标签与 A2A 派发（Ink 实现）。'

plugins.name: l541402398/dsh-file-uploads
plugins.descEn: Upload arbitrary local files from the Web composer, show pending cards, and manage stored files in Settings.
plugins.descZh: 从 Web 输入框上传任意本地文件，以待发送卡片展示，并在设置中管理已存文件。

plugins.name: LaoYueHanNi/dsh-git-worktree
plugins.descEn: Branch switching and isolated git worktrees as real workspaces, from the Web UI composer.
plugins.descZh: 在 Web 输入框切换分支、以真实工作区方式创建隔离的 git worktree。

plugins.name: LCQ-1024/dsh-prompt-enhancer
plugins.descEn: Adds a prompt-enhancement button to the DSH composer that rewrites drafts into agent-ready prompts.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH 输入框添加提示词增强按钮，将草稿改写为可直接交给 Agent 执行的提示词。

plugins.name: Leeminjing/dsh-eyes
plugins.descEn: 'On-demand vision for text-only DeepSeek models: upload images, and the model calls a view_image tool backed by any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (Qwen/DashScope by default).'
plugins.descZh: '为纯文本 DeepSeek 模型提供按需视觉：上传图片后，模型通过 view_image 工具调用任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点（默认 Qwen/DashScope）。'

plugins.name: Leeminjing/dsh-messages-sanitizer
plugins.descEn: Auto-repairs the messages array after a tool-dispatch crash (orphaned tool_calls / tool messages), preventing 400 INVALID_REQUEST session lock-ups.
plugins.descZh: 工具调度崩溃后自动修复 messages 数组（孤儿 tool_calls / tool 消息），防止 400 INVALID_REQUEST 会话卡死。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/agent-loop-workflow
plugins.descEn: 'A project-agnostic multi-agent collaboration protocol for the DeepSeek Harness: loop guards that stop runaway agent loops, a six-field handoff format, risk-tiered review routing, and a fixed verify→commit→push→review→close sequence. One skill instead of the same rules copy-pasted into every agent''s instructions.'
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness、与具体项目无关的多智能体协作协议：阻止失控循环的循环守卫、六字段交接格式、按风险分级的评审路由，以及固定的验证→提交→推送→评审→关闭流程。用一个 skill 取代复制粘贴进每个 agent 指令里的相同规则。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-fleet-audit
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only agent-fleet credential hygiene audit: credential-file permissions, embedded credentials in git remotes (masked in output), and provider token literal counts; zero-dependency and deterministic.'
plugins.descZh: 只读的 agent 机群凭据卫生审计：检查凭据文件权限、git remote 内嵌凭据（输出脱敏）与 provider token 字面量计数；零依赖、确定性。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/dsh-session-search-pro
plugins.descEn: 'Search, list and read past and current sessions through the harness''s own `sessionQuery` service: uses the SQLite FTS5 index where a deployment enables it, and falls back to a bounded newest-first scan where it does not.'
plugins.descZh: 通过 harness 自带的 `sessionQuery` 服务搜索、列出、读取历史与当前会话：部署启用了 SQLite FTS5 索引时走索引，未启用时回退到有上限的倒序扫描。

plugins.name: LeslieWylie/review-workflow
plugins.descEn: 'A structured multi-panelist review workflow for the DeepSeek Harness: N panelists score in isolated subagents, blind to each other; a chair reconciles disagreement by anchor match then Δ-level adjudication; an independent critic audits the process. Works for design, code, paper or project review.'
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的结构化多评审人评审工作流：N 个评审人在相互隔离、彼此不可见的 subagent 中独立打分；一名 chair 先按锚点匹配、再按 Δ 级别裁决来调和分歧；一名独立的 critic 负责审计整个评审过程。适用于设计、代码、论文或项目评审。

plugins.name: lilyblessing/dsh-mcp-skill-panel
plugins.descEn: 'MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible.'
plugins.descZh: 'MCP 与技能管理面板：设置页面板实时启停 MCP 服务器与 Skill 释放上下文占用；可选 AI 中间层（mcp_search/mcp_call）按需调用停用服务器，按 server 状态过滤模型可见性（用户打开的保持可见）。'

plugins.name: linhut/dsh-stock-terminal
plugins.descEn: 'Stock market skin + real-time ticker plugin for DSH Web GUI: candlestick (K-line) popup with day/week/month periods, watchlist with pinyin fuzzy search, portfolio P&L tracker, trading session indicators, support for A-share/HK/US/crypto/forex.'

plugins.name: LIU20030725/dsh-skill-manager
plugins.descEn: Manage and organize your agent skills by category, tags and collections in DeepSeek Harness, with a settings panel and a slash-command folder picker.
plugins.descZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按分类、标签和集合文件夹管理你的 agent 技能，自带设置面板与输入框文件夹技能挑选器。

plugins.name: ljsysfurryACE/dsh-aura-scheduler
plugins.descEn: 'Proactive scheduling: an adaptive heartbeat plus a value network (urgency, relevance, interruption cost) decides when the agent should speak unprompted.'
plugins.descZh: 主动调度：自适应心跳 + 价值网络（紧迫度、相关性、打断代价）决定 Agent 何时主动开口。

plugins.name: lonelymoon87/dsh-guardian
plugins.descEn: Adds dangerous-operation policy checks, output redaction, and a security-review workflow.
plugins.descZh: 增加危险操作策略检查、输出脱敏和安全审查工作流。

plugins.name: lucky8197/dsh-code-smell
plugins.descEn: 'Code smell radar: statically scans TODO/FIXME debt, stub implementations, long lines, oversized files and duplicated blocks, with severity-sorted read-only fix suggestions.'
plugins.descZh: 代码气味雷达：静态扫描 TODO/FIXME 债务、未实现桩、超长行、大文件与重复代码块，按严重度输出修复建议，全程只读。

plugins.name: lucky8197/dsh-doc-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Document-code consistency guard: audits version headers / changelog tables / directory trees / module & test counts / cross-doc references for drift, with severity-sorted, read-only fix suggestions.'
plugins.descZh: 文档与代码一致性守护：版本号/更新记录表/结构树/模块清单/测试计数/交叉引用漂移审计与修复建议，全程只读。

plugins.name: magicOF2/dsh-chat-width-customizer
plugins.descEn: Session-header button that cycles the conversation width (748-1600px), widening the chat column, composer, and user bubbles together.
plugins.descZh: 会话标题栏按钮循环切换对话宽度（748–1600px），消息区、输入框、用户气泡同步加宽。

plugins.name: magicOF2/dsh-turn-marks
plugins.descEn: 'Left-edge turn-marks strip in chat: one bar per user message, click to jump to that message, hover for a preview, active bar turns white.'
plugins.descZh: 会话左侧消息标记条：每发一条消息多一根条条，点击跳转到该消息、悬停预览内容，当前消息对应的条条变白。

plugins.name: MangMax/dsh-themes
plugins.descEn: 'Look & theme plugin for the DSH Web UI: built-in palettes, light/dark/follow-system appearance modes, Open VSX theme search & install, and VS Code theme import with a persisted theme library.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web UI 外观与主题插件：内置调色板、明 / 暗 / 跟随系统外观模式、Open VSX 主题搜索导入与 VS Code 主题导入，主题库持久化。

plugins.name: marvin9551/dynamic-schulte-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Dynamic Schulte grid waiting-time mini-game: click 1..N in order on a static grid or a spinning roulette wheel while the model thinks.'

plugins.name: mexiaosqwq/want-a-init
plugins.descEn: 'Model-driven /init command: the agent analyzes the current repo and generates/updates a high-signal AGENTS.md, with a persistent system-prompt reminder to keep it maintained.'
plugins.descZh: 模型驱动 /init 命令：让 agent 分析当前仓库并生成/更新高信号 AGENTS.md，并通过常驻 system prompt 提醒持续维护。

plugins.name: miisaka19800/dsh-restart-fab
plugins.descEn: 'Floating restart button for the DSH web GUI: restarts the dsh process in place with a full-screen overlay and auto-reloads the page; no launcher script required, works on Windows/macOS/Linux.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 网页界面右下角的一键重启按钮：全屏遮罩原地重启 dsh 进程并自动刷新页面；无需启动脚本，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。

plugins.name: miku00039-01/dsh-whale-pet
plugins.descEn: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

plugins.name: mingzeng21/dsh-notion
plugins.descEn: 'Connect dsh to Notion via the official Notion MCP (OAuth + PKCE): search, read, and write pages, databases, and comments through `mcp__notion__*` tools.'
plugins.descZh: 通过官方 Notion MCP（OAuth + PKCE）把 dsh 连接到 Notion：通过 `mcp__notion__*` 工具搜索、读写页面、数据库与评论。

plugins.name: MJorgin/dsh-agent-conductor
plugins.descEn: 'Dispatch self-contained tasks from DSH to 11 external agent CLIs (Codex, Claude Code, TraeCode, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, Kimi, Qwen, Copilot, WorkBuddy, Grok): a host-only bundle registering the conductor_dispatch tool plus an auto-triggered conductor skill.'
