plugins.name: 1321928757/dsh-prompt-polish
plugins.descEn: 'Input-bar prompt optimizer: rewrites drafts with 6 strategies × 3 languages plus custom instructions, optional goal/todo/compaction-summary/tool-result and chat context, a confirm dialog, last-5 history and three-tier settings persistence.'
plugins.descZh: 输入栏提示词优化：6 种策略 × 3 种语言与自定义指令重写草稿，可选携带目标、任务清单、压缩摘要、工具结果与聊天上下文，附结果确认弹窗、最近 5 次历史与三级设置持久化。

plugins.name: 133563825as-ai/dsh-api-dashboard
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita and xAI under the composer, estimated per-session and per-subagent cost with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, automatic discovery of relays configured in DSH settings, and an optional draggable whale widget.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web GUI 的多平台 API 余额与用量看板：在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阶跃星辰、硅基流动、MiniMax、OpenRouter、Novita、xAI 的余额，估算本会话与子代理消耗并按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价，自动发现 DSH 设置里已配置的中转站，另有一个可拖拽的大肥鱼挂件。'

plugins.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-anatomy-panel
plugins.descEn: 'Anatomy panel for the Agent-Body organs: serves a live vitals dashboard at /anatomy inside the harness itself - organs, heartbeat, healing ledger, self-training counters and the real pulse stream - read straight from the runtime files rather than retyped. Host-only, no client bundle and no build step.'
plugins.descZh: 'Agent-Body 器官的解剖面板：在 harness 内部的 /anatomy 提供实时体征看板——器官、心跳、自愈账本、自训练计数与真实脉冲流，数据直接读自运行时文件而非誊写。仅 host 端，无客户端 bundle、无构建步骤。'

plugins.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-cortex
plugins.descEn: "The memory organ of Agent-Body: after 2 minutes of silence it enters light sleep and after 5 minutes deep sleep, where deterministic rules distil real experience into memory cards (pitfalls, playbooks, hotspots, unresolved issues, facts). Incoming commands recall related cards by keyword and inject them into context; cards unused for long decay on a half-life and are archived rather than deleted. It also de-noises body-wide homeostasis warnings: repeats inside a window are counted instead of re-printed, and a warning that keeps recurring without ever healing converges into a known steady-state offset and goes quiet. Consolidation and recall make no model calls."
plugins.descZh: "Agent-Body 的记忆器官：静默 2 分钟进浅睡、5 分钟进深睡，深睡里用确定性规则把真实经历压成记忆卡（坑/打法/薄弱环节/未解决/事实），新命令进来按关键词召回并注入上下文；久未使用的卡按半衰期衰减后归档而非删除。同时对全身的稳态告警做降噪：窗口内重复只计数不刷屏，反复出现且从未自愈的收敛成已知稳态偏移并静默。巩固与召回都不调用模型。"

plugins.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-organism
plugins.descEn: "The organ kernel of Agent-Body: plugins organized as one body. Each command is turned into a nerve impulse that deterministically innervates the organ which should handle it and names the capability to use; a heartbeat with a variable interval (faster on alerts, slower when idle) pumps operator directives, proprioception and homeostasis warnings system-wide; reflex arcs fire with zero model calls; failures go through deterministic attribution (missing tool / arguments / permission / timeout / network), a prescription, and a re-check loop, with argument errors never auto-retried. A missing organ is compensated by the one with the highest capability overlap, and tool schemas are gated by the current intent (84.7% measured reduction, reproducible in-repo). This entry is the kernel plugin package inside the agent-body repository."
plugins.descZh: "Agent-Body 的器官内核：把插件组织成一具身体。命令先被转成神经冲动、确定性地支配到该处理它的器官并指明用哪个能力；心跳按内环境变速（告警加快、静默放慢）把指令、本体状态与告警打包泵向全身；反射弧零模型调用、命中即执行；失败走确定性归因（缺工具/参数/权限/超时/网络）加处方与复检闭环，参数错误不自动重试。器官缺失时按能力重叠自动代偿，工具 schema 按当前意图显影（仓库内实测省 84.7%）。本条目是 agent-body 仓库中的内核插件本体。"

plugins.name: 1420079678-ctrl/agent-body#dsh-zero-residence
plugins.descEn: 'Zero-residence context engine: large tool payloads are evicted out of the live context into a queryable store and only deterministic pointers are left behind, so per-turn prompt tokens stop growing with the transcript. Any masked content is reconstructed verbatim from the session log on demand, by tool-call id or session seq.'
plugins.descZh: '零驻留上下文引擎：把体积大的工具输出从活跃上下文驱逐到可查询存储，只留下确定性指针，于是每轮的提示词 token 不再随对话长度增长。被遮蔽的内容可随时从会话日志逐字重建，按工具调用 id 或会话 seq 定位。'

plugins.name: 1497105876/dsh-text-inject
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a "Text Injection" section to the DSH Settings sidebar: user-maintained blocks in a standalone Markdown file are injected into the system prompt every turn or into session context with keyword gating, with hot reload and automatic history backups.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH 设置页左侧栏新增「文字注入」分区：独立 Markdown 文件中的文字块可注入系统提示词（每轮生效）或会话上下文（关键词门控、去重），支持热加载与自动历史备份。'

plugins.name: 1569126506-sudo/dsh-team-cost
plugins.descEn: 'Team cost captain: meters every model call (subagents included), attributes each call to a member by workspace rules, prices it with the built-in DeepSeek 2026-09 catalog (peak/off-peak, CNY/USD) or user overrides, and appends it to a local JSONL ledger. Adds hot-reloadable member budgets, 80%/100% webhook alerts, optional over-budget enforcement, a team_cost_report tool with CSV export, and a settings-page team dashboard served over a Typert RPC service.'
plugins.descZh: '团队成本管家：按成员/工作空间计量每次模型调用的 token 与费用（含子代理），内置 DeepSeek 2026-09 价目表与自定义价格覆盖，成员预算热更新、阈值 Webhook 告警、可选超支拦截，提供成本报表工具与 CSV 导出，并在设置页提供团队成本看板。'

plugins.name: 173787247/dsh-wsl-eventlog
plugins.descEn: Read recent Windows event log entries from WSL, filtered by log name, level, provider and time window.

plugins.name: 173787247/dsh-wsl-expose

plugins.name: 173787247/dsh-wsl-git

plugins.name: 173787247/dsh-wsl-github

plugins.descZh: 探测 WSL 内的 nvidia-smi 与 GPU 可见性。

plugins.name: 173787247/dsh-wsl-helm
plugins.descEn: Read-only Helm list / status / history.
plugins.descZh: Helm 只读：list / status / history。

plugins.name: 173787247/dsh-wsl-im
plugins.descEn: 'Bridges Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Slack, Discord, Telegram and Mattermost into dsh agents (outbound WS/Stream/Gateway/long-poll/webhook), with im_status, optional local Whisper ASR, plain-text outbound for QQ/DingTalk/Telegram/Mattermost, and env CSV allowlists (DSH_IM_*_ALLOWED_USER_IDS). plugins.descEn: "Route conversation-compaction calls to a chosen summarizer model in the Web settings page, and retry them on a configured fallback model when the primary ends in an error."
plugins.descZh: "在 Web 设置页里为会话压缩指定摘要模型，并在主模型出错时改用配置的兜底模型重试。"

plugins.name: 6mt/dsh-plugin-loopback-trust
plugins.descEn: 'Restores Host-persisted settings when dsh web is reached through a reverse proxy on a non-loopback hostname: marks the page connection as host-owning so the Settings and model pages load instead of reporting "settings are unavailable in this browser". For dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x.'
plugins.descZh: '反向代理域名访问 dsh web 时恢复设置页的 Host 持久化：将页面连接标记为宿主可信，设置与模型页正常加载，不再报 "settings are unavailable in this browser"。适用于 dsh 0.1.7 – 0.2.x。'

plugins.name: 764475881/dsh-chat-width
plugins.descEn: 'Drag-to-resize the chat content width in the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a handle on the column right edge overrides the built-in 748px width (default 1040px, 520-2400 range, persisted per browser, double-click resets).'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供可拖拽的聊天内容宽度：文字列右缘的把手覆盖内置的 748px 宽度（默认 1040px、范围 520~2400、按浏览器记忆，双击恢复默认）。'

plugins.name: 778672151/dsh-session-turn-eta
plugins.descEn: 'Live progress bar under the composer with a percentage and an estimated time left for the current DeepSeek Harness turn; the estimate re-anchors as the turn runs and never reads 100% until the turn ends, and the bar turns red when the turn fails or is interrupted.'
plugins.descZh: 在输入框下方显示当前这一轮 DeepSeek Harness 任务的实时进度条、百分比与预计剩余时间；估计随轮次实时重锚，任务失败或中断时进度条变红。

plugins.name: 7starsseeker/dsh-fact-check
plugins.descEn: 'Skill that fact-checks a claim against the open web rather than model memory: it splits the claim into independently checkable fact points, routes each point to the primary-source ladder for its domain (policy, academic, medical, financial, disaster and accidents, food safety, science, education, sports, entertainment, judicial, and more), searches domestic and international ecosystems in parallel, fetches primary pages, grades sources by type, re-searches with debunking keywords, and reports conclusion-first with a full URL and citation position behind every statement, keeping unverified and undecidable points separate from confirmed ones. Three factual judgements can be routed to a TypeSafe Jev (System One) decision model when a key is configured, falling back to the skill''s deterministic rules when it is not; a model verdict can only lower a confidence tier.'
plugins.descZh: '事实核查技能：不依赖模型记忆，去公开互联网核实——把论断拆成可独立验证的事实点，先按事实范畴（政策、学术、医疗、金融、灾害事故、食品安全、科学常识、教育考试、体育、娱乐名人、司法案件等）选定该范畴的一手来源阶梯，国内外信息生态并行搜索，抓取一手页面并按来源类型分级，再用质疑关键词反查一轮，最后结论先行地输出报告，每条论断都带完整 URL 与引用位置，「未证实」「无法裁定」与「已证实」分档呈现。三类事实判断在配置了密钥时可交给 TypeSafe Jev（System One）决策模型，未配置则回退到内置的确定性规则；模型的判断只能降档、不能升档。'

plugins.name: 7starsseeker/dsh-jev-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Pre-execution safety valve for DSH that judges with TypeSafe Jev: it hooks tools/pre-execute and decides every bash/pwsh call by first applying offline static rules, then by asking the Jev model — the System One model from TypeSafe, which returns a structured decision instead of prose — one yes-no question ("will this command irreversibly delete or overwrite real data?"), turning the answer into allow, revise, block or escalate; revise hands the model a safer rewrite, escalate offers a one-shot human token; exhausted credit or a missing API key degrades loudly instead of failing silent, and a missing key is requested in the conversation itself (`guard key set`, read from stdin); every verdict is appended to a shared audit log and the text people read is bilingual zh-CN/en.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 执行前安全阀门，用 TypeSafe Jev 模型做判定：挂载 tools/pre-execute，对每条 bash/pwsh 调用先过离线静态规则，再向 Jev 模型（TypeSafe 的 System One 模型，返回结构化判定而非散文）提一个是非问句——「这条命令会不可逆地删除或覆盖真实数据吗？」——把答案切成允许／修正／拦截／上报人工四态；修正给模型更安全的写法，上报提供一次性人工令牌；额度耗尽或没有可用密钥时大声降级而非静默失效，缺密钥时会直接在对话里要求录入（录入用 `guard key set`，只从标准输入读）；每条判定写入共享审计日志，面向人的文案中英双语。'

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-memory-setup
plugins.descEn: 'Local, auditable personal memory for DeepSeek Harness: preferences, project conventions, workflows and error lessons persisted as a changelogged JSON file in the workspace, with onboarding, auto project-convention extraction and evidence-backed lessons.'
plugins.descZh: 解决 AI 金鱼脑：本地可审计的个人记忆层——偏好、项目约定、工作流与纠错教训，以带变更日志与完整性校验的 JSON 持久化在工作区，支持一次性设置、项目约定自动提取、证据化教训与快照恢复。

plugins.name: 863683348/dsh-plugin-scorecard
plugins.descEn: 'Quality & security scorecard for the DSH plugin ecosystem: sync the dsh-plugin topic catalog, audit any plugin (0-100, A-D, security veto), rankings, search, and historical score curves with a workspace-persisted catalog.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 插件生态体检评分卡：同步 dsh-plugin 目录，对任意插件做质量与安全审计（0-100 分、A-D 等级、安全一票否决），榜单、搜索与历史评分曲线（目录持久化）。

plugins.name: 9087/dsh-diff-approval
plugins.descEn: 'Pending-change review for DeepSeek Harness: every `edit`, `write` and `str_replace_editor` change is collected automatically into the file list, where a single change block, the blocks within a selection, or the whole file can be kept or reverted, and undo/redo is supported. It imports the workspace''s version-control changes, shows the diff in a single-column or side-by-side view, and provides a Markdown preview in which changes can also be kept or reverted, in-file search, block jumping and copyable line references; the diff data is stored persistently, so the review continues after a restart.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的待处理改动审查：每次 edit/write/str_replace_editor 改动都会自动汇总到文件列表，可对单个差异块、选区内的多块或整个文件执行保留/回退，支持撤销重做。还能导入工作区的版本控制改动，以单栏或左右对照视图展示差异，并提供亦能保留/回退差异的 Markdown 预览、文件内搜索、差异块跳转与可复制的行号引用；差异数据持久化存储，重启后可继续审查。'

plugins.name: 988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-a11y-scan

plugins.descZh: "原生 WCAG 无障碍扫描工具：对本地 HTML / 构建产物 / URL 运行 axe-core，输出规则 id、impact、WCAG 2.1 映射、元素定位与修复建议（Markdown/HTML/JSON），只读可进 CI。"

Two further tabs list what is already installed and which of those have a newer version in the catalog, with an update button on each row. The update view reports installed plugins whose update status cannot be determined, and overlapping install requests are refused. The catalog is cached locally for an hour with a mirror, a CDN and the npm registry as fallbacks when the official source is unreachable.'

plugins.name: a792883583/dsh-cron-panel
plugins.descEn: "Scheduled tasks panel for managing DSH agent and system crontabs with natural language input and execution logs."
plugins.descZh: "定时任务面板：分区管理 DSH 与系统 crontab、自然语言生成表达式、执行日志与完成后消息推送。"

plugins.name: a792883583/dsh-git-panel
plugins.descEn: "Git sidebar panel with commit graphs, ahead/behind tracking, branch operations, and one-click chat context injection."
plugins.descZh: "Git 侧边栏面板：提交图谱、超前/落后跟踪、分支操作及改动 Diff 一键带入对话。"

plugins.name: a792883583/dsh-message-gateway
plugins.descEn: "Multi-platform message gateway and WeCom AI bot bridge with session context compression and smartsheet creation."
plugins.descZh: "多平台消息网关与企微智能机器人桥接：会话自动压缩持久化与智能表格一键创建。"

plugins.name: a792883583/dsh-smart-reminder
plugins.descEn: "Smart calendar and checklist assistant with lunar dates, macOS/Windows native notifications, and WeCom push."
plugins.descZh: "智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。"

plugins.name: a86582751/dsh-nexttavern
plugins.descEn: 'Roleplay workspace for DeepSeek Harness: import SillyTavern/TauriTavern character cards or author one from scratch through an interactive flow; turn a long TXT novel into a playable card with either an intensive or a coarse reading pass; the main agent consults worldbooks on demand, and prose is read in a dedicated tavern reader tab; explore multiple worldlines inside one conversation (regenerate, edit-and-send, explicit clone); scoped style presets with 16 built-in styles, a character agent cluster, a standalone decision card, and card or novel export; long stories hold together through a frozen settings prefix, a hard-cut context window, traceable director notes and keyword/semantic/hybrid recall, with embeddings either online or fully local. Targets Harness 0.1.2-alpha.3 and applies its documented compatibility patches.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DeepSeek Harness 的角色扮演工作台：人物卡可以导入（SillyTavern／TauriTavern），也可以从零交互式写出一张；长篇 TXT 能改编成可玩的角色卡，精读或粗颗粒度两种读法；主代理按剧情主动查阅世界书，正文在独立的酒馆阅读 TAB 中呈现；同一对话里探索多条世界线（重新生成、改后发送、显式分支）；带作用域的文风预设（16 种自带文风）、角色 Agent 集群、独立决策卡，以及角色卡或小说导出；长篇由固定设定前缀、硬切上下文窗口、可追溯导演笔记与关键词／语义／混合检索撑住，嵌入可用在线服务，也可完全本地运行。面向 Harness 0.1.2-alpha.3，安装需按文档应用显式兼容补丁。'

plugins.name: "A8Chann/dsh-pet-live2d#dsh-live2d-pet"
plugins.descEn: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
plugins.descZh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

plugins.name: a903067276-rgb/dsh-perm-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-approval permission guard: a middle tier between workspace-write and danger-full-access — auto-allows safe operations inside trust directories, always asks a human for destructive ones, with 11 per-category switches and an audit trail.'
plugins.descZh: '自动审批权限守卫：介于 workspace-write 与 danger-full-access 之间的中间档——信任目录内安全操作自动放行，危险操作一律人工确认；11 个分类开关可调，自带审计记录。'

plugins.name: a981008/dsh-switch
plugins.descEn: Mirrors cc-switch providers and models into DeepSeek Harness the moment they are saved, and shows each provider's plan windows, account balance, or custom usage script in the composer and the settings card.
plugins.descZh: 把 cc-switch 的供应商与模型在保存的瞬间镜像进 DSH，并在输入框和设置卡片里显示各供应商的套餐窗口、账户余额或自定义用量脚本的结果。

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-antigravity-oauth"
plugins.descEn: "Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk."
plugins.descZh: "提供独立账户存储的非官方 Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth 接入，存在封号风险。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-auto-review"
plugins.descEn: "Adds Auto-review and Approve for me modes for DSH tool calls."
plugins.descZh: "为 DSH 工具调用提供 Auto-review 和 Approve for me 模式。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-autoresearch"
plugins.descEn: "Creates, runs and monitors persistent research experiment loops from the DSH Web UI."
plugins.descZh: "在 DSH Web 界面创建、运行和监控可持久化的研究实验循环。"

plugins.name: aa2246740/dsh-better-display
plugins.descEn: 'A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.'
plugins.descZh: 更安静的 DeepSeek Harness 阅读视图：原生过程细节、实时推理，以及干净的最终回答。

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-compact-saviour"
plugins.descEn: "Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup."
plugins.descZh: "使用专用模型处理上下文压缩恢复，并在原生上下文弹窗提供手动压缩。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-creator-mode-plus"
plugins.descEn: "Creates, activates, checks and removes external DSH plugins from a conversation through fixed tools; requires the external DSHX devkit."
plugins.descZh: "通过对话中的固定工具创建、激活、检查和移除外部 DSH 插件，需要外部 DSHX 开发工具。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-cuadrive-mac"
plugins.descEn: "macOS computer-use tools backed by a plugin-owned Cua Driver runtime."
plugins.descZh: "通过插件独立管理的 Cua Driver 运行时提供 macOS 电脑操作工具。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-dragndrop-attachments"
plugins.descEn: "Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents."
plugins.descZh: "支持拖放本地文件、文件夹、ZIP 压缩包和 Office 文档作为附件。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-firecrawl"
plugins.descEn: "Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings."
plugins.descZh: "提供 Firecrawl 搜索服务及多账户 API Key 设置。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-gateway"
plugins.descEn: "Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications."
plugins.descZh: "使用自建机器人应用，将一个 DSH Host 接入 Slack 和飞书。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-image-conatiner"
plugins.descEn: "Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer."
plugins.descZh: "以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-livevoice"
plugins.descEn: "Realtime WebRTC voice using Codex OAuth, with task delegation to a DSH session."
plugins.descZh: "使用 Codex OAuth 的 WebRTC 实时语音，并可将任务交给 DSH 会话执行。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-model-fusion"
plugins.descEn: "Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes."
plugins.descZh: "提供由 Lead 规划与审查、Sidekick 执行代码修改的组合模型线路。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-notch#dsh-notch-focus"
plugins.descEn: "Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web."
plugins.descZh: "DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-notch"
plugins.descEn: "Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion."
plugins.descZh: "将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-oauth-login"
plugins.descEn: "Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store."
plugins.descZh: "通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-opendesigner"
plugins.descEn: "Local visual React and Tailwind designer with project-scoped file tools; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2."
plugins.descZh: "提供本地 React 与 Tailwind 可视化设计及限制在项目内的文件工具，现有文档面向 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-orca-agents"
plugins.descEn: "Dispatches coding tasks to local Orca-managed agents and reports completion to DSH; documented for DSH 0.1.5-rc.2."
plugins.descZh: "将编程任务派给本地 Orca 管理的 Agent 并将完成状态带回 DSH，现有文档面向 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-resume"
plugins.descEn: "Imports local coding-agent session histories so work can continue in DSH."
plugins.descZh: "导入本地编程 Agent 的会话历史，在 DSH 中继续工作。"

plugins.name: "aa2246740/dsh-skillhub"
plugins.descEn: "Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories."
plugins.descZh: "浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。"

plugins.name: aa2246740/dsh-watcher
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible reasoning.'
plugins.descZh: 只读会话工作路径观察器：收起轮次看阶段数、执行数、耗时与 tok/s，展开看并行分支、工具结果与供应商可见推理。

plugins.name: "aa2246740/pstack-dsh"
plugins.descEn: "Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows."
plugins.descZh: "将 poteto 的 pstack 工程工作流移植到 DSH，涵盖规划、审查、验证与发布。"

plugins.name: Aafff623/dsh-callout
plugins.descEn: 'GitHub-style alert cards for DSH assistant Markdown: a qualifying `> [!NOTE]`, TIP, IMPORTANT, WARNING, or CAUTION blockquote becomes a theme-aware card. Stored session content is left unchanged.'
plugins.descZh: 把 DSH 助手 Markdown 里合格的 `> [!NOTE]`、TIP、IMPORTANT、WARNING、CAUTION 块引用渲染成跟随主题的 GitHub 风格提示卡片，不改会话存档。

plugins.name: Aafff623/dsh-keyboard-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Keyboard shortcuts for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+Q toggles the left sidebar, Ctrl+E toggles the right panel, and Ctrl+S opens Settings. Physical key codes can be overridden in the profile patch.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web UI 提供快捷键：Ctrl+Q 切换左侧栏，Ctrl+E 切换右侧栏，Ctrl+S 打开设置。物理键码可在 profile 补丁中覆盖。

plugins.name: AaronandWork/dsh-evidence-gate
plugins.descEn: Evidence-first conclusion gate that cross-checks first-hand claims against a durable per-session tool-activity index, blocks unverified guesses and tracks blocked-versus-converted metrics.
plugins.descZh: 实证门——按会话将第一手结论与持久工具活动索引交叉核验、拦截未验证猜测并以台账统计拦截与转化，中英双语界面。

plugins.name: abbccdd/dsh-panel-tint
plugins.descEn: Add independent opacity controls for the sidebar, message panels and composer in dsh web.
plugins.descZh: 为 dsh web 的侧边栏、正文框和输入框提供独立的不透明度控制。

plugins.name: AbelKeithsun/dsh-question-nav
plugins.descEn: 'In-session question navigator for the DSH Web UI: a dot minimap on the conversation edge (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hover shows the full question text, click jumps to it.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web UI 会话内提问导航：对话栏左/右缘（可在设置中切换）的圆点迷你地图，一个圆点对应一个用户提问——悬停显示全文，点击跳转到该提问。'

plugins.name: accpowered/dsh-auto-review
plugins.descEn: 'LLM approval answerer for sandbox escalations beyond workspace-write: a deterministic regex filter first, then a clean-context reviewer model; humans are asked only when it is unsure. Requires the bundled core patches.'
plugins.descZh: '沙箱越权审批的 LLM 应答器：先过确定性正则过滤，再交给干净上下文的审核模型；拿不准才转人工。需要随附的核心补丁。'

plugins.name: accpowered/dsh-credential-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Named user credentials the model uses by reference: values are entered on a Settings → Credentials page and injected into each shell execution as DSH_CM_* variables instead of being printed into the transcript, with credential_read as the documented last resort.'
plugins.descZh: '具名凭据按引用使用：秘密值在「设置 → 凭据」页录入，按次注入 shell 执行环境的 DSH_CM_* 变量而不打印进对话，credential_read 是文档化的最后手段。'

plugins.name: acdsh4869/dsh-deepseek-web-relay
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a native sidebar menu item in DSH that opens chat.deepseek.com in a standalone browser window with persistent login, and supports bidirectional text selection transfer between DSH and the web page.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH 左侧边栏添加原生菜单项，一键打开 chat.deepseek.com 独立窗口（登录态持久化），支持 DSH 与网页端双向划词互传。'

plugins.name: acebang0303/dsh-quick-launch
plugins.descEn: 'One-click create, update or remove the DeepSeek Harness desktop shortcut with switchable custom icons and a draggable whale button.'
plugins.descZh: '一键创建、更新或删除 DeepSeek Harness 桌面快捷方式，图标可自定义上传切换，蓝白金鲸鱼悬浮按钮可拖动，点击旋转 90° 弹出面板。'

plugins.name: activeing123/dsh-mcptoon
plugins.descEn: 'Mounts the mcptoon MCP gateway as one stdio server, so the agent discovers the tools of every MCP server you have configured through mcptoon''s compressed view instead of full JSON schemas on each turn. Ships a doctor CLI that checks the mcptoon executable resolves and prints the exact command/args override when it does not.'
plugins.descZh: '把 mcptoon 作为一条 stdio MCP 服务接入，让 agent 通过 mcptoon 的压缩视图发现已配置 MCP server 的工具，而非每轮支付完整 JSON schema。附带 doctor CLI：校验 mcptoon 可执行文件能否解析，不能时打印精确的 command/args 覆盖配置。'

plugins.name: addie-ace/dsh-fullwidth-punctuation
plugins.descEn: Converts half-width punctuation in AI replies to full-width Chinese punctuation, so copied answers stay publication-ready.
plugins.descZh: 将 AI 回答中的半角标点转换为中文全角标点，让复制的回答可直接用于公文材料。

plugins.name: addie-ace/dsh-livebench-rankings
plugins.descEn: LiveBench leaderboard for DSH — discovers the release the official site currently publishes, then reads its CSV and category JSON, and renders model rankings in an isolated same-origin iframe opened from a button beside the composer. Search, organization / open-weight / reasoning filters, per-category sorting, task-level detail, up to four models side by side, CSV export; refreshes every 60 s by default (configurable 30–3600) and caches only to the plugin's own .cache/rankings.json.
plugins.descZh: DSH 内的 LiveBench 能力排行榜：识别官网当前发布的榜单版本，再读取其官方 CSV 与分类 JSON，在由输入框按钮打开的独立同源 iframe 中渲染模型排名。支持搜索、机构／开放权重／推理模型筛选、按能力维度排序、任务级明细、最多 4 个模型并排对比与 CSV 导出；默认每 60 秒同步（可配 30–3600），缓存只写入插件自身的 .cache/rankings.json。

plugins.name: addie-ace/dsh-mattpocock-skills
plugins.descEn: 'Skill pack plugin: the 25 promoted skills from mattpocock/skills (engineering and productivity), translated to Chinese, registered as a bundled DSH skill provider.'
plugins.descZh: '技能包插件：把 mattpocock/skills 的 25 个 promoted 技能（工程与效率）全文汉化，注册为 DSH 捆绑技能 provider，经技能系统发现与调用。'

plugins.name: adithyanraj03/dsh-graft-plugin
plugins.descEn: "Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers, graft_skeleton and graft_map as native tools."
plugins.descZh: '显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。'

plugins.name: adithyanraj03/dsh-schedule-later
plugins.descEn: "Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across chats, delivery as a normal user message even with the browser closed, and schedule_message, list_scheduled_messages and cancel_scheduled_message tools so the model can come back to a chat on its own."
plugins.descZh: "把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message 三个工具，模型因而能自己回到某个会话。"

plugins.name: AdonisSheldon/dsh-openai-oauth
plugins.descEn: Connect a ChatGPT account to Codex models in DeepSeek Harness through browser PKCE or device-code OAuth, with automatic token refresh and Web or headless login.
plugins.descZh: 通过浏览器 PKCE 或设备码 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 账户接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 Codex 模型，并支持自动刷新令牌以及 Web 或无头登录。

plugins.name: adoresever/graph-memory
plugins.descEn: Traceable, searchable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness — conversation knowledge as typed graph nodes (TASK/SKILL/EVENT) and typed edges.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的可追溯、可检索跨会话记忆：把对话知识沉淀为带类型的图节点（任务/技能/事件）与关系边。

plugins.name: adrianleb/dsh-tmux-cc
plugins.descEn: Persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DSH Web that mirrors native panes in a dock.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 提供持久的 tmux 控制模式驾驶舱，在停靠栏中镜像原生窗格。

plugins.name: advance-lion/dsh-brand
plugins.descEn: One-click brand replacement for the DSH web GUI — logo, product name, version badge, hero headline, tab title and favicon.
plugins.descZh: 一键替换 DSH Web GUI 品牌信息（商标、产品名、版本徽标、Hero、标签页标题与 favicon），方便二改分发。

plugins.name: ADWMC/helm-d#helmd
plugins.descEn: 'Single-bundle reverse-engineering and pentest security plugin: first-turn tool narrowing, domain routing, and 33 tools covering APK, web, native binary, protocol, malware and LLM samples — with unpacking, license-bypass and anti-analysis case playbooks, an H-CoT evaluation engine (semantic routing, /hcot command), a web workbench with a ledger-driven tool shelf, an on-disk case workflow (auto-persisted evidence chain, E-numbered validated findings, post-compaction resume), GitHub-based external tool discovery, and 361 on-demand reference docs.'
plugins.descZh: '单包逆向与渗透测试安全分析插件：首轮工具收敛、领域路由与 33 个工具，覆盖 APK、Web、原生二进制、协议、恶意样本与 LLM 场景的逆向分析、加壳脱壳与 License 破解绕过；内置 H-CoT 评估引擎（语义路由、/hcot 命令）、账本驱动的 Web 工作台与工具货架、磁盘案件工作区（证据链自动存证、E 编号结论校验、上下文压缩后恢复）、GitHub 工具检索与 361 篇按需参考文档。'

plugins.name: Aealen/dsh-coding-workspace
plugins.descEn: 'Coding workbench for DSH: docked workspace panels, a grouped project sidebar, split editor tab groups with hibernate/resume, file preview and diff views — built on parallel git worktree development with cross-session collaboration primitives.'
plugins.descZh: coding 工作台：停靠式工作区面板、项目分组侧栏、可休眠/恢复的分栏编辑器 TAB 组、文件预览与 DIFF 查看，以 git worktree 并行开发与跨会话协作为地基。

plugins.name: Aeroscis/dsh-temptask
plugins.descEn: One-click temporary tasks for DeepSeek Harness — each task is a disposable timestamped workspace plus its own session, shown as a native sidebar workspace node.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的临时任务模式：一键创建一次性的时间戳工作区并开会话，直接成为侧边栏原生工作区节点。

plugins.name: aexachao/dsh-balance-tracker
plugins.descEn: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
plugins.descZh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

plugins.name: afoxsss/dsh-conversation-map
plugins.descEn: 'Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview, click-to-jump and drag-to-scroll with a live viewport indicator, and collapse to a 4px strip.'
plugins.descZh: '停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。'

plugins.name: AgentConnect/dsh-awiki
plugins.descEn: Provides DeepSeek Harness agents with native identities based on the open Agent Network Protocol (ANP), plus identity-based direct, group, mail, and Agent-to-Agent communication.
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供基于开放协议ANP的原生身份，以及基于该身份的私聊、群聊、邮件和智能体间通信能力。

plugins.name: AgentDebugX/AgentDebugX#dsh-agentdebugx
plugins.descEn: Diagnoses current and saved DeepSeek Harness trajectories with AgentDebugX and opens structured reports in its dashboard.
plugins.descZh: 使用 AgentDebugX 诊断当前及已保存的 DeepSeek Harness 轨迹，并在其仪表盘中打开结构化报告。

plugins.name: agentscope-ai/ReMe#dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe''s local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.'
plugins.descZh: '将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。'

plugins.name: AHIOSUZ/dsh-workspace-tools
plugins.descEn: Applies per-workspace default Agent and permission presets to new root sessions automatically (Settings - Workspace defaults), using only official extension points.
plugins.descZh: 按工作区规则为新建根会话自动应用 Agent 预设与权限预设（设置 - 工作区默认设置），仅使用官方扩展点。

plugins.name: ai-eks/dsh-docking-layout
plugins.descEn: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
plugins.descZh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

plugins.name: ai-fu-cn/dsh-plugin-memos-code-retrospect
plugins.descEn: 'Coding retrospect distilled memory for DSH: distills rejected solutions, pitfalls and constraints from each turn via a local LLM, tags them into MemOS (type:rejected_solution), and boosts weighted recall on coding tasks via agent/pre-step.'
plugins.descZh: '编码任务复盘记忆：每轮对话后用本地 LLM 蒸馏被否决方案/踩坑/工程约束，按 type:rejected_solution 写入 MemOS，编码任务时对这类记忆加权召回。'

plugins.name: ai-tools-mtl/Aurify#bundle-patent
plugins.descEn: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure drafting, figures and simulation runs, seven-dimension review and docx/PDF export. Skills work out of the box; the search, export and experiment tools come from a bundled Python MCP service that ships disabled - one line in ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml enables it, and uvx fetches the wheel from PyPI.
plugins.descZh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx 会从 PyPI 自动拉取。

plugins.name: ai-yukin/dsh-0-tools
plugins.descEn: 'One-click free-model setup for DSH web, built for coding beginners: one-click installer for Windows (install.bat) and macOS/Linux (install.sh, v1.7.0+); four permanently free channels — Zhipu GLM (text + image), SiliconFlow (Qwen3-8B plus 15+ sub-9B models), iFlytek Spark Lite and the OpenRouter free pool, which routes through openrouter/auto and picks from a pool that changes over time; bottom-left setup hint hides once any free model is connected; real-time DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing reminder; bundled beginner help center.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 小白零门槛零费用套件：一键安装支持 Windows（install.bat）和 macOS/Linux（install.sh，v1.7.0 起）；一键接入四款永久免费渠道——智谱 GLM（文本+图片）、硅基流动（Qwen3-8B 及 15+ 款 9B 以下小模型）、讯飞星火 Lite，以及 OpenRouter 免费池（一个 Key，经 openrouter/auto 自动挑选，池内模型随时变化）；接入任一免费模型后左下角配置提示自动隐藏；含 DeepSeek 计价时段提醒、内置新手帮助中心。'

plugins.name: AIcivilization/deepseek-harness-vps
plugins.descEn: 'One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy with version, upgrade and gateway status, or the one-command setup when DSH is not yet on a VPS.'
plugins.descZh: '一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 部署到自有 VPS：零依赖登录网关加自动 HTTPS，反向代理原生 Web 界面，令牌保护的初始化向导，DSH 一键升级且失败自动回滚；作为插件在设置中新增「VPS 部署」页，显示版本、升级与网关状态，DSH 尚未上 VPS 时则给出一键部署命令。'

plugins.name: AIcivilization/dsh-vps-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 21 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.'
plugins.descZh: '通过 SSH 密钥登录管理 VPS：21 条不走模型的 /vps- 命令（查看状态、按菜谱安装并先出计划再用 /vps-yes 确认、重启并等机器回来），对话里的终端（xterm.js + ssh -tt，可运行菜单脚本等交互程序），5 个按风险分级确认的 agent 工具，改文件自动备份与还原、改防火墙和 SSH 前设自动恢复，29 条内置菜谱，以及添加机器的设置页。'

plugins.name: Aicksion/dsh-clean-desktop-shell-pro
plugins.descEn: 'Enhanced desktop shell for DSH: auto-starts the local backend on launch (no browser tab), asks before closing the backend on quit, and starts the backend in parallel with Electron for faster cold start. Fork of dsh-clean-desktop-shell.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 桌面壳增强版：启动即自动拉起后端（不弹浏览器）、退出时询问是否关闭后端、后端与窗口并行启动加速冷启动。基于 dsh-clean-desktop-shell 的 fork。'

plugins.name: Aik358/dsh-ark9canvas
plugins.descEn: 'Image generation workbench and agent tool for DSH: one tool (ark9_generate_image) paints text-to-image and image-to-image via any OpenAI-compatible API. Channels are entirely user-configured - no bundled endpoint, you bring your own baseURL, key and model name (manual input supported). Agent-initiated generations are approval-gated by default: requests queue in the floating panel and nothing bills until you approve; approval is non-blocking (the agent replies "awaiting your approval" immediately, and results, denials or timeouts are injected back so the agent reports them in the next turn). Floating glass workbench with five tabs (Generate / Approvals / Prompts / History / About), aspect-ratio grid with quality-budget + 16px-alignment sizing, transparent background, batch up to 10 images as aggregated sub-tasks, prompt library with custom JSON sources fetched through a host proxy, persistent generation logs with one-click retry, multi-channel aggregation with per-channel model fetching, bilingual UI (zh/en), stroke-SVG icon set, config import/export. Registers as a Better Sidebar tab when dsh-better-sidebar is installed; stacks above the dsh-cua FAB when both are present.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 生图工作台与 Agent 生图工具：一个工具（ark9_generate_image）走任意 OpenAI 兼容图片 API 文生图/图生图。渠道完全由用户自行添加——默认零预置，自带 baseURL、Key 与模型名即可（支持手动输入任意模型名）。Agent 发起的生图默认需用户审批：请求进入浮窗审批页，批准才开始生成并计费；审批非阻塞——Agent 立即回复"等你审批"，结果、拒绝或超时以通知注入后续轮次并自动汇报。玻璃拟态浮窗五页签（生成/审批/提示词/记录/说明）、比例网格（质量预算+16px 对齐）、透明背景、批量最多 10 张（子任务聚合，部分成功也返回）、提示词库（自定义 JSON 来源经宿主代理拉取）、生成记录持久化与一键重试、多渠道聚合与逐渠道拉模型、中英双语界面、线性 SVG 图标、配置导入导出。安装 dsh-better-sidebar 自动注册侧栏页签；与 dsh-cua 共存时自动堆叠其悬浮按钮上方。

plugins.name: Aik358/dsh-cua-pre
plugins.descEn: 'Windows desktop automation for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility-first observe/act loop with 30 standard tools (element/coordinate targets, auto/a11y/event strategy routing), superseded-observations and no-replay safety semantics, persistent kill switch, RuntimeId/rect-drift stale protection, chat cards and a floating panel (live ops, frame wall, env auto-detect settings), tiled vision describe for low-res models, JSONL audit trail and a pid allowlist. Requires Windows 10+ and Python 3.9+ with uiautomation and pillow (installable from the settings page).'
plugins.descZh: 'Windows 桌面自动化插件：无障碍优先的观察-动作回路（30 个标准工具，元素/坐标双目标与 auto/a11y/event 策略路由），写后作废与禁重放安全语义，持久急停开关，RuntimeId/矩形漂移防错位，对话卡片与悬浮面板（实况/画面/环境自检设置），面向低分辨率模型的分块识图，JSONL 审计与 pid 白名单。需 Windows 10+ 与 Python 3.9+，并安装 uiautomation 与 pillow（设置页可一键安装）。'

plugins.name: Aik358/dsh-literature
plugins.descEn: 'Self-contained literature library for DSH with optional Zotero export: full-text PDF fetching (Unpaywall/arXiv/custom URL templates), loose Crossref-backed search, APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago citation generation, a side-panel PDF reader with highlights and notes, and AI-assisted Q&A/translation steered into the current conversation.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 内置文献库（可选导出到 Zotero）：通过 Unpaywall/arXiv/自定义 URL 模板获取全文 PDF，Crossref 候选式宽松搜索，APA/GB-T 7714/MLA/Chicago 引用生成，侧窗 PDF 阅读器（高亮与笔记），以及注入当前对话的 AI 问答/翻译。'

plugins.name: Akimiya-z/codex-guard#dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Pre-submit pull-request hygiene checks inside DeepSeek Harness: scans the current diff for TODO leftovers, hardcoded secrets, and non-conventional commit subjects.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DeepSeek Harness 内做提交前的 Pull Request 卫生检查：扫描当前改动中的 TODO 残留、硬编码密钥与非规范提交信息。'

plugins.name: AKS1st/dock-editor
plugins.descEn: 'Text viewer and editor for the dock workbench: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, unsaved-change confirmation and binary detection, registered as the default file viewer.'
plugins.descZh: dock 系列文本查看与编辑器：支持撤销重做、Ctrl+S 保存、未保存确认和二进制检测，作为 dock-files 的默认文本查看器。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dock-files
plugins.descEn: 'File explorer for the dock workbench: tree browsing of the session workspace with create/rename/copy-paste/delete, drag-and-drop import and paste of local files and clipboard images.'
plugins.descZh: dock 系列文件浏览插件：侧边栏目录树浏览会话工作区，支持新建/重命名/复制粘贴/删除、拖放导入、粘贴本地文件与剪贴板图片。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dock-git
plugins.descEn: 'Git history visualization for the dock workbench: swimlane commit graph, branch and tag management, stage/commit/push and remote operations.'
plugins.descZh: dock 系列 Git 历史可视化插件：泳道式提交图、分支/标签管理、暂存/提交/推送与远端操作。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dock-images
plugins.descEn: 'Image viewer for the dock workbench: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF, with SVG rendered as image data only.'
plugins.descZh: dock 系列图片查看器：支持 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/SVG/ICO/AVIF 格式，SVG 仅以安全方式渲染。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dock-markdown
plugins.descEn: 'Markdown viewer for the dock workbench: GFM rendering with DOMPurify sanitization, document outline and relative-path image/link resolution, with one-click switch to editing.'
plugins.descZh: dock 系列 Markdown 查看器：GFM 渲染 + DOMPurify 消毒、文档大纲、相对路径图片/链接解析，可一键切换编辑。

plugins.name: AKS1st/dock
plugins.descEn: 'VSCode-style workbench shell for the DSH Web UI: activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel and status bar, with a registry service (ctx.workbench) for mounting panels, views and commands.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 工作台基座插件：提供 VSCode 风格布局外壳（活动栏/侧边栏/编辑器区/面板/状态栏）和 ctx.workbench 开放注册表，供功能插件挂载面板、视图与命令。

plugins.name: AKUSH99/dsh-balance-chip
plugins.descEn: 'Live DeepSeek API balance in the sidebar footer plus an always-visible bottom-right pill: status dot and amount, refreshed every 60 seconds, the API key is read from the local credential store and never embedded.'
plugins.descZh: 侧边栏底部与右下角常驻胶囊实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额：状态点加金额，每 60 秒自动刷新，密钥从本机凭证库读取。

plugins.name: alaxrpg/dsh-llm-approve-for-me
plugins.descEn: "Uses an isolated LLM review to approve or reject DSH sandbox permission requests."
plugins.descZh: "使用隔离的 LLM 审查来批准或拒绝 DSH 沙箱权限请求。"

plugins.name: alaxrpg/dsh-vision-bridge
plugins.descEn: "Adds image input and recognition through configured DSH providers or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint."
plugins.descZh: "通过已配置的 DSH Provider 或 OpenAI 兼容端点提供图片输入与识别。"

plugins.name: alchemistwu/dsh-tool-call-guard
plugins.descEn: Neutralize tool calls with invalid JSON arguments on the wire so one malformed model generation cannot brick a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers.
plugins.descZh: 在 wire 层中性化 arguments 为非法 JSON 的 tool call，避免一次模型畸形输出让 session 在严格 OpenAI 兼容服务端上永久 400。

plugins.name: alexfengrui/dsh-client-ui-skin-real-madrid
plugins.descEn: 'Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.'
plugins.descZh: '皇家马德里双模式皮肤：暗色为夜场伯纳乌全景，亮色为纯白主场暗纹，队徽与 1902 背号作为背景层（非官方球迷作品）。'

plugins.name: AlexPeng07/dsh-custom-plugin
plugins.descEn: Web GUI convenience suite with appearance controls, timeline navigation, project folders, prompts, conversation export, Mermaid rendering, quote reply, and DeepSeek balance and daily token usage.
plugins.descZh: DSH Web GUI 便利套件，提供外观控制、时间线导航、项目文件夹、提示词、会话导出、Mermaid 渲染、引用回复，以及 DeepSeek 余额和每日 token 用量。

plugins.name: AlexYin-Tongji/dsh-ui-enhancer
plugins.descEn: 'Desktop-style UI enhancements for the DSH Web client: adaptive wallpapers, a desktop pet companion with an activity feed and feeding economy, @file workspace references, and the resizable file/preview right panel.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DSH Web 客户端的桌面化 UI 增强：自适应对比度壁纸、带活动流与投喂玩法的桌面宠物、@file 工作区文件引用，以及可缩放的文件/预览右侧面板。'

plugins.name: AliceLJY/dsh-thumb
plugins.descEn: 'A phone shell for the web GUI - the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer that closes when a session is tapped, the settings sheet goes full-screen single column, and the transcript is retuned for phone reading.'
plugins.descZh: '网页版界面的手机外壳：侧栏改为覆盖式抽屉、点会话自动收起，设置面板改全屏单列，正文排版按手机阅读距离重调。'

plugins.name: AlienGene/dsh-llm-balance-siderbar
plugins.descEn: 'DeepSeek Harness plugin for querying LLM service provider usage: reads DeepSeek and Moonshot balances plus Kimi For Coding and OpenCode Go quota windows on the host and shows them in an always-visible card with three view modes, edge docking and a collapsed letter bubble.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 服务提供商用量查询插件：在宿主侧读取 DeepSeek、Moonshot 余额与 Kimi For Coding、OpenCode Go 的配额窗口，在常驻卡片中展示，支持三种视图、边缘磁吸与收起为字母气泡。'

plugins.name: Aliuyanfeng/dsh-soul
plugins.descEn: 'Personalization for the agent: a Web UI panel (about-you, reply style & tone, traits for headings/lists and emoji, output language, custom instructions) and `/soul` commands, with nickname/occupation/bio/style/traits/language compiled into a system prompt and re-injected into active sessions. Exposes `soulConfig` for other plugins and a `set_persona` tool the agent can call.'
plugins.descZh: '为 Agent 提供个性化设置：Web 设置栏目（关于你、回复风格和语调、标题与列表 / 表情符号特质、输出语言、自定义指令）与 `/soul` 命令；昵称 / 职业 / 介绍 / 风格 / 特质 / 语言编译进提示词并推送给所有活动会话。向其他插件暴露 `soulConfig` 服务，并注册 Agent 可调用的 `set_persona` 工具。'

plugins.name: Aliww2468/dsh-client-ui-aqua-patched
plugins.descEn: 'Aqua glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, forked from upstream and repaired to load on DSH 0.1.2-rc.1: mica and compatibility modes with adjustable blur and frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, background brightness, and a master switch that restores the stock UI.'
plugins.descZh: 'Aqua 玻璃质感主题（上游分支，修复以适配 DSH 0.1.2-rc.1）：云母/兼容双模式、可调模糊与磨砂、流体/壁纸背景、背景亮度，以及一键还原原生界面的总开关。'

plugins.name: aLIZELI/belief-merge#belief-merge
plugins.descEn: 'Merges other sessions'' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust labelling that resists cross-session prompt injection, and budget-bounded packing. Ships a benchmark.'
plugins.descZh: '把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。'

plugins.name: All3nCN/dsh-better-sidebar-N23
plugins.descEn: 'Full workbench fork of dsh-better-sidebar: explorer, editor, terminal, Git, browser and split panes, plus a VSCode-like shell refactor with a full-width compact header and activity rail; publishes as @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23 on npm.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh-better-sidebar 完整工作台 fork：资源管理器、编辑器、终端、Git、浏览器与分屏，外加仿 VSCode 外壳重构（全宽紧凑顶栏与活动栏）；npm 包名 @all3cn/dsh-better-sidebar-n23。'

plugins.name: All3nCN/dsh-qa-suite-N23
plugins.descEn: 'Quality suite: background tsc --noEmit diagnostics fed back after the agent edits TypeScript, plus a /code-review command running five parallel review lenses with confidence scoring; absorbs dsh-code-check and dsh-command-code-review.'
plugins.descZh: '质控套件：agent 编辑 TypeScript 后自动回喂 tsc --noEmit 诊断，另含 /code-review 命令（五镜头并行审查 + 置信度评分）；吸收合并 dsh-code-check 与 dsh-command-code-review。'

plugins.name: AllenWES365/dsh-local-memory
plugins.descEn: Project-isolated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness that keeps one bank per project and adds a cross-project view; it can also seed a project's memory from its git history without opening a session there.
plugins.descZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的跨项目长期记忆：每个项目各存各的库，另有一次性看遍全部的查询视图；还能不打开会话就直接从项目的 git 历史播种记忆。

plugins.name: alllllinnrann/dsh-inapp-browser
plugins.descEn: 'Shared browser panel for DeepSeek Harness via Better Sidebar, with local Chromium, human and agent mouse and keyboard control, page snapshots, screenshots, and per-chat persistent profiles.'
plugins.descZh: '通过 Better Sidebar 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供共享浏览器面板，支持本地 Chromium、人和 AI 的鼠标键盘操作、页面快照、截图及按聊天持久保存的浏览器资料。'

plugins.name: almazom/dsh-almazom-approve-escalate
plugins.descEn: 'One-click Approve & escalate on the approval card: answers the pending request and switches the live session to a permission preset.'
plugins.descZh: '审批卡片上的「批准并升级」一键操作：既应答当前待批请求，又把当前会话切换到指定的权限预设。'

plugins.name: alone-tree/dsh-skill-mcp-manager
plugins.descEn: 'One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.'
plugins.descZh: '一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看'

plugins.name: AloneFu/dsh-calendar-plugin
plugins.descEn: "Obsidian daily notes, tasks and Day Planner time blocks in the DSH sidebar: a Monday-first month grid with per-day word-count and task dots, a compact timeline for HH:mm time blocks, the selected day's diary excerpt and task list, and write-back of checkbox state, task text and times to the Markdown files; a first-run wizard detects the vault or accepts a path."
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 右侧栏里的 Obsidian 日记、待办与 Day Planner 时间块：周一起始的月历（带每天的字数点与任务点）、紧凑时间轴（HH:mm 时间块）、选中日的日记摘要与任务列表；勾选状态、任务内容与时间都会写回 Markdown 文件，首次使用有向导，可自动找到知识库或手填路径。'

plugins.name: alpacachen/dsh-automation
plugins.descEn: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
plugins.descZh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

plugins.name: alpacachen/dsh-kanban
plugins.descEn: A shared kanban board that lets people and DSH agents manage workspace tasks through a Board tab and kanban tools.
plugins.descZh: 一个由用户与 DSH Agent 共同维护的工作区看板，通过看板标签页和 kanban 工具管理任务。

plugins.name: alpacachen/dsh-worktree
plugins.descEn: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
plugins.descZh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。
