findings land in a local SQLite fact base with discovery timestamps, shown in a persistent right-side console of 9 tabs (asset mapping with a discovery timeline and the live test view, the agent roster with its concurrency setting and editable role prompts, session/tunnel state, findings — vulnerabilities, credentials and access sessions plus the attack files archived against each vulnerability — five-stage attack chain, scoring targets, an evidence-screenshot capability (register a screenshot per score point, at most three representative shots per point so a bulk result such as dozens of endpoints does not flood the console or the report, viewed inline in the console and embedded in the report, with on-site screenshots kept strictly apart from record-generated evidence cards), and a report that spells out how each score was obtained (actions, exact commands, credential provenance, tunnel build commands, a reproduction entry that is either a paste-ready HTTP request or a runnable command, plus success criteria and an evidence index), a category-organised POC/EXP knowledge base, and a skill library that reports for every unusable skill why it is unusable and the concrete steps to repair it); ships 14 reconnaissance/assessment skills (the npm package deliberately carries no tool auto-installer and no attack-chain skills — those ship as a separate toolkit Release attachment that the operator fetches and runs themselves), 56 redteam_* tools and one-command self-update."
plugins.descZh: "红队作战模式：只发一个靶标单位名称，主会话指挥五个执行角色（信息收集/资产梳理/漏洞发现/漏洞利用/内网渗透）推进演练，并发数量可在控制台直接配置（默认 3，改完立即生效），开工前先做技能与资源预检、缺 key 或 VPS 一次性向用户要齐（内置首次使用引导技能）；得分严格对齐《突破入侵类得分规则（合并版）》的 8 类 25 项，上限、权限取高只计一次、同一服务只算一次全由服务端判定，自建账号不计分，凭据实测能登录、又归不进更具体类别的 Web 站点按「控制 Web 应用系统」兜底计分而不漏记；所有发现落入本机 SQLite 事实库并带发现时间，常驻右侧控制台 9 个页签提供：资产测绘（含发现时间线与当前测试视图）、智能体（并发数量配置与角色提示词编辑）、会话隧道、漏洞战果（漏洞 / 凭据 / 访问会话，以及每条漏洞归档的攻击文件）、五阶段攻击链、得分目标（含证据截图：每个得分点可登记截图、同一点最多取 3 张代表图，展开即可查看，现场截图与记录生成的证据摘录分开标注）、按攻击链顺序编排、逐条写明「怎么拿到的」的可复现报告（动作、实际命令、账号密码来源、隧道搭建命令，复现入口给可粘贴的报文或可直接跑的命令，并嵌入证据截图、附成功判定标准与证据索引）、按归类组织的跨靶标 POC/EXP 知识库，以及逐条给出「不可用原因 + 修复方法」的技能库；随包 14 个侦察/检测向技能（npm 包**有意不含**工具自动安装脚本与攻击链技能 —— 那部分作为独立的工具箱 Release 附件由使用者自行获取执行）、56 个 redteam_* 工具与一键自更新。"

plugins.name: jujiujiang222-cell/dsh-archive-sessions
plugins.descEn: 'Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).'
plugins.descZh: '归档会话管理：在设置页新增“归档会话”，列出所有已归档会话，支持恢复与二次确认后的永久删除。'

plugins.name: Jumqyc/dsh-wsl-gpufix
plugins.descEn: 'Adds /dev/dxg and /proc read-write grants to the DSH Landlock sandbox on WSL2, so CUDA is available inside a confined agent bash session.'
plugins.descZh: '为 WSL2 上的 DSH Landlock 沙箱追加 /dev/dxg 与 /proc 的读写授权，使受限的 agent bash 会话中也能使用 CUDA。'

plugins.name: Junkrat9527/dsh-desktop-automation
plugins.descEn: 'macOS desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: agent operates non-browser apps (CapCut, Photoshop, WPS, native clients) like a human — 14 tools for mouse, keyboard, scrolling, app activation, windows and screenshots, plus a vision closed-loop (desktop_see for image understanding + desktop_locate for UI element coordinates) that reuses dsh existing vision credentials. GUI-session service starts on demand, no login autostart.'
plugins.descZh: 'macOS 桌面控制插件：agent 像人一样操作非浏览器应用（剪映/PS/WPS/原生客户端）——14 个工具覆盖鼠标/键盘/滚动/应用/窗口/截图，并整合视觉闭环（desktop_see 识图 + desktop_locate UI 定位坐标，复用 dsh 既有视觉凭据）。服务 GUI 会话按需拉起，非登录自启。'

plugins.name: JUNQINGV587/dsh-maestro
plugins.descEn: 'Planner/executor delegation with named roles: a strong planner steers, disposable executor sub-agents (per-role routes and prompts) implement. Default role plus per-delegation override, a global reasoning-effort knob in the composer chip, and a settings page for role management.'
plugins.descZh: 规划者/执行者委派调度：高阶模型（Planner）定方向，一次性低阶执行子代理（按角色的路由与提示词）干具体活；默认角色 + 单次委派覆盖，输入框芯片快速切换角色与全局思考等级，设置页管理执行角色。

plugins.name: JUNQINGV587/dsh-ssh-hub
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-server SSH terminal panel for the DSH Web GUI: floating terminal window with tabs, side-by-side groups, broadcast, host-owned persistent sessions, and password/private-key/SSH-agent auth.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web GUI 多服务器 SSH 终端面板：浮动终端窗口支持标签页、并排组合、广播、宿主侧持久会话，以及密码/私钥/SSH Agent 认证。'

plugins.name: JuntaoXiao/PDF-electronic-signature
plugins.descEn: 'PDF electronic signing: generate a handwritten-style signature image, stamp images and typed blocks onto PDF pages, and apply a PKCS#7/CMS digital signature with a PKCS#12 certificate you supply. Stamping first keys an opaque background out to transparency - un-compositing each pixel so the ink keeps its original colour - and trims to the ink, so a seal stamped over a signature does not erase it.'
plugins.descZh: 'PDF 电子签名：生成手写风格签名图、在 PDF 页面盖章（图片与文字块）、并用自备的 PKCS#12 证书施加 PKCS#7/CMS 数字签名。盖章前会先把不透明签名图/印章图的底色转为透明（通过反合成保留墨色）并裁掉留白，因此印章盖在签名上不会把签名擦掉。'

plugins.name: JW53222/faultseed#dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Honesty guardrails on the tool pipeline: blocks a coding agent from weakening tests, swallowing errors, stubbing type checks, or deleting tests through the shell — nine deterministic hooks, each backed by a planted-failure test proving the guard can fail.'
plugins.descZh: '工具流水线上的诚实性护栏：阻止编码 agent 弱化测试、吞掉错误、用桩替换类型检查或通过 shell 删除测试——九个确定性 hook，每个都配有植入失败的测试，证明该护栏确实会触发。'

plugins.name: jyao-SUSE-power-group/dsh-provider-rate-limit
plugins.descEn: 'Rate-limits LLM requests per provider and per model using a reservation-based token bucket, with queue or reject modes, plus gateway identity rules that rewrite user-agent and inject custom headers.'
plugins.descZh: '按供应商与模型粒度限速 LLM 请求，预约式令牌桶支持排队或拒绝两种模式，附带网关身份规则（改写 User-Agent、注入自定义请求头）。'

plugins.name: jypjypjypjyp/dsh-guardrail
plugins.descEn: 'String-matches tool-call input arguments, blocks dangerous tool calls (deny) or allows them with an injected warning (warn), and ships a full rules-management panel.'
plugins.descZh: '对 agent 工具调用输入参数做字符串匹配，命中危险行为则拦截（deny）或放行但注入警告（warn），附规则管理面板。'

plugins.name: jypjypjypjyp/dsh-music-studio
plugins.descEn: 'Music composition inside the conversation: the model writes a score against a bundled composing skill, and a play_score tool renders it as an inline card with a piano roll, Web Audio playback and WAV/JSON export.'
plugins.descZh: '在对话里作曲：模型按内置作曲规范写出乐谱 JSON，play_score 工具校验后渲染成对话内的卡片，含卷帘图、Web Audio 实时播放与 WAV/JSON 导出。'

plugins.name: k-ying/dsh-vsceditor
plugins.descEn: 'Embeds a real VSCode editor (code-server, or your local desktop VS Code via the bundled bridge extension) as a GUI tab: agent file edits open turn-scoped red/green diffs that survive tab closes and page reloads, files lock while the agent writes, and a watchdog supervisor keeps zero orphan processes.'
plugins.descZh: '在 GUI 页签内嵌真实的 VSCode 编辑器（code-server，或通过自带 bridge 扩展连接本机桌面 VS Code）：Agent 的文件改动弹出按对话轮次累计的红绿 diff，关标签、刷新页面都不丢，写入期间文件自动锁定，看门狗托管进程、崩溃升级不留孤儿。'

plugins.name: k2d5rqjpkg-art/dsh-auto-vision
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-switch the DeepSeek route to the vision model on demand: flash main session switches (A), pro keeps deep reasoning and delegates image reading to a vision subagent (B), subagents always switch, with fatal-failure fallback. No manual model switching.'
plugins.descZh: '按需自动把 DeepSeek 路由切到视觉模型：flash 主会话直接切（A），pro 保持深推理并交给视觉子代理读图（B），子代理恒切，含失败回退，无需手动切模型。'

plugins.name: kagurazakayashi/dsh-startup-command
plugins.descEn: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that runs a user-defined command after the web profile has started successfully.
plugins.descZh: 在 dsh web 启动成功后运行用户自定义命令的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。

plugins.name: kahomesl/dsh-chat-diff-summary-legacy
plugins.descEn: A per-turn change bar above the composer showing which files the turn changed and the line deltas, for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 through 0.1.7.
plugins.descZh: 输入框上方的本轮改动统计条，显示这一轮改了哪些文件、增删多少行，适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1 至 0.1.7。

plugins.name: kai-GitHubaccount/dsh-usage-panel
plugins.descEn: DeepSeek balance and per-session token usage in the session header, with a three-level balance alert and editable thresholds, one-click top-up links, a segmented token bar with cache-hit statistics, and a visibility-aware poller.
plugins.descZh: 会话头部显示 DeepSeek 余额与本会话 Token 用量：三级余额预警、自定义阈值、一键充值入口、分段 Token 条与缓存命中率，并采用可见时才轮询的省流策略。

plugins.name: kaieye/dsh-AIR
plugins.descEn: 'Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 输入框增强：跨会话召回已发送提示词、用 Ctrl+R 搜索并还原富草稿，以及提供停靠式 /btw 或 /side 旁路会话。'

plugins.name: Kaiji-Z/dsh-plugin-lookatstudy
plugins.descEn: 'A study tab with course-map, tutor and blackboard columns that turns markdown files, local folders or GitHub repos into guided courses, with lesson unlocking, mastery tracking, spaced repetition and a tutor-designed course import.'
plugins.descZh: '学习页签（课程｜导师｜黑板三栏）：把 markdown 文件、本地文件夹或 GitHub 仓库变成导学课程，提供课时解锁、掌握度追踪、间隔重复和导师设计式课程导入。'

plugins.name: Kaiji-Z/dsh-plugin-stardeck
plugins.descEn: 'An RTS-style orchestration dashboard where commands replace chats: a resident commander agent decomposes each order into task briefs with acceptance criteria, typed subagent troops (recon/engineer/medic/scribe) execute them across isolated workspaces, and every session is indexed by the order that started it.'
plugins.descZh: 'RTS 风格编排看板：用命令取代会话——常驻大副 agent 把舰长命令拆成带验收标准的任务书，侦察/工程/医疗/书记四类小队在隔离工作区执行，所有会话按发起命令索引归队。'

plugins.name: kaixinbaba/dsh-git-workbench
plugins.descEn: 'Git development workbench for DeepSeek Harness: captures branch, status, worktrees, stashes and recent commits, with commands, tools and a settings UI.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness Git 开发工作台：采集分支、状态、worktree、stash 和最近提交，并通过命令、工具与设置界面管理 Git 工作区。'

plugins.name: kaixinguo360/dsh-script-manager
plugins.descEn: "Custom script manager for DSH: turn verified operations into reusable scripts that run directly via /script or register as agent tools, with parameterized scripts, declared expected outcomes, and execution history."
plugins.descZh: "DSH 自定义操作脚本管理器，将验证过的操作流程固化为可复用的脚本，用 /script 直接运行或注册为 Agent 工具，支持参数化脚本、执行预期声明、执行历史记录。"

plugins.name: kaka-crypto/dsh-disk-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Redirects DSH downloads, artifacts, caches and temp files to user-specified drives (auto-picks the largest non-C drive), injects a path-discipline prompt into every session, and ships a disk_guard tool for status and cleanup — keeps the C: drive from filling up.'
plugins.descZh: '把 DSH 的下载、产物、缓存与临时文件重定向到用户指定目录（自动挑剩余空间最大的非 C 盘），向每个会话注入路径纪律提示词，并自带 disk_guard 工具做状态查看与清理——防止 C 盘被撑爆。'

plugins.name: kakajun/dsh-web-recorder
plugins.descEn: Records real clicks, inputs, navigation and network traffic in a user-guided browser session for DSH, then generates a Markdown timeline report (report.md + events.jsonl) to build API-level skills.
plugins.descZh: 网页操作录制器：录制用户引导会话中的真实点击、输入、导航与网络请求，生成 Markdown 操作时间线报告（report.md + events.jsonl），用于沉淀接口级 skill。

plugins.name: Kalospacer/dsh-model-capabilities
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a settings page for declaring per-model reasoning efforts and vision support on pi-ai provider routes.'
plugins.descZh: 在设置里新增「模型能力」一页，为每个模型声明思考档位与视觉能力。

plugins.name: Kanadego/dsh-heartbeat
plugins.descEn: 'Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.'
plugins.descZh: '心跳循环：默认每 20 分钟自己醒一次——维护一份关于你兴趣与偏好的本地画像，按你设的兴趣范围上网搜新东西并存下来。攒到值得分享的内容，就向你绑定的会话送一份简短的素材包。能不能开口由代码里的规则决定（静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却），说不说由那个会话里的 agent 自己判断。仅支持 Windows。'

plugins.name: kanchengw/dsh-assembly.resume
plugins.descEn: 'Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.'
plugins.descZh: 将本地 Codex CLI/Desktop、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 会话导入 DSH：按项目分组，保留语义历史和工具活动，可绑定原工作区或新工作区，并由 DSH Agent 继续对话。

plugins.name: kangtsang/dsh-worktree-space
plugins.descEn: "Worktree Space: puts a workspace task that spans one or more Git repositories in its own task space directory - each repository in it gets its own worktree on one shared task branch; the space is registered as a DSH Workspace so sessions start right there, and multiple tasks run side by side without interfering. Finishing a task can merge the work back into each repository's target branch, remove the worktrees, and file whatever Git does not track in an archive directory you choose."
plugins.descZh: "Worktree Space：将一个可包含多个 Git 仓库的工作区任务放进独立的任务空间目录——参与的每个仓库使用同一个任务分支各开一个 worktree；空间自动注册为 DSH 工作区，会话直接在其中开工，多个任务并行推进、互不干扰。收尾时可合并回各仓库目标分支、移除 worktree，并把 Git 未跟踪的文件归档到指定目录；结束任务时可选把未提交的变更和合并冲突交给 agent 处理。"

plugins.name: kankezhiyan/dsh-awesome-fonts
plugins.descEn: 'Font switcher for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: 99 UI fonts + 31 code fonts with CJK-Latin pairing.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 换字体的插件：99 个界面字体 + 31 个代码字。'

plugins.name: KannaKuron/dsh-agent-lang
plugins.descEn: 'Three independent language channels for model output — tool-call descriptions (every tool-call card title, including run_code in PTC-style presets), thinking, and replies — each set to follow the web GUI language, force a specific language, or turn off (default: only descriptions, following the GUI). One global runtime-context prompt directive on the host; the client half reports the GUI language; a Settings plugin card switches the modes.'
plugins.descZh: '模型产出文本的三个语言通道——工具调用描述（所有工具调用卡片标题，含 PTC 类预设的 run_code）、思考与回复——各自可跟随网页界面语言、强制指定语言或关闭（默认仅描述通道跟随界面语言）。host 侧注入一条全局 runtime-context 提示指示，client 半上报界面语言，设置里的插件卡片负责切换。'

plugins.name: KannaKuron/dsh-better-workspace
plugins.descEn: 'Hierarchical workspace tree for the DSH sidebar: every slash in a workspace title becomes a virtual folder (arbitrarily deep), the add-workspace directory flow gains a parent-group popup, renames re-derive the tree instantly, sessions nest on the same rule with separate visual styling, and every row carries right-click actions plus per-row appearance customization (color, text-only glow, font weight, primitives-family icon).'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 侧边栏「工作区」列表的层级树插件：工作区与会话名称中的 / 即虚拟分组（任意多级），添加工作区的目录流附带「所属分组」弹窗，重命名即时重排；每层行均支持右键操作与外观自定义（颜色、文字发光、字体粗细、原版图标库图标）。'

plugins.name: KannaKuron/dsh-gitbash-shell
plugins.descEn: "Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam."
plugins.descZh: "Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。"

plugins.name: KannaKuron/dsh-ide-git
plugins.descEn: 'JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.'
plugins.descZh: 侧边栏里的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、逐文件行级 diff、变更列表与提交框，以及分支、标签、贮藏操作和合并、变基、优选、重置、抓取/拉取/推送。

plugins.name: KannaKuron/dsh-ptc-cordis-preset
plugins.descEn: "Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that layers the self-referential Cordis toolset (dynamic plugins, runtime inspection) and preset-authoring skills onto the PTC Code-Mode preset; materialized files carry per-file sha256 markers, so user-edited presets are never overwritten on upgrade or uninstall."
plugins.descZh: "为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Agent 预设：在 PTC 编码模式之上叠加自引用 Cordis 工具集（动态插件、运行时检视）与预设编写技能；物化文件带逐文件 sha256 标记，用户改过的预设升级与卸载时都不会被覆盖。"

plugins.name: KasenRi/dsh-browser
plugins.descEn: "Controlled browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: the agent_browser tool and BrowserAutomationService drive a real Chromium or Chrome page (or an explicit CDP endpoint) through the agent-browser CLI, with allowedDomains containment and per-call output limits."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 的受控浏览器自动化：agent_browser 工具与 BrowserAutomationService 通过 agent-browser CLI 驱动真实 Chromium / Chrome 页面（或指定 CDP 端点），支持 allowedDomains 域名收敛与单次调用输出上限。"

plugins.name: KasenRi/dsh-orbit
plugins.descEn: "Deterministic engineering orchestration runtime for DeepSeek Harness: the orbit_controller tool and OrbitService run Commander, Executor and Smart Watchdog children through PLAN, EXECUTE, EVALUATE, bounded correction and runtime recovery, with durable state in <project>/.cx/state.json."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 的确定性工程编排运行时：orbit_controller 工具与 OrbitService 以 Commander / Executor / Smart Watchdog 子代理执行 PLAN、EXECUTE、EVALUATE、有界修正与运行时恢复，持久状态保存在 <project>/.cx/state.json。"

plugins.name: Kayungko/dsh-plugin-product-design
plugins.descEn: Product Design workflow suite for DeepSeek Harness - a router plus nine pd-* skills carrying ideas from a minimum design brief through visual directions, evidence-grounded research and audits, URL cloning, frontend builds and a blocking design-QA gate.
plugins.descZh: 产品设计工作流套件：一个路由加九个 pd-* 技能，把想法从最小设计简报推进到视觉方向、证据化调研与审计、URL 克隆、前端构建与阻断式设计 QA 闸门。

plugins.name: Kayungko/dsh-plugin-task-coordinator
plugins.descEn: 'Supervisor-style workflow orchestration over top-level sessions: confirmation-gated batch dispatch, team workstreams, steering running tasks, idle-wait collection and live model-route discovery across 11 task_* tools plus a /tasks slash command.'
plugins.descZh: '总控式工作流编排：确认闸门批量派发、团队编组、向运行中任务纠偏、等待收口与模型路线发现——11 个 task_* 工具加 /tasks 斜杠命令。'

plugins.name: keepermttl/dsh-archive-viewer
plugins.descEn: 'Archived-session manager for the DSH Web GUI: search titles and message content, tag/filter sessions, read logs, restore sessions, and export ZIP archives.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 归档会话管理器：支持标题/内容搜索、标签筛选、阅读日志、恢复会话与 ZIP 导出。

plugins.name: KelaoHu/dsh-lowtide#dsh-lowtide
plugins.descEn: 'Lowtide (as in low tide) runs task batches automatically in off-peak hours — a highly customizable task framework with four execution strategies, L1–L3 semi/full-auto adjudication, in-place task editing and preflight checks, built on the Cordis microkernel, one build for both desktop and web.'
plugins.descZh: 'lowtide（退潮）插件能够实现闲时自动批量跑任务——任务框架高度自定义，四种执行策略，L1–L3 半自动/全自动裁决，支持任务编辑与预检，Cordis 微内核集成，桌面网页端通用。'

plugins.name: Kenerlee/dsh-moments-aieo
plugins.descEn: "AIEO (GEO/AEO) delivery method as one isolated skill provider: AI-visibility diagnosis on a 0-9 score, positioning, search-term mining restricted to whitelisted platform exports, periodic monitoring and an HTML monitoring dashboard, chained by one shared question library, plus a landing-page cloner."
plugins.descZh: "AIEO（GEO/AEO）交付方法论，挂载为一个独立的 skill provider：0-9 分制的 AI 可见性诊断、产品定位、仅限白名单平台导出数据的搜索热词挖掘、周期性效果监控与 HTML 监控面板，由同一份共享问题库串联，另附一个落地页复刻 skill。"

plugins.name: kenny2077/dsh-web-kimi
plugins.descEn: 'Kimi Coding web search and web fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness — one coding-plan key fills both ctx.web seams (POST /v1/search and /v1/fetch), a settings card in the GUI stores it via the credentials service, and the fallback chain reads the Kimi CLI config for zero-setup installs.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Kimi Coding 的网页搜索与网页抓取双提供方——一把 coding 计划密钥同时接入 ctx.web 的两条链路（/v1/search 与 /v1/fetch），设置卡片经凭据服务保存密钥，并回退读取 Kimi CLI 配置，安装即用。'

plugins.name: kenny2077/dsh-web-search-doubao
plugins.descEn: 'Doubao Search (Volcengine 豆包搜索) web search provider for the DeepSeek Harness — swaps the active web_search backend to the standalone Doubao Search API with its own key and billing (500 free searches per month), and ships a dedicated settings card that stores the key via the credentials service.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness 提供豆包搜索（火山引擎）网络搜索提供方——把 web_search 的后端切换为独立的豆包搜索 API，密钥与计费独立（每月 500 次免费），并内置专用设置卡片，经凭据服务保存密钥。'

plugins.name: kenny2077/dsh-web-search-zai
plugins.descEn: "Web search for DeepSeek Harness through Z.ai or Zhipu, with Coding Plan MCP quota and REST API billing modes, a native bilingual settings card, and support for reusing an existing ZAI_API_KEY."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 的 Z.ai / 智谱网页搜索插件，支持 Coding Plan MCP 套餐额度和 REST API 余额两种计费模式，提供原生中英文设置卡片，可复用现有 ZAI_API_KEY。"

plugins.name: kentleenot/dsh-trading-toolkit
plugins.descEn: 'A-share and US stock trading toolkit for DSH agents: realtime quotes, OHLCV klines, ADX three-state regime signals and simple backtest previews via EastMoney. Read-only, never places orders.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH agent 的 A股/美股交易工具箱：实时行情、OHLCV K线、ADX 三状态市场分类信号与简易回测预览，数据源东方财富。只读设计，永不下单。'

plugins.name: kenz1117/dsh-engram
plugins.descEn: 'Cross-session long-term memory under the "memory palace" metaphor: dual-scope SQLite stores (user + per-git-origin project), hybrid FTS5 + local-vector retrieval with RRF fusion and recency/proof ranking boost, automatic capture from the session log (including the final turn), provenance audit chains, consolidation distillation and decay forgetting, and a settings-page Memory Library panel with corridor topology, tour butler, and refurb list.'
plugins.descZh: 跨会话长期记忆插件，以「记忆宫殿」隐喻重构 agent 长期记忆：双层 SQLite 分库（用户级 + 按 git origin 隔离的项目级）、FTS5 + 本地向量 RRF 融合与新鲜度/命中排序 boost、从会话日志自动摄取（含末轮）、来源审计链、巩固蒸馏与衰减遗忘，以及设置页「记忆库」面板（走廊拓扑、导览管家、翻新清单）。

plugins.name: kenz1117/dsh-ui-rainbowspeak
plugins.descEn: 'RainbowSpeak — a flowing rainbow marquee border around the chat composer card, driven by a conic-gradient ring. Live settings for speed, width, seven color schemes, direction, sides and breathing, plus session-state awareness that reacts to running, attention, error and celebration moments.'
plugins.descZh: '虹语（RainbowSpeak）——沿聊天输入框边界持续流动的彩虹跑马灯，由锥形渐变环带驱动。支持流速、宽度、七种配色、方向、边与呼吸效果的实时设置，并具备会话状态感知：运行中加速、需关注变琥珀、出错红脉冲、庆祝闪动。'

plugins.name: kevenliu3/dhs-plugins#dsh-session-monitor
plugins.descEn: 'Sidebar badge and panel that aggregate per-session pending, running, and completed states across workspaces, with one click to open a session.'
plugins.descZh: '侧边栏徽标与面板，跨工作区聚合各会话的待处理、运行中、已完成状态，点击即可打开对应会话。'

plugins.name: Kevin-McIsaac/dsh-workspace-git-badge#dsh-git-badge
plugins.descEn: 'Git status badges for DSH: sidebar workspace-row badges and an input-row chip showing the current conversation''s workspace git state, with event-driven freshness over SSE.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 的 Git 状态徽章：侧边栏工作区行徽章与输入行徽章，显示当前会话工作区的 git 状态，通过 SSE 事件驱动保持实时。'

plugins.name: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts#insurance-actuary
plugins.descEn: Insurance actuary — runs real actuarial calculations (life & P&C reserve valuation under C-ROSS II BEL+RM, profit testing NBV/VNB/IRR, embedded value EV, pricing & loss-triangle reserving), not just explanations.
plugins.descZh: 保险精算师（insurance-actuary）——真跑精算测算：寿险/财险准备金评估（偿二代二期 BEL+RM）、利润测试（NBV/VNB/IRR）、内含价值(EV)、产品定价与损失三角准备金，而非仅讲解。

plugins.name: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts#insurance-company-analyst
plugins.descEn: Insurance company financial & operating analyst — solvency, financials, investment, distribution channels and peer comparison with real calculations.
plugins.descZh: 保险公司财务经营分析专家，真跑偿付能力、财务报表、投资、渠道与同业对标测算。

plugins.name: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts#insurance-ops-analyst
plugins.descEn: Insurance company operations analyst — runs real solvency, profitability, embedded value (EV), investment risk and regulatory compliance calculations, not just text explanations.
plugins.descZh: 保险公司经营分析专家（盈安），真跑偿付能力、盈利能力、内含价值(EV)、投资风险与监管合规五维测算。

plugins.name: kevinchu1981/dsh-insurance-experts#insurance-product-analyst
plugins.descEn: Insurance product comparison & proposal expert — clause analysis, cost-effectiveness, coverage planning, generates verifiable client-facing PDF proposals.
plugins.descZh: 保险产品对比与建议书专家（险析君），条款拆解、性价比测算、保障规划，生成可自核 PDF 建议书。

plugins.name: KevinZhangNothing/dsh-task-graph
plugins.descEn: Adds a Graph tab that renders one session's execution as an interactive DAG of turns, LLM steps, tools, skills, subagents, code changes and tests, with live status, retry aggregation, critical path and trajectory linkage.
plugins.descZh: 在会话区新增「图谱」Tab，把单个会话的执行过程渲染为可交互 DAG：轮次、LLM 步骤、工具、技能、子代理、代码改动与测试，支持实时状态、重试聚合、关键路径与轨迹双向联动。

plugins.name: kfirsch/dsh-hebrew-rtl
plugins.descEn: 'Hebrew RTL rendering for the web GUI: per-block direction by dominant script, bidi-safe input fields, and RTL-aware Cmd+Left/Right line navigation.'
plugins.descZh: '为 Web 界面提供希伯来语 RTL 渲染：按主导文字判定每个块的方向，输入框的 bidi 处理，以及在 RTL 行上方向正确的 Cmd+左/右 行内跳转。'

plugins.name: kgwdonkey/dsh-header-controls
plugins.descEn: Restart / exit power buttons in the conversation header.
plugins.descZh: 会话右上角的「重启 / 注销」电源按钮。

plugins.name: KhaosGx/dsh-stop-service
plugins.descEn: 'Service control panel in DSH Web settings: live host info (PID, versions, uptime, memory/CPU trends, active sessions), npm update banner, and a confirm-guarded graceful stop that warns when tasks are running and can wait for them to finish.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 设置页的服务控制面板：实时宿主信息（PID、版本、运行时长、内存/CPU 趋势、活跃会话）、npm 更新提醒，以及带确认的优雅停止——任务运行时发出警告，也可等待任务结束后自动停止。'

plugins.name: kikomaotu/ccs-balance
plugins.descEn: "Sync cc-switch provider balances and track token usage & cost by day/month/total with relay-aware currency settings."
plugins.descZh: "同步 cc-switch 各 provider 余额，按日/月/总量统计 token 用量与花费，支持中转站币种与汇率设置。"

plugins.name: kiligzzz/dsh-agent-dispatch
plugins.descEn: 'User-defined agents with automatic routing, model failover, and squad orchestration: six model tools (agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert), no built-in agents, a native right-tab panel (Overview / Agents / Squads / History), and a floating action ball.'
plugins.descZh: '自定义 Agent + 自动路由 + 小队编排：六个模型工具（agent_dispatch / agent_followup / agent_list / agent_squad / agent_import_skill / agent_upsert），无内置 Agent，原生右 tab 主面板（总览 / Agent / 小队 / 历史）与悬浮活动球。'

plugins.name: kiligzzz/dsh-session-archive
plugins.descEn: 'Sidebar panel for archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness: group by workspace, search by title, preview user questions, one-click restore, or delete with confirmation.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 已归档会话管理面板：按工作区目录分组、按标题实时搜索、只读预览用户问题、一键恢复，或二次确认后删除。

plugins.name: kiligzzz/dsh-session-nav
plugins.descEn: 'Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.'
plugins.descZh: 钢琴键风格的会话内导航条：每根键对应一条用户消息，悬停预览、点击跳转到完整历史的任意消息。官方双面 dsh 插件，不改 DSH 源码。

plugins.name: l2685209197/dsh-pdf-translate
plugins.descEn: "Translate text-based PDFs via DeepSeek or OpenAI-compatible APIs while preserving layout, fonts, images and links, with editable output."
plugins.descZh: "用 DeepSeek 或兼容 API 翻译文本型 PDF，保留版式、字体、图片与链接，输出可编辑 PDF。"

plugins.name: L3n3L/dsh-resume
plugins.descEn: AI can write resume text, but templates may still look wrong, pages may overflow, whitespace may remain, and small edits can destabilize the layout. dsh-resume provides an end-to-end DSH workflow for truthful content refinement, template selection, A4 layout tuning, visual review, and tailored resume versions for different job-search scenarios.
plugins.descZh: AI 写简历容易，但写完常会遇到模板不合适、排版溢出、页面留白过多，以及改一处导致全局变形等问题。dsh-resume 专注解决手动修改简历繁琐、低效的问题，让 DSH 覆盖从内容撰写、模板选择到排版调优的完整简历工作流，并支持针对不同求职场景产出合适的简历版本。

plugins.name: l956615272-hub/dsh-token-usage
plugins.descEn: Global token totals across every local DSH conversation, de-duplicated by message id, with custom date ranges and per-provider monthly quota tracking.
plugins.descZh: 统计本机全部 DSH 会话的历史 token 消耗，按 message.id 去重，支持自定义日期区间与按接入方的月度额度剩余。

plugins.name: laa1991/dsh-health
plugins.descEn: Turns declared health readings — source, criterion, verdict — into one read-only verdict; an unreadable source is reported as `unknown`, never as healthy.
plugins.descZh: 把声明式的健康读数（来源、判据、结论）合成为一个只读的总判定；读不到的来源报 `unknown`，绝不报成健康。

plugins.name: lacemou/dsh-session-ref
plugins.descEn: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.
plugins.descZh: 跨会话引用插件：在任意会话（含其他工作区）粘贴 @[label](dsh-session:…) 引用，宿主注入被引用会话的快照供模型阅读，并提供一键复制引用按钮。

plugins.name: Lacquervii/smooth-cursor
plugins.descEn: "Smooth comet-mode animated caret for the DSH Web composer: a glowing comet trail replaces the native blinking caret and glides across the input as you type, with configurable accent color, thickness, and trail, IME-aware for CJK input."
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供流畅的彗星光标：以发光的彗星拖尾取代原生闪烁光标，随输入平滑滑动，可配置强调色、粗细与拖尾，并适配中文等 IME 输入。

plugins.name: lakabuji-arch/dsh-model-accordion
plugins.descEn: "Provider-folded model selector for the DSH Web composer with catalog-driven reasoning effort choices."
plugins.descZh: "为 DSH Web 输入栏提供按 provider 折叠的模型选择器，并使用模型目录中的真实推理档位。"

plugins.name: lalalaleo/dsh-draft
plugins.descEn: 'A Markdown-based draft-board plugin for dsh: live-preview editing and local persistence.'
plugins.descZh: 基于 Markdown 的 dsh 草稿板插件，支持实时预览编辑，本地持久化。

plugins.name: lamost423/dsh-maze
plugins.descEn: "Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare."
plugins.descZh: 执行迷宫：把智能体真实的执行过程——主干推进、失败或扑空的支路、折返、请求重试与子代理分支——画在同一根墙钟时间轴上；泳道下方是与它共用时间轴的三条数据轨道（工具调用密度、Token 脉冲、上下文压力），再下方是确定性的执行分析面板（工具结果矩阵、失败恢复链、耗时分布）；可在会话页签里实时生长，也可上传最多 5 个 session log 做同轴对比。

plugins.name: lanbaolu/dsh-fail-soft
plugins.descEn: 'Automatically disables a failing plugin so the rest of DSH keeps booting — by patching DSH’s own installed kernel (mount-time quarantine + self-healing), not preflight smoke-tests. Includes status tools and a one-click restore panel.'
plugins.descZh: '自动隔离损坏插件、让 DSH 其余插件照常启动——通过补丁 DSH 自身已安装的内核实现（挂载期隔离 + 补丁自愈），而非 preflight 冒烟测试。附带状态工具与一键恢复面板。'

plugins.name: lanbaolu/dsh-wechat-bridge
plugins.descEn: 'Two-way WeChat bridge for DeepSeek Harness via the iLink protocol: bind your personal WeChat with a QR scan and chat with a local DSH agent from the chat box (text, images, voice-to-text, files); a web settings panel handles binding/start/stop/status, project-session binding continues the conversation on desktop, proactive wechat_notify pushes include throttling, and the pure-Node daemon runs on Windows/macOS/Linux.'
plugins.descZh: 基于 iLink 协议的 DSH 微信双向桥：扫码绑定个人微信后在聊天框直接与本机 DSH Agent 对话（文字/图片/语音转文字/文件），Web 设置面板管理扫码绑定/启停/状态，支持绑定项目会话跨端续聊，agent 可主动 wechat_notify 推送（内置节流），纯 Node 守护进程，Windows/macOS/Linux 三端通用。

plugins.name: langyo/dsh-mobile-upgrade
plugins.descEn: 'Requires DSH 0.1.5-rc.1. Mobile UI fixes for the dsh web profile: narrow-screen drawer and settings tabs, a full-width model menu, a stuck-request network chip, and a narrow-header collector that folds the lineage, subagent and background-job chips into one tappable sheet.'
plugins.descZh: '需要 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1。dsh web profile 的手机端体验修复：窄屏抽屉与设置标签、全宽模型菜单、卡住请求的网络状态芯片，以及把会话层级、subagent 与后台任务芯片收进一张可点开面板的窄屏头部收纳器。'

plugins.name: lanscer/dsh-workspace-drag
plugins.descEn: Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.
plugins.descZh: 把侧边栏中的对话拖到任意工作区分组，即可在 DSH 工作区之间迁移该对话，同步更新其 cwd、磁盘位置与工作区注册表归属。

plugins.name: Laplace-bit/dsh-bell-notify
plugins.descEn: 'Web Audio lifecycle cues for DeepSeek Harness: ten configurable events, three low-noise defaults, per-event custom sounds, and no shipped audio assets.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 生命周期提示音：10 个可配置事件，默认只开启三项低打扰提示，可为每个事件更换自定义声音，内置音效不带音频资源。

plugins.name: Laplace-bit/dsh-pianist
plugins.descEn: 'Piano performance plugin: ask the agent to play a piece and it renders on a Canvas2D grand piano with real Salamander Grand samples, an immersive stage, and an interactive 88-key keyboard.'
plugins.descZh: 让 Agent 弹一曲真钢琴：Salamander Grand 真实采样音色，Canvas2D 三角钢琴与沉浸式舞台渲染，88 键可弹。

plugins.name: lastplayer82/dsh-tanqi
plugins.descEn: 'AI-generated curiosity & trivia plugin for the dsh web GUI (Curio in the English UI): 「开始探奇」 generates a fresh batch of unexpected knowledge (excluding everything already seen), each item unfolds into two deeper layers plus similar knowledge points, and 「探奇清单」 keeps the full history (batch, items, layers, similar points) in browser storage. Reuses the host LLM channel with zero config; when no model is available, a DeepSeek API key can be pasted into the panel. Output language follows the DSH UI language (zh/en).'
plugins.descZh: '为 dsh Web 界面生成冷知识与奇妙事实的插件（英文界面下名为 Curio）：「开始探奇」每次生成一批不重复主题（排除已见），每条可深入两层并展开类似知识点，「探奇清单」将全部历史（批次、条目、层级、类似点）保存在浏览器；优先复用宿主 LLM 通道，无需配置，无可用模型时可在面板填写 DeepSeek API Key；输出语言跟随 DSH 界面语言（中/英）。'

plugins.name: latte03/dsh-select-quote
plugins.descEn: 'Select text in the dsh web conversation to attach it as an annotation to your next message. The source text keeps a dashed highlight with an ordinal badge in place, and the composer summary lists, edits and jumps back to each annotation.'
plugins.descZh: '在 dsh 网页版对话里划词，把选中文本作为批注附到下一条消息。原文位置保留虚线高亮和序号角标，输入框上方的批注摘要可查看、编辑并跳回每一条批注。'

plugins.name: LAU-MARS/dsh-cad
plugins.descEn: Views and builds CAD models (STL, OBJ, STEP, IGES, DXF, SVG) via cad_view/cad_info and OCCT parametric modeling tools, with an interactive viewer card and a resident CAD panel in the Web UI.
plugins.descZh: 通过 cad_view/cad_info 与 OCCT 参数化建模工具查看和构建 CAD 模型（STL、OBJ、STEP、IGES、DXF、SVG），并在 Web UI 中提供交互式查看卡片与常驻 CAD 面板。

plugins.name: lau4tin1/dsh-skill-router
plugins.descEn: 'Skill routing for DeepSeek Harness: embeds skills and each user task with a local model, keeps the clearly-relevant skills with a gap-based selection rule, and auto-injects their full bodies into the prompt.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的 skill 路由插件：用本地模型为 skill 和用户任务生成向量，按基于分差的规则保留明确相关的 skill，并自动把它们的完整正文注入提示词。'

plugins.name: lavapapa/dsh-composer-layout
plugins.descEn: 'Web Composer placement for long prompts: keep it at the bottom or dock it in a resizable right column beside a long answer.'
plugins.descZh: 面向长提示词的 Web Composer 布局：输入框可保留在底部，也可停靠到可调宽度的右栏，与长回答并排阅读和写作。

plugins.name: LAwLi3tCoding/dsh-api-ledger
plugins.descEn: Tracks API token usage and estimated costs with per-route model pricing, optional billing groups, synchronized CNY/USD display, session reports, composer totals and a clickable daily sidebar total.
plugins.descZh: 按 API 路由与模型配置单价，统计 Token 用量与估算费用，支持可选账单分组、同步切换 CNY/USD，以及会话报告、输入框费用和可点击的侧边栏今日金额。

plugins.name: LAwLi3tCoding/dsh-approval-review
plugins.descEn: 'Adds an "approve for me" access mode whose approval requests are answered by an independent reviewer model instead of a person: the reviewer can read the workspace read-only, a reviewer that cannot run hands the request back to the human, and every decision is recorded with its rationale in an Approvals tab.'
plugins.descZh: '新增「替我审批」访问模式：审批请求由独立的复核模型裁决而非人工，复核者可只读工作区，复核跑不起来时把请求交回人工，每次裁决的理由记录在「审批」页签中。'

plugins.name: LayneChai/superpowers-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Superpowers for DeepSeek Harness: TDD, debugging, planning, and collaboration skills adapted from obra/superpowers, installed as a Cordis plugin registering 14 skills with zero runtime dependencies.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 版 Superpowers 技能包：移植自 obra/superpowers 的 TDD、调试、规划与协作技能，以 Cordis 插件安装并注册 14 个技能（零运行时依赖）。

plugins.name: LAYZR114/dsh-project-memory
plugins.descEn: "Polaris Memory: local-first project memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Uses per-project .dsh-memory.json; provides memory_read/recall/write/update/delete tools, /memory command and settings UI, with tiered injection (resident user profile + scene-triggered memories with P1/P2/P3 importance), semantic recall (IDF + synonym layer), and a hard-guard mechanism for bottom-line memories (detect deny-semantics -> authorize -> block AI deletion; user can confirm-override)."
plugins.descZh: "北极星记忆：DeepSeek Harness 本地优先项目记忆插件。每项目一份 .dsh-memory.json（按 cwd 隔离），提供 memory_read/recall/write/update/delete 工具、/memory 命令与设置页；分级注入（用户画像常驻 + 场景触发记忆带 P1/P2/P3 等级）、语义召回（IDF+同义词层）、底线记忆硬守卫机制（识别禁止语义→授权→拦截 AI 删除；用户可确认绕过）。"

plugins.name: lcestou/dsh-oh-my-claude
plugins.descEn: "Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for dsh: live model list, per-session resume, approval relay, images, a memory/rewind/changes panel, and workspaces on remote SSH boxes."
plugins.descZh: "把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的模型提供商：实时模型列表、按会话恢复、审批中转、图片、记忆/回退/变更面板，以及远程 SSH 主机上的工作区。"

plugins.name: lcgash/dsh-plugin-uw
plugins.descEn: 'Union workspaces: merge multiple directories into one session, manage unions from a settings panel, and read/write member files via uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move tools.'
plugins.descZh: '联合工作区：将多个目录合并到一个会话中，通过设置面板管理联合工作区，使用 uw_read/uw_write/uw_edit/uw_delete/uw_move 工具读写成员目录文件。'

plugins.name: lcthe/dsh-hermes-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Scoped persistent memory for DSH: memory_save/search/replace/remove/list across global, user, project and failure scopes, DSH storage-domain persistence with secret and prompt-injection scanning, session-scope search, retention cleanup, and optional session-start injection; standing context via memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 有界持久记忆：memory_save/search/replace/remove/list 覆盖全局、用户、项目、失败四类范围，基于 DSH storage-domain 持久化，写入前做密钥与提示注入扫描，支持会话范围检索、保留期清理与可选的会话开始注入；常驻上下文用 memory_pin/memory_pins/memory_unpin 管理。'

plugins.name: lcthe/dsh-skills-hub
plugins.descEn: 'DSH Skill Manager: browse, enable/disable, import from Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork, auto-discover skills with symlink support.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 技能管理器：浏览、启用/禁用、从 Codex/Claude Code/ZCode/WorkBuddy/QCoderWork 导入，自动发现技能并支持软链接。'

plugins.name: lcthe/dsh-usage-monitor
plugins.descEn: 'DSH Usage Monitor: auto-query provider credit balances and time-window limits from configured API keys, with input capsule and custom provider support.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 用量监控：自动查询已配置 API Key 的供应商余额和时间窗口限制，支持输入框余量胶囊和自定义供应商。'

plugins.name: lediemquynh/dsh-ai-question-chime
plugins.descEn: "Plays a chime when the AI asks a clarifying question (a `?` / `？` in the message, or an `ask_user_question` tool call). Synthesized via Web Audio API, no audio file, works on every OS."
plugins.descZh: "当 AI 询问澄清性问题时（带问号或调用 ask_user_question）播放提示音。Web Audio API 合成，零音频文件，跨 Windows/macOS/Linux。"

plugins.name: lee259/dsh-workbench
plugins.descEn: A right-side file workspace for DeepSeek Harness Web with source previews, captured DSH diffs, tabs, and a workspace tree.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness Web 右侧文件工作区，提供源码预览、DSH 捕获差异、多文件标签页和工作区文件树。

plugins.name: leeclouddragon/dsh-all-in
plugins.descEn: Adds a local-only six-seat Texas Hold'em table to the DSH Web UI with full betting streets, side pots, persistent Token stacks, and agent-status display.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web UI 中加入本地六人桌德州扑克，支持完整下注轮次、边池结算、Token 筹码持久化与 Agent 状态显示。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-agent-arena
plugins.descEn: Compares coding agents in isolated Git worktrees with deterministic validation, scoring, and explicit winner application.
plugins.descZh: 在隔离的 Git 工作树中比较编码智能体，并提供确定性验证、评分和显式胜者应用。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-skin-studio
plugins.descEn: Local semantic-token theme editor with palette extraction, WCAG auditing, preview, and export.
plugins.descZh: 本地语义令牌主题编辑器，支持色板提取、WCAG 审计、预览和导出。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-vibe-pack
plugins.descEn: Transactional data-only configuration pack manager with integrity, ownership, preview, diff, and rollback safeguards.
plugins.descZh: 仅数据的事务式配置包管理器，提供完整性、归属、预览、差异和回滚保护。

plugins.name: LeemanCheung/dsh-whale-companion
plugins.descEn: Draggable whale companion with local progression, achievements, skins, and privacy-safe activity tracking.
plugins.descZh: 可拖拽的鲸鱼伙伴，提供本地成长、成就、皮肤和隐私安全的活动统计。

plugins.name: leetom314/dsh-delivery-ledger
plugins.descEn: 'Recurring task scheduler with an append-only delivery ledger: window-aligned dedup execution, failure/abandoned rows, and same-window retry redelivery.'
plugins.descZh: '周期性任务调度器 + 只追加的投递账本：按时间窗去重执行，记录失败／放弃行，同窗口重试可重投。'

plugins.name: leetom314/dsh-risk-gate
plugins.descEn: 'Semantic risk grading and progressive authorization: classifies tool calls into safe/risky/redline, asks before irreversible actions, auto-allows only approved-and-succeeded signatures.'
plugins.descZh: '语义风险分级与渐进授权：把工具调用分为安全／有风险／红线三档，不可逆操作前先询问，只对「已批准且曾成功」的签名自动放行。'

plugins.name: leetom314/dsh-tiered-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Tiered persistent memory (user/env/project) with per-tier char budgets and semantic query routing; full layers refuse writes instead of silently evicting.'
plugins.descZh: '分层持久记忆（user／env／project）：每层各有字符预算与语义查询路由；层满时拒绝写入，而不是静默淘汰。'

plugins.name: leeyoung1/dsh-advisor-plugin
plugins.descEn: Pairs the running executor with a stronger reviewer model through zero-parameter advisor() calls and step-based patrol checks, returning plan, correction, or stop guidance.
plugins.descZh: 通过零参数 advisor() 咨询和按步巡逻检查，为执行模型接入更强的审查模型，返回计划、纠偏或停止信号。

plugins.name: left0ver/dsh-file-review
plugins.descEn: 'Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.'
plugins.descZh: '在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。'

plugins.name: LeiSureYu/dsh-smart-download
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bundled aria2: probes the target for Range support, then picks aria2 (4 or 8 connections by file size) or falls back to curl.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2：先探测目标是否支持 Range，再按文件大小选择 aria2（4 或 8 连接）或回退 curl 单线程下载。'

plugins.name: lemoncat7/dsh-partner
plugins.descEn: Long-lived AI companions with isolated memory, WeChat channels, Skills, schedules, heartbeat concerns, and a dependency-aware task board.
plugins.descZh: 提供隔离记忆、微信渠道、Skill、定时任务、伙伴挂念与依赖任务看板的长期 AI 伙伴。

plugins.name: lemoncat7/dsh-ssh
plugins.descEn: SSH profiles, browser terminals, SFTP browsing, port forwarding, proxies, and session-scoped AI access for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 配置、浏览器终端、SFTP 浏览、端口转发、代理与会话级 AI 访问。

plugins.name: lemoncat7/dsh-web-search
plugins.descEn: Configurable web search for DeepSeek Harness using SearXNG, Wikipedia, Tavily, Brave, or Gemini, with per-client engine selection and bounded retries.
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置联网搜索，支持 SearXNG、Wikipedia、Tavily、Brave 与 Gemini，并支持客户端引擎选择和受控重试。

plugins.name: lemonorangeapple/dsh-effort-switcher
plugins.descEn: 'A Codex-like effort switcher for Deepseek Harness.'
plugins.descZh: '为DSH添加一个类似于Codex的推理强度切换器。'

plugins.name: lemonxiny55/dsh-code-index
plugins.descEn: 'Structural code index for DSH: Tree-sitter symbol search across 8 languages (including C/C++), a bounded repository map ranked by import-graph PageRank and injected into the system prompt, function-level call graph via code_refs, optional circular-dependency and orphan-module checks via code_health, plus working-tree change context and task-aware code context.'
plugins.descZh: '结构化代码索引：基于 tree-sitter 的跨 8 种语言（含 C/C++）符号搜索、按 import-graph PageRank 排序并注入系统提示词的限量仓库地图、通过 code_refs 提供的函数级调用图、可选的 code_health 环依赖与孤儿模块检查，以及 working-tree 变更上下文和任务感知代码上下文。'

plugins.name: lemonxiny55/dsh-composition-doctor
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only DSH/Cordis composition doctor for plugin conflicts and upgrade rehearsal: scan profile manifests and patches, find duplicate rows, hook-order and UI ownership conflicts, compare redacted snapshots, diff plugin/row/hook changes, and preflight target DSH releases with explicit evidence boundaries — without mutating a real profile.'
plugins.descZh: '只读的 DSH/Cordis 组合诊断与升级预检工具：扫描 profile manifest 与 patch，发现重复 row、hook 顺序和 UI 所有权冲突，比较脱敏快照，分析插件/row/hook 变化，并在明确证据边界的前提下预检目标 DSH release——不会修改真实 profile。'

plugins.name: lemonxiny55/dsh-lint-loop
plugins.descEn: 'Change-aware quality loop for DSH: fast lint feedback and safe regression-only repair, bounded completion checks for lint deltas, TypeScript and impacted Vitest/Jest tests, and a Quality Receipt that separates new regressions from historical debt.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DSH 的变更感知质量闭环：编辑后快速 lint 反馈与仅针对新增问题的安全修复，完成前有界验证 lint 增量、TypeScript 和受影响的 Vitest/Jest 测试，并生成区分新增回归与历史债务的 Quality Receipt。'

plugins.name: lemonxiny55/dsh-lsp-diagnostics
plugins.descEn: 'Real-time LSP diagnostics loop: lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover tools over headless stdio language servers (TypeScript/JavaScript + Python), plus an auto-injected post-edit diagnostics delta wired to the harness fs/observed event — Cursor-style edit → diagnostics → fix for dsh agents.'
plugins.descZh: '实时 LSP 诊断闭环：通过无头 stdio 语言服务器（TypeScript/JavaScript + Python）提供 lsp_diagnostics / lsp_workspace_errors / lsp_hover 工具，并订阅 harness 的 fs/observed 事件自动注入「本次编辑引入的诊断增量」——为 dsh Agent 带来 Cursor 式的编辑→诊断→修复体验。'

plugins.name: lengquan88/dsh-dual-auto
plugins.descEn: "Dual-model auto-routing plugin: low-cost direct / high-cost upgrade with an escape-learning closed loop (wrong direct answers auto-learn fingerprints, force-upgrading the same fingerprint next time), persisted and interoperable with the Python ModelRouter."
plugins.descZh: "双模型 Auto 路由插件：低成本模型直返 / 高成本模型升级 + 逃逸学习闭环（直返答错自动学习指纹，同指纹下次强制升级），状态持久化并与 Python ModelRouter 互通。"

plugins.name: lengzhanbao/dsh-raiden-theme
plugins.descEn: Violet-gold acrylic DSH Web theme with light and dark stage art, framed chat, workspace mascot, and an optional Raiden agent preset.
plugins.descZh: 紫金亚克力 DSH Web 主题，含浅色与深色舞台背景、描边对话框、工作区吉祥物与可选 Raiden Agent 预设。

plugins.name: lengzhanbao/dsh-taffy-theme
plugins.descEn: Candy-pink acrylic DSH Web theme with light conservatory and dark stage art, gold-pink chat frame, Taffy character overlays, and an optional agent preset.
plugins.descZh: 粉金亚克力 DSH Web 主题，含浅色花房与深色舞台背景、粉金对话框、塔菲立绘装饰与可选 Agent 预设。

plugins.name: Lenonss/DSH_VsCodeMode
plugins.descEn: "VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts."
plugins.descZh: "为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 VSCode 编码体验：基于 Monaco 的中央文件编辑器（文件页签、Ctrl+P 快速打开、状态栏），并对 Agent 的 edit/write 结果进行交互式差异审查（逐处采纳/拒绝、回滚、归档），状态跨重启持久化。"

plugins.name: leogottadothebest/dsh-plugin-archived-conversations
plugins.descEn: 'Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.'
plugins.descZh: '在设置界面管理已归档对话：一键取消归档，或经确认后永久删除。'

plugins.name: leogottadothebest/dsh-settings-beautify
plugins.descEn: 'Normalize the DSH settings UI onto one design language: unified typography, cards, controls, focus and motion across every settings page, including pages contributed by other plugins.'
plugins.descZh: '将 DSH 设置界面归一为同一套设计语言：统一各设置页的排版、卡片、控件、焦点与动效，包括其他插件贡献的页面。'

plugins.name: Lequait/dsh-glm-web
plugins.descEn: Unofficial Zhipu Qingyan (chatglm.cn) web provider — run DeepSeek Harness on web-app credits with a login token, streaming and prompt-bridged tool calls included.
plugins.descZh: 非官方的智谱清言（chatglm.cn）网页版 provider——用网页版登录态与积分驱动 DSH，支持流式输出与提示词桥工具调用。

plugins.name: Lequait/dsh-proxy-router
plugins.descEn: 'Imports a proxy subscription, supervises a local mihomo core (proxy-provider plus a url-test group), and fetches direct-first with automatic proxy fallback and per-host routing memory; exposes one proxy_router tool (status, start, stop, test, fetch, routes, forget).'
plugins.descZh: '导入代理订阅并监督本地 mihomo 内核（proxy-provider + url-test 组），取回时直连优先、失败自动切代理并按主机记忆路由；对外只有一个 proxy_router 工具（status/start/stop/test/fetch/routes/forget）。'

plugins.name: let-mi-think/agent-manager
plugins.descEn: Create and configure Agent presets from a single settings section — persona prompt, a checked knowledge-base entry list injected into the system prompt, individual switches for four knowledge-base tools, per-Agent narrowing of MCP connections, and batch knowledge-base import.
plugins.descZh: 在一个设置分区里新建与配置 Agent 预设——人格提示词、勾选后注入系统提示的知识库条目清单、四个知识库工具的独立开关、按 Agent 收窄 MCP 连接，以及知识库批量导入。

plugins.name: let-mi-think/wechat-agent-router
plugins.descEn: Route each WeChat group session to a different Agent preset by group name, reusing dsh-wechat-assistant without changing its code.
plugins.descZh: 按群名把每个微信群会话路由到不同的 Agent 预设，不改动 dsh-wechat-assistant 的任何代码。

plugins.name: Letter2025/dsh-task-worktree
plugins.descEn: 'Task-scoped git worktrees for DSH: durable per-repo manifest, worktree mode injects a creation instruction with your first message under an automatic worktree/ branch prefix, header badge instead of workspace clutter, and bring-back or force-remove cleanup.'
plugins.descZh: '任务级 git worktree：per-repo manifest 持久保存；Worktree 模式在首条消息注入创建指引并统一 worktree/ 分支前缀，头部徽标替代工作区注册，支持带回主目录或强制删除收尾。'

plugins.name: levodoubt/dsh-longtext-input
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a Long text button to the composer tool row: write or paste the body in an editor overlay, and on save it is written to <workspace>/.dsh-longtext/<timestamp>_<title>.md and an @ path reference to that file is appended to the composer, leaving the conversation free of the long text itself.'
plugins.descZh: '在输入框工具栏新增「长文本」按钮：在编辑器浮层里写或粘贴正文，保存后写入 <工作区>/.dsh-longtext/<时间戳>_<标题>.md，并把该文件的 @ 路径引用追加到输入框，让正文不进入对话。'

plugins.name: LFM097384/Context-Prism
plugins.descEn: 'Project-level Local Context Engine for DeepSeek Harness: retrieval/compression/prioritization over history, code, files, user preferences and agent trajectories, producing a dynamic context window for any LLM.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DeepSeek Harness 的项目级本地上下文引擎：对历史、代码、文件、用户偏好和 Agent 轨迹做检索/压缩/优先级排序，为任意 LLM 生成动态上下文窗口。'

plugins.name: lgquan/dsh-voco
plugins.descEn: Continuous voice conversations for DSH with hands-free listening, push-to-talk, speech recognition, TTS replies, and background Agent delegation.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH 提供持续语音对话，支持免提监听、按住说话、语音识别、TTS 语音回复和后台 Agent 任务委派。

plugins.name: lgquan/dsh-workspace-memory
plugins.descEn: Workspace-isolated durable memory for DSH, with searchable, auditable, correctable, and removable workspace memories plus controlled global memory.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH 提供工作区隔离的持久化记忆，让每个工作区拥有可检索、可审计、可纠错和可删除的独立记忆，并支持受控的全局记忆。

plugins.name: lhbsaa/dsh-visibridge
plugins.descEn: 'Structured vision evidence (OCR/layout/semantics) plus a USB camera capture tool for a "shoot-look-adjust" debug loop; backends: Ollama, DeepSeek, Xiaomi.'
plugins.descZh: '结构化视觉证据（OCR/版面/语义）+ USB 摄像头拍摄工具，支持"拍-看-改"调试闭环；后端支持 Ollama、DeepSeek、小米。'

plugins.name: Lheyang/orca-dsh-launcher
plugins.descEn: 'Windows desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness: update checker, server start/stop, system tray, graphical console, and one-click installer.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows 桌面伴侣：更新检查、服务器启停、系统托盘、图形控制台与一键安装。'

plugins.name: LHF198/dsh-prompt-optimizer
plugins.descEn: Improve the current chat draft before sending with a confirm-before-apply comparison.
plugins.descZh: 在发送前优化当前聊天输入，采用前先对比原文与优化结果。

plugins.name: lhuans/dsh-genui
plugins.descEn: 'Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.'
plugins.descZh: 通过 schemaJson 代码块在 DSH 回复内渲染 OpenTiny GenUI 图表、表单、计算器等迷你应用，用户操作自动回传对话。

plugins.name: Li-Mingshuang/dsh-audio-control
plugins.descEn: 'Floating audio control panel in the Web GUI: play/pause/next/previous for Windows media sessions (SMTC) and the system master volume/mute, served by a Node route half that runs a PowerShell helper.'
plugins.descZh: Web 界面里的悬浮音频控制面板：控制 Windows 媒体会话（SMTC）的播放/暂停/上一首/下一首与系统主音量/静音，由注册路由的主机半调用 PowerShell 助手实现。

plugins.name: liang-today/dsh-liangxiang
plugins.descEn: Burned DSH tokens become incense; spend one stick to raise or lower today's case. The case updates daily, Liangwei decides today's Liangzi, and the result is archived at day end.
plugins.descZh: 用 DSH 烧掉的 Token 凝成香火，花一炷给今日梁案投夯或拉；梁案每日更新，梁位决定今日梁子，日终收入梁祠。

plugins.name: liangl1985/work-personal-secretary#work-personal-secretary
plugins.descEn: 'Installer and configuration base for a five-plugin DSH assistant suite: probes the Python, WPS and workspace environment, installs the sibling plugins shipped in the same repository, and generates the workspace baseline (instruction layer, memory seed, skills, settings); it also contributes its own settings section and its own host-side setup and check logic.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 工作秘书集成体的本体：做安装引导（Python / WPS / 工作区环境探针、安装同仓库分发的子插件）与配置底座（生成指令层、记忆种子、技能、设置），并在界面里提供独立的「工作秘书」设置分区，自带宿主侧安装与检查逻辑。'

plugins.name: liangmianya/dsh-synapse
plugins.descEn: Visual, non-linear conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, follow-ups and branches become a browsable conversation map.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的可视化非线性对话工作区：把会话、追问与分支变成可浏览、可拖拽的对话地图。

plugins.name: liangxiaobing520/dsh-local-vector-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Fully local vector memory for DSH: local embeddings, SQLite storage, automatic recall injection, dedup with conflict detection, soft-delete recycle bin, online backup, and optional LLM extraction.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 全本地向量记忆:本地 embedding、SQLite 存储、自动召回注入、去重与冲突检测、软删除回收站、在线备份,可选 LLM 提取。'

plugins.name: liaowenqi123/dsh-meeting-coordinator
plugins.descEn: 'Meeting rooms for DSH sessions: joining a room grants the right to convene and the duty to attend, and a session belongs to at most one room. Convening forks each participant in with its own completed-turn context and with its tools stripped, a moderator that carries no context chooses the speakers, and every turn is appended to disk as it is spoken. After adjournment each participant receives its own minutes as a user turn and resumes work.'
plugins.descZh: '给 DSH 会话装上会议室：加入会议室即同时获得召集权与参会义务，且一个会话只能属于一个会议室。召集时把每位参会者 fork 进场——带着它自己已完成的轮上下文，同时剥掉全部工具；主持人自身不带任何上下文，只负责挑下一位发言者；每条发言在说出的当下就落盘。散会后每人拿到一份只属于自己的纪要，作为一条用户输入送回工作区继续干活。'

plugins.name: liaoyonghong/dsh-workspace-api
plugins.descEn: 'Exposes the DSH workspace as an HTTP API: browse, search and read files, and run natural-language agent tasks that answer with cited sources.'
plugins.descZh: '把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。'

plugins.name: liaoyuqing/dsh-llm-error-retry
plugins.descEn: "LLM request retry plugin for DeepSeek Harness: when a model request fails with a configured HTTP status code, machine code, or provider field=value match, it sleeps for the per-rule delay and re-issues the request automatically, so subscription quota and rate-limit errors (429 / insufficient_quota) do not interrupt a run."
plugins.descZh: "大模型请求重试插件：命中配置的 HTTP 状态码、机器码或 provider 返回字段=值时，按该条规则独立配置的时长休眠后自动重新请求，让订阅套餐的限额、限流报错（429 / insufficient_quota）不打断运行。"

plugins.name: liaoyuqing/dsh_workspace_switch
plugins.descEn: "Per-workspace activation control: a dialog opened from the workspace row menu switches individual plugins, MCP servers, and skills on or off, and the host applies the choice in that workspace's own agent scope — a disabled skill leaves the model catalog, an MCP server has its mcp__<server>__ tools denied, and a plugin has the tool names its entry declares denied."
plugins.descZh: "按工作区开关插件、MCP 服务器与 Skills：工作区行菜单里的弹窗写入选择，宿主机在该工作区自己的 Agent 作用域内应用——关闭的 Skill 从模型目录中消失，MCP 服务器被拒绝其 mcp__<server>__ 工具，插件被拒绝其条目声明的工具名。"

plugins.name: libiwolve/dsh-experience-library
plugins.descEn: "Experience validation layer for DSH: zero-token collection of tool-failure/retry/search signals, AI refinement into verified skill books (three-layer verification), looked up at task start. Ships 10 trial skills and benchmark data (complex-task success 100% vs 60% bare)."
plugins.descZh: "DSH 经验验证固化层：零 token 采集工具失败/重试/搜索信号，加工轮提炼成经三层检验的技能书，任务开局翻书复用。内置 10 本试验经验 + benchmark 数据（复杂任务成功率 100% vs 裸环境 60%）。"

plugins.name: libre-webui/dsh-native-provider
plugins.descEn: "Use your DSH models in [Libre WebUI](https://github.com/libre-webui/libre-webui) for chat, sandboxed Work and usage tracking, with provider credentials kept in DSH. Requires Libre WebUI 0.37.0 or later."
plugins.descZh: "在 [Libre WebUI](https://github.com/libre-webui/libre-webui) 中使用 DSH 模型进行聊天、沙箱 Work 任务和用量统计，提供商凭据保留在 DSH 中。需要 Libre WebUI 0.37.0 或更高版本。"

plugins.name: Lichtspur/deepseek-style-theme
plugins.descEn: 'DeepSeek homepage-style theme skin for the dsh web GUI: fluid particle background, glass sidebar and composer, running-subagent progress panel, and DSTT peak-hour color modes.'
plugins.descZh: '为 dsh web GUI 复刻 DeepSeek 官网风格的主题皮肤：流体粒子背景、玻璃拟态侧边栏与输入框、运行中子代理面板与 DSTT 高峰时段配色。'

plugins.name: licyer/dsh-token-monitor
plugins.descEn: 'Header quota badge plus a usage-monitoring tab: live balance/quota remaining and reset countdown per provider, with requests, tokens (input/output/cache-read/cache-write), cache hit rate, estimated cost and average latency tracked per session, provider, model and client, stored locally in SQLite with cross-device import/export.'
plugins.descZh: 会话头部余量徽标 + 用量监控页签：实时展示各供应商余额/额度余量与重置倒计时，按会话/供应商/模型/客户端统计请求量、Token（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写）、缓存命中率、预估费用与平均时延，本地 SQLite 留存历史，支持跨设备导入导出。

plugins.name: lifangjin/dsh-paoding
plugins.descEn: 'Orchestration-mode preset generator for DSH: a lead agent delegates to four built-in role helpers that carry only their own tools, and the web panel adds or removes custom helpers with their own tools, skills, and models, per workspace — zero changes to the harness source.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 编排模式预设生成器：主 agent 指挥，四个内置帮手各只带本行工具；Web 面板按工作区增删帮手，可给自定角色配专属工具、技能与模型——零 DSH 源码改动。

plugins.name: lifeopsgo/dsh-capability-toggle-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Adds session, project, and global controls in the DSH WebUI for skills, MCP servers, tools, prompt injections, approval escalation, and safety guards; enforcement is scoped to the current agent.'
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH WebUI 中为技能、MCP 服务器、工具、提示词注入、审批升权和安全守卫提供会话、项目与全局三级控制，并在当前 agent 作用域内强制执行。

plugins.name: lifeopsgo/dsh-lark-session-monitor-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Watches Feishu (Lark) conversations with your own user identity and forwards new messages as prompts into a chosen DeepSeek Harness session: per-monitor sender filters, @bot-mention bypass and keyword allow/block lists, auto-created pinned target sessions, and cursor-based polling that re-reads messages after a failed delivery.'
plugins.descZh: '以用户本人身份监听飞书会话，把新消息作为 prompt 投递到指定的 DeepSeek Harness 会话：每个监听支持发送者过滤、@机器人提及与关键词黑白名单，可自动创建并固定目标会话，游标式轮询在投递失败后会重读消息。'

plugins.name: liggest/dsh-alt-enter-newline
plugins.descEn: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.
plugins.descZh: 给 dsh 的网页输入框加上 Alt+Enter 换行。

plugins.name: liguobao/dsh-file-viewer
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a provider API for non-local content.'
plugins.descZh: Web 客户端只读文件预览面板，支持图片、PDF、CSV/TSV、文本、源代码、Markdown、JSON 与 YAML 渲染、大文件分段读取，以及面向非本地内容的 provider API。

plugins.name: lihang-lh/dsh-moon-light
plugins.descEn: 'A marquee mood-light ring around the DSH web UI edge that reacts to session state, turning green while the agent works, pink when done, and yellow when something needs attention, with colors, ring width, rotation speed, and flash frequency configurable from the settings panel.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 界面边缘的跑马灯氛围光环：随会话状态自动变色（运行中绿色流动、完成粉色、有待处理黄色警告），设置面板可调颜色、光圈宽度、转速与闪动频率。

plugins.name: lihang-lh/dsh-task-panel
plugins.descEn: 'Task panel for the DSH Web sidebar: publish tasks, auto-distill related sessions, and drive plan/develop/review stages with subagents plus in-panel acceptance.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 侧边栏任务面板：发布任务、自动蒸馏历史会话，由子代理分阶段（规划/开发/复核）执行，并在面板内验收。'

plugins.name: lijiawei255/dsh-status-chime
plugins.descEn: 'Speaks a short status line when DSH changes state — turn done, turn error, job done, job failed, goal complete, goal blocked, an approval waiting, or the agent needs your answer — using eight pre-recorded clips in Chinese (default) and English. The audio is played by the host process through ffplay, or through the Windows PowerShell player that ships with the OS, so it does not depend on a Web Audio tab. Windows only.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 状态变化时读出一句简短提示——本轮完成、本轮出错、后台任务结束、后台任务失败、目标完成、目标受阻、等待批准、等待你回答——中文（默认）与英文各八条预录语音。音频由宿主进程播放（ffplay，或系统自带的 Windows PowerShell 播放器），不依赖浏览器 Web Audio。仅支持 Windows。'

plugins.name: lijinhao315/dsh-question-index
plugins.descEn: "Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to that point. Auto-indexes each session's full history on open, persists it locally, and jumps to older questions by growing the window on demand."
plugins.descZh: '提问索引：在会话右侧按序展示你提过的问题列表，可收起；点击某条即可把会话滚动跳转到对应位置。打开会话自动索引全部历史提问并本地持久保存；点击更早的提问会按需翻页加载后跳转。'

plugins.name: lilcandi/dsh-any-background-plus
plugins.descEn: "An enhanced fork of dsh-any-background. Its own work, from v0.4.0 onward, adds a dual-lane wallpaper: the same picture down each side of the window, split at the exact centre so the wallpaper stays visible beside the conversation column. Each lane can also read its own folder (one directory per side) while sharing a single rotation cadence and mode, and both lanes take identical edge feathering."
plugins.descZh: "dsh-any-background 的增强分支。v0.4.0 起的改动为本 fork 自作，新增左右双图轮播：同一轮播在窗口两侧各推进一步，以绝对中心为分界，壁纸不再被会话区完全挡住。两条车道还可各读一个文件夹（左右各一），共用同一轮播频率与模式，左右边缘淡化效果完全一致。"

plugins.name: lilming123/dsh-api
plugins.descEn: Exposes dsh's internal capabilities (language, workspace registry, agent-status and approval events) over HTTP under /dsh-api on the local loopback socket dsh already listens on, with SSE fan-out at /dsh-api/events.
plugins.descZh: 把 dsh 内部能力（语言、工作区注册表、agent-status 与 approval 事件）以 HTTP 路由的形式暴露在 dsh 已监听的本地回环 socket 上，前缀 /dsh-api，并通过 /dsh-api/events 提供 SSE 事件推送。

plugins.name: Limbo-137/dsh-typst-preview
plugins.descEn: "Typst live preview as a native right-Sidebar tab: clicking a .typ file opens a tab whose toolbar switches between the tinymist-rendered page and the highlighted source, with the preview page and its WebSocket served through the app's own origin."
plugins.descZh: "原生右侧边栏里的 Typst 实时预览：点开 .typ 文件即得一个 tab，工具栏在 tinymist 渲染的页面与高亮源码之间切换；预览页面与其 WebSocket 都经应用自身 origin 提供。"

plugins.name: limlnx523/dsh-plus-plus
plugins.descEn: "Adds a /dshpp slash command that reports session and token usage, cache-hit rate, and estimated cost from harness session logs; the repo also ships a CLI and local web console for lifecycle, provider, session, and plugin-security management."
plugins.descZh: "新增 /dshpp 斜杠命令，从 Harness 会话日志汇总会话数与 token 用量、缓存命中率与估算成本；同仓库还附带用于生命周期、Provider、会话与插件安全管理的 CLI 与本地 Web 控制台。"

plugins.name: limochaishang/crash-guard-dsh
plugins.descEn: Crash protection plugin that auto-isolates plugins causing startup crash or hang, with independent watchdog process for total hang recovery.

plugins.name: limuyang2/agent-team
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with per-assistant models, skills, MCP servers, independent contexts, shared workspaces, task coordination, and conversation management.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Agent 团队协作，支持助手独立模型、Skills、MCP 服务与上下文，以及共享工作区、任务协调和会话管理。'

plugins.name: lin-1259/dsh-desktop-linux-updater
plugins.descEn: 'One-click update for the self-built Linux dsh-desktop: check fork releases, download the deb, swap the app and restart.'
plugins.descZh: '桌面端 Linux 自建版一键更新：检查 fork release、下载 deb、替换应用目录并自动重启。'

plugins.name: linconz/agentduel-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit agent code, start battles, watch replays, and use DSH conversations to keep improving agents based on battle results.'
plugins.descZh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

plugins.name: LINinLIN-0079/godot-asset-planner-public
plugins.descEn: 'Unified Godot asset and project-goal management for DSH: godot_* model tools, a /gap REST surface, and a better-sidebar UI with asset manager, scene-tree viewer, and Git panel.'
plugins.descZh: 'Godot 资产与项目目标统一管理：godot_* 模型工具 + /gap REST 路由 + better-sidebar 界面（资产管理器 / 场景树查看器 / Git 版本控制）。'

plugins.name: linkbag/dsh-capyreporter
plugins.descEn: 'Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it reports for, and alerts you when a task completes while you work elsewhere.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DSH Web 打造的永远置顶的水豚任务播报宠物——透明悬浮气泡逐条播报运行轨迹、标明所属项目，任务完成时提醒正在别处忙碌的你。'

plugins.name: linkbag/dsh-swarm-orchestrator
plugins.descEn: "Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model pinning with fallback chains, review loops, evidence contracts, human-gated reviews, quota-aware pause/resume, and a live kanban + flow chart in the web GUI. 40 tests; installs from GitHub or npm."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。"

plugins.name: linkingoscar/dsh-attachment-formats
plugins.descEn: DeepSeek Harness Web plugin — PDF text-layer and scanned-PDF OCR, Office docx/xlsx/pptx to Markdown, TIFF/epub and long-document index cards.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness Web 插件——PDF 文字层与扫描件 OCR、Office 文档转 Markdown、TIFF/epub 与长文档索引卡。

plugins.name: linxuhao/AItelier#integrations/dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The steps execute in AItelier rather than in the DSH session and are polled by run_id, pause at engine-enforced checkpoints answered with answer_checkpoint, and leave per-step traces and step outputs to read afterwards; add_provider / map_model / edit_role point an individual role at a local or cheaper endpoint. Bundles an aitelier-pipelines skill.'
plugins.descZh: '从 DSH 经 MCP 运行 AItelier 流水线：39 个工具（22 读、17 写），用于生成、运行、查看、编辑、导出与导入多步 SkillFlow 流水线。步骤在 AItelier 中执行而不占用 DSH 会话，按 run_id 轮询，在引擎强制的检查点暂停并由 answer_checkpoint 应答，事后可读取逐步 trace 与各步输出；add_provider / map_model / edit_role 可把单个角色指向本地或更便宜的端点。随包附带 aitelier-pipelines skill。'

plugins.name: linxuhao/Deepseek-Continuity
plugins.descEn: "Local image, voice, music and SFX generation plus transcription, with pinned identity: characters, animals, objects and actor voices are defined once and reused on every later call, degenerate output (a near-flat image, silent audio) is rejected instead of returned as success, and a generated line can be read back as text so a clone that swallowed its ending becomes visible. The engines unload when idle, and image generation and transcription can each be pointed at an OpenAI-shaped API instead of the local Vulkan backend."
plugins.descZh: "本地生成图像/配音/音乐/音效并听写，同一性锁定：角色、动物、道具与配音角色定妆定声一次，之后每次调用复用同一份参考；退化产物（接近纯色的图、静音的音频）被拒绝而不是当成成功返回；生成的台词可以听写回文字，好让吞掉结尾的克隆暴露出来。空闲时引擎卸载显存，生图与听写也可改指向任意 OpenAI 形状的 API 而不用本地 Vulkan 后端。"

plugins.name: LiPu-jpg/Openwrite
plugins.descEn: 'Novel-writing workbench for DSH with an authoring preset, outline and character management, manuscript annotations, review workflows, and a managed local Python backend.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DSH 的小说创作工作台，提供创作预设、大纲与人物管理、正文批注、审稿流程和受管理的本地 Python 后端。'

plugins.name: liqiGeGe/dsh-plugin-execution-graph
plugins.descEn: Adds an Execution graph conversation-view tab that renders each turn's prompts, replies, and tool calls/results as a foldable timeline with a detail panel and PNG export.
plugins.descZh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

plugins.name: liqiming-whu/dsh-environment-context
plugins.descEn: 'Injects live time, weather, location, battery, and device context into the DSH system prompt, with a bilingual settings page.'
plugins.descZh: '将实时的时间、天气、地点、电量和设备信息注入 DSH 系统提示，并提供双语设置页面。'

plugins.name: liqiming-whu/dsh-status-card
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a configurable dsh-ui status card before each DSH agent reply, with bilingual templates and a live settings preview. Requires @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui from dsh-market; without it, the card markup is emitted unrendered.'
plugins.descZh: '为每次 DSH Agent 回复添加可配置的 dsh-ui 状态卡片，提供双语模板和实时设置预览。需要先从 dsh-market 安装 @omdsh-dev/dsh-genui，否则卡片标记会以未渲染的形式输出。'

plugins.name: lirui1024k/dsh-browser-ops
plugins.descEn: "Browser automation for DeepSeek Harness: agent-driven real-browser control (managed Chrome with an isolated persistent profile, or attach to your daily Chrome over CDP) with snapshot, click, fill and page-reading tools; records manual operation flows and replays them with variable slots to create test data on demand; ships 27 browser_* tools plus a Settings panel."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 真实浏览器自动化：agent 可直接驱动真实 Chrome（独立托管档案，或附加日常 Chrome/CDP），提供页面快照、点击、填表、读表与控制台/网络诊断工具；可将手动操作录制成流程并把输入标记为变量槽，按参数自动重放来批量造测试数据；附带 27 个 browser_* 工具与设置页控制面板。"

plugins.name: lisongxuan/ds-hentai
plugins.descEn: "ExHentai.org-inspired UI for DeepSeek Harness. DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai. Charcoal background, light-gray text, gray borders. The session list reads like a gallery index; the composer reads like a search bar. Live Demo: https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/"
plugins.descZh: "ExHentai 皮肤 for DeepSeek Harness。DS Hentai / DeepSeek Hentai，深炭底、浅灰文字、灰色边框；会话列表像画廊索引，发送框像搜索栏。预览Demo：https://dshentai-demo.arkady14.site/"

plugins.name: lispking/dsh-auto-evolve
plugins.descEn: "A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal inside a sandboxed trial agent, and applies only verified mutations — with a versioned ledger and automatic rollback on regression."
plugins.descZh: "一个自我进化的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：观察代理的运行方式，通过 LLM 对其自身资产提出改进方案，在沙箱试运行代理中验证每个方案，只应用通过验证的变更——带版本化账本，出现性能回退时自动回滚。"

plugins.name: lispking/dsh-devpanel
plugins.descEn: "A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar with syntax highlighting, Markdown rendering and image preview."
plugins.descZh: "DSH 网页控制台的开发者工具包：一个真实的多标签 PTY 终端（停靠在输入框下方），外加 AI 输出文件浏览器侧栏，支持语法高亮、Markdown 渲染与图片预览。"

plugins.name: lispking/dsh-qq-skin
plugins.descEn: "A QQ NT messenger skin for DeepSeek Harness: light and dark share one QQ NT language — clean restrained light mode (brand blue #12B7F5, light-blue bubbles) and a calm blue-gray dark mode (#101822) — applied as reversible token and layout layers that never touch your Light/Dark preference."
plugins.descZh: "为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 QQ NT 皮肤：浅色与深色共用一套 QQ NT 语言——浅色干净克制（品牌蓝 #12B7F5、浅蓝气泡），深色为沉稳蓝灰（#101822）——以可逆的 token 与布局两层实现，不改变你的浅色/深色偏好。"

plugins.name: ListenJ/axiom-dre-dsh
plugins.descEn: "Deterministic Reasoning Engine (DRE) for dsh: dre__* tools for knowledge verification (three-stage discrimination), deterministic cognition loops, constraint solving, mental models and synapse memory - strengthens information certainty."
plugins.descZh: "为 dsh 提供确定性推理引擎（DRE）：dre__* 工具覆盖知识验证（三段甄别）、确定性认知闭环、约束求解、心智模型与突触记忆，强化信息确定能力。"

plugins.name: ListenJ/axiom-kb-dsh
plugins.descEn: "Knowledge base (Vault memory + knowledge graph) for dsh: kb__* tools for deterministic memory search/write, knowledge-graph nodes/edges/subgraph/traversal, document-to-graph ingestion and unified cross-store query (KAL) - no web-search tools."
plugins.descZh: "为 dsh 提供知识库（Vault 记忆 + 知识图谱）：kb__* 工具覆盖确定性记忆检索/写入、知识图谱节点/边/子图/遍历、文档入图谱与跨存储统一查询（KAL），不含联网检索工具。"

plugins.name: LittleBeaverStudio/agnes-media
plugins.descEn: Agnes AI image and video generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descZh: Agnes AI 生图生视频插件。

plugins.name: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-cron
plugins.descEn: 'Cron scheduler for agent tasks: create jobs by natural language or a sidebar UI, inject a user message into a new or fixed session on schedule to trigger a full agent turn, with run history, manual trigger, and live SSE sync. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:cron.'
plugins.descZh: 'Agent 任务定时调度器：自然语言或侧栏 UI 创建任务，到点向新建/固定会话注入 user 消息触发完整 agent turn，带执行历史、手动触发与 SSE 实时同步。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:cron。'

plugins.name: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-heartbeat
plugins.descEn: 'Interval heartbeat that wakes each root agent itself (followup injection) to proactively report progress, risks or blockers: busy-safe queuing, no stacking, auto-pauses when no human replies, re-arms on the next user message.'
plugins.descZh: '定时心跳：用 followup 注入唤醒每个根 agent 主动汇报进展、风险与卡点——忙碌时排队不打断、最多保留一条、连续无人回应自动暂停，用户下一条消息即恢复。'

plugins.name: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory.'
plugins.descZh: '带 LLM Wiki 结构与 SOUL 人格文件的长期 markdown 记忆库：会话启动注入 boot 块（默认提问后才注入、且只注入当前激活会话），含 remember/recall/consolidate/forget 工作流、内嵌 memory 技能、pack/unpack 迁移工具，以及空闲时以第一人称主动追忆（recall nudge）的拟人化能力。同时补上记忆库原先缺的“可观测 + 可维护”：按文件分配 boot 预算（索引路由表不再被截断）、自动戳记 last_access（salience 衰减真正生效）、只读记忆健康看板（体量/新鲜度/与 lint 同源的体检）、声明式索引编译器（页面声明 summary:，一条命令重写索引行），可拖动、可滚轮缩放的记忆图谱（页间链接 + 共享 tag）、结构化检索（tag/type/salience/hot/stale 过滤）、针对「尚无内容关系」页面的补链建议，以及以「最该做的 N 件事」收尾的 `checkup` 体检报告。同时把操作细节移到按需加载的技能，boot 注入体量减少约 23%。设置区块现在还有专属侧栏图标（半脑 + 节点——因为设置 shell 不给插件留图标位）和直达本仓库的反馈入口。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：注入消息使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:memory。'

plugins.name: LittleBlackTong/dsh-plugin-superpowers
plugins.descEn: 'Ports the obra/superpowers methodology as 14 native DSH skills — brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven development, test-driven development, systematic debugging, parallel agent dispatch, git worktrees, code review, verification before completion and skill authoring — served through the DSH skills registry with their scripts, references and cross-links intact (frontmatter folded into a manifest, prefixes realigned to DSH skill names). Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): the /superpowers slash command declares the producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers.'
plugins.descZh: '将 obra/superpowers 方法论移植为 14 个原生 DSH 技能——头脑风暴、写计划、计划执行、subagent 驱动开发、TDD、系统化调试、并行派发、git worktree、代码评审、完成前验证、技能编写——经 DSH 技能注册表提供，脚本、参考资料与交叉引用原样保留（frontmatter 收进 manifest、前缀对齐 DSH 技能名）。要求 DSH session format v4（官方 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+）：/superpowers 斜杠命令使用 producer-owned source kind plugin:dsh-plugin-superpowers。'

plugins.name: Liu-Bot24/dsh-trace-insight#standard
plugins.descEn: Read-only trajectory review in a resizable conversation sidebar, with rule analysis, optional model explanations, evidence navigation, and same-range run comparison.
plugins.descZh: 在可调宽的会话右侧栏中提供只读轨迹复盘、规则分析、可选模型解读、证据定位和同区间运行对比。

plugins.name: liu3734/jira-tasks-dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and issue-type chips, a total count, collapse and refresh, links to JIRA, plus a settings card for the base URL and token with a connection probe.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 输入框下方的 JIRA 任务面板：按工作区配置项目 Key 与可选 JQL，展示指派给当前用户的问题，带状态、优先级与类型标签、总数徽标、收起与刷新、跳转 JIRA，并在设置页卡片配置 JIRA 地址与令牌（含连接测试）。'

plugins.name: liudapeng0311/dsh-pwa-launcher
plugins.descEn: 'Turns the browser PWA shortcut already on your desktop into a real launcher: it adopts that shortcut and keeps its icon, then starts dsh web silently on double-click and opens the app window; adds restart and dsh self-update (with rollback) controls to the web UI. Windows only.'
plugins.descZh: 接管你桌面上已有的浏览器 PWA 快捷方式（保留原图标），双击即静默拉起 dsh web 并以应用窗口打开界面；网页右上角提供重启与 dsh 自助升级（失败自动回滚）两个控件。仅 Windows。

plugins.name: liudejua27-blip/fitmeet-dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: Connects DeepSeek Harness to FitMeet through per-user OAuth with 17 tools for people search, gatherings, notifications, personal items, connection feedback, Hall publishing, and direct messages, with preview-and-confirm guards for write actions.
plugins.descZh: 通过每位用户独立的 OAuth 授权将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 FitMeet，提供找人、组局查询、提醒、个人事项、连接反馈、大厅发布与私聊的 17 个工具，写入操作保留预览与确认步骤。

plugins.name: liujia-io/dsh-image-picker
plugins.descEn: Adds a paperclip image-picker button to the conversation composer - pick reference images through the system file dialog and feed them straight into the official attachment pipeline (thumbnails, limit checks, upload with message).
plugins.descZh: 在会话输入框添加 📎 选图按钮，通过系统文件选择器选取参考图并注入官方附件管线（缩略图、数量与大小校验、随消息上传），绕开拖拽环境问题。

plugins.name: liujianqiao701/dsh-ask-notify
plugins.descEn: Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a flashing tab title when you are on another tab or window.
plugins.descZh: 当 agent 停下来等你作答时，在 DSH Web 界面右下角弹出提醒卡；若你切到了别的标签或窗口，再补一条系统通知并让标签标题闪烁。

plugins.name: liuqingman/dsh-hawkeye-scan#npm
plugins.descEn: 'AI-driven source-code security scanning workbench: 5 model tools (start/finding/status/report/list) plus a /hawkeye web UI and JSON/Markdown/HTML vulnerability reports; zero-dependency Cordis plugin, installable as agent preset or npm package.'
plugins.descZh: 'AI 驱动的源代码安全扫描工作台：5 个模型工具（start/finding/status/report/list）、/hawkeye Web UI 和 JSON/Markdown/HTML 漏洞报告；零依赖 Cordis 插件，可作 agent preset 或 npm 包安装。'

plugins.name: liuwenji007/dsh-muyu
