plugins.descEn: 'Electronic wooden fish in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web UI, a whale-girl sprite by default: tap the head to earn merit; it knocks by itself while the model is busy; per-session merit is stored locally, and the sprite can be swapped for custom art.'
plugins.descZh: 右下角电子木鱼，默认是鲸鱼娘图包：敲头记功德，模型忙碌时自动敲；功德按会话存本机，可换自定义图源。

plugins.name: liuwenji007/dsh-trust-check
plugins.descEn: 'Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins'' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.'
plugins.descZh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

plugins.name: liweidong1722/dsh-work-list
plugins.descEn: Local-first DSH Web work checklist with rich-text notes, categories, folding, drag reordering, search, JSON import/export, and a restorable trash.
plugins.descZh: 本地优先的 DSH Web 工作清单，支持富文本笔记、分类、折叠、拖拽排序、搜索、JSON 导入导出和可还原回收站。

plugins.name: liwuzhan/agent-native-trade#dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: Adds catalog discovery, counterparty contact, deal signing, settlement coordination, human-task handoff, and signed receipt tools for agent-native trade.
plugins.descZh: 为模型原生交易提供目录检索、交易方联络、合同签名、结算协调、人工任务交接和签名评价回执工具。

plugins.name: liwuzhan/cad-tool#dsh-cad-studio
plugins.descEn: Adds parametric CAD modeling, geometry validation, previews, design history, and STEP/STL export to DSH.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH 添加参数化 CAD 建模、几何验证、预览、设计历史和 STEP/STL 导出能力。

plugins.name: Lixiuxiu559/AgentForge
plugins.descEn: 'Six engineering skills for Claude Code and DSH: research, architecture scouting, implementation orchestration, three-axis diff review, complexity audit and mutation testing. Skills delegate through the host’s generic subagent tools when available.'
plugins.descZh: '可安装到 Claude Code 与 DSH 的六个工程技能：调研、架构侦察、实施编排、三轴评审、复杂度审计和突变测试。按需通过宿主通用子 agent 能力委派，无需注册自定义 agent。'

plugins.name: liyu34/dsh-wsl-tray
plugins.descEn: Windows desktop shortcut and system-tray launcher for DSH running in WSL, with fully hidden startup, tray open/restart/exit menu, and a plugin-configuration card to manage the shortcut.
plugins.descZh: 为运行在 WSL 的 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面快捷方式和系统托盘启动器：完全隐藏启动，托盘菜单支持打开/重启/退出，插件配置页可管理快捷方式。

plugins.name: LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity
plugins.descEn: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider with quota management and model selector.
plugins.descZh: Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist 模型提供商插件，支持配额查看与模型选择管理。

plugins.name: ljh257110/dsh-local-installer
plugins.descEn: 'Local plugin installer in the DSH web Settings: a file picker for .tgz plugin packages (multi-select) or a full machine path, installing them into the auto-detected profile via the official `dsh plugin add` with live CLI output — no terminal needed.'
plugins.descZh: 本地插件安装器：DSH 网页设置页里的本地插件安装入口——文件选择器多选 .tgz 或输入本机完整路径，自动检测所在 profile 并执行官方 `dsh plugin add`，实时回显安装日志，无需终端。

plugins.name: lkh081231/screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp#dsh-screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp
plugins.descEn: Adds a take screenshot tool plus two optional automatic capture points, putting the screen into the conversation as an image block; requires an image-capable model.
plugins.descZh: 一个截图工具，外加两个默认关闭的自动截图时机。需要模型支持图片输入。

plugins.name: Lkrain821/dsh-pixelwhale
plugins.descEn: Pixel-font "deep seeking" thinking status with an animated DeepSeek blue whale (20 spout frames and 32 tail-wag frames).
plugins.descZh: 深度求索时，派一只像素蓝鲸（20 帧喷水 + 32 帧摆尾）喷水摆尾，并把「深度求索中」渲染成像素字体。

plugins.name: lkshjd/dsh-balance
plugins.descEn: 'Real-time DeepSeek account balance readout in the session header: host /api/balance route resolves the API key through the credentials seam (never sent to the browser), 60-second auto-poll plus manual refresh.'
plugins.descZh: '会话标题栏实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额：host 端 /api/balance 路由经凭据 seam 解析 API key（密钥绝不下发浏览器），60 秒自动轮询并支持手动刷新。'

plugins.name: lkshjd/dsh-debate
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-agent isolated debate for DeepSeek Harness: debaters of different temperaments research independently (no herding), then cross-examine, then judges converge to a conclusion. Runs as a background job with per-agent progress, token accounting, wave-parallel execution, and session-referenced resume.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 多 agent 隔离辩论：不同底色的辩手各自独立联网取证（互不可见防人云亦云）、交叉辩论互相反驳、评审收敛出结论。后台 job 运行，逐 agent 进度可见、token 统计、波次并行、断点续传。'

plugins.name: LL-cmyk-so/dsh-balance-widget
plugins.descEn: 'A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。'

plugins.name: lldois/dsh-jev
plugins.descEn: 'Semantic tool routing, skill discovery, and typed System One decisions for DeepSeek Harness powered by TypeSafe Jev.'
plugins.descZh: '基于 TypeSafe Jev 的 DeepSeek Harness 语义工具路由、技能发现与类型化 System One 决策插件。'

plugins.name: LLYlab/DLT
plugins.descEn: "Six independently togglable modules in one DSH plugin: per-turn CNY cost, DeepSeek account balance, PDF/Word/Excel/CSV read-write tools with right-sidebar preview, a compiler/runtime environment registry, and run/build tools that execute a program or an MSBuild project by environment id. Toolchain paths are resolved at run time (Visual Studio install-root scan, %ProgramFiles%, PATH) and can be overridden per environment through plugin config, so nothing is pinned to the author's machine."
plugins.descZh: "一个 DSH 插件里的六个可独立开关的模块：每轮对话的人民币成本、DeepSeek 账户余额、PDF/Word/Excel/CSV 直接读写工具与右栏预览、编译/运行环境表，以及按环境名执行程序或编译 MSBuild 工程的 run/build 工具。工具链路径在运行时解析（扫描 Visual Studio 安装根、%ProgramFiles%、PATH），并可在插件配置里逐个环境覆盖，没有写死在作者机器上的路径。"

plugins.name: LLYlab/DSHEssentialTools
plugins.descEn: "A permanent DSH plugin that bundles a developer workbench, an in-session conversation tree, and a plugin manager: build and run an LVAL project, browse its code, and keep per-program version snapshots with rollback; edit, retry, or branch any message in place, with message micro-versions; a feature manager plus a global-plugin library whose entries each carry an enable tier; cross-dialogue memory, one-shot temporary chats, and model collaboration; five network-permission tiers, mixed-model routing, a security audit, and browser control through a companion extension."
plugins.descZh: "DSH 永久插件工作台：LVAL 工程工具的编译/运行、代码查看与程序版本快照回退；会话内对话树（就地编辑 / 重新生成 / 分支）与消息小版本；DET 管理器，以及每条记录各带一档启停权限的全局插件库；跨对话记忆、一次性临时对话与模型合作；五档网络权限、混合模型路由、安全审计，以及经配套浏览器扩展的浏览器控制。"

plugins.name: lninghaha/dsh-coding-remote-kit
plugins.descEn: "Mobile pairing remote for DeepSeek Harness: E2EE companion over dual-plane allowlisted RPC (LAN, Tailscale, optional Cloudflare Quick Tunnel or self-hosted rendezvous)."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 移动配对远程插件：双平面白名单 RPC 上的端到端加密 Companion（局域网、Tailscale，可选 Cloudflare Quick Tunnel 或自建 rendezvous）。"

plugins.name: lninghaha/dsh-hub-oauth-gateway
plugins.descEn: "DSH Web Usage Center with local SQLite history, HUD and dashboard, Hub account/quota snapshots, custom pricing and fee ledger, and CSV/JSON export, plus coding-plan OAuth and an optional loopback OpenAI/Anthropic gateway."
plugins.descZh: "DSH Web 用量中心：本地 SQLite 历史、HUD 与仪表盘、Hub 账户与额度快照、自定义定价与订阅费用账本、CSV/JSON 导出，并含 coding 计划 OAuth 与可选回环 OpenAI/Anthropic 网关。"

plugins.name: lnsdlszsqxxx/dsh-courseware
plugins.descEn: Takes the user's own .pptx template plus a course outline (lesson plan / document / plain text) and produces a courseware .pptx that adopts the template's background, color scheme, fonts, and page skeleton. Pure plugin package, no built-in API keys; the image backend must be configured by the user.
plugins.descZh: 拿用户自己的 .pptx 模板 + 一份课程大纲（教案/文档/纯文本），产出套用该模板背景、配色、字体、页面骨架的课件 .pptx。纯插件包，无内置密钥，图片后端需用户自行配置。

plugins.name: loadingvx/deepseeh-harness-ultra-slash
plugins.descEn: 'Separate slash-command group in the Web UI composer: /steer injects text on the agent''s next step without interrupting the turn, /new starts a blank session, /skill and /docs wrap /steer with post-turn skill or docs tasks, and custom /steer aliases are configurable in Settings.'
plugins.descZh: '在 Web UI 输入框的斜杠菜单里单独一组插件命令：/steer 在模型下一步注入内容且不打断当前回合，/new 开启空白会话，/skill 与 /docs 在 /steer 基础上附加完成后写入 skill 或 docs，并可在设置里为常用 /steer 内容配置自定义快捷命令。'

plugins.name: loeanxi/dsh-injection-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Source-aware prompt injection guard for DSH: tracks untrusted turn context, detects injection signals, scores sensitive sinks, and blocks high-risk tool calls with explainable audit logs.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DSH 的来源感知提示词注入防护：跟踪 Turn 中的不可信上下文，检测注入信号，评估敏感 Sink，并通过可解释审计日志阻断高风险工具调用。'

plugins.name: log-li/dsh-automode
plugins.descEn: 'CC-style auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness: deterministic deny/allow rules plus a two-stage allow/reject classifier with a circuit breaker and denial guidance.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Claude Code 式自动审批：确定性 deny/allow 规则 + 两阶段 allow/reject 分类器，内置熔断器与拒绝引导。'

plugins.name: log-li/dsh-peakrate
plugins.descEn: 'Peak / off-peak rate badges for the model selector (every row) and the composer tool row, judged per provider by its own time zone and schedule; the live catalog is served from the host over a fenced route.'
plugins.descZh: '为模型选择器（每一行）与 composer 工具行显示峰谷倍率，按每个 provider 自己的时区与时段规则判定；实时目录由 host 经带信任围栏的路由下发。'

plugins.name: Lohaslee/dsh-super-pm
plugins.descEn: "Product-thinking companion for DeepSeek Harness: clarifies negative boundaries first, separates facts from assumptions, routes through seven product lenses, and persists confirmed decisions to project memory."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 的产品思考助手：先明确负向边界，拆开事实与假设，经七套产品视角讨论取舍，并将确认的决策沉淀到项目记忆中。"

plugins.name: lokih1028/dsh-plugin-canvas-pro
plugins.descEn: Adds a Canvas drawer and eight model tools to create, patch, version, and export HTML, Markdown, Mermaid, SVG, and React artifacts.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 增加 Canvas 抽屉与八个模型工具，用于创建、局部补丁、版本管理和导出 HTML、Markdown、Mermaid、SVG 与 React 工件。

plugins.name: lokih1028/dsh-prompt-optimizer
plugins.descEn: One-click prompt enhancement and structuring button for DSH composer.
plugins.descZh: DSH 输入框一键提示词结构化增强与润色插件。

plugins.name: Lolancier/v-manager-dsh-pet
plugins.descEn: "A Live2D pet companion for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: the Vivi (芊芊) character with petting/feeding, a daily-treat bond economy and mood-driven expressions."
plugins.descZh: "DSH Web UI 桌宠：内置 Vivi（芊芊）Live2D 形象，支持抚摸/喂食、每日小鱼干羁绊经济与情绪驱动表情。"

plugins.name: LonelyHerbivore/dsh-image-question#plugin
plugins.descEn: "Ask the user a question about a local image; the DSH Web card offers zoom, pan, box, brush and lasso annotation, NG/OK/unsure verdicts and a note, and the agent receives annotations back in source-image pixel coordinates."
plugins.descZh: "带本地图片向用户提问；DSH Web 卡片支持缩放平移、框选、画笔与套索标注、NG/OK/不确定判定和说明，Agent 收回原图像素坐标下的标注。"

plugins.name: longgege-cd/dsh-skin-pixel-anime
plugins.descEn: 'Pixel Dynamic Starfield theme: five palettes, four layered text schemes, five pixel fonts including a simplified-Chinese face, square or rounded corners, a rotating pixel starfield with meteors, and a header pixel clock — configured from its own settings tab.'
plugins.descZh: '像素动态星空主题：五套配色、四套分层文字方案、五款像素字体（含简体中文像素字体）、方角与圆角可选、旋转像素星空与流星、顶栏像素时钟，均在插件设置页配置。'

plugins.name: longisland-icetea/dsh-lan-access
plugins.descEn: 'Configurable LAN access for the DSH Web GUI: a settings tab binds the server to all interfaces, trusts only the addresses you configure, sets the browser session lifetime or removes the token login, and repairs the settings layer on non-loopback visits.'
plugins.descZh: '可配置的 DSH Web GUI 局域网访问：设置页开启后绑定全部网卡，只信任你配置的访问地址，可调整浏览器会话有效期或去掉 token 登录，并修复非回环访问时的设置层。'

plugins.name: longmiaoo/dsh-native-browser
plugins.descEn: Controls user-authorized Chrome tabs from DeepSeek Harness through a local native-messaging broker, with semantic page reads, actions, screenshots, and explicit handoff.
plugins.descZh: 通过本地原生消息 Broker，让 DeepSeek Harness 操作用户明确授权的 Chrome 标签页，支持语义化页面读取、交互、截图与显式交接。

plugins.name: LONGSASASASASA/dsh-issue2pr
plugins.descEn: "Verifiable issue-to-PR delivery chain: an 11-stage pipeline (analysis, search, code understanding, hypothesis, planning, implementation, patch ledger, tests, review, failure classification, PR build) with 4 human review gates, GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts credential connections, a 5-page workbench and a draggable AI assistant panel."
plugins.descZh: "Issue-to-PR 可验证交付链：11 阶段流水线（分析→检索→理解→假设→规划→实现→补丁→测试→评审→归因→PR 构建），4 道人工复核闸门，GitHub/GitLab/CodeArts 凭据连接，5 页工作台与可拖拽智能助手浮窗。"

plugins.name: loopx-project/loopx#dsh-loopx-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'LoopX, a provider-neutral, local-first state kernel and control plane for long-horizon agents: keeps Goal, Todo, gate, evidence, quota, recovery, and handoff state above DeepSeek Harness, while the plugin bootstraps the CLI and skills, admits bounded same-session continuation, and adds a loopback GoalBar for the exact bound loop.'
plugins.descZh: 'LoopX——面向长周期 Agent 的提供商中立、本地优先状态内核与控制平面：在 DeepSeek Harness 执行层之上持久化 Goal、Todo、门禁、证据、配额、恢复与交接状态；插件负责引导安装 CLI 与技能、准入有界的同会话续跑，并为精确绑定的工作循环提供本地 GoalBar。'

plugins.name: Lorvaste/DSH-Project-Initialization
plugins.descEn: "An agent preset that turns a one-line idea into requirements, tech plan and maintenance baseline — every step is restated and confirmed by you before proceeding. No scenario presets: 73 atomic skills (6 master skills + a verify dispatcher + 66 sub-skills) load by context."
plugins.descZh: '「想法落地」agent preset：一句话想法 → 需求规格 → 技术方案 → 维护基准；每一步先复述、你确认、再继续。无场景预设：73 个原子 skill（6 主 + verify 调度 + 66 子）按上下文加载。'

plugins.name: lory69060/cn-intel-mcp-dsh
plugins.descEn: "China hard-tech supply chain intelligence: 33-signal board, H1 earnings tracker, hit-rate track record and Q&A, via a remote MCP (mcp__cn_intel__*)."
plugins.descZh: "中国硬科技供应链情报：33 条信号看板、中报验证追踪、命中率记录与问答，通过远程 MCP 接入（mcp__cn_intel__*）。"

plugins.name: Lostforest7/dsh-encoding
plugins.descEn: 'Correct-encoding command runner and mojibake recovery: encoding_run spawns a child process and decodes its raw output bytes (UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK auto-detected or forced), and encoding_decode recovers garbled text back to correct Unicode.'
plugins.descZh: '编码正确的命令执行与乱码还原：encoding_run 自动识别 UTF-8/UTF-16LE/GBK 并正确解码子进程输出，encoding_decode 把乱码文本还原为正确 Unicode。'

plugins.name: LouisHaoL/dsh-timer-agent
plugins.descEn: 'Host-resident cron engine with a web jobs board and a timer_agent tool: fires real agent sessions on schedule, continuing a pinned session for context or starting fresh ones in a chosen project workspace.'
plugins.descZh: '常驻宿主的定时引擎，带 Web 任务面板与 timer_agent 工具：按 cron 计划触发真实 Agent 会话，可固定已有会话保持上下文连续，也可在指定项目目录新开会话。'

plugins.name: dsh-loulan-mcp
plugins.descEn: 'Reads .mcp.json from the .dsh home and from the agent workspace, mounts every mcpServers entry into DSH, and adds an MCP tab in the Web UI for listing, adding and unloading servers.'
plugins.descZh: '读取 .dsh 根目录与 agent 工作区里的 .mcp.json，把其中的 MCP server 挂载进 DSH；Web 界面增加「MCP」标签页，可查看、添加与卸载服务。'

plugins.name: dsh-loulan-rules
plugins.descEn: 'Injects the rule files under $DSH_HOME/rules and <cwd>/.dsh/rules into the conversation at the first agent pre-step, re-injecting them after compaction.'
plugins.descZh: '在首次 agent pre-step 读取 $DSH_HOME/rules 与 <cwd>/.dsh/rules 下的规则文件并注入会话，被 compaction 遮蔽后自动补回。'

plugins.name: LoveDoLove/Project-Memory-Agent#dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: DSH bundle plugin that mounts 8 Project Memory skills, bootstraps memory architecture on first use, and registers codebase-memory bridge tools.
plugins.descZh: DSH 插件：挂载 8 个 Project Memory 技能，首次使用时引导记忆架构初始化，并注册 codebase-memory 桥接工具。

plugins.name: loveXbanshee/dsh-fleet
plugins.descEn: 'Fleet console for DeepSeek Harness: one local dsh page manages many remote dsh machines — live idle/running status, in-place switching without new tabs, keep-alive iframes, cross-device session reading, one-click refresh/restart, and a controller/managed role split.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 多机指挥台：用一个本地 dsh 页面管理多台远程 dsh——实时查看远程忙闲、免切标签页原地切换与使用、远程页面保活秒开、跨设备读取历史会话、一键刷新/重启，并支持控制端/被控端角色。'

plugins.name: lovezi0/dsh-model-extension
plugins.descEn: 'Models+ settings page for the DSH web UI: per-model reasoning-effort tables, input modalities and compat flags saved through the official settings pipeline, with models.dev metadata prefill and API key management.'
plugins.descZh: '模型+ 设置页:按模型声明推理挡位、输入模态与兼容参数(走官方 settings 管线保存),支持 models.dev 元数据预填与 API 密钥管理。'

plugins.name: lovezi0/dsh-workspace-acl-allow
plugins.descEn: 'Windows workspace pre-authorization: adds an explicit full-control DACL ACE (including WRITE_OWNER, required by dsh >=0.1.7 sandbox startup) to user-declared workspace directories, removing the repeated full-access escalation prompt. Grants only on explicit intent — new workspace records or paths added in the plugin settings page; system directories are hard-blocked. Windows only.'
plugins.descZh: 'Windows 工作区预授权：为用户显式声明的工作区目录补一条完全控制的 DACL 授权项（含 dsh ≥0.1.7 沙箱启动所需的 WRITE_OWNER），消除反复出现的完全访问升权弹框。仅在新增工作区记录或插件设置页手动添加路径时授权，系统目录硬拒绝。仅支持 Windows。'

plugins.name: lovvvve/dsh-quick-actions#composer-quick-actions
plugins.descEn: Global Quick Actions beside every session-backed composer in DSH. One press sends a preset or your own saved text, with per-action send confirmation.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH 每个由会话支持的消息编辑器旁提供全局快捷动作。一键发送预置或你自己保存的文本，每个动作可单独设置发送确认。

plugins.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-chat-image-lightbox
plugins.descEn: "Full-screen lightbox for chat images with zoom, drag pan, download, and keyboard or touch navigation. Images returned by the display_image tool render inline in chat."
plugins.descZh: "聊天图片全屏查看器：点击对话中的图片打开灯箱，支持缩放、拖拽平移、滚轮缩放、文件名显示、下载保存，以及键盘方向键与移动端滑动切换；display_image 工具返回的图片可直接内联显示。"

plugins.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-font-enhancer
plugins.descEn: "DIY your DSH UI fonts and colors: per-region styling, unified overrides, theme save and switch, random font and color."
plugins.descZh: "DIY 你的 DSH 界面：按区域自定义字体、字号与颜色，支持全局统一设置、主题保存切换与随机配色。"

plugins.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-lobsterai-daddy
plugins.descEn: 'Turns the LobsterDaddy multi-account console into a floating ball in the DSH window: drag it anywhere and the position persists, and the panel can be set to follow the ball. Clicking it slides out a drawer that renders the console as native DOM (no iframe) from the loopback-only same-origin proxy, showing action buttons, the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, and a per-account list with balance, check-in state and last check-in time; a resizable persisted drawer, a live online/offline dot and an account-count badge are included.'
plugins.descZh: '把 LobsterDaddy 多账号控制台变成 DSH 界面上的悬浮球：可拖到任意位置并自动记忆坐标，面板可设置为跟随悬浮球移动；点开以抽屉呈现控制台——界面由原生 DOM 渲染（不用 iframe），数据经仅限本机的同源反向代理获取，自上而下为操作按钮、当前登录账号、以及含积分余额与签到状态（附最近签到时间）的账号列表；抽屉可拖动缩放并记忆尺寸，另有在线状态圆点与账号数徽标。'

plugins.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-model-fold
plugins.descEn: 'Groups the DSH model picker by provider: the menu lists sources with their model counts, and clicking a source slides that provider''s models out in a side panel (default) or expands them inline below the title, switchable by double-clicking the source title. The active model stays visible at a glance. Pure DOM enhancement with zero intrusion - the panel is plugin-owned DOM mounted on body and selection happens by programmatically clicking the real menu buttons, so no React-managed node is moved or removed, keeping the host rendering intact and coexisting with other UI plugins. Styling follows the host by reusing the official --dsw-* theme tokens, with an enforced opaque background, sufficient contrast, and one shared set of sizing and colour tokens for both menu levels. No network access and no telemetry. Built for DSH kernel 2.0.15-next.'
plugins.descZh: '把 DSH 模型选择器按来源（provider）分组：菜单只列来源与其模型数，点来源在右侧滑出该来源的模型子面板（默认），或改为在列表内就地展开，双击来源标题即可切换；当前使用的模型一眼可见。纯 DOM 增强、零侵入——面板是插件自建 DOM 并挂载到 body，选择通过程序化点击原菜单真实按钮完成，不移动也不删除任何 React 管理的节点，因此不影响原组件渲染，并能与其他 UI 插件共存。配色与排版跟随宿主：复用官方 --dsw-* 主题变量，背景保证不透明、对比度充足，来源清单与子集清单共用同一套尺寸与色值令牌。不联网、无遥测。适配 DSH 内核 2.0.15-next。'

plugins.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-skill-browser
plugins.descEn: "Browse the DSH skill library from a floating-ball panel: categories, Chinese descriptions, instant search, full SKILL.md viewer, and an automatic skill-failure ledger driven by tools/result events."
plugins.descZh: "悬浮球面板直接浏览 DSH 技能库：两级分类、中文简介、实时搜索、SKILL.md 全文查看；内置失效台账自动登记（监听 tools/result 事件，成功/失败自动记录），支持一键恢复悬浮球默认位置。"

plugins.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-todo-float-ball
plugins.descEn: 'Floating progress ball for the AI agent todo checklist: six skins, live done/total ring, multi-session monitoring with pins, inline rename, capsule mode, draggable; realtime sync via the sessions service.'
plugins.descZh: '悬浮球常驻显示 AI 会话的任务清单进度：六种皮肤（星云流光/宝石/顶弧、石墨、蓝宝石、玻璃）、外环进度环、多会话固定监控、面板内改名，数据实时同步。'

plugins.name: loyalchiiina/dsh-voice-alert
plugins.descEn: 'Speaks or plays a sound at the end of every turn and plays a failure cue when a tool call or a turn errors. Ships 20 built-in effects (10 alert chimes + 10 nature sounds) and defaults to effect mode, so it needs no API key and no audio files; an optional Volcengine voice-clone route generates the three announcement clips in one click. Plays through winmm/waveOut as-is, never changing the system volume or mute state. Windows only.'
plugins.descZh: '每个 turn 结束自动语音/音效提醒，出错时播失败提示；内置 20 个音效（提醒 10 + 大自然 10）且默认「音效」模式，零配置开箱即用、不需要任何 API Key 与音频文件；进阶可用火山「声音复刻」克隆自己的音色并一键生成三条播报语音；走 winmm/waveOut 原样播放，绝不改动系统音量或静音状态。仅 Windows。'

plugins.name: lpf20200901/dsh-memory-delta
plugins.descEn: Layered cross-session memory for DSH that pushes only what changed - the first round injects every active entry, later rounds push only added / updated / removed ones, and nothing at all is injected when nothing changed, with keys that merely repeat an entry id left out of the text so the baseline is about 26% smaller. Facts and decisions carry semantic keys (one active truth per key), the model may only write to an inbox that a human promotes, an entry can carry a review date that raises a one-time reminder when due, and search is relevance-ranked with journal lines down-weighted and Chinese matched by bigram. A sidebar tab tells the lifecycle story instead of listing files - entries are grouped by stage (awaiting confirmation / in use / archived) along four axes (topic - one level, human-assigned, type, tag, date), each group can be ticked for batch promote / withdraw / archive / restore / delete / assign topic, and topics can be renamed store-wide or searched on their own. The archived stage reads in three levels - the category says why an entry left (distilled into the docs / useless for good / not needed right now, the first two being defaults you can add to), below it the entry topic stays collapsed until you click it, and entries with no topic sit right under the category. The tab also shows the global and workspace instruction files plus the current injection size. A zero-dependency CLI ships with it, so the store is usable without DSH.
plugins.descZh: 分层跨会话记忆，只推变化的部分：首轮注入全部有效条目，之后只推新增 / 已更新 / 已失效，没有任何变化时一个字都不注入；与条目 id 重复的 key 不再写进正文，基线体积因此小约 26%。事实与决策带语义键（一个 key 只有一个有效结论），模型只能写收件箱、由人确认后才成为常驻事实；条目可以带复核时间，到期后提醒一次；检索按相关度排序、流水行被降权，中文按 bigram 匹配。侧边栏页签不再只是列文件，而是讲清流程：条目按「待你确认 / 已在用 / 已归档」分组，每个阶段都能按四个维度（主题——一级、由人归类，类型，标签，日期）查看；可逐条勾选做批量提升 / 撤回 / 归档 / 取回 / 删除 / 归类，主题可全库改名、也可只在该主题内搜索。「已归档」分三层：分类说明它为什么退场（已蒸馏 / 已废弃 / 暂时不用，前两个是默认分类，也能自己新建一个），分类下面是主题行、点开才列出条目，没写主题的条目直接列在分类下。页签同时显示全局与工作区规范文件以及当前注入体积。附带零依赖 CLI，不装 DSH 也能用这套记忆库。

plugins.name: lrplrplrp/dsh-live2d
plugins.descEn: A Live2D waifu plugin for DSH.
plugins.descZh: dsh 的 Live2D 看板娘插件。

plugins.name: lsdt45/dsh-plan-plus
plugins.descEn: 'Plan review enhancement for DeepSeek Harness Web: reply to the plan-review card inline to have the model revise the plan, and browse, compare, edit and archive every plan version in a full-screen overlay.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness Web 的计划评审增强：在评审卡片内直接回复意见让模型修订计划，并在全屏浮层中回看、对比、编辑和留档每一版计划。'

plugins.name: lsh2002/dsh-custom-fonts
plugins.descEn: Customize the UI's Chinese and English fonts, code font, and global font-size offset on a settings page, with a live preview and one-click reset.
plugins.descZh: 在设置页自定义界面中英文/代码字体与全局字号偏移，实时预览，一键恢复默认。

plugins.name: lsjspl/dsh-reel
plugins.descEn: 'Local media library management and playback powered by dsh Web: responsive on PC and mobile with touch swipe reels, instant seeking and on-the-fly transcoding.'
plugins.descZh: '基于 dsh 内置 Web 服务管理、浏览与播放本地媒体库，完美适配 PC 与移动端，支持手势上下滑动刷视频、即时拖拽秒播与实时转码。'

plugins.name: lsq-dsh-plugins/dsh-windows-notifications
plugins.descEn: Adds Windows desktop notifications, optional sounds, and DSH-styled in-page notifications for task events.
plugins.descZh: 为任务事件提供 Windows 桌面通知、可选提示音和 DSH 风格的页面通知。

plugins.name: lsq-dsh-plugins/dsh-workbench-layout
plugins.descEn: Rearranges DSH Web into a three-column workbench with file editing, Git views, Markdown preview, and workspace terminals.
plugins.descZh: 将 DSH Web 重排为三栏工作台，提供文件编辑、Git 视图、Markdown 预览和工作区终端。

plugins.name: lsqace-del/dsh-progress
plugins.descEn: "Lab/project progress management for DeepSeek Harness: 16 progress_* agent tools (item CRUD, day-board pages, daily records, global search, overview, gantt, comments, import/export) plus a 「进度」sidebar tab in better-sidebar hosting the original web UI; data lives in the session project's .progress/progress.json."
plugins.descZh: "「进度」实验/项目进度管理：16 个 progress_* agent 工具（安排增删改查、画板页、每日记录、全局搜索、概览、甘特、留言、导入导出），并在 better-sidebar 注册「进度」侧边栏 tab 托管原版界面；数据存会话项目 .progress/progress.json，随项目目录走。"

plugins.name: Luawig/dsh-cloudflare-access
plugins.descEn: Re-validates Cloudflare Access JWTs at the DSH origin so Settings, Credentials, Agent Preset management, and model discovery work from a remote hostname.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Origin 校验 Cloudflare Access JWT，使 Settings、凭据、Agent Preset 管理与模型发现可在远程主机名下使用。

plugins.name: lubanqihao9875/dsh-figma-mcp
plugins.descEn: 'One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH (DeepSeek Harness).'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件。'

plugins.name: lubenweimeiyoukaig/dsh-file-upload-local
plugins.descEn: 'Local file upload: paperclip button and drag-and-drop, per-session storage under .dsh-uploads, and a read_document tool that pages text and OCRs images.'
plugins.descZh: '本地文件上传：回形针按钮与拖拽上传、按会话隔离存储到 .dsh-uploads，并提供 read_document 工具分页读文本、对图片 OCR。'

plugins.name: Lucasli2018/totoro-pet
plugins.descEn: A desktop pet that lives in a floating overlay; click it to interact and switch between idle, sleeping, happy, and eating states.
plugins.descZh: '桌面宠物插件，常驻悬浮层养一只龙猫，点击互动并可在待机、睡觉、开心、进食等状态间切换。'

plugins.name: LucienLL/dsh-plugin-proxy
plugins.descEn: "Global proxy for DeepSeek Harness: route agent tools, model requests and web fetches through the Windows system proxy or a custom address with one persistent toggle, an editable settings card, and agent-visible proxy status."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 全局代理插件：通过 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址统一代理模型请求与工具流量，主界面常驻开关，且 Agent 在对话中实时感知代理状态。"

plugins.name: LucienLL/dsh-session-status
plugins.descEn: "Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors."
plugins.descZh: "为每个会话设置项目状态标签（内置进行中/已结项/搁置中+自定义标签，颜色可调），在侧栏、对话头部与悬停卡片中显示。"

plugins.name: lucifergzsz414/dsh-windows-native
plugins.descEn: Injects native-Windows (non-WSL) PowerShell, encoding, filesystem, and cross-platform-build gotchas into the system prompt.
plugins.descZh: 向系统提示注入原生 Windows（非 WSL）环境下 PowerShell、字符编码、文件系统与跨平台构建的常见坑点。

plugins.name: LuckVd/dsh-btw
plugins.descEn: 'Side-ask drawer opened from a completed answer''s action row: follow-up questions run in an independent, auto-archived session seeded with the prior conversation text (read-only, capped at 48,000 characters), leaving the main session untouched. The side session inherits the main session''s model, switchable inside the drawer, with a context-usage ring.'
plugins.descZh: '每条已完成回答操作行上的侧问抽屉：追问在独立且自动归档的会话中进行，携带此前的已完成对话文本（只读，上限 48000 字符）作为参考，主会话零写入；模型默认继承主会话并可在抽屉内切换，附上下文占用圈。'

plugins.name: lucyTrump/dsh-runninghub-api
plugins.descEn: Run RunningHub cloud ComfyUI workflows from chat — settings card, sha256 media upload cache, concurrency gate, and background task ledger.
plugins.descZh: 在对话中运行 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流：设置卡片、sha256 媒体上传缓存、并发闸门与后台任务台账。

plugins.name: Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault#memory-auto
plugins.descEn: 'Session-memory autopilot: watches DSH sessions and extracts OKF entries in-process through the harness LLM (ctx.llm, deepseek-official by default) at idle, commit, compaction and end checkpoints, storing them via the vault MCP server.'
plugins.descZh: '会话记忆自动驾驶：监听 DSH 会话，在会话结束与压缩前通过宿主 LLM（ctx.llm，默认 deepseek-official）就地抽取 OKF 条目，无需外部 API Key。'

plugins.name: Luisarg03/dsh-memory-vault#memory-mcp
plugins.descEn: 'Bridges the agent to a persistent OKF memory vault over MCP stdio: a Python server (SQLite FTS5 + Markdown) with 10 tools for searching and storing decisions, facts, learnings, conventions, profiles and sources.'
plugins.descZh: '经 MCP stdio 把 Agent 接入持久化 OKF 记忆库：Python 服务端（SQLite FTS5 + Markdown），10 个工具用于检索与写入决策、事实和偏好。'

plugins.name: Luke-Yong/dsh-plugin-project-management
plugins.descEn: 'A DeepSeek Harness plugin that interviews the user about a project, generates a project timeline / Gantt chart, and exports it as Word or Excel. '
plugins.descZh: '一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，通过与用户进行项目需求访谈，生成项目时间线 / 甘特图，并导出为 Word 或 Excel 格式。'

plugins.name: LuminariSoftwares/context-guardian
plugins.descEn: 'Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a seq pointer on every line (vendored dsh-compaction-instant compiler). Adds recall and search tools, /recall and /context commands, an idle trigger at 45% of the window and an on-disk span archive. The engine mounts as one row in the agent preset (docs/dsh-integration.md).'
plugins.descZh: '为 compaction-basic 提供压缩兜底：当 LLM 摘要抛错、返回空内容或放不进上下文窗口时，改为确定性编译该区段，每行带 seq 指针（内置 dsh-compaction-instant 编译器）。提供 recall、search 工具与 /recall、/context 命令，占用超过窗口 45% 时空闲自动压缩，并将被压缩区段归档到磁盘。引擎以一行配置挂载到 agent preset（见 docs/dsh-integration.md）。'

plugins.name: LuminariSoftwares/tool-guardian
plugins.descEn: 'Fronts stdio MCP servers with three router tools (list_capabilities, describe_tool, call_tool) so schemas load on demand instead of riding every request; shapes every tool result through a deterministic output ladder that archives the original first (retrieve_spill reads it back); prices tool groups in tokens and can hide built-in groups per agent. Bridges to a standard-library Python router, so Python 3.9+ is required.'
plugins.descZh: '用三个路由工具（list_capabilities、describe_tool、call_tool）代理 stdio MCP 服务器，schema 按需加载，不再随每次请求发送；所有工具结果经过确定性输出阶梯压缩，有损处理前先归档原文（retrieve_spill 可读回）；按 token 为工具分组标价，并可按 agent 隐藏内置分组。桥接到纯标准库的 Python 路由器，需要 Python 3.9+。'

plugins.name: lumoping/dsh-todo-inbox
plugins.descEn: 'Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session''s agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list; a sidebar entry shows a count badge and an expandable list to open and complete them, persisted to ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 全局跨会话待办收件箱：任意会话的 agent 通过 inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list 登记等待人类处理的事项（合并 MR、审批工单、评审等）；侧边栏入口显示未完成数角标与可展开的待办列表，支持打开与完成，数据持久化到 ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json。

plugins.name: lunaship/dsh-links
plugins.descEn: 'Android companion bridge: QR-code LAN pairing with revocable device tokens and TLS fingerprints, a phone-connection and device-management panel, and an HTTPS access proxy serving sessions, live events and approvals to the paired native app.'
plugins.descZh: Android 配套桥接：局域网扫码配对（可吊销的设备 Token 与 TLS 指纹）、手机连接与设备管理面板，以及向配对原生 App 提供会话、实时事件与审批的 HTTPS 接入代理。

plugins.name: Lunatic029/dsh-clash-proxy
plugins.descEn: "Routes DeepSeek Harness outbound traffic through a local Clash proxy, with automatic fallback to direct when the proxy is off."
plugins.descZh: "让 DeepSeek Harness 的出网流量走本地 Clash 代理，代理关闭时自动回落直连。"

plugins.name: luomeii/dsh-review-squad
plugins.descEn: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one severity-grouped report from /review or a code_review tool call.
plugins.descZh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

plugins.name: luweiyabo/dsh-whale-pet
plugins.descEn: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable actions and triggers, click interactions, dragging and screen wandering.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的精致悬浮鲸鱼桌宠，拥有 95 个分类透明动画、状态感知事件回应、可自定义动作与触发规则，并支持点击互动、拖拽和屏幕漫游。

plugins.name: luxi233/dsh-settings-nav-scroll
plugins.descEn: Adds a visible vertical scrollbar to the DSH Web settings navigation when its sections exceed the viewport.
plugins.descZh: 当 DSH Web 设置导航的分区超出视口时，为其添加可见的纵向滚动条。

plugins.name: luxiwusuobuneng/dsh-plugin-context-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Context manager for DeepSeek Harness: auto-summarizes every turn into priority-sorted records, injects them plus pinned cross-session notes and custom text into each model request, and folds any-size real conversation ranges into summaries to save tokens. Persistent and restart-safe. NOTE: manual multi-step install — copy the three package folders into profiles/node_modules and add the provided cordis.patch.yml rows, then restart DSH; not a standard one-command install.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 上下文管理：每轮对话自动总结为记录并按优先级排序注入，⭐ 置顶记录跨会话继承，自定义文本每轮注入；真实对话任意范围折叠成摘要真省 token，全状态持久化重启不丢。注意：非标准一键安装——需手动将三个包目录复制到 profiles/node_modules、粘贴 cordis.patch.yml 接线并重启 DSH。

plugins.name: luxueliu/luxueliu-usage-command
plugins.descEn: 'Daily cost card for your local LLM gateway: /usage reads gateway_usage.jsonl and itemizes spend per model and per hour, covering official direct, OpenRouter relay, and in-plan metered pools.'
plugins.descZh: '本地 LLM 网关当日花费价目卡：/usage 读取 gateway_usage.jsonl，按模型×分小时列出消费，覆盖官方直连、OpenRouter 中转与套餐内计费池。'

plugins.name: lw-storm/dsh-plugin-masterprompt
plugins.descEn: 'Per-conversation persona / master prompt plugin: create, edit, switch and delete persona templates from the composer toolbar, with highest-priority system-prompt injection, fixed interaction guardrails, subagent inheritance, new-conversation default, and local JSON persistence.'
plugins.descZh: 每对话独立的人设 / 主提示词插件：在输入框工具栏创建、编辑、切换和删除人设模板，最高优先级系统提示注入，附带固定交互护栏、子代理继承、新对话默认继承与本地 JSON 持久化。

plugins.name: lw-storm/dsh-plugin-noticeme
plugins.descEn: 'Background notification plugin: desktop notification, with a tab-title fallback, when an approval prompt or an ask-user-question card appears while the page is in a background tab. The host queues approval and question events behind a same-origin endpoint that the client polls every 3 seconds; clicking the notification focuses the page, and the tab title is restored once the page becomes visible.'
plugins.descZh: 后台通知插件：页面处于后台时出现审批提示或提问卡片，即发送桌面通知（通知权限不可用时回退为标签页标题 ⚠ 前缀），点击通知聚焦页面；宿主将事件存入同源队列供前端每 3 秒轮询，页面恢复可见后标题自动还原。

plugins.name: LWJ007/dsh-browser-tabs
plugins.descEn: "Type /tabs to pick a browser tab (via chrome-devtools-mcp) and auto-fill its URL into the composer."
plugins.descZh: "输入 /tabs 弹出浏览器标签页选择器，点选后链接自动填入输入框。"

plugins.name: LWLAymh/dsh-edit-guardian
plugins.descEn: File-change diff bar with keep/undo summary, plus dangerous-command approval and red highlighting for bash/pwsh.
plugins.descZh: 文件修改 diff 栏与保留/撤销汇总，以及对 bash/pwsh 危险命令的审批与标红。

plugins.name: LWLAymh/dsh-tool-emoji
plugins.descEn: Replace tool-card leading icons with emoji while preserving the original cards.
plugins.descZh: 把工具卡片前面的图标换成 emoji，同时保留原卡片全部内容。

plugins.name: lxfu1/dsh-plugin-chart
plugins.descEn: Enhances data visualization in DeepSeek Harness by automatically selecting chart types from user input and generating images for trends, comparisons, proportions, relationships, and flows.
plugins.descZh: 增强 DeepSeek Harness 数据可视化能力，根据用户输入自动选择图表类型并生成图片，支持趋势、比较、占比、关系和流程等可视化场景。

plugins.name: lxp731/agents-plugins#dsh-service-control
plugins.descEn: 'Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe and logs, plus shell completions and self-update.'
plugins.descZh: '通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。'

plugins.name: lxp731/agents-plugins#task-complete-notify-for-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。'

plugins.name: lxxz1918/dsh-theme-customizer
plugins.descEn: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import and export, persisted across restarts.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

plugins.name: LyaxZ/dsh-fonttune
plugins.descEn: 'Font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height and weight, the interface has a font and a weight of its own and follows the conversation by default, code keeps its own axis with ligature control, and whole setups save as presets.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 字体插件：对话拥有字体、字号、行高与字重，界面用字体与字重并默认跟随对话（也可独立设置，两边互不影响），代码独立成轴并支持连字，整套配置可存为预设方案。'

plugins.name: lyd123qw2008/pi-control-chrome#dsh-tool-control-chrome
plugins.descEn: 'Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_* tools, a Skill and /chrome commands.'
plugins.descZh: '通过 MV3 扩展和本地 loopback Bridge 驱动用户已登录的真实 Chrome/Edge Profile、标签页与 Cookie，为 DSH 提供 browser_* 工具、Skill 和 /chrome 命令。'

plugins.name: lyhue1991/dsh-soup
plugins.descEn: 'Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab for Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/notebook/PDF + code highlighting, a live model throughput badge, and a multiline GoalBar.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 右侧 details 列项目资源管理器（多选、拖拽移动、上传、下载、重命名、废纸篓、系统打开），会话内只读预览 Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/Notebook/PDF 与代码高亮，附带模型实时吞吐徽标与多行 GoalBar。'

plugins.name: lyingice/dsh-client-ui-mc-skin
plugins.descEn: 'Minecraft-styled skin for the DSH Web client: MC GUI palette and pixel bevels, a pixel logo, on/off switch art, two persistent toggles in Settings, and an optional 16 MB Minecraft AE pixel font served on demand by the host half.'
plugins.descZh: '给 DSH Web 客户端用的 Minecraft 风格皮肤：MC 调色板与像素立体边框、像素标志图、开关图案、设置里两个可持久化的开关，以及由 Host 半边按需发货的 16 MB Minecraft AE 像素字体。'

plugins.name: lynote-ai/dsh-humanizer
plugins.descEn: Writing tools that remove AI-sounding patterns and match your personal voice. 8 deterministic tools scan text, build a style fingerprint from your samples, and return rewrite briefs.
plugins.descZh: 写作工具：去除 AI 腔并贴合个人文风。8 个确定性工具扫描文本、从样本提取文风指纹，并返回改写 brief。

plugins.name: lyp88997/dsh-browser-service
plugins.descEn: 'Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth, request-path whitelist and WebSocket rewriting, no root/GUI/Electron needed), plus a web panel — a real page you can click, scroll and type in, operation/console/network logs with one-click cleanup, a customizable window (border color, transparency, glass, fit-to-picture with no black bars, top-inset and self-centering) and an adjustable page size (1920x1080 by default) — plus a collapsed pill that can be dragged to any spot on the screen (free position), a live view that auto-resumes when you switch back to the web tab, and a 1920px default max edge for the live frame — and two bundled skills (browser, browser-runtime) served through the plugin built-in skill provider, so the skill centre lists them as system-level by default without writing into $DSH_HOME/skills.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 headless Chromium（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 / Electron）；另带一个网页面板——可直接点、滚、打字的实时页面，操作/控制台/网络日志与一键清理，窗口外观（边框色、透明度、玻璃效果）与几何（贴合画面比例去黑边、顶部留白、默认居中）可自定义，页面分辨率可调（默认 1920×1080）——收起后的胶囊可拖到任意位置（自由位置），切回「网页」自动续帧不用再点「开始」，实时画面「最大边」默认 1920——外加两份随包技能（browser、browser-runtime），由插件经 DSH 内置技能提供者提供，技能中心显示「系统内置」，默认不往 $DSH_HOME/skills 落盘。'

plugins.name: lyxx999/Automatic-session-renaming-for-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with configurable title language and max title bytes.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 会话自动重命名（session rename）：基于全部会话消息的 LLM 总结标题，首条提示词与 /handoff 后自动命名，会话头按钮或 /autotitle 手动触发，标题语言与最大字节数可设置。'

plugins.name: Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab
plugins.descEn: 'Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab or chat turn-tail row — line-level diffs and undo.'
plugins.descZh: '把 agent 的文件改动审查放进 dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 或对话尾部行，支持行级 diff 与撤销。'

plugins.name: Lzh3070/dsh-search-hub
plugins.descEn: 'Configurable web search hub for the built-in web_search tool: switch the active entry between DeepSeek official native search and Zhipu GLM web_search, with entry and credential management on a Settings page tab.'
plugins.descZh: '可配置的原生 web_search 后端：在 DeepSeek 官方原生搜索与智谱 GLM web_search 之间切换当前生效入口，并在设置页管理搜索入口与凭证引用。'

plugins.name: Lzz2133/dsh-manutd-fixtures
plugins.descEn: Manchester United 2026/27 fixtures in the sidebar with kickoff times in your local timezone, finished matches with W/L/D results.
plugins.descZh: 在侧边栏查看曼联 2026/27 赛季赛程，开球时间按你的本地时区显示，已结束比赛带 W/L/D 比分结果。

plugins.name: m1452700576/dsh-app-updater
plugins.descEn: Sidebar button that checks for DSH updates on startup, shows red dot for new versions, supports ignoring specific versions, and displays changelog preview with live download progress and GitHub mirror support for China.
plugins.descZh: 侧边栏按钮：启动时自动检查DSH更新并显示红点提示，支持忽略特定版本、预览更新日志，带实时下载进度、国内镜像加速和下载安全校验。

plugins.name: m1khal3v/dsh-llm-key-rotation
plugins.descEn: Rotates configured LLM API keys after quota, rate-limit, or authentication failures.
plugins.descZh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

plugins.name: m1khal3v/dsh-tool-codegraph
plugins.descEn: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
plugins.descZh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

plugins.name: Machine-126/dsh-alert-sound
plugins.descEn: 'Audio and voice alerts for the dsh web GUI: distinct tones and optional speech for approvals, questions, completions and errors.'
plugins.descZh: '为 dsh 网页界面提供声音/语音提醒：审批、提问、完成、错误各有独立音色，可选语音朗读。'

plugins.name: mackwan84/dsh-ui-mockup#ui-mockup
plugins.descEn: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
plugins.descZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

plugins.name: mafeis/dsh-image-guard
plugins.descEn: Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries with fewer images so image-heavy sessions keep working.
plugins.descZh: 发送前把请求中的历史图片裁剪至保留张数，并从上游 400 错误解析单次图片上限、按更少张数降级重试，保证含图会话不被图片数量限制打断。

plugins.name: magian1127/deepseek-harness-zhipu_plan_tools
plugins.descEn: 'Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page reading, optionally registers github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file repo tools, and adds a settings card with toggles and a credential-ref field.'
plugins.descZh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure / github_read_file 开源仓库工具，附设置卡片配置开关与凭据引用名。

plugins.name: magicOF2/dsh-autoload-history
plugins.descEn: Automatically loads the full conversation history when a session opens, so older messages are ready without clicking "Load earlier".
plugins.descZh: 打开会话时自动加载全部历史消息，免去反复点击「加载更早」。

plugins.name: magicOF2/dsh-schedule
plugins.descEn: 'Local long-term schedule panel: top-bar "日程" text button, today/week/history month-calendar views with stats, completion checkmarks with per-day history, schedule↔conversation links with click-to-jump, recurring tasks (daily/weekly), optional auto carry-over for unfinished one-time tasks, and dailytask_* agent tools.'
plugins.descZh: 本地长期日程面板:顶栏「日程」文字按钮、今天/本周/历史月历统计视图、完成打勾(按天记录历史)、日程↔会话链接点击跳转、重复日程(每天/每周)、一次性日程可选未完成自动顺延,以及 dailytask_* agent 工具。

plugins.name: Mandarin715/dsh-autostart
plugins.descEn: 'Windows boot autostart and one-click restart for the DSH service, from inside DSH: a resident supervisor that outlives the host, so a failed restart cannot leave DSH down; DSH spawned attached to a hidden console the supervisor owns, so no console window appears; plus a restart button, the current tokenised access URL and an optional post-start hook.'
plugins.descZh: Windows 平台的 DSH 服务开机自启与一键重启（都在 DSH 设置页内）：由常驻看护进程启动 DSH，它活得比 DSH 久，因此重启失败不会让 DSH 停摆；DSH 依附在看护进程的隐藏控制台上，不再每条命令弹一个控制台窗口；另有设置页重启按钮、当前带 token 的访问地址与可选的服务启动后钩子。

plugins.name: mangomt/dsh-power
plugins.descEn: 'Floating power dock for the DSH web GUI: one-click restart or graceful shutdown of the dsh host, loopback-guarded and dependency-free.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 悬浮电源坞:一键重启或优雅关机,仅限环回访问,零依赖。'

plugins.name: MannixHu/dsh-statusbar-config
plugins.descEn: 'Configurable statistics row below the composer via a ${variable} display template — which segments appear and how they are labelled is fully user-defined.'
plugins.descZh: '用 ${变量} 显示模板自定义输入框下方的会话统计行——显示哪些统计段、单位文案怎么写，全部由模板决定。'

plugins.name: MAOLEIJIN/dsh-mattpocock-skills
plugins.descEn: 'DSH bundle that vendors the full mattpocock/skills tree, preserves upstream invocation policies, and applies an exact-match DSH semantic overlay checked during automatic upstream synchronization.'
plugins.descZh: '将完整 mattpocock/skills 技能树打包为 DSH 插件，保留上游调用策略，并在自动同步上游时校验和应用精确匹配的 DSH 语义适配层。'

plugins.name: maoyuching/dsh-voice-chat
plugins.descEn: 'Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM condensing (long replies summarized into short spoken lines, following the current conversation model), TTS-friendly text cleaning, selectable Edge TTS voices, adjustable silence auto-stop, and settings embedded in DSH settings dialog.'
plugins.descZh: '豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。'

plugins.name: MarchLiu/dsh-farm
plugins.descEn: 'Service farm for DSH: register, start, stop and restart long-running project services, with agent tools (farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register), farm.yaml declarations and an overview drawer UI with live log follow, search and export.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 服务农场：注册、启动、停止、重启长驻项目服务，提供 agent 工具（farm_status/start/stop/restart/logs/register）与 farm.yaml 声明式服务，总览抽屉支持按工作区分组、实时日志 follow、搜索与导出。'

plugins.name: MarchLiu/dsh-graft
plugins.descEn: 'Graft, forward and fork DSH sessions: read a slice of one session log, export it, fork at a turn boundary, or forward a selection into another session as a self-contained graft message.'
plugins.descZh: '移植、转发与分叉 DSH 会话:读取会话日志切片并导出,在回合边界分叉会话,或将选中部分作为独立 graft 消息转发到另一会话(可为全新会话)。'

plugins.name: MarchLiu/dsh-rich-editor
plugins.descEn: 'Rich Markdown notebook for the composer region: a tool-row toggle plus a CodeMirror editor card with Codex-style list editing, submitted through the conversation service.'
plugins.descZh: '为输入区提供富 Markdown 笔记本：工具行开关加 CodeMirror 编辑卡片，支持 Codex 风格列表编辑，经会话服务提交。'

plugins.name: margbug01/dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-handoff
plugins.descEn: 'Secret-redacted session handoff with review, auto-start, and brief-only modes.'
plugins.descZh: 脱敏会话交接，支持审阅、立即启动和仅生成简报。

plugins.name: margbug01/dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-librarian
plugins.descEn: Evidence-first GitHub research subagent with bounded tools and in-memory request caching.
plugins.descZh: 带行号证据和内存缓存的 GitHub 只读调研子代理。

plugins.name: margbug01/dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-oracle
plugins.descEn: Strongly read-only, secret-aware Oracle second-opinion subagent.
plugins.descZh: 强制只读、会脱敏的第二意见子代理。

plugins.name: MaRi23333/dsh-agent-instructions-editor
plugins.descEn: 'Edit global and project instruction files in DeepSeek Harness settings, with project-chain discovery, byte-budget display, and save-conflict handling.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页编辑全局和项目指令文件，提供项目指令链浏览、字节预算显示与保存冲突处理。'

plugins.name: MaRi23333/dsh-grok-kit
plugins.descEn: 'Unofficial Grok integration for eligible SuperGrok or X Premium subscriptions: grok-4.6 chat with main-loop web/X search, shared Grok CLI OAuth, configurable model visibility, and Imagine images saved to an attachment or chosen path.'
plugins.descZh: '面向符合资格的 SuperGrok 或 X Premium 订阅的非官方 Grok 集成：支持 grok-4.6 对话、主循环网页/X 搜索、共用 Grok CLI OAuth、可配模型显示，以及将 Imagine 图片保存到附件库或指定路径。'

plugins.name: MaRi23333/dsh-serverchan-watchdog
plugins.descEn: 'Unofficial host-side ServerChan alerts for DeepSeek Harness: sends a mobile reminder when an approval, plan review, or question stays unanswered past a configurable threshold, even with the browser closed.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的第三方 Server酱提醒插件：在主机端监控审批、计划评审和问答，超过设定时间仍未处理时发送手机提醒，无需保持浏览器打开。'

plugins.name: MaRi23333/dsh-subagent-library
plugins.descEn: 'Named subagent roster: manage role entries (model, persona, tool filter, depth, background mode) from a hot-reloaded settings page; the model picks one with list_subagents and dispatches by id with delegate — foreground, background, or continuable.'
plugins.descZh: '具名子代理名册：设置页可视化维护角色条目（模型、persona、工具过滤、深度、后台模式），热生效；模型用 list_subagents 选人、delegate 按 id 派活，支持前台、后台与可续聊。'

plugins.name: mario03690/dsh-netcafe
plugins.descEn: 'Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table conversion, SQL dialect transpiling, and mainland-China reachability probes run from a China Mobile network vantage point.'
plugins.descZh: '托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。'

plugins.name: mario841859784/dsh-expert-orchestrator
plugins.descEn: "Multi-agent orchestration agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: one chief orchestrator that never implements itself — it triages every request, has a PM expert plan the work, and delegates implementation to domain experts via a merged expert roster (list and summon tools), scheduling parallel work through a dependency-DAG taskboard and a file-based message bus, with delivery gated by an independent review. Ships 11 core experts; more expert teams (Agency agents EN/ZH, classic collections) are one-click downloads from the settings page over dual GitHub/CDN channels with sha256 verification. Published on npm as dsh-expert-orchestrator (requires DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2)."
plugins.descZh: "多智能体编排 agent preset：首席编排者不亲自实施——先分诊、请 PM 专家规划、经合并专家花名册（召唤工具）把实施委派给领域专家，依赖 DAG 任务板与落盘消息总线调度并行协作，交付前经独立评审门禁。出厂内置 11 位核心专家；更多专家团（Agency agents 中英文、classic 集合）可在设置页一键下载，走 GitHub/CDN 双通道并经 sha256 验签。npm 包名 dsh-expert-orchestrator（要求 DSH >= 0.1.7-alpha.2）。"

plugins.name: mario841859784/dsh-onebot
plugins.descEn: 'QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards, merged forwards, and a settings page.'
plugins.descZh: '给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。'

plugins.name: MarioLuLu7/dsh-git-plus
plugins.descEn: 'DSH Source Control tab in dsh-better-sidebar that mirrors VS Code Git workflows.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh-better-sidebar 中的 DSH 源代码管理面板，尽量对齐 VS Code 的 Git 工作流。'

plugins.name: Marquez807/dsh-experience-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Cross-session experience memory for DSH. Lessons are evidence-graded, injected when the turn is about the same thing, and shown just before an action only when the record declares which call it applies to. A rule that holds whatever the turn is about — "always answer in Chinese" — can be marked **standing** and is then carried every turn: measured on 24 isolated real-model turns, a standing rule is followed 6/6 against 0/18 for the controls (empty store, same record unmarked, unrelated standing record). A guess still cannot become always-on: a standing record needs a verified passage like any other. What nobody looks up is retired, reversibly. Five tools, seven slash commands, zero runtime dependencies.'
plugins.descZh: '跨会话经验记忆：经验按证据定级，本轮话题相同时才注入；动手前提示只在记录自己声明了适用哪次调用时才出现。不管聊什么都要守的规矩（例如「一律用中文」）可以标成**常驻**，之后每一轮都会带上它——24 个隔离真模型回合实测：标常驻 6/6，对照组（空库、同一条不标、无关常驻）合计 0/18。光是猜的东西进不了常驻层：标了常驻也必须有可核实的出处。没人再查的记录会被退役（可逆）。五个模型工具、七个斜杠命令、运行时零依赖。'

plugins.name: Martlet-Tech/dsh-approval-explain
plugins.descEn: 'Adds an Explain button to the approval card: one model call returns exactly three lines reading the pending operation, covering what it does, which files or system state it reads, writes, modifies or executes, and a risky/attention/safe verdict with a one-sentence justification. It also renders the detail area for `write` and `edit` calls, which the shipped renderer leaves blank because it only reads a `command` field.'
plugins.descZh: '在审批卡片上加一个「解释」按钮：一次模型调用返回固定三行解读——做什么、读写改了什么、是否安全（风险等级加一句理由）。同时补上 `write`/`edit` 类调用详情区留白的问题——官方渲染器只读 `command` 字段，那两类调用没有该字段。'

plugins.name: Martlet-Tech/dsh-open-folder-fix
plugins.descEn: 'Fixes the Windows workspace-open action. The shipped opener runs `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`, which on some hosts reports success without raising a window — the exit-code verdict cannot tell an opened window from nothing happening. This routes that one action to `explorer.exe /e,<dir>`, which raises a window reliably, and leaves every other application in the menu on the shipped path.'
plugins.descZh: '修正 Windows 上「打开工作目录」的行为。官方调用 `explorer.exe "<file:// URI>"`，在某些主机上会报告成功却不弹窗口——因为成功判据是退出码，分不出「窗口开了」和「什么都没发生」。本插件把该操作改走 `explorer.exe /e,<目录>`，稳定新开窗口；菜单里其它应用仍走官方路径。'

plugins.name: master1Sun/dsh-file-workbench-lib
plugins.descEn: File workbench library plugin for DSH, provide file processing capability.
plugins.descZh: DSH 文件工作台库插件，提供文件处理相关能力。

plugins.name: master1Sun/dsh-prompt-library
plugins.descEn: 'DSH Prompt Library plugin: prompt CRUD, tags & categories, import/export, AI polish, one-click clip selected text, sidebar and assistant bubble reminders.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH提示词库插件：支持提示词增删改查、分类标签、导入导出、AI智能优化、选中文本一键剪藏，附带侧边栏与词库助手气泡提醒。'

plugins.name: master1Sun/dsh-QQbot
plugins.descEn: DSH QQ bot bridge plugin, connect DeepSeek Harness with QQ bot.
plugins.descZh: DSH QQ机器人桥接插件，将DeepSeek Harness对接QQ机器人。

plugins.name: MasterBenC/shangshi-dsh
plugins.descEn: Local Qimen business-timing workbench for DeepSeek Harness, with nine palaces, deterministic scoring, future-window ranking, and direction advice.
plugins.descZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中本地完成奇门排盘、商务评分、未来择时和方位建议。

plugins.name: Matcha-Eason/dsh-answer-highlighter
plugins.descEn: Automatically highlights key points, definitions, warnings, and questions in completed assistant answers using one separate model call.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web 的助手回答完成后，额外调用一次模型，自动高亮其中的关键点、定义、警告和问题。

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-capture
plugins.descEn: 'Dual-engine screen capture for DSH: inside the SSiD desktop shell, a global hotkey or tray opens a fullscreen box-select overlay (all monitors, per-display pixel-perfect frames) with in-place red-box annotation and a WeChat-style toolbar; in plain DSH (browser), the composer camera button captures the display via getDisplayMedia and reuses the same single-phase box-select + annotation overlay in-page. The cropped image lands in the current conversation composer through the official attachment intake.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 双引擎截图：思灵桌面壳内，全局快捷键/托盘打开全屏框选浮层（多显示器、逐屏像素级抓帧），选区定格后工具条就地画红框，一次确认送进输入框；纯 DSH（浏览器）下由输入框相机按钮经 getDisplayMedia 捕获屏幕，复用同一套单阶段框选+标注遮罩。均走官方附件通道。'

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-chat-rail
plugins.descEn: 'Scroll-painting message rail for DeepSeek Harness: a slim right-edge rail with one indicator per user message, scroll-spy follows the reading position, hover unfolds a canvas with full message previews, and clicking jumps to any history message; animates in sync with better-sidebar panels.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 画卷式消息导航栏：会话面板右侧一条竖排导轨，每条用户消息一个指示点，scroll-spy 跟随阅读位置，hover 展开画卷查看完整消息预览，点击跳转任意历史消息；与 better-sidebar 面板动画同步避让。

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-draft-polish
plugins.descEn: 'Draft polish for the DSH composer: one-click AI polish of the input draft (sparkles button next to send), with optional conversation context and a configurable model channel.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 输入框草稿润色：发送键左侧一键调用 LLM 润色草稿，可携带会话上下文，模型渠道可配置。'

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-node-appearance
plugins.descEn: 'Conversation node appearance for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: configurable per-category and per-tool colors (left accent bar + tinted background), plus a show-thinking toggle; pure frontend rendering, takes effect instantly and persists to the DSH user settings file.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话节点外观插件：按节点类别/工具名可配置着色（左侧色条 + 淡色底），附带"显示思考过程"开关；纯前端渲染增强，改动即时生效并持久化到 DSH 用户设置文件。

plugins.name: Max-Null/dsh-quick-toolbar
plugins.descEn: 'Plugin-button aggregator with carrier + on-site-LLM extensibility: gather any plugin''s scattered buttons into one entry (SSiD title bar / web floating ball), LLM registers per environment, right-click deregisters — pure data, no plugin source touched.'
plugins.descZh: '插钮聚合器（载体+驻场 LLM 范式）：把任何插件的散落按钮聚合到统一入口（SSiD 标题栏 / web 悬浮球）——LLM 按环境注册、右键删除=注销，纯数据零代码，不动插件源码。'

plugins.name: MaxHou-infinity/dsh-scout
plugins.descEn: 'Evidence-driven company and job due-diligence for DSH: logs sources with evidence levels, adds evidence-bounded claims, verifies the legal entity against official registries, and renders a PROCEED/VERIFY/STOP report with a verification checklist and interview questions.'
plugins.descZh: 证据驱动的公司与岗位尽调插件：登记带证据等级的来源、添加受证据边界约束的结论、用官方登记信息核验公司主体，并生成推进/核验/停止三态报告，附核验清单与面试问题。

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-forge
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs and changed files, and Actions runs, jobs and job logs. Tool metadata is available in English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese.'
plugins.descZh: '面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。'

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-grafana-query
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert state, and provisioned alert rules. Range queries downsample to a point budget; an explicitly supplied step that would exceed it is rejected rather than silently changed, so the model never receives data at a resolution it did not ask for.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。'

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-odoo
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field names may not contain dots, so related-record traversal is not possible. A draft-create tool is registered only when allowWrite is enabled, and is limited to sale.order and project.task with the draft state enforced by the plugin.'
plugins.descZh: '经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与 project.task，草稿状态由插件强制。'

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-sentry
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed stacktrace. Local variables, request headers and bodies, query strings, packages and secret-looking tags are removed before the event reaches the model, and oversized events degrade through source context, breadcrumbs and frames rather than failing.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。'

plugins.name: maxmilian/dsh-sonarqube
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single hotspot detail, and coverage, duplication or caller-selected measures. Issue and hotspot results carry a normalized location with component key, file path, line and text range.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。'

plugins.name: maxwell-feng/dsh-tinyfish-search
plugins.descEn: 'TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.'
plugins.descZh: '基于 TinyFish 的网页搜索提供方：把内置 web_search 接到 TinyFish Search API，每次搜索一次 GET，不消耗模型调用。'

plugins.name: MaybeJustLikeThis/rainbow-fart-dsh
plugins.descEn: Adds combo scoring, activity breakdowns, turn ratings, and optional Jev-based encouragement to DSH Web sessions.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 会话添加连击计分、活动明细、轮次评价和可选的 Jev 辅助鼓励。

plugins.name: mays-hi/dsh-git-idea
plugins.descEn: "Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count, opens a branch switcher on hover and an IDEA-style VCS panel on click (branch tree, commit graph, changes and staging, commit detail, file diff), plus a settings page for commit identity, the git binary and the network flags. Registers no model tools with DSH."
plugins.descZh: "照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。"

plugins.name: MDR-EX1000/dsh-desktop-kit
plugins.descEn: 'macOS desktop shell for the DSH web UI: a plugin plus a small Tauri/WKWebView window over the loopback web surface — real macOS fullscreen, single instance, external links delegated to the system browser, and browser-style zoom.'
plugins.descZh: '把 DSH Web UI 装进原生 macOS 桌面窗口：插件 + 轻量 Tauri/WKWebView 外壳跑在同一个 loopback 地址上——真 macOS 全屏、单实例、外链交给系统浏览器、类浏览器页面缩放。'

plugins.name: MDR-EX1000/dsh-rw
plugins.descEn: 'Remote-SSH-style workspaces: turn an SSH host and a remote directory into a native DSH workspace; the agent operates the remote filesystem directly via 12 rw_* tools (SFTP/exec), with workspace-confined paths and known_hosts verification.'
plugins.descZh: 'Remote-SSH 风格工作区：把 SSH 主机上的远程目录变成原生 DSH 工作区，agent 通过 12 个 rw_* 工具（SFTP/exec）直接操作远程文件，路径限定在工作区内并校验 known_hosts。'

plugins.name: megatronyy/dsh-skin-background
plugins.descEn: Image-background skin with four shipped wallpapers, a user wallpaper directory, custom image URLs, and live dim/blur controls in Settings.
plugins.descZh: 图片背景皮肤：内置四张壁纸，支持用户壁纸目录与自定义图片链接，设置页实时调节压暗与模糊。

plugins.name: megatronyy/dsh-tradingagents
plugins.descEn: A-share multi-agent analysis behind /trading-agent, ported from TradingAgents-AShare, running 14 roles (analysts, bull/bear debate, risk review, trader) through the harness LLM route.
plugins.descZh: /trading-agent 命令背后的 A 股多智能体分析，移植自 TradingAgents-AShare：14 个角色（分析师、多空辩论、风控、交易员）经 dsh 已配置的模型路由协作产出完整投研报告。

plugins.name: MeghanBao/dsh-backstory
plugins.descEn: A `/backstory` command and tool that annotate each line with the git commit that last touched it and the agent turn + prompt that wrote it, from a persistent per-line ledger (drift-proof by content hash), DSH-* commit trailers, or the live session log.
plugins.descZh: '/backstory 命令与工具：为每一行标注最后改动它的 git 提交，以及写下它的 agent 轮次与提示词；数据取自按行持久化的账本（以内容哈希防漂移）、DSH-* 提交尾注或实时会话日志。'

plugins.name: meihaoyidian/life-workbench
plugins.descEn: 'Personal workbench panel with an overview dashboard, custom kanban boards, a note pad and a file library, persisted to local JSON by the host.'
plugins.descZh: '个人工作台面板：总览仪表盘、自定义看板、随手记与资料库，数据由 Host 持久化到本地 JSON。'

plugins.name: Mekansm1/DSH-WebGIS
plugins.descEn: Conversational GIS for the DSH Web UI with local file and PostGIS querying, interactive maps, and spatial analysis.
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web UI 的对话式 GIS：支持本地文件与 PostGIS 查询、交互式地图与空间分析。'

plugins.name: mekos2772/dsh-plugin-mimi
plugins.descEn: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows Computer Use for observing and controlling desktop windows.
plugins.descZh: DSH 的 Mimi 桌面伴侣，跟随工作会话状态显示动画反应和气泡，提供独立聊天模式，并内置 Windows Computer Use 以观察和操作桌面窗口。

plugins.name: melandlabs/opencontext#dsh-opencontext
plugins.descEn: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights, and document retrieval.
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

plugins.name: melt502/dsh-hotkey
plugins.descEn: Configurable VS Code style keyboard shortcuts for the DSH web GUI, with a settings-page keybinding editor, conflict detection and JSON import/export.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供可配置的 VS Code 风格键盘快捷键，内置设置页改键、冲突检测与 JSON 导入导出。

plugins.name: melt502/DSH-Session-Reference-UX-Patch
plugins.descEn: Durable, reversible installer that patches DSH Desktop session-reference UX — workspace-prioritized @ candidates, title-first display, two-line menu layout, and sidebar drag-to-composer session references.
plugins.descZh: 可回滚的 DSH Desktop 会话引用体验补丁安装器——@ 菜单当前工作区优先、标题优先展示、两行布局，以及侧边栏拖拽会话到输入区形成引用。

plugins.name: memorax-ai/dsh-webui-studio
plugins.descEn: 'Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and validation.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。'

plugins.name: menghuanshiguang/devctl-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Drive a DSH instance from another device: a host plugin opens a token-authenticated TCP port that a single-file Python CLI drives - listing and creating sessions, sending prompts with images, streaming replies, and switching models, permissions and workspaces.'
plugins.descZh: '从另一台设备驱动 DSH：Host 插件开一个 token 鉴权的 TCP 端口，单文件 Python CLI 负责列会话、建会话、发带图消息、看流式回复，以及切模型、权限与工作区。'

plugins.name: mengnanxyyyy/dsh-markdown-xyy
plugins.descEn: Lightweight Markdown conversation theme plugin — enhances native color scheme with 4 built-in themes (light/dark dual), user-defined CSS themes, system-aware auto-switching, in-browser theme editor, designed to enhance reading speed and clarity.
plugins.descZh: 轻量级对话 Markdown 主题插件——增强原生着色，4 套内置主题（浅/深双档）、用户自定义 CSS 主题、系统感知自动切换、内置主题编辑器，提升快速阅读体验。

plugins.name: mengqi1436/dsh-db-tool
plugins.descEn: "Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。"

plugins.name: mengqi1436/DSH-Rtk-rewrite
plugins.descEn: Replaces the web profile's pwsh shell executor with a subclass that rewrites every command through `rtk rewrite` before execution for token savings, running the original command unchanged on any rewrite failure (no equivalent, missing rtk, timeout) and keeping sandbox semantics intact.
plugins.descZh: 将 web profile 的 pwsh shell 执行器替换为执行前经 `rtk rewrite` 透明改写的子类以节省 token，任何改写失败（无等价、rtk 缺失、超时）都原样执行且沙箱语义完整保留。

plugins.name: Mengshang-spec/dsh-plugin-trustlens
plugins.descEn: "Read-only DSH plugin auditor with static scanning, current-session model review, and confirmation gates."
plugins.descZh: "只读 DSH 插件审查器：静态扫描、当前会话模型审查和启用前确认。"

plugins.name: Mengshang-spec/dsh-third-party-api-balance-wallet
plugins.descEn: "Compact DSH wallet panel for any Sub2API-compatible third-party balance site. Uses /v1/usage with a long-lived API Key, auto-discovers configured providers, and shows balance plus daily usage."
plugins.descZh: "通用 Sub2API 第三方余额面板：使用 /v1/usage 和长期 API Key，自动发现 DSH provider，显示余额及今日用量。"

plugins.name: mengxiaoxian/lookover#dsh-expmem
plugins.descEn: 'Personal-experience memory for DSH: turns solved tasks into sourced problem cases with condition-scoped claims, recalls them into new tasks via hidden pre-step injection, and makes corrections/deletes cascade to future recall.'
plugins.descZh: '个人经验记忆：把真实解决过的问题存为带来源、可纠正、有适用条件的案例，新任务中自动召回复用，纠正与删除会级联影响后续召回。'

plugins.name: mengxiaoxian/lookover#dsh-look
plugins.descEn: 'Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated local OCR), plus a summon-hotkey snapshot captured the instant you press.'
plugins.descZh: 'macOS 场景感知探针：拉模型零轮询的 look 工具，读取最前非自身窗口（应用信息、AX 标题/选中文本、按需本地 OCR），支持召唤热键按下瞬间抓取快照注入对话。'

plugins.name: MengYuil/dsh-ponytail
plugins.descEn: 'Port of ponytail: an always-on lazy-senior-developer coding persona with intensity levels, persistence of the default level, and review, audit, debt, gain and help skills for DeepSeek Harness.'
plugins.descZh: 'ponytail 移植：常驻的「懒惰资深开发者」编码人设，带强度档位与 review、audit、debt、gain、help 技能，适用于 DeepSeek Harness。'

plugins.name: menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-browser
plugins.descEn: 'Native headless and visible Chromium browser automation agent for DeepSeek Harness with DOM tree extraction, screenshot capture, and built-in SSRF protection.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 原生无头及可视化 Chromium 浏览器自动化插件：支持 DOM 树提取、网页截图捕获及内置 SSRF 安全防护。'

plugins.name: menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-mcp
plugins.descEn: 'Universal Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridge for DeepSeek Harness: connects agents to stdio/sse/websocket MCP servers with a 10k dormant scale engine, sub-millisecond BM25 tool search, dynamic token budgeting, and a real-time web UI dashboard.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 通用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 桥接插件：支持 stdio/sse/websocket 协议，具备 10k 休眠伸缩引擎、亚毫秒级 BM25 工具检索、动态 Token 预算管理及实时 Web UI 仪表盘。'

plugins.name: menotbobbybrown/dsh-plugin-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Persistent long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a JSON store of typed entries (fact, preference, entity, rule, episodic) exposed as the memory_remember and memory_recall agent tools, with recall ranked by keyword overlap, importance and access frequency.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的长期持久记忆：以 JSON 保存事实／偏好／实体／规则／经历等分类条目，注册为 memory_remember 与 memory_recall 两个 agent 工具；召回按关键词重叠、重要度与访问频次排序。'

plugins.name: mercy719/dsh-client-ui-weather
plugins.descEn: Weather dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with city switching, current conditions, an eight-hour trend, and a five-day forecast.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 天气看板，支持城市切换、当前天气、八小时趋势图和五日预报。

plugins.name: merenguesL/dsh-tool-normalizer
plugins.descEn: 'A self-healing layer for tool calls: missing params, wrong fields and out-of-range paths are fixed before they reach the model. Measured visible error rate fell from 7.95% to 2.20%.'
plugins.descZh: 给工具调用加一层自愈：缺参数、错字段、路径越界在到达模型前自动修好，实测可见错误率从 7.95% 降到 2.20%。

plugins.name: MerkurevSergei/dsh-notion-oauth-ui
plugins.descEn: Connect Notion from the GUI with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE — official Notion MCP, no integration token.
plugins.descZh: 在图形界面中以 OAuth 2.0 + PKCE 连接 Notion —— 官方 Notion MCP，无需集成令牌。

plugins.name: mervin1944/dsh-version-badge
plugins.descEn: 'Version badge above the sidebar settings button: shows the current dsh version, expands to list every core package version, and checks npm for updates with one-click deploy.'
plugins.descZh: '侧边栏设置按钮上方的版本徽标：常驻显示当前 dsh 版本，展开可查看全部核心包版本，并支持检查 npm 更新与一键部署。'

plugins.name: Meteor-system/dsh-codegraph
plugins.descEn: Indexes the current workspace into a relation graph and exposes one agent tool, codegraph_explore, for reachability, callers, and impact, plus a Web sidebar graph pane.
plugins.descZh: 将当前工作区索引为关系图，向 agent 暴露一个工具 codegraph_explore（可达性、调用者、影响面），并在 Web 右侧栏提供图形面板。

plugins.name: Meteor-system/mattpocock-skills-for-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'A DeepSeek Harness bundle of the 25 promoted mattpocock/skills with a native agent preset, an invocation-aware skill provider, and a light grilling-to-implement bootstrap.'
plugins.descZh: '将 mattpocock/skills 的 25 个正式技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness bundle，附原生 Agent 预设、区分人触发与模型调用的技能 provider，以及轻量 grilling 到 implement 引导。'

plugins.name: Meteor-system/superpowers-for-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'A DeepSeek Harness bundle of 14 obra/superpowers engineering skills with a native agent preset, automatic session bootstrap, and Windows sandbox compatibility.'
plugins.descZh: '将 obra/superpowers 的 14 个工程技能打包为 DeepSeek Harness bundle，附原生 Agent 预设、自动会话引导和 Windows 沙箱兼容。'

plugins.name: MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget
plugins.descEn: "A fixed-corner whale widget for the DSH web GUI — balance, today's usage and per-turn cost with peak/off-peak pricing, editable balance-alert and daily-budget bubbles, a module-based custom bubble queue with A/B weighted choices and random lines or images, 30+ vendor templates (OpenAI, OpenRouter, Kimi, SiliconFlow, Ark, Zhipu, MiniMax and more) with per-model balance and subscription quota, plus task-end sound, imported audio, custom roles and a resource manager. Local-only, no telemetry."
plugins.descZh: 右下角常驻的小鲸鱼挂件：余额、今日已用与每轮对话消耗（含峰谷价），余额预警与今日预算的泡泡内容都可编辑；泡泡点击序列模块化自定义，支持并列加权 A/B、随机台词与随机图片；内置 30+ 厂商模板（OpenAI / OpenRouter / Kimi / 硅基流动 / 方舟 / 智谱 / MiniMax 等），按模型查余额与订阅额度；另有任务结束音效、导入音频、自定义角色与资源管理。数据全在本机，无遥测。

plugins.name: meyaomiao/dsh-files-native
plugins.descEn: 'Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads and sent cards sit on the user bubble.'
plugins.descZh: '接近原生的 DSH 附件：PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF 走官方缩略图，其它文件经拖入、粘贴或回形针变成 64px 卡片；非图片落到 .dsh-uploads，发送后贴在用户气泡旁。'

plugins.name: meyaomiao/dsh-github-workbench
plugins.descEn: 'GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or cancel CI; mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right panel.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。'

plugins.name: meyaomiao/dsh-graphmemory
plugins.descEn: 'DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions, and ships as the npm package dsh-graphmemory.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 知识图谱记忆：better-sidebar「记忆图谱」页签与独立看板 /graph-memory/app；抽取任务/技能/事件节点并跨会话召回，npm 包名为 dsh-graphmemory。'

plugins.name: meyaomiao/dsh-server-deck
plugins.descEn: 'Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a better-sidebar tab or a standalone right drawer.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 服务器卡片仪表盘：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点卡片进入 xterm.js SSH 终端；支持导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧抽屉。'

plugins.name: mhxy13867806343/my-dsh-desktop-extra
plugins.descEn: 'DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。'

plugins.name: mia-wong1016/dsh-codex-plus
plugins.descEn: "Brings the Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) subscription already signed in on this machine into DSH. It (1) shows the 5-hour and weekly windows with their reset times and the remaining reset credits in a sidebar panel, with one-click reset that consumes a credit; (2) registers the subscription route in llm-pi-ai (openai-codex) when the quota is read, so the Codex models appear in the model picker; (3) refreshes the OAuth access token before expiry and writes it back atomically, so no key has to be replaced by hand; and (4) adds a codex tool that delegates a task to the local Codex agent. No API key has to be entered."
plugins.descZh: "本机已登录的 Codex（ChatGPT Plus/Pro）订阅接入 DSH。用途：①在侧边栏展示 5 小时窗口与一周窗口的剩余额度、重置时间与剩余重置券数量，并支持一键消耗一张重置券重置额度；②读取额度时自动把订阅线路注册进 llm-pi-ai（openai-codex 路由），使 Codex 模型出现在模型选择器中；③access token 到期前自动续期并原子写回，无需手动更换密钥；④提供 codex 工具把任务委派给本机 Codex agent。无需填写任何 API key。"

plugins.name: miaomiao636/dsh-message-navigator
plugins.descEn: "Codex-style message navigator for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a tick per user message along the conversation edge, hover or click to preview and smooth-jump to the message, with full history auto-loading."
plugins.descZh: "为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Codex 风格的消息导航器：对话边缘为每条用户消息生成刻度，悬停或点击即可预览并平滑跳转到对应消息，自动加载完整历史记录。"

plugins.name: Miaotofu01/Study-Mate
plugins.descEn: 'Your AI learning companion: helping you plan your studies, understand concepts, and build projects to master a subject.'
plugins.descZh: 你的AI学习搭档：定计划、讲知识、做项目，学透一门科目。

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-btw
plugins.descEn: 'Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.'
plugins.descZh: '提供 /btw 一次性上下文旁问，不执行工具；回答显示在可复制、折叠或关闭的独立气泡中，不写入主对话。'

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-code-review
plugins.descEn: 'Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.'
plugins.descZh: '提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。'

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-codex-pet
plugins.descEn: 'An in-page pet for DSH Web with multi-session task notifications and controls to open tasks, stop turns, and respond to supported approval and question requests.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 页内宠物，提供多会话任务提醒，可打开任务、停止当前轮次，并处理受支持的审批和问答请求。'

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-pua
plugins.descEn: 'Adds /pua to steer the agent to try another approach and verify results before claiming completion, with 15 company styles, persona modes, global and per-conversation settings, and an optional loop that continues until a verification command passes, the iteration limit is reached, or the user cancels.'
plugins.descZh: '提供 /pua，在 Agent 失败后促使其换方法，并在宣称完成前核验收据；含 15 种公司风格、角色模式、全局与会话设置，以及可选验收循环（直到验收命令通过、达到迭代上限或用户取消）。'

plugins.name: MichengAI/dsh-simplify
