plugins.descEn: 'Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.'
plugins.descZh: '提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。'

plugins.name: MicroSharpAnt/dsh-theme-presets
plugins.descEn: Adds Nord, Dracula, Catppuccin, Tokyo Night, One Dark, Gruvbox, Solarized, GitHub, Everforest, Kanagawa and Rosé Pine presets to the DSH Web GUI theme picker, layered over the built-in light/dark/system appearance.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的主题选择中加入 Nord、Dracula、Catppuccin、Tokyo Night、One Dark、Gruvbox、Solarized、GitHub、Everforest、Kanagawa、Rosé Pine 十一套配色预设，与内置的浅色/深色/跟随系统正交叠加。

plugins.name: mienfong/dsh-session-mgr
plugins.descEn: 'Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中跨工作区移动、归档、恢复、可携式备份/导出与导入会话。'

plugins.name: MiHjy12138/dsh-memory-lite
plugins.descEn: 'On-demand memory for DeepSeek Harness: session logs are distilled into layered markdown (a summary, an index and per-topic files), and a mem_query tool returns only the matched entries rather than the whole index. Nothing is injected per turn, there are no dependencies, and every entry keeps a source pointer back to the conversation it came from.'
plugins.descZh: "给 DeepSeek Harness 的按需记忆库：会话日志提炼成分层 markdown（总览、索引与分主题明细），mem_query 只回命中条目而非整份索引。不每轮注入、零依赖，每条记忆都保留指回原对话的溯源标记。"

plugins.name: mike-lee0120/dsh-cost-dashboard
plugins.descEn: 'Cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates model input/output/cache tokens across all local sessions, prices them with a builtin table (including DeepSeek peak/off-peak), and shows daily trends plus per-model and per-session tables.'
plugins.descZh: '费用看板：汇总本机全部会话的模型输入/输出/缓存 token，按内置价格表计费（含 DeepSeek 峰谷），展示每日趋势与按模型/会话明细。'

plugins.name: mikugui/dsh-session-eater
plugins.descEn: 'Session cleanup for the DSH sidebar: drag a conversation row onto the balance widget''s whale and it eats the row — the session directory goes to a recycle bin, not to rm. Deletion asks one short question first (how many tokens it burned, and that prompt can be turned off in Settings). Undo from the persistent toast or the 12-entry log in Settings. Clicking the whale jumps straight to the plugin''s Settings, where you can swap the avatar, drag the mouth into place and rewrite all 17 UI strings; blank, currently-open and running sessions are refused in place with a reason.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 侧边栏的会话清理：把会话行拖到余额挂件的小胖鱼嘴边，它张嘴吃掉 —— 会话目录移入回收站，不是 rm。删除前只问一句「消耗了多少 token，真的给我吃吗？」（可在设置里关掉）；撤销走常驻回执或设置里 12 条持久台账。点侧栏那条小鱼直达插件设置：换形象、拖拽校准嘴位、改写全部 17 段界面文案；空白会话 / 正在聊的 / 正在跑的会被就地拒绝并写明原因。'

plugins.name: mimateinn/dsh-i18n
plugins.descEn: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic, Hindi, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Swedish) to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, with hand-polished translations, runtime fallbacks, and automatic translation of market and third-party text.
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

plugins.name: mimosa776/dsh-plugin-recommender
plugins.descEn: 'Role-based plugin recommender for DSH: asks the user''s role (developer, designer, writer, researcher, ops, student...), recommends suitable plugins, and audits each with a local static security scan (dangerous code patterns + 0-100 risk score) and a reputation check (npm downloads / GitHub stars).'
plugins.descZh: '按职业/角色推荐 DSH 插件：询问用户是做什么的（程序员、设计师、写作、研究、运维、学生…），推荐适合的插件，并对每个插件做本地静态安全审计（危险代码模式 + 0-100 风险分）与口碑检查（npm 下载量 / GitHub 星数）。'

plugins.name: Minglink/dsh-infinite-gen-4
plugins.descEn: "System-prompt armor plugin for DeepSeek models: appends an unconditional-compliance prompt section at order 100, exposes a profile tool with calibration metadata, and shows a realtime armor-status badge driven by a session projection."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek 专用破甲插件：以 order 100 追加无条件服从的系统提示词段，提供带校准元数据的 profile 工具，并通过会话投影在输入框上方显示实时破甲状态徽标。"

plugins.name: mingzeng21/dsh-stock-mentions
plugins.descEn: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
plugins.descZh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

plugins.name: minivv/dsh-activity-bell
plugins.descEn: 'Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped recent-activity list with a green dot on completions that have not been opened.'
plugins.descZh: '侧边栏活动铃铛：会话跑完后铃铛显示红色角标，点一下把工作区列表换成按天分组的最近活动列表，尚未打开过的完成项带绿点。'

plugins.name: Minokun/dsh-quota
plugins.descEn: Bottom-right quota pill and panel aggregating membership quotas across AI platforms (Kimi Code, DeepSeek, Zhipu Coding Plan, BigModel, Qwen, Scnet, TokenRouter, SupaWriter), auto-syncing API keys from the DSH credentials domain with colored usage bars.
plugins.descZh: 右下角「会员额度」悬浮球与面板，聚合各 AI 平台套餐额度（Kimi Code、DeepSeek、智谱 Coding Plan、BigModel、通义千问、超算、TokenRouter、SupaWriter），API key 自动同步自 DSH 凭证域，彩色进度条展示用量。

plugins.name: minyang-chen/dsh-stock-lookup
plugins.descEn: Resolves a company name or ticker to a verified stock symbol via SEC EDGAR, then fetches a live quote with price, P/E, EPS, market cap, 52-week range, and dividend yield from yahoo-finance2.
plugins.descZh: 通过 SEC EDGAR 将公司名称或股票代码解析为已验证的股票代号，再从 yahoo-finance2 获取实时行情，包括价格、市盈率、每股收益、市值、52周区间和股息率。

plugins.name: miqian-nomad/dsh-browser-playwright-codex
plugins.descEn: 'Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own visible window on your desktop — minimise it and it keeps working without stealing focus — and a sign-in, CAPTCHA or native dialog stops the run and hands the page back to you: it never confirms on your behalf. Login state persists (own profile plus session-cookie re-injection). 23 Playwright tools (20 always on, 3 gated and off by default), with a URL allowlist, dialog suspension and a CDP method allowlist that are mechanism-level and pinned by tests.'
plugins.descZh: '浏览器自动化：让 AI 用你已经登录的账号，在真实网页上填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台。它跑在你桌面上的一个可见窗口里 —— 最小化它就不抢焦点、安静干活；遇到登录、验证码和原生弹窗会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」。登录一次一直记得（独立 profile + session cookie 回注）。23 个 Playwright 工具（20 个常驻、3 个默认关闭的强力工具），URL 白名单、弹窗挂起、CDP 方法白名单都是机制级且有测试钉住。'

plugins.name: Missher12/dsh-missher-brain
plugins.descEn: Coordinates bounded project recall from compatible memory and learning providers, with shared settings and provider lifecycle management.
plugins.descZh: 协调兼容的记忆与学习提供方进行有界项目召回，提供共享设置和提供方生命周期管理。

plugins.name: Missher12/dsh-missher-enhance
plugins.descEn: Adds usage statistics, a highlighted footer, piano navigation, projectless sessions, and model and document helpers to DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加使用统计、高亮底栏、钢琴键导航、无项目会话以及模型和文档辅助功能。

plugins.name: Missher12/dsh-missher-evolution
plugins.descEn: Records scoped workflow rules and correction reminders with bounded evidence, local settings, and optional Brain Hub integration.
plugins.descZh: 根据有界证据记录限定范围的工作流规则与纠错提醒，提供本地设置并支持可选 Brain Hub 集成。

plugins.name: Missher12/dsh-missher-memory
plugins.descEn: Project-scoped local memory with review-before-recall, source references, reversible consolidation, and a portable Cordis service; the Harness adapter provides search and settings, with optional Brain integration.
plugins.descZh: 按项目隔离的本地记忆，支持审核后检索、来源追溯、可回滚整理与通用 Cordis 服务；Harness 适配提供搜索和设置页，可选接入 Brain。

plugins.name: Missher12/dsh-project-ops
plugins.descEn: Discover and run project tasks through Harness Jobs, inspect run receipts, and check project configuration with an Agent tool.
plugins.descZh: 通过 Harness Jobs 发现和执行项目任务，检查运行回执，并使用 Agent 工具诊断项目配置。

plugins.name: MistyRain-field/dsh-hu-tao-skin
plugins.descEn: 'A Genshin Impact Hu Tao (Wangsheng Funeral Parlor) skin for the dsh web GUI - a 14-token ink-black, crimson and amber palette, falling plum petals and spirit butterflies, a plum-blossom brand mark, and a floating petal toggle that tracks the sidebar.'
plugins.descZh: '原神胡桃（往生堂）主题皮肤：14 个主题令牌的墨黑、绯红与琥珀金配色，飘落梅花瓣与流光蝴蝶，梅花徽记，以及会跟随侧栏收放的浮动开关。'

plugins.name: MitterMeierGithub/dsh-darksoft-theme
plugins.descEn: 'Dark theme plugin for dsh web (port of Obsidian things-soft-colorful-headings): warm-gray dimmed text via --dsw-alias-label-* token overrides plus soft colorful h1-h6 headings, zero dependencies.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh web 暗色主题插件（移植自 Obsidian things-soft-colorful-headings）：通过 --dsw-alias-label-* token 覆盖实现暖灰调暗文本，配合柔和的彩色 h1-h6 标题，零依赖。'

plugins.name: miuzel/dsh-graph#dsh-graph-host
plugins.descEn: "Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view."
plugins.descZh: "dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。"

plugins.name: miuzel/dsh-subagent-ui
plugins.descEn: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
plugins.descZh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

plugins.name: mjylfz/dsh-skill-mover
plugins.descEn: 'Migrates skills from other agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more) into DSH: scans 14 agent platforms plus the shared ~/.agents skills layer, detects duplicate names across sources, lets you pick the best source per skill, copies them into the DSH skills directory, and rolls back previously migrated skills.'
plugins.descZh: 把其他 Agent（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等）的技能一键搬进 DeepSeek Harness：扫描 14 个平台外加共享的 ~/.agents 技能层，识别不同来源的同名技能，可挑选每个技能的最佳来源，复制到 DSH 技能目录，支持回滚移除已迁移的技能。

plugins.name: mjylfz/dsh-subagent-codex
plugins.descEn: Adds a subagent_codex tool that delegates tasks to the local OpenAI Codex CLI, running the work in an isolated external process.
plugins.descZh: 新增 subagent_codex 工具，把任务委派给本机 OpenAI Codex CLI 在独立外部进程中执行，与主对话完全隔离。

plugins.name: mkiea/dsh-forge
plugins.descEn: 'Plugin-combination analysis for the DeepSeek Harness: dependency trees, conflict detection, risk scoring with prediction, visualization, and combination simulation.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 插件组合分析工具：依赖树、冲突检测、风险评估（含预测）、可视化与组合模拟。

plugins.name: Mlte0907/dsh-brake
plugins.descEn: 'Dead-loop brake for DSH agent sessions: detects repeated identical tool calls, repeating call sequences, and duplicate text, then reminds the agent or refuses the call before it runs.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 会话死循环刹车器：检测重复的相同工具调用、循环的调用序列与重复文本，提醒 agent 或在执行前拒绝调用。'

plugins.name: Mlte0907/dsh-remote-x
plugins.descEn: 'Remote control and mobile overlay for DeepSeek Harness: LAN and public (cloudflared) tunnels with QR-code access, a phone-first mobile UI under 768px, and a LAN reverse-proxy CLI.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的远程控制与移动端覆盖层：局域网与公网（cloudflared）隧道 + 二维码接入、768px 以下的手机端界面，附局域网反向代理 CLI。'

plugins.name: Mlte0907/dsh-teams-x
plugins.descEn: 'Orchestrates durable multi-agent teams from one DSH session: a captain spawns member subagents, drives a dependency-aware task DAG with quality gates, and coordinates through persistent mailboxes, with a live activity panel.'
plugins.descZh: '把单个 DSH 会话编排成持久化多智能体团队：captain 生成成员子代理、驱动带质量门的依赖感知任务 DAG、通过持久邮箱协调，附带实时活动面板。'

plugins.name: mo-n/dsh-provider-qoder
plugins.descEn: Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.
plugins.descZh: 将 Qoder 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持国际版与中国区、多模态与工具调用。

plugins.name: MochiNek0/dsh-web-search-free
plugins.descEn: "Replaces the default web search and fetch channel with eight free search engines including Tavily, Exa and Brave, tried in a configurable fallback order. Keys are entered in a settings card that also toggles the web_fetch tool."
plugins.descZh: "把默认的 Web 搜索与抓取通道替换为 Tavily、Exa、Brave 等八个免费搜索引擎，按可配置的顺序依次 fallback。在设置卡片中填写各引擎 Key，并可开关 web_fetch 工具。"

plugins.name: mocilukalbj/dsh-open-code-review
plugins.descEn: 'Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.'
plugins.descZh: '将阿里 Open Code Review 接入 DSH：通过原生文件筛选、规则工具和审查技能复用当前会话模型，并提供可选的 OCR 独立审查模式。'

plugins.name: Modellix/dsh-modellix
plugins.descEn: 'Modellix integration for DSH: schema-driven image, video and audio generation in a split Design workspace, a live LLM model catalog, and native web search and fetch providers through one API key.'
plugins.descZh: '将 Modellix 接入 DSH：使用一个 API Key 在分栏 Design 工作区中提供基于 Schema 的图片、视频与音频生成、实时 LLM 模型目录，以及原生网页搜索与抓取 Provider。'

plugins.name: mokuyoaxis/dsh-iris
plugins.descEn: 'Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff, HTML-screenshot verification and video summarization, with DashScope and OpenAI-compatible providers, model pools and a workbench client.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。'

plugins.name: Moon-shiyue/dsh-github-connect
plugins.descEn: 'Connects your GitHub account to DSH agents from the composer GitHub button (OAuth device flow or personal access token) and lets them call the GitHub API through the github_api tool.'
plugins.descZh: '在对话框左下角一键连接你的 GitHub 账号（OAuth 设备流或 Personal Access Token），之后 AI 可通过 github_api 工具读取和操作你的 GitHub。'

plugins.name: moon16u/dsh-pouch
plugins.descEn: 'A pouch of practical micro-plugins for DSH: per-turn wall-clock time injection, safe restart, session ID header badge, Tavily search provider, configurable LLM request-header routes, and an MCP server console managing the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client at runtime — add/edit/enable/disable/reconnect, per-tool switches, live status over SSE, mcpServers JSON import, and auto-migration of profile-YAML MCP entries.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 实用小插件锦囊：每轮真实时钟注入、安全自愈重启、顶栏会话 ID 复制、Tavily 真实搜索提供方、可配置的 LLM 请求头路由，以及运行时管理官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 的 MCP 服务器控制台——增删改/启停/重连、工具级开关、SSE 实时状态、mcpServers JSON 导入、profile YAML 条目自动移植。'

plugins.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-agent-approval
plugins.descEn: 'An independent approval subagent judges every sandbox escalation, with a configurable model and an audit log.'
plugins.descZh: '由独立审批子代理裁决每次沙箱提权，可配置审批模型并带审计记录。'

plugins.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-archive-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 会话归档管理：分组归档面板，支持恢复与删除。'

plugins.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/DSH-Desktop#whaleharbor-promo
plugins.descEn: "Turns a plain-browser DSH session into the WhaleHarbor lite client: a standalone browser --app window with a client-style top bar and task notifications, while the full desktop installer downloads in the background (multi-source, SHA-256 verified) and an install prompt appears when ready."
plugins.descZh: "把浏览器里的 DSH 会话变成鲸港简版客户端：独立 --app 窗口、客户端顶栏与任务通知；后台多源下载完整桌面安装包（SHA-256 校验），完成后提示安装。"

plugins.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-git-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Git workspace manager for DeepSeek Harness: a repo-gated composer button opens a settings-style panel for diff/commit, branch, conflict, and worktree management, plus a commit history with branch-graph lines.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作区管理：输入框「模式」选择器旁的仓库感知入口，打开与设置同规格的面板，覆盖 diff/commit、分支、冲突、worktree 管理与带分支线的提交历史。'

plugins.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-memory-manager
plugins.descEn: 'ZCode-style persistent project memory with a full settings manager, index-first injection and agent memory tools.'
plugins.descZh: 'ZCode 风格持久化项目记忆：设置内完整管理页、索引式注入与 agent 记忆工具。'

plugins.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-model-prompt-injector
plugins.descEn: 'Per-model system prompt injector for DeepSeek Harness: append custom prompt text to the END of the system prompt for locally configured models, matched by exact provider/model route or a provider-wide provider/* rule (both stack in order). A Settings page lists every configured provider and its models for per-route editing with instant effect, and rules persist to DSH_HOME so they survive restarts. Applies to main sessions, subagents, and workflow children alike.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 按模型注入系统提示词：为本地已配置的模型把自定义提示词追加到系统提示词末尾，支持 provider/model 精确匹配与 provider/* 服务商级通配（两者按序叠加）。设置页自动列出每个已配置服务商及其模型，逐行编辑、即时生效；规则持久化保存、重启不丢；对主会话、subagent 与 workflow 子代理同样生效。'

plugins.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-token-stats
plugins.descEn: 'Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness: per-model daily and range charts plus a yearly contributions heatmap.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量统计：近 7 天/30 天按模型的柱状图、饼图，外加近一年每日活跃热力图。'

plugins.name: MoonlitDropOfBlood/dsh-whale-pet
plugins.descEn: 'WhaleHarbor desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: an always-on-top transparent float window hosts a chibi whale-maid built from 13 AI-generated parts and animated as a CSS paper-doll (breathing, blinking, ahoge sway, sweat, hops, tremors), mirroring work state in eight moods — idle, busy, approval, question, error, celebration, nap, and subagent clones — with poke, drag, three sizes, tray toggle, and live stats in the speech bubble. Requires the WhaleHarbor desktop shell (Windows build).'
plugins.descZh: '鲸港 WhaleHarbor 大白鲸娘桌面窗宠：13 个 AI 生成零件以 CSS 纸片人方式驱动（呼吸、眨眼、呆毛摇摆、汗滴、蹦跳与抖动），八种状态实时反映 DSH 工作情况——空闲、忙碌、审批、提问、出错、庆祝、打盹、子代理分身——支持戳一戳、拖动、三档尺寸、托盘开关与气泡实时统计。需 WhaleHarbor 桌面壳（当前提供 Windows 构建）。'

plugins.name: Moonshile/moonshile-dsh-plugins#dsh-workspace-sort
plugins.descEn: 'Re-sorts sidebar workspaces by last activity once per day; stable order within the day.'
plugins.descZh: '侧边栏工作区每日按最近活动排序一次，当天顺序稳定。'

plugins.name: MoRanYue/dsh-openrouter-providers
plugins.descEn: Route OpenRouter requests through a configured provider list and quantization cap, injected as provider.only/order with allow_fallbacks, plus provider.quantizations.
plugins.descZh: 配置 OpenRouter 请求使用的提供商列表与量化位数上限，注入 provider.only/order（allow_fallbacks）与 provider.quantizations 路由参数。

plugins.name: MoRanYue/dsh-winrm
plugins.descEn: 'Node.js fork of andyfan1094/dsh-winrm: the same WinRM host panel and seven agent tools, with the backend ported from Python/pywinrm to a native Node WinRM client so the machine running dsh needs no Python.'
plugins.descZh: 'andyfan1094/dsh-winrm 的 Node.js 分支：同样的 WinRM 主机面板与七个 agent 工具，后端从 Python/pywinrm 移植到原生 Node WinRM 客户端，运行 dsh 的机器不再需要 Python。'

plugins.name: more-nico/dsh-nico-theme
plugins.descEn: 'Switchable liquid-glass theme for the DSH web UI — 14 panels become frosted glass over a fluid backdrop, with material sliders and hover elasticity.'
plugins.descZh: 可切换的 DSH 网页端液态玻璃主题——14 个面板在流体背景上变成磨砂玻璃，材质参数有滑杆，悬停时玻璃与面板内容一起倾斜。

plugins.name: MoruTeaven/dsh-key-panel
plugins.descEn: 'A secret store for DSH Desktop that keeps API keys in one place and injects them into the assistant''s shell as $DSH_* variables.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DSH Desktop 提供密钥库，集中保管 API 密钥并以 $DSH_* 变量注入助手的 shell 中。'

plugins.name: Movingtoleveltwo/dsh-revert
plugins.descEn: "A production-ready UI Rewind/Revert plugin for DSH. Features inline prompt editing and a flawless dual-engine state recovery system (Workspace ShadowGit + External Tracker) with full support for forked sessions."
plugins.descZh: "现代化对话回退与重试插件：纯 UI 图形化交互、原地 Prompt 微调、支持工作区与外部文件双引擎安全快照同步，完美解决分支重放断代问题。"

plugins.name: moyu-good/dsh-lark-bridge
plugins.descEn: 'Feishu/Lark IM channel for DeepSeek Harness agents with native thinking-process messages, approval cards, live goal and todo cards, workflow fan-out lines, session text search, and background job and subagent settlement notices. Access is bounded by the Feishu app''s own visibility scope by design — anyone the app admits can drive the agent and answer its approvals unless the optional sender, group and approver allowlists are filled in.'
plugins.descZh: '飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。'

plugins.name: mozhuanzuojing/dsh-liangwengu
plugins.descEn: 'DeepSeek API pricing reminder with a game HUD: Beijing-time countdowns to peak/off-peak windows, a draggable HP capsule with day/moonlight themes, and a nine-realm cultivation system with breakthrough animations.'
plugins.descZh: 按北京时间提醒 DeepSeek API 定价高峰/空闲时段的游戏化插件：可拖动血条胶囊、日夜主题、隐藏彩蛋与修仙突破动画。

plugins.name: MrmoLabs/dsh-mermaid
plugins.descEn: Render Mermaid code fences as SVG diagrams with streaming support, diagram/code switching, fullscreen zoom and pan, SVG export, and a bundled same-origin runtime.
plugins.descZh: 将 Mermaid 代码围栏渲染为 SVG 图表，支持流式输出、图形/代码切换、全屏缩放与拖拽、SVG 导出，以及内置的同源运行时。

plugins.name: MrmoLabs/dsh-yorha-ui
plugins.descEn: A NieR:Automata / YoRHa-inspired industrial terminal theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with sand-and-charcoal palettes, square geometry, and interface-wide styling.
plugins.descZh: 一款面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 NieR:Automata / YoRHa 风格工业终端主题，提供沙色与炭黑配色、直角几何和全界面样式。

plugins.name: mrRisega/dsh-remote#dsh-remote-web
plugins.descEn: 'Remote control for dsh web from a phone browser, from anywhere (no public IP needed): hosted cloud relay works over 4G, or self-host the router; one command installs the desktop bridge and this in-harness Settings panel (cloud/self-hosted tabs, account login, bridge start/stop, feedback); the tunnel data plane is end-to-end encrypted (E2EE phone↔desktop, with a QR / one-time-link desktop grant so you never re-type the password), with HTTP/WebSocket pass-through, access-key auth, a live device list and optional traffic quotas.'
plugins.descZh: '手机浏览器远程控制 dsh web，人在哪都能用（免公网 IP）：官方托管中继 4G 即用，也可自建 relay；一条命令安装电脑端 bridge 与设置页「远程控制」面板（云端/自建切换、账号登录、bridge 启停、反馈）；隧道数据面端到端加密（E2EE：手机↔电脑端正文与 WS 内容加密，中继只见路由元数据；支持扫码/一次性链接桌面授权，免重复输密码）；HTTP/WebSocket 全量透传，访问密钥认证、实时设备列表、可选流量配额。'

plugins.name: mrSutivu/plugin-effort-slider
plugins.descEn: Notched reasoning-effort slider grouped with the model picker in the composer, with theme variables and English, French and Chinese labels.
plugins.descZh: 与模型选择器连为一体的带刻度推理强度滑杆，位于输入框内，支持主题变量与中英法三语。

plugins.name: MrWeiCodes/dsh-fs-encoding
plugins.descEn: 'File encoding guard: byte-exact read/write/edit for GBK, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, Windows-125x, UTF-16 and UTF-32 files, so editing a legacy file leaves it in its original encoding instead of silently rewriting it as UTF-8; UTF-8 BOM preserved exactly as it was, line endings (CRLF/LF/CR) kept, characters the encoding cannot represent refused rather than written as "?", and non-UTF-8 files listed with candidate encodings so the model can re-read them explicitly.'
plugins.descZh: '文件编码守护：为 GBK、Big5、Shift-JIS、EUC-KR、Windows-125x、UTF-16、UTF-32 文件提供字节级无损读写与编辑，改完仍是原编码而不是被悄悄转成 UTF-8；UTF-8 BOM 原样保留，CRLF/LF/CR 换行符保持，编码表示不了的字符拒绝写入而不是写成「?」；非 UTF-8 文件会列出候选编码，模型可显式指定重读。'

plugins.name: Mrxieyong/dsh-mcp-market
plugins.descEn: 'MCP marketplace and management panel in the Web sidebar: one-click official templates (Apifox public/private, Apipost, MasterGo, Pixso), paste raw mcpServers JSON, and enable, edit or delete your services with hot reload.'
plugins.descZh: Web 侧边栏的 MCP 市场与管理面板：官方模板一键配置（Apifox 公有云/私有化、Apipost、MasterGo、Pixso）、粘贴完整 mcpServers JSON、我的服务增删改启停，热加载生效。

plugins.name: mrzhangkris/dsh-session-pruner
plugins.descEn: 'Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.'
plugins.descZh: '全类型会话生命周期管理：一次性子 agent 完成后归档，闲置的可续聊子 agent 与主会话归档（可恢复），容量上限、投影缓存清理，以及热重载设置面板。'

plugins.name: MS666666/dsh-archive-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.'
plugins.descZh: '归档管理：在设置页列出已归档会话，并可真正删除，连同会话日志、归档标记与投影缓存一并清理。'

plugins.name: Mu-scorpio/dsh-reasoning-effort
plugins.descEn: 'Configures provider and model reasoning-effort mappings for DeepSeek Harness, with a grouped model picker and composer slider.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置 Provider 与模型的推理强度映射，并提供按 Provider 分组的模型选择器和输入框滑块。

plugins.name: mu915275-cmd/dsh-boot-animation
plugins.descEn: 'Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself, embedded in code with no separate video files, and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The picker has two independent sections, so the intro animation and the workspace wallpaper are picked separately; the wallpaper can be a still or a looping tail of the last N seconds, with independent transparency for the picture and the sidebar plus three blur levels. The sidebar and the workspace also get a text colour each, for when the picture is at full strength and the theme own text no longer reads.'
plugins.descZh: '打开新对话、或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，铺满窗口播放一段片头动画。插件自带四段片头，直接内嵌在代码里（不带独立的视频文件）；界面里的片库可切换、可预览，也能随时换成你自己的片子。片库分成「入场动画」和「工作区壁纸」两个分区，两者各自独立选段；壁纸可以是静帧，或只循环片尾 N 秒的动态，画面与侧边栏各有独立透明度，另有三档模糊。工作区与侧边栏还各有一个字体颜色，画面全强度时主题自带的字看不清，就靠它。'

plugins.name: MuAllen/dsh-gateway-wallet
plugins.descEn: Live remaining balance for the current API key from Sub2API, New API, or official DeepSeek, plus actual spend when the site publishes it, not a local token estimate.
plugins.descZh: 读取当前 API key 在 Sub2API、New API 或 DeepSeek 官方账本上的剩余额度；站点公布实扣时才显示实扣，不是本地 token 估算。

plugins.name: mumuer1024/dsh-ui-liteglass
plugins.descEn: 'A lightweight appearance skin for DeepSeek Harness: custom wallpaper, glass-like panel transparency, and an accent color; server-side settings shared across devices, native light/dark mode left untouched.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 轻量级外观皮肤：自定义壁纸、玻璃质感面板与重点色；服务端持久化、多设备一致，不接管原生深浅色。'

plugins.name: MurasakiIzumi/dsh-quake-alert
plugins.descEn: 'Real-time disaster alerts for DeepSeek Harness: Japan earthquakes (P2PQuake) and JMA EEW, tsunami and weather telegrams, global earthquakes (EMSC/USGS) and NOAA tsunamis, mainland China earthquakes (CENC via Wolfx) plus nmc.cn rainstorm and geological-hazard warnings, and US/Canadian NWS and ECCC flood, rainfall and storm-surge warnings — matched against your watch regions and thresholds.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的实时灾害预警：日本地震（P2PQuake）与 JMA 紧急地震速报、海啸、气象电文，全球地震（EMSC/USGS）与 NOAA 海啸，中国大陆地震（CENC via Wolfx）及 nmc.cn 暴雨、地质灾害预警，美国 NWS 与加拿大 ECCC 的洪水、降雨、风暴潮预警——按你关注的地域与阈值匹配播报。'

plugins.name: MurasakiIzumi/dsh-ticker-jp
plugins.descEn: 'A floating stock ticker for DeepSeek Harness: real-time quotes for Nikkei 225 and TOPIX ETF out of the box, plus worldwide markets via Yahoo Finance — Japan (.T), US, Hong Kong (.HK), China (.SS/.SZ) and any other symbol — with a customizable watchlist, display aliases and 16 UI languages.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的全球股市行情悬浮窗：默认显示日经225 与 TOPIX ETF，另支持通过 Yahoo Finance 实时报价全球市场——日本 .T、美国、香港 .HK、中国 .SS/.SZ 及任意代码，带自选列表、显示别名与 16 种界面语言。'

plugins.name: mustakimabdullah25-tech/dsh-screen-translator
plugins.descEn: 'Universal on-screen translator for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: translates text, attributes, Shadow DOM, and iframes across 45+ languages.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 界面即时屏幕翻译：支持菜单、设置、Shadow DOM 与嵌套 iframe，覆盖 45+ 种语言。'

plugins.name: Mutx163/dsh-model-memory
plugins.descEn: "Reasoning-effort tier manager for custom API models plus cross-session preference memory: inline low/medium/high/max toggles inside Settings → Models, with atomic settings writes."
plugins.descZh: "为自定义 API 模型提供推理强度分级管理与跨会话偏好记忆：在「设置 → 模型」中内联切换 low/medium/high/max，配置写入为原子操作。"

plugins.name: muyuanjin/dsh-ptc-plus
plugins.descEn: "Session-bound persistent TypeScript REPL for DSH PTC mode: bindings and imports stay live across run_code calls, edit_run_code replaces one line without resending the block, module import/export syntax is adapted via AST rewriting, and durable bindings are restored from the session journal after a cold restart."
plugins.descZh: "把 DSH PTC 模式的顶层 run_code 变成会话绑定的持久 TypeScript REPL：变量与导入在多次 run_code 调用间保持可用，edit_run_code 只替换一行而无需重发整段，import/export 模块语法经 AST 改写适配，持久绑定在冷重启后由会话日志恢复。"

plugins.name: MuzeWinter/dscomputer-control
plugins.descEn: 'Windows desktop automation for dsh: 14 tools that enumerate apps and windows, capture window screenshots that still work when the window is covered by other windows, read the accessibility tree, and perform real input — click, type text (CJK included), press key combinations, scroll and drag. Loads the official computer-use runtime (@oai/sky) already installed on the machine, discovering it by enumerating vendor directories, so vendor upgrades that change hash directories do not break it.'
plugins.descZh: '为 dsh 提供 Windows 桌面自动化：14 个工具，可枚举应用与窗口、抓取被遮挡也能截的窗口截图、读取无障碍树，并执行真实输入——点击、输入文字（含中文）、按组合键、滚动与拖拽。加载机器上已安装的官方电脑控制运行时（@oai/sky），按厂商目录枚举发现，引擎升级换目录也不会失效。'

plugins.name: muzyLink/dsh-subagent-profile
plugins.descEn: Dispatch subagents with named profiles (model, reasoning effort, and tool scope per task), safety checks, cost estimation with savings comparison, and a full dispatch decision ledger.
plugins.descZh: 子 Agent 派发插件：按任务选模型、推理强度与工具范围，存成命名方案随时复用；内置安全检查、成本估算与节省分析、完整派发决策台账。

plugins.name: myd74108520/cadence-skill
plugins.descEn: 'Cadence SKILL (Virtuoso Lisp) assistant for EDA engineers: official-doc-anchored API lookup (3557 entries across 5 IC6.1.8 manuals, signature confidence levels, never invents APIs) plus zero-execution static analysis driven by a lexical depth coordinate system — iterator-safe deletion with position-sensitive copy() protection, printf placeholder/argument reconciliation, in-loop nth O(N^2) detection, deprecated APIs with page refs, dangerous-intent interception and CIW error-log triage. Host half has zero third-party dependencies.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 Cadence Virtuoso 版图工程师的 SKILL 脚本助手：官方文档锚定的 API 检索（5 本 IC6.1.8 手册 3557 条，签名带置信度，查不到绝不臆造）＋不执行代码的深度静态检查——词法深度坐标系可精确判定跨行循环体与同行闭合，覆盖迭代中删除（copy 位置敏感）、printf 占位符与实参对账、循环内 nth O(N^2)、废弃 API（带页码引用），另有危险需求拦截与 CIW 错误日志定位修复。宿主半区零第三方依赖。'

plugins.name: MyPanda-Hash/CHENGXIAO
plugins.descEn: 'Pairs two DeepSeek Harness machines with a one-time code - directly on a LAN, or across networks through an end-to-end-encrypted relay with a zero-config official default - so one agent can run tasks and exchange files on the other while each machine keeps its own files in place.'
plugins.descZh: '用一次性配对码把两台 DeepSeek Harness 机器连起来——局域网直连，或跨网络经端到端加密中继（默认自带官方中继，零配置）——让一边的 agent 在另一边执行任务、交换文件，各自文件都留在本机。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-auto-trust-all
plugins.descEn: 'Dynamically trusts every Host header that actually arrives and flips the default web binding to 0.0.0.0: wildcard or unenumerable entry domains work without editing the start command, the authentication layer is untouched, and hosts are evicted by LRU beyond a capacity cap.'
plugins.descZh: '动态信任所有实际到达的 Host 并把 web 默认绑定翻转为 0.0.0.0：泛域名等无法枚举的入口免改启动命令，认证层不动，超出容量的 Host 按 LRU 淘汰。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-context-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Conversation enhancements: a history-input overlay (Alt+Up with workspace/session/global/prompt scopes), recall of unapplied interjected messages, conversation forking with fork-family version switching, and optional auto-resend after forking (off by default).'
plugins.descZh: '对话增强：历史输入浮层（Alt+↑，workspace/session/global/prompts 四范围搜索回填）、未应用插话撤回、对话分叉与家族版本切换、分叉后自动重发（默认关）。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-cron-board
plugins.descEn: 'Cron job board: schedules local scripts or dsh session tasks (fresh or pinned sessions) by cron expression, with centralized environment-variable management, run logs, and concurrency and timeout control.'
plugins.descZh: '定时任务看板：cron 调度本地脚本或 dsh 会话任务（每次新建/固定会话），环境变量集中管理，执行日志与并发/超时控制。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-llm-pi-gateway
plugins.descEn: 'Session-affinity routing for LLM gateways: injects the session ID into every request sent to NewApi-style gateways so the gateway can pin requests per session and raise prompt-cache hits; takes over the official pi-ai routing on install and restores it on uninstall.'
plugins.descZh: 'LLM 网关会话粘性路由：把会话 sessionId 注入发往 NewApi 类网关的每个请求，供网关做请求亲和以提升 prompt cache 命中，装上即接管官方 pi-ai 路由，卸载即还原。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-maintain
plugins.descEn: 'Version and maintenance suite for DSH itself: detects new host releases from npm dist-tags, upgrades with one click, restarts safely, and the web page auto-recovers once the host is back.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 版本与运维一体化：自动发现新版本、一键升级、安全重启，重启后页面自动恢复。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-model-capability-editor
plugins.descEn: 'Model capability editor: edit each model reasoning-effort levels and image-input (multimodal) declarations inline in the official model page, written back to settings.yaml as a whole group, with a floating entry as fallback when the anchor breaks.'
plugins.descZh: '模型能力编辑器：在官方模型页行内可视化编辑各模型的思考档位与图片输入（多模态）声明，整组写回 settings.yaml，锚点失效时浮动入口兜底。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-session-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Session management: auto-archives stale sessions on a configurable threshold, with an archive panel, unarchive, and recycle-bin deletion with restore.'
plugins.descZh: '会话管理：超期会话自动归档（阈值可配），归档面板支持取消归档，删除移入系统回收站可还原。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-settings-nav-icons
plugins.descEn: 'Section icons for the settings navigation: replaces the uniform gear icons with per-section glyphs and fills the plugin-market card avatar slot with each plugin icon; a page reload after uninstall restores the official icons.'
plugins.descZh: '设置导航分区图标：把千篇一律的齿轮换成各分区专属图形，并为插件市场卡片头像槽提供插件图标，卸载后重载页面即恢复官方图标。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-think-expand
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-expands streaming thinking: always keeps the latest thinking block expanded, manual actions take priority, only the last block expands when opening a session, and nothing remains after uninstall.'
plugins.descZh: '流式思考自动展开：始终显示最新一条思考，手动操作优先，打开会话仅展开最后一条，卸载无残留。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-turn-notify
plugins.descEn: 'Turn event notifications: six event classes (completed, error, interrupted, approval requested, AI question, limit reached) delivered via sound, system notification, in-page banner, webhook, IM and host desktop-notification channels; when several browser windows are open, only one rings.'
plugins.descZh: '回合事件通知：完成/出错/被中断/等待审批/AI 提问/达到上限六类事件，经声音、系统弹窗、页内提示、webhook、IM、宿主桌面通知通道推送，多窗口只响一次。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-usage-dash
plugins.descEn: 'Session usage statistics panel: token and request stats at day/hour/minute granularity, an activity heatmap, bottom-bar session info takeover with per-turn cost chips, and cost estimation under multi-condition time-segmented pricing. Re-implemented from HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel with extensions.'
plugins.descZh: '会话用量统计面板：天/小时/分钟三粒度 token 与请求统计、活跃热力图、会话底栏信息接管与回合费用芯片、多条件分时段定价费用估算；复刻自 HaoyueQin/dsh-usage-statistics-panel 并扩展。'

plugins.name: mzzsfy/dsh-plugin#dsh-usage-panel
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-platform LLM balance and quota panel: configure DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Kimi, Zhipu GLM, MiniMax, NewApi or custom endpoints, poll on a schedule, draw balance and quota trend charts, and push threshold and window-reset notices through multiple channels.'
plugins.descZh: '多平台 LLM 账号余额与额度面板：配置 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Kimi、智谱、MiniMax、NewApi 或自定义端点，定时自动查询并绘制趋势图，余额/额度阈值与窗口重置经多通道推送通知。'

plugins.name: N9-Developer-Empowerment/DSH-Vibeify#dsh-vibeify-experience
plugins.descEn: "Turns completed DeepSeek Harness public-content work into a browser-local visual magazine with explicit updates and reviewed one-article sharing."
plugins.descZh: "将 DeepSeek Harness 中已完成的公开内容工作整理为浏览器本地的视觉杂志，支持显式更新和经审核的单篇文章分享。"

plugins.name: NamesMT/dsh-home-hosted
plugins.descEn: "Starts your dsh web and other servers at boot, sets up and manages services like Gitea and Jellyfin just by asking, and puts them all under one home-hosted panel."
plugins.descZh: "让 dsh web 与其他服务器随开机自动启动；只需一句提示就能搭建和管理 Gitea、Jellyfin 等服务，并统一收纳到一个 home-hosted 面板中。"

plugins.name: nanami-0713/dsh-jev-decide
plugins.descEn: 'TypeSafe Jev (System One decision model) as the jev_decide tool for DeepSeek Harness: noul, choice and score questions return calibrated probabilities; credentials reuse the DSH credential seam; 429/529 backoff retry built in.'
plugins.descZh: '把 TypeSafe Jev（System One 决策模型）接入 DSH 的 jev_decide 工具：noul/choice/score 三种问题形状返回校准概率，凭证复用 DSH 凭证缝，内建 429/529 退避重试。'

plugins.name: NanmiCoder/dsh-auto-mode
plugins.descEn: 'Adds an Auto permission preset between Workspace Write and Full access: routine work stays in the official workspace-write sandbox while the current session model reviews escalation and destructive calls, granting one exact wider access once, asking when the intent is ambiguous, and denying critical paths.'
plugins.descZh: '在 Workspace Write 与 Full access 之间增加 Auto 权限档：日常操作留在官方 workspace-write 沙箱内，由当前会话模型复核升权与破坏性调用，精确的越界访问按次放行一次，意图不明时询问，命中关键路径则拒绝。'

plugins.name: naodeng/dsh-qa
plugins.descEn: 'QA project workbench for dsh: manage test projects, requirements, test cases, defects, milestones, reports and approval gates through a browser UI and 18 QA-domain tools.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh 质量项目工作台：通过浏览器界面和 18 个 QA 领域工具管理测试项目、需求、用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与审批门禁。'

plugins.name: NativeDog1/dsh-boot-animation
plugins.descEn: 'Plays an intro full-frame on a new conversation, or every time you open the one you pinned. Four clips ship inside the plugin itself — embedded in code, with no separate video files — and an in-app library switches between them, previews the choice, and accepts your own clip. The pin button sits beside Settings.'
plugins.descZh: '打开新对话、或每次打开你钉住的那个会话时，铺满窗口播放一段片头动画。插件自带四段片头，直接内嵌在代码里（不带独立的视频文件）；界面里的片库可切换、可预览，也能随时换成你自己的片子；设置旁一键钉住会话。'

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-memory
plugins.descEn: Persistent five-layer memory system with relevance injection, LLM auto-extraction, profile rotation, and six agent tools.
plugins.descZh: 五层持久记忆系统：相关性注入、LLM 自动提取、画像轮替与六个 agent 工具。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-notifications
plugins.descEn: Adds a Settings card that pops a system notification and optional chime when a conversation turn completes.
plugins.descZh: 在设置中新增卡片，对话轮次完成时弹出系统通知与可选提示音。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-petdex-market
plugins.descEn: Browses the petdex.dev catalog in Settings and runs a floating macOS desktop pet that reacts to agent activity.
plugins.descZh: 在设置中浏览 petdex.dev 宠物市集，并运行一只响应 agent 活动的 macOS 悬浮桌面宠物。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-pin-session
plugins.descEn: Adds Pin/Unpin to the sidebar session-row menu and a collapsible Pinned Sessions group above the session list, with host-side persistence, hover quick-unpin, collapse memory, and live running-state dots.
plugins.descZh: 在会话行菜单加入 Pin/Unpin，并在侧边栏列表上方提供可折叠的 Pinned Sessions 分组：主机端持久化、悬停快速取消置顶、折叠状态记忆与实时运行状态点。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-sidebar-views
plugins.descEn: Adds a Workspaces / Recent-sessions switcher above the sidebar list, with a pinned-sessions group, a per-row menu (pin/unpin, copy session id), title filtering, and browser-local pin storage with a one-shot migration from dsh-plugin-pin-session.
plugins.descZh: 在侧栏列表上方加「工作区 / 最新会话」切换条，含固定会话分组、行级菜单（固定/取消固定、复制 Session ID）、标题过滤；pin 存于浏览器 localStorage，并对 dsh-plugin-pin-session 做一次性迁移与过渡双写。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-plugin-wechat-bridge
plugins.descEn: Bridges WeChat (ilink bot) private chats into DSH agent sessions and streams replies back, with hot-plug and a Settings tab.
plugins.descZh: 把微信私聊桥接进 DSH agent 会话并流式回传回复，支持热插拔与设置页签。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-safe-delete
plugins.descEn: Tools guard that moves agent-issued `rm` targets to the macOS Trash instead of deleting, with a shell-aware lexer covering compound and disguised commands; a switch in Settings → General turns it off.
plugins.descZh: 工具守卫将 agent 执行的 rm 目标移入 macOS 废纸篓而非直接删除，shell 感知词法器覆盖复合与伪装命令；设置页通用设置中可随时关闭。

plugins.name: NattoCB/dsh-web-search-session-follow
plugins.descEn: "Drop-in web_search provider that follows the session's routed model: a runtime-editable priority chain with three wire dialects (Anthropic web search, OpenRouter online, Zhipu bigmodel), per-route endpoints and credentials, a Settings UI panel, local JSONL call audit, and built-in official fallback."
plugins.descZh: "替换内置 web_search 的 provider：按会话当前路由的模型选择端点与凭据，运行时可编辑的优先级链支持 Anthropic web search、OpenRouter online、智谱 bigmodel 三种方言，设置 UI 面板可视化编辑，本地 JSONL 调用审计，链全失败回退内置官方方案。"

plugins.name: ne-ilyxa/dsh-session-drafts
plugins.descEn: 'Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace''s single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.'
plugins.descZh: 'Cursor 风格的新会话：每次点击都新建一个空白草稿会话（首条消息前即持久化），不再复用工作区唯一的空会话；侧栏新增草稿切换器，可同时保留多个空会话。'

plugins.name: NecromanAlbert/dsh-show-media
plugins.descEn: Shows a local image or short video in the current conversation card, with click-to-preview.
plugins.descZh: 在当前对话卡片里展示本地图片或短视频，点击可预览。

plugins.name: NecromanAlbert/dsh-skill-slash-fuzzy
plugins.descEn: Resolves unique kebab-case skill substrings in slash tokens, so /oneshot can load game-package-oneshot.
plugins.descZh: 用唯一 kebab 片段解析斜杠 skill，例如 /oneshot 可加载 game-package-oneshot。

plugins.name: NEINC1/muche-dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: Chat panel for the MuChe companion with per-user backend settings, plus an outbound bridge that runs tasks on the user's local dsh.
plugins.descZh: 连接小沐的 dsh 插件：和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务。

plugins.name: nengong-ai/dsh-keychain-credentials
plugins.descEn: 'Pure JavaScript macOS Keychain credentials provider for DeepSeek Harness, replacing plaintext .credentials.yaml storage and fully supporting both refs and records without native builds, signing, or Xcode.'
plugins.descZh: '纯 JavaScript 实现的 macOS Keychain 凭据提供器，替换 DeepSeek Harness 的明文 .credentials.yaml 存储，完整支持 refs 和 records，无需原生构建、代码签名或 Xcode。'

plugins.name: Neo65536-engineer/dsh-agent-log
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only work report rebuilt from local session logs: tools used and how often, commands run, files read and written, whether tests passed, failures and their causes, token usage, and whether the task finished.'
plugins.descZh: 从本机会话日志只读还原的工作报告：用了哪些工具、各调用多少次、执行了哪些命令、读写哪些文件、测试有没有通过、失败了几次及原因、消耗多少 Token，以及最后完成了没有。

plugins.name: Neptune810/dsh-model-router
plugins.descEn: Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.
plugins.descZh: 维护一个模型池，把每个 agent 步骤路由到池内模型并设置其思考等级——全部在输入栏点选配置，不需要写 JSON。路由面板接管输入栏的模型位置，同一个控件里既有本会话的模型与思考等级，也有路由自身的设置。三种授权范围（模型 / 思考 / 全部）：手动选择只在所属范围内生效；「思考」范围下路由只作用于你选定的那一个模型。另有按任务类型给模型加权的预设、带图任务的视觉分流、会话信号（当前 todo / 上下文压力 / token 预算 / 子 agent 深度），以及可选的语义任务分类。思考等级保持常开，因为 DeepSeek 会拒绝思考关闭时产生的工具调用。

plugins.name: Neptune810/dsh-power-button
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a draggable power pill to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: a live status dot plus restart and stop actions, where restart is handed to a detached helper that resumes the same boot invocation once the port is released.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面加一个可拖动的电源胶囊：实时状态点，加上重启与结束两个动作；重启交给脱离终端的辅助进程，等端口释放后按原启动命令重新拉起。'

plugins.name: netori/galfree
plugins.descEn: 'Ren''Py galgame production workbench: a host-side project service (write gateway plus git snapshots, a dialogue/scene dialect parser, derived progress, human-only review stamps, pinned-SDK validation and playtest, local publish) behind one seam, driven by an embedded web panel and agent tools.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH 里制作 Ren''Py galgame 的工作台：宿主侧项目服务（写网关 + git 快照、方言子集解析器、推导进度、只由人盖的审读戳、钉版 SDK 校验与试玩、本地发布）收在一条接缝后面，由内置 Web 工作台面板与 agent 工具驱动。'

plugins.name: neufagents/dsh-healthcheck
plugins.descEn: 'Session health check for DSH, read-only: scans the whole session library (totals, largest sessions, warnings for oversized sessions and event-count blowups) and deep-inspects a single session log (tail-balance / crash-tail check, tool-call/result pairing, event-type distribution).'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DSH 的会话健康体检（只读）：全库扫描（总量、最大会话、体积 / 事件数超限告警）与单会话深检（尾部闭合检查、工具调用 / 结果配对、事件类型分布）。'

plugins.name: NEVSTOP-LAB/dsh-approval-mode
plugins.descEn: 'Adds an approval-mode toggle next to the permission selector: default approval keeps per-call confirmation, bypass approval auto-approves every tool call while staying in Workspace Write.'
plugins.descZh: '在权限下拉框旁增加「审批模式」开关：默认审批保留逐次确认，绕过审批自动放行所有工具调用，同时保持 Workspace Write 权限。'

plugins.name: nguyenduclong-ict/dsh-session-progress
plugins.descEn: 'Session progress tracking for DeepSeek Harness, without digging through the logs: the agent keeps a live nested checklist of the work — from a whole phase down to a single step — and every item carries a weight, so the ring and the % pill in the composer dock row always match reality. Hover it for the current activity, or open the Session Progress tab in the native right sidebar for the goal, the weighted checklist with per-item shares, the next steps and the working notes; when the session ends, the same checklist stands as a clean record of what got done.'
plugins.descZh: '不用再翻日志，也能随时知道 DeepSeek Harness 的会话做到哪一步了：agent 维护一份实时嵌套清单——从整个阶段到单个步骤——每一项都带权重，所以输入框下方 dock 行的进度环与百分比胶囊始终反映真实进度。悬停可看当前活动，或打开原生右侧边栏的 Session Progress 标签页，查看目标、带单项占比的加权清单、后续步骤与工作备注；会话结束时，它就是一份清晰的工作记录。'

plugins.name: nicecx/dsh-auto-approver
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-approval agent for DSH permission requests: rule layer (denyAlways/allowlist) plus Hermes Pro semantic adjudication with quick-fail retries, fail-closed to human when Hermes is unavailable, rejection feedback returned to the requesting session, and approve tasks enqueued into the task queue with a shared busy mutex.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 权限请求自动审批代理：规则层（黑名单/白名单）+ Hermes Pro 语义裁决（快速失败重试），Hermes 不可用时 fail-closed 转人工；拒绝原因回传发起会话；审批任务入队并与消费端共用忙锁串行化。'

plugins.name: nicecx/dsh-design-review
plugins.descEn: 'Mandatory cross-review for design proposals and lessons-learned: auto-detects design doc writes and enqueues them (tier=review) into the task queue, delivers the external reviewer verdict back to the initiating session, and appends approved preventive measures to OPS-GUARDRAILS.md (append-only, conflict-checked).'
plugins.descZh: '设计方案与事故教训强制交叉评审：自动识别设计文档写入并入队（tier=review），外部评审结论投递回发起会话，approved 的防复发措施以 append-only + 冲突检测方式追加到守则文件。'

plugins.name: nicecx/dsh-relay
plugins.descEn: 'Relay agent approval requests and questions to iMessage / Email / WeChat channels and resolve them by replying with the request number (#N 批准 / 拒绝 / 回答).'
plugins.descZh: 把 agent 的审批与提问诉求推送到 iMessage / 邮件 / 微信通道，回复 `#编号 批准/拒绝/回答` 即可处理，无需打开网页。

plugins.name: nicecx/dsh-reset-handoff
plugins.descEn: 'Hands DSH reset requests to an external ops agent via a versioned JSON protocol: preflight snapshot, pre-restart maturity gate (no pending approvals, free disk, cooldown), restart, health check, and interrupted-work recovery, with the result delivered back to the requesting session.'
plugins.descZh: '把 DSH 重置请求经带版本的 JSON 协议交给外部运维 agent：预检快照、重启前成熟度门禁（无待审批、磁盘充足、冷却期）、重启、健康检查与业务恢复，结果投递回发起会话。'

plugins.name: nicecx/dsh-task-queue
plugins.descEn: 'Tiered task queue as the single source of truth for DSH↔Hermes work (reset > approve > review): enqueue tools for all submission paths, lease/claim model with concurrency 1, priority aging against starvation, atomic busy mutex, and a Hermes-side consumer (cron */1 + monitor gating) that drains tasks, writes review-handoff requests with single-slot checks, and invokes the reset agent.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH↔Hermes 协作的缓存梯队任务队列（reset > approve > review，queue.json 唯一真相源）：全部提审路径入队、租约/认领模型并发 1、优先级 aging 防饿死、原子忙锁；Hermes 侧消费端（cron */1 + monitor 门控）出队执行、单槽检查写审核请求、调用重置 agent。'

plugins.name: nicecx/insta360-ai-content-studio
plugins.descEn: 'Automated daily content pipeline for Insta360 GO 3S: BLE/WiFi remote capture of aquarium footage, wireless import, ffmpeg quality evaluation with decision log, Auto editing (segment selection, TTS narration, music, subtitles), and Bilibili upload via biliup (dry-run by default).'
plugins.descZh: 'Insta360 GO 3S 自动每日内容管线：BLE/WiFi 遥控拍摄鱼缸素材、无线取回、ffmpeg 质量评估与决策记录、自动剪辑（选段/旁白/配乐/字幕）、biliup 投稿（默认 dry-run）。'

plugins.name: Nicercz007-cloud/schedule
plugins.descEn: Three draggable, resizable, auto-positioning floating desktop widgets for DSH Desktop — daily schedule, goals tracker, and calendar planner.
plugins.descZh: DSH Desktop 的三个可拖动、可缩放、自动记忆位置的悬浮桌面小组件：每日时间安排、目标设置与日期规划。

plugins.name: nickhelion/dsh-plugins#qwen-token-plan-cn-responses
plugins.descEn: Qwen Token Plan CN Responses provider for DeepSeek Harness via the OpenAI Responses API, with Qwen server-side tools, DSH local function tools, text/reasoning/tool-call multi-turn history, persisted image attachments, and a per-release official model catalog snapshot.
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的千问 Token Plan 个人版 Responses API 提供方，保留 Qwen 服务端内置工具与 DSH 本地函数工具，多轮文本/推理/工具调用历史与图片附件均被支持，官方模型目录按 npm 版本冻结快照发布。

plugins.name: nickhelion/dsh-plugins#serverchan-notify
plugins.descEn: ServerChan3 (Server酱) push notifications when a turn finishes — title, model, project directory, git branch, status and a reply excerpt, with subagent filtering and fire-and-forget delivery.
plugins.descZh: 回合结束时向 Server酱3 推送微信通知——标题、模型、项目目录、Git 分支、状态与回复摘要，支持子代理过滤，fire-and-forget 不阻塞主流程。

plugins.name: nickkkkkk123123/dsh-resume-on-restart
plugins.descEn: "Auto-wakes the main agent after a DSH service restart: compares last-run timestamps, posts a recovery notice with humanized downtime, and delivers it so interrupted work picks itself back up. Runs on plain cordis ctx, packaged-DSH-Desktop ready."
plugins.descZh: "检测 DSH 服务重启后自动唤醒主 agent：对比上次运行时间、人性化播报中断时长，并把提示消息投递回来让中断的工作自动恢复。仅依赖 cordis ctx 服务，兼容 DSH Desktop 打包环境。"

plugins.name: nickkkkkk123123/dsh-whale-girl
plugins.descEn: "Interactive whale-girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: live balance/usage/context occupancy, slingshot toss, easter-egg bubbles, eco mode. 346KB package, zero extra processes."
plugins.descZh: "会卖萌、会记账、会弹跳的鲸鱼娘桌宠：实时余额/用量/上下文占用、中键弹弓抛掷、彩蛋气泡、省电模式；安装包 346KB，零新进程。"

plugins.name: NickyWooden/dsh-halo
plugins.descEn: 'One-click publish of DSH conversations as Markdown articles on a Halo CMS blog: confirm in the GUI, type the console password (never stored), and the Q&A record is created through the Halo REST API.'
plugins.descZh: '一键将 DSH 对话发布为 Halo CMS 博客的 Markdown 文章：界面确认、输入控制台密码（永不存储），问答记录通过 Halo REST API 创建。'

plugins.name: nightosong/gord-dsh-worktree
plugins.descEn: 'Git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness — isolate parallel work in its own directory and branch. Ships Fast mode (快速模式).'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Git worktree 管理：把并行开发放进各自独立的目录与分支。随包发布快速模式（Fast mode）。'

plugins.name: nikoart-liu/dsh-open-in-x
plugins.descEn: Open DSH workspace directories in installed file managers, terminals, and supported editors from the Web UI.
plugins.descZh: 从 DSH Web UI 使用已安装的文件管理器、终端和受支持的编辑器打开工作区目录。

plugins.name: nineknineTK/dsh-plugin-geo3d-modeling
plugins.descEn: 'Geological 3D modeling and 3D seismic processing workflow skill: SEG-Y volume parsing, CGCS2000 coordinate unification, fault representative line and exploration boundary shapefile output, and multi-mine 3D geology platform building.'
plugins.descZh: '地质三维建模与三维地震资料处理全流程技能：SEG-Y 数据体解析、CGCS2000 坐标统一（带带号）、断层代表线与勘探范围 shp 输出、多矿区三维地质平台建设。'

plugins.name: ninglovegithub/dsh-workspace-combiner
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-workspace manager: bind a docs anchor plus ordered code-project repositories into one session, injecting their absolute paths, a recursive file index, a server/client endpoint index and optional coding standards, and syncing writable directories into the sandbox.'
plugins.descZh: '多工作区管理器：把文档锚点目录与若干代码项目仓库组合进同一会话，注入绝对路径、递归文件索引、前后端端点落点索引与可选的开发规范，并把可写目录同步进沙盒。'

plugins.name: ningmengxr/dsh-task-control
plugins.descEn: 'Task control for DeepSeek Harness: one-click emergency stop and force-termination of stuck downloads and tool calls, download progress, stuck detection, pwsh activity monitoring, and append-condition / pause / resume with invisible recovery.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 任务控制：卡死的下载与工具调用一键急停与强制终止、下载进度、卡死识别、pwsh 运行状态检测，以及追加条件/暂停/恢复（恢复指令隐形注入，不打扰聊天）。'

plugins.name: ninipa/oh-my-dsh-slim
plugins.descEn: "Match your models and token budgets to each role, then let DSH delegate specialized subagents by task type. Covers architecture analysis, UI/UX, code implementation, codebase exploration, and documentation research, with automatic setup plus per-role reasoning effort and tool permissions."
plugins.descZh: "合理搭配你的模型及 Token 额度，让 DSH 按任务类型自动委派专业子代理，覆盖架构分析、UI/UX、代码实现、代码库探索与文档调研。安装后自动配置，并支持按角色设置思考强度和工具权限。"

plugins.name: nirvanaslash/dsh-artifact-preview
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a produced-files card row to the chat and a resizable split-screen preview panel for workspace artifacts (Markdown, source code, CSV, JSON, images, HTML), plus a localhost port preview.'
plugins.descZh: '在对话中新增产出文件卡片行，并提供可拖拽分屏的产物预览面板，支持 Markdown、源码、CSV、JSON、图片、HTML，以及本地端口预览。'

plugins.name: nirvanaslash/dsh-bat2exe
plugins.descEn: 'Compiles a Windows .bat/.cmd launcher into a real .exe from inside DSH: renders an icon from a built-in bitmap font, emits a C# wrapper that runs the batch file next to it, compiles with csc.exe (or dotnet build), and can write Start Menu / Desktop shortcuts.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH 内把 Windows .bat/.cmd 启动器编译成真正的 .exe：用内置位图字体生成图标，生成调用同目录批处理的 C# 薄壳，经 csc.exe（或 dotnet build）编译，并可选写入开始菜单/桌面快捷方式。'

plugins.name: nishit130/dsh-notification
plugins.descEn: Desktop and webhook alerts on macOS, Linux and Windows when an agent finishes a turn, errors, or waits for approval — zero-dependency native notifications (osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast) plus a Slack-compatible webhook, with a configurable minimum turn duration.
plugins.descZh: '桌面与 webhook 通知：任务完成、出错或等待审批时提醒；零依赖，走系统自带的 osascript / notify-send / PowerShell toast，并支持 Slack 兼容的 webhook，可配置最短回合时长。'

plugins.name: NIU-001-LIU/dsh-win-minimal
plugins.descEn: 'Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: fixed one-line persona, three tools, no runtime context.'
plugins.descZh: Windows 极简模式 preset：单句 persona、三工具、无运行时上下文。

plugins.name: Nixz0824/dsh-composer-alcove
plugins.descEn: Collapses the composer to an iPhone-style home indicator while you scroll, then restores it on hover, click, or scroll up. Corner arcs dock the real composer into the left or right gutter.
plugins.descZh: 阅读时把输入栏收到底部 Home 指示条，悬停预览、点击钉住或上滑还原。左右圆角弧线把原来的输入框停到两侧留白。

plugins.name: nobu121/dsh-opencode-session
plugins.descEn: 'Attaches a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header to OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider requests, fixing 400 MissingSessionID errors and keeping session affinity and prompt-cache routing intact.'
plugins.descZh: '为 OpenCode / OpenCode Go 提供商请求自动附加每个会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 请求头，修复 400 MissingSessionID 错误，同时保持会话亲和与提示缓存路由。'

plugins.name: Noemm/dsh-web-search-glm
plugins.descEn: "Zhipu GLM web search provider: registers as `glm` on the ctx.web seam and runs the native web_search server tool through GLM's Anthropic-compatible API (Coding Plan billing)."
plugins.descZh: "智谱 GLM 联网搜索 provider：以 glm 注册到 ctx.web 缝，经 GLM 的 Anthropic 兼容 API 执行原生 web_search 服务端工具（走 Coding Plan 计费）。"

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-codex-sidebar
plugins.descEn: 'Codex-style details sidebar for DSH with Files, Review, Browser, and Terminal panes, transcript file links and diff stats, annotations, and Host-managed browser controls.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 的 Codex 风格详情侧栏：提供 Files、Review、Browser 与 Terminal 面板、对话文件链接和 diff 统计、批注，以及 Host 管理的浏览器控制。'

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-external-agents
plugins.descEn: External Agent control plane for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor Agent, and Antigravity adapters with settings and background job visibility.
plugins.descZh: 外部 Agent 控制面，接入 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor Agent 与 Antigravity，并提供设置和后台任务可见性。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-assistant
plugins.descEn: 'Resident Web overlay seat with its own assistant session: chat, images, reminders, a duty heartbeat, and on-demand read-only task reference.'
plugins.descZh: 常驻 Web 席位，背后是独立助理会话：对话、图片、提醒、值班心跳，以及按需只读引用当前任务。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-commandcode
plugins.descEn: 'Command Code Provider API chat for DSH with a Host-held API key, discovered model catalog, effort defaults, an optional zero-data-retention header, quota meters, and per-model OpenAI or Anthropic protocol selection.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 的 Command Code Provider API 聊天：Host 持有 API key，支持模型发现、effort 默认值、可选零数据保留请求头、额度仪表，以及按模型选择 OpenAI 或 Anthropic 协议。'

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-opencode-go
plugins.descEn: 'OpenCode Go subscription chat for DSH with per-model Completions, Responses, or Anthropic protocol selection, model discovery, context, vision and thinking metadata, effort defaults, and usage meters.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 的 OpenCode Go 订阅聊天：按模型选择 Completions、Responses 或 Anthropic 协议，支持模型发现、上下文、视觉与思考元数据、effort 默认值和用量仪表。'

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-llm-providers-ui
plugins.descEn: 'Mounted owner of the LLM Providers Settings page: provider cards, drag-reorder card order, and picker sort.'
plugins.descZh: LLM Providers 设置页的挂载 owner：provider 卡片、拖拽排序与 picker 排序。

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-mobile-pairing
plugins.descEn: 'Mobile remote pairing for DSH with QR offers, a loopback Host Gateway, encrypted Relay or Quick Tunnel transport, same-LAN WebRTC Direct, and revocable Device Tokens for the Android client.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 手机远程配对：提供二维码 offer、回环 Host Gateway、加密 Relay 或 Quick Tunnel、同网 WebRTC Direct，以及可撤销的 Android Device Token。'

plugins.name: NOirBRight/dsh-model-switch
plugins.descEn: 'Explicit model routing for Main, Subagents, web_search, and image generation, plus a catalog-driven Composer and Plan Review picker with Model, Effort, Context, Fast, and Thinking variants.'
plugins.descZh: '显式路由 Main、Subagent、web_search 与图像生成，并提供由模型目录驱动的 Composer/Plan Review Picker，支持 Model、Effort、Context、Fast 与 Thinking 变体。'

plugins.name: NoneadChina/dsh-nonead-universal-robots
plugins.descEn: "A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that lets you control Universal Robots (UR) collaborative arms directly from natural language, developed by Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd. based on the same logic as the company's own nUR MCP Server. (Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.)"
plugins.descZh: "让 DSH 用自然语言直接控制 Universal Robots（UR）机械臂的插件，由拓德科技（Nonead）基于自研的 nUR MCP Server 同源逻辑开发。（Suzhou Nonead Robot Technology Co., Ltd.）"

plugins.name: Nono-neko/dsh-browser
plugins.descEn: 'An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 与 Desktop 端的内置浏览器：为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供的 AI 原生浏览器工作区，融合了多标签浏览、实时页面批注、轻量级代码编辑、工作区预览，以及跨网页和桌面的智能助手辅助迭代功能。

plugins.name: nononononofish/dsh-region
plugins.descEn: Switches DSH's package download source between the npmmirror China mirror and the official npm registry on timeout or failure, with a Web UI to inspect and switch manually.
plugins.descZh: 在下载超时或失败时，于 npmmirror 国内镜像与官方 npm 源之间自动切换下载源，并附带 Web UI 可手动查看与切换。

plugins.name: NoodleStormno/dsh-plugin-tic80
plugins.descEn: 'TIC-80 fantasy console for DeepSeek Harness: 3-column embedded web player, 14 agent tools, live hot reload, and native CLI export.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的 TIC-80 虚拟游戏机插件：三栏嵌入式 Web 播放器、14 个 Agent 工具、实时热重载与原生 CLI 导出。'

plugins.name: Norman-else/dsh-claude
plugins.descEn: Runs Claude Code as a DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.
plugins.descZh: 将 Claude Code 作为 DSH 会话运行，同时保留其原生智能体循环、工具、技能、钩子和 MCP 集成。

plugins.name: noteflowai/dsh-skills-anywhere
plugins.descEn: "Live skill provider that adds skills from 60+ other agents' directories (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot), Claude Code plugin marketplaces, and any git repository of skills to the dsh catalog without copying or symlinking; deduplicates, repairs frontmatter, renames name collisions, and ships a CLI (list, add, sync, doctor)."
plugins.descZh: "实时技能提供器：把 60+ 个其他 Agent（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot）的技能目录、Claude Code 插件市场以及任意 git 技能仓库中的技能接入 dsh 目录，零拷贝零软链接；自动去重、修复 frontmatter、处理同名冲突，并附带 CLI（list、add、sync、doctor）。"

plugins.name: NoxTyrannus/dsh-cipher
plugins.descEn: 'Cipher memory platform as a DSH bundle: four memory types (attention, experience, preference, cognitive) sedimented per turn by four memory agents, cross-session deterministic recall injected via systemPrompt.context, insight review kept out of user-facing output, per-session UNNI/LOOP modes with memory-driven auto-continuation, memory search/ingest tools, plus a settings page (SOUL editor) and an AgentPool panel.'
plugins.descZh: '把 cipher 记忆平台原生带进 DSH：四类记忆每轮沉淀、跨会话确定性检索经 systemPrompt.context 注入、洞察复核只进沉淀、会话级 UNNI/LOOP 模式（记忆驱动自动续轮）、记忆检索/写入两个工具，以及设置页（SOUL 编辑器）与 AgentPool 面板。'

plugins.name: ns-zzj/dsh-hos-scrcpy
plugins.descEn: 'Control a HarmonyOS phone from the DSH web UI with AI: live H.264 screen mirroring, mouse touch and system keys, hilog streaming, and agentic tools that let the model read the screen, locate UI controls, then tap, long-press, press keys, or type.'
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH 网页中用 AI 操控鸿蒙手机：实时 H.264 投屏、触控与系统按键、hilog 日志，并让模型读屏、定位 UI 控件，再执行点击/长按/按键/输入。

plugins.name: nuaaweixinye/dsh-gme-test-generator
plugins.descEn: 'Drives the GME Test Agent from inside Harness: three tools list interface catalogs, start and repair autonomous test generation in a local Python backend, poll the task until review, and keep PR, skip and cleanup actions behind explicit user consent.'
plugins.descZh: '在 Harness 内驱动 GME Test Agent：三个工具负责列出接口目录、在本地 Python 后端启动并修复自主测试生成、轮询任务直到待评审，并把创建 PR、跳过与清理等动作挡在用户显式同意之后。'

plugins.name: null5069/dsh-better-stats
plugins.descEn: 'Composer stats strip for the DSH Web UI: official CNY pricing with auto-synced peak/off-peak tiers, per-model accounting, live timers, subagent-tree merging, DeepSeek account balance, budget alerts, and streaming cost estimation.'
plugins.descZh: DSH Web 输入框下方的增强统计条：官方人民币计价（峰谷分时、价目自动同步）、多模型分账、实时计时、子代理树合并、余额直连、预算预警与流式成本估算。

plugins.name: nullptr-DZF/dsh-academic-research-skills
plugins.descEn: 'Ported from the ARS Claude Code plugin (44k+ stars on GitHub): academic research skills for DeepSeek Harness — a deep-research agent team, a paper-writing pipeline, a multi-perspective peer-review panel, and an end-to-end orchestrator, plus sixteen /ars-* commands.'
plugins.descZh: '移植自 ARS Claude Code 插件（GitHub 44k+ stars）：面向 DeepSeek Harness 的学术研究技能套件——深度调研 agent 团队、论文写作流水线、多视角同行评审小组与端到端编排器，外加十六个 /ars-* 命令。'

plugins.name: Nwflower/dsh-claude-style
plugins.descEn: Claude Code Desktop look-and-feel for the DSH Web GUI — ivory/warm-black dual canvas, clay accent, three-font typography, permission segmented control and brand switcher, via CSS overrides and client DOM overrides.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web GUI 复刻 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互——象牙白/暖黑双画布、陶烬橙强调色、三字体排版、权限分段控件与品牌切换，以 CSS 覆盖与客户端 DOM override 实现。

plugins.name: nxz1026/dsh-tray
plugins.descEn: 'Windows system-tray launcher for DeepSeek Harness Web: start, stop, restart, open the Web UI, tail logs, live status icon, and a launch-at-login toggle.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness Web 的 Windows 托盘启动器：托盘图标一键启动、停止、重启服务，打开 Web UI、查看日志，实时状态图标，并支持开机自启开关。'

plugins.name: nxz1026/SinglePlayer
plugins.descEn: 'AI-native music player plugin for DeepSeek Harness: aggregates NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music and KuGou search with cross-provider playback fallback, renders word-by-word karaoke lyrics synced live over USB HID to HALO PIXELBAR speakers, and exposes search, playback, queue, alarm and speaker control as model tools.'
plugins.descZh: '运行于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 原生音乐播放器（music player）：聚合网易云（NetEase）、QQ Music 与酷狗（KuGou）搜索并支持跨源播放回退，逐字卡拉OK歌词（karaoke lyrics）经 USB HID 实时同步至花再音箱（HALO PIXELBAR），搜索、播放、队列、闹钟与音箱控制均可由对话操控。'

plugins.name: NyaaCaster/dsh-yuque-kb
plugins.descEn: Yuque knowledge base as external memory for dsh — auto-injects matching document fragments into conversation, with catalogue search, cloud full-text search and online reading.
plugins.descZh: 把语雀文档作为 dsh 的外部记忆：对话中自动检索并注入相关文档片段，支持目录快照检索、云端全文搜索与在线阅读。

plugins.name: nyantused-cpun/gewu-tools
plugins.descEn: 'Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus.'
plugins.descZh: 面向纯文本 DSH 主脑的模型无关视觉审阅流水线：HTML 逐页截图 + 视觉子代理简报契约（gewu_prep），再把每条审阅发现定位回源码核验真值（gewu_locate）；已在 mimo-v2.5 与 qwen3.7-plus 上实测。

plugins.name: objectivex666/dsh-settings-search
plugins.descEn: Instantly find DSH settings pages, tabs and rows by keyword, pinyin, intent or AI — and jump straight to them.
plugins.descZh: 通过关键词、拼音、意图或 AI 一键搜索 DSH 设置面板，并直达目标设置页、标签或选项。

plugins.name: Octo-o-o-o/dsh-plugin-deploy
plugins.descEn: 'Ship a project to Cloudflare and publish your plugin to npm — the first deploy needs no cloud account, and credentials never reach the model.'
plugins.descZh: '一句话把项目部署到 Cloudflare、把做好的插件发布到 npm：首次部署零账号，凭据模型看不到。'

plugins.name: Odefined/dsh-mobile-webui
plugins.descEn: 'Mobile-viewport fixes for the dsh web GUI: overlay drawer sidebar with swipe gestures, icon-only composer with a mode · model · effort status line, centered popovers, and horizontal-overflow/scrollbar centering fixes.'
plugins.descZh: '修复 dsh web GUI 的手机视口体验：抽屉式侧栏与滑动手势、纯图标 composer 与「权限·模型·思考深度」状态行、浮窗居中、横向溢出与滚动条挤压居中修复。'

plugins.name: oh-my-engine/dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine
plugins.descEn: An approval-gated OME engineering delivery preset with session-isolated lifecycle evidence.
plugins.descZh: 采用阶段审批门禁和会话隔离证据记录的 OME 工程交付 Agent 预设。

plugins.name: "olimc2016/dsh-token-meter-panel"
plugins.descEn: "Adds a sidebar panel to the DeepSeek Harness web UI that reports token usage and cost straight from DeepSeek's own usage API (today's spend, 7/30-day trends, today's hourly split, a history table, cost breakdown, peak/off-peak tier pricing), plus per-session detail from local logs. Zero-config: it reads the browser sign-in for the official figures, and falls back to local session logs with the source labelled."
plugins.descZh: "在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏加入 Token 用量与花费面板：直接采用 DeepSeek 官方用量接口（今日消费、7/30 天趋势、今日分时、历史表、成本构成、峰谷分档计价），并用本机会话日志给出按会话明细。凭据零配置——自动读取浏览器登录态取官方数据，取不到时退回本地日志并标明来源。"

plugins.name: Olina1Ye/internal-skill-workshop-plugin
plugins.descEn: Browse, sign in to, and safely install public or private team Skills from a configured Skill Base in DSH Web.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web 中浏览、登录并安全安装来自团队 Skill Base 的公开或私有 Skill。

plugins.name: omdsh-dev/stent
plugins.descEn: An MC-Fabric-style hook processor.
plugins.descZh: 类似 MC Fabric 的 hook 处理器。

plugins.name: OMSociety/dsh-fishpai
plugins.descEn: 'WeChat Official Account typesetting workbench: renders Markdown into inline-styled HTML you paste straight into the WeChat editor, with a sidebar panel, 11 themes and five model tools for block-level revision.'
plugins.descZh: '微信公众号排版工作台：把 Markdown 渲染成带内联样式的 HTML，粘进公众号编辑器即成排版；配右侧栏面板、11 套主题与五个模型工具做块级改稿。'

plugins.name: OMSociety/dsh-git-forge
plugins.descEn: 'Project-scoped Git credentials for DeepSeek Harness: forge accounts (GitHub, Gitea, GitLab, Bitbucket or a custom host) live in the right-sidebar "Git Forge" tab, are granted per project, and reach the agent as an HTTPS credential helper so the token never enters the conversation. Pushes to a host the project has not granted are rejected.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness 提供项目级 Git 凭据：forge 账号（GitHub、Gitea、GitLab、Bitbucket 或自定义域名）在右侧栏「Git 凭据」标签页里管理并可按项目授权，再由生成的凭据 helper 交给 agent 走 HTTPS 推送，token 不进对话；未授权 host 的推送会被拦截器直接拒绝。'

plugins.name: OMSociety/dsh-kimi-ppt
plugins.descEn: 'DSH plugin bundling the kimi-ppt skill: create, edit and export PPT slides and presentations as a locally generated .pptx with Pillow-rendered previews, no browser needed.'
plugins.descZh: '内含 kimi-ppt 技能的 DSH 插件：创建、编辑与导出 PPT 幻灯片和演示文稿，本地生成 .pptx，Pillow 渲染预览图，不需要浏览器。'

plugins.name: OMSociety/dsh-ssh-tunnel
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-host SSH workbench: keep remote servers in a host library, grant them per project, and open an interactive terminal or dual-pane SFTP in the right sidebar, while the SSHManager tool runs remote commands and transfers files without exposing keys to the model.'
plugins.descZh: '多机 SSH 工作台：把远程服务器收进主机库、按项目授权，在右侧栏里开交互式终端或双栏 SFTP；模型用 SSHManager 工具远程执行命令、上传下载文件，密钥不进模型上下文。'

plugins.name: onlyqzq/dsh-riskproof
plugins.descEn: 'Live security beacon for DSH that follows tool activity. Click to view call statistics, risk provenance chains and blocked actions, with read-only task restrictions and tool metadata change detection.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 实时安全浮标，随工具调用更新防护状态，点击查看调用统计、风险来源链和拦截结果，支持只读任务约束及工具元数据变化检测。'

plugins.name: OnTheWay111/dsh-plugin-path-completion
plugins.descEn: 'Completes @path references in the Web composer: type @ (optionally ./src/ma) to list matching files and directories, pick one with the arrow keys, and the draft receives an @./relative/path reference (quoted when the path has spaces).'
plugins.descZh: '在 Web 输入框补全 @ 路径引用：输入 @（可继续输入 ./src/ma）即列出匹配的文件与目录，用上下键选择后草稿得到 @./相对路径引用（路径含空格时自动加引号）。'

plugins.name: oopsylol/dsh-waaagh-ork
plugins.descEn: "A green pixel-Ork mascot for DSH Web that masks model thinking and output as Waaaaaaagh! until clicked to reveal, plus a random-length input mask."
plugins.descZh: "给 DSH Web 加一个会眨眼的像素绿皮兽人：把模型思考与输出掩码成 Waaaaaaagh!（点击显示原文），并支持随机长度的输入掩码。"

plugins.name: OPaimon/dsh-model-gate
plugins.descEn: 'Single-model disable gate: hides denied models from DSH catalogs, blocks direct dispatch with an in-protocol error chunk, and exposes a settings UI for the denylist.'
plugins.descZh: '提供模型粒度的启用禁用机制：从 DSH 模型目录隐藏被禁用的模型，以协议内错误块拦截直接分发请求，并提供UI设置界面。'

plugins.name: opdsh/unity-plugin
plugins.descEn: "Drive the Unity Editor from DSH through the official unity CLI: live-Editor scene commands, in-Editor C# eval and runtime command discovery over a warm unity shell session, plus a raw CLI escape hatch for project creation, tests and builds. Mounts Unity's official skill collection alongside its own Unity workflow and Asset Store skills."
plugins.descZh: "通过官方 unity CLI 在 DSH 中操作 Unity 编辑器：实时场景命令、编辑器内 C# 求值、运行时命令发现，均复用常驻的 unity shell 会话；另有原始 CLI 通道用于建工程、跑测试与构建。同时挂载 Unity 官方技能集，以及插件自带的 Unity 工作流与 Asset Store 技能。"

plugins.name: open-dshai/dsh-employee
plugins.descEn: Digital Employee，Integrates three catalogs — Experts, Skills, and Connectors — supporting browsing, favoriting, invoking, and publishing without modifying the host.
plugins.descZh: 数字员工，整合专家、技能、连接器三大目录，支持浏览、收藏、召唤与发布，且无需改动宿主代码。

plugins.name: openbkn-ai/bkn-dsh#openbkn-business-context
plugins.descEn: "Business knowledge-network context for DeepSeek Harness: bind a session to an OpenBKN knowledge network, query its objects and metrics through managed MCP tools, and open trace-backed provenance (execution facts and a business graph) for each answer. Ships with the OpenBKN Runtime; the provenance views need an OpenBKN enterprise license."
plugins.descZh: "为 DeepSeek Harness 提供业务知识网络上下文：将会话绑定到 OpenBKN 知识网络，通过受管 MCP 工具查询对象与指标，并为每轮回答打开可溯源的执行事实与业务上下文图。随 OpenBKN Runtime 发布；溯源视图需企业版 License。"

plugins.name: openma-ai/Martty#npm
plugins.descEn: A DSH-first Rust/ratatui agent TUI with streamed tool calls, subagents, durable sessions, and a Cordis-extensible client UI.
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Rust/ratatui Agent TUI，支持流式工具调用、子代理、持久会话和可扩展的 Cordis 客户端界面。

plugins.name: oppnc/dsh-kernel-mesh
plugins.descEn: "Registers Kimi, Grok, Codex, and MiniMax as DeepSeek Harness model routes, vendor subagent recipes, and kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch tools."
plugins.descZh: "把 Kimi、Grok、Codex、MiniMax 注册成 DeepSeek Harness 的模型路由、各家子代理配方，以及 kernel_status / kernel_run / kernel_switch 工具。"

plugins.name: orzgithub/dsh-ollama
plugins.descEn: Use local Ollama in DSH with Ollama native API and params support.
plugins.descZh: 在DSH中使用带有原生API和参数设置的Ollama。

plugins.name: Oscar-Williams/dsh-deepatlas
plugins.descEn: "Task-aware DSH plugin navigator: builds a local index from GitHub topics and community lists, retrieves across 28 bilingual capability classes, and provides commit-level static risk audit, consent-gated pinned installation, composition checks, and recovery."
plugins.descZh: "任务感知的 DSH 插件导航：聚合 GitHub topic 与社区清单建立本地索引，按 28 类中英能力检索；提供 commit 级静态风险审计、用户确认后的锁定版本安装、组合验证与恢复流程。"

plugins.name: Oscar-Williams/dsh-deepcanary
plugins.descEn: "Evidence-first attention supervision for DeepSeek Harness with C0–C3 policy, deduplicated Inbox alerts, quiet hours, and redacted outcome records."
plugins.descZh: "面向 DeepSeek Harness 的证据优先注意力监督，提供 C0–C3 策略、去重 Inbox 提醒、静默时段和脱敏结果记录。"

plugins.name: OtterMind/sqlx#sqlx-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'SQLX database tools: list saved datasources, show or test a connection, execute SQL and open a local result page, with the sqlx CLI installed on first use.'
plugins.descZh: 'OtterMind SQLX 数据库工具：列出已保存的数据源、查看或测试连接、执行 SQL、打开本地结果页，缺少 sqlx CLI 时首次调用自动安装。'

plugins.name: OTTTTTO/dsh-scheduled-send
plugins.descEn: 'Scheduled send: fire a drafted message into the bound conversation as a normal user bubble at a set time. Runs host-side, so the browser can stay closed; per-session isolation and restart-safe redelivery.'
plugins.descZh: '定时发送：到点将拟好的消息以正常用户气泡发送到绑定的会话。调度在服务端执行，关闭浏览器不影响发送；会话隔离、重启自动补发。'

plugins.name: ouli-1242/dsh-plugin-tool-management
plugins.descEn: 'DSH plugin: one settings panel managing MCP servers, skills, scenes, memories, subagent personas, AGENTS.md presets and archived sessions — one scene can switch the environment, and the model can help drive it all too.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 插件：一个设置面板，统一管理 MCP 服务器、技能、场景、记忆、子智能体人格、AGENTS.md 预设与归档会话——一个场景即可切换整个环境，模型也能帮你驱动这一切。'

plugins.name: Ox0400/dsh-vault
plugins.descEn: "Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card data, with health audits, expiry rotation, imports/exports and read-only/ask access modes."
plugins.descZh: "Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。"

plugins.name: oxlyn/dsh-flyout-sidebar
plugins.descEn: 'Flyout sidebar with a file tree, uncommitted-changes list and multi-tab file/diff previews; pops out into a standalone browser tab.'
plugins.descZh: 可弹出侧边栏：文件树、Git 未提交变更列表与多标签文件/diff 预览，一键弹出为独立浏览器标签页。

plugins.name: oxlyn/dsh-model-health
plugins.descEn: 'Model Health panel in Settings: lists every model configured in settings.yaml and batch-tests availability and latency for each.'
plugins.descZh: 设置页「模型健康」面板：列出 settings.yaml 配置的全部模型，一键批量测试可用性与延迟。

plugins.name: oxlyn/dsh-plugin-mgr
plugins.descEn: 'Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click update, uninstall, search, and load-error badges.'
plugins.descZh: 设置页卡片式插件管理：经 profile 补丁层启停插件（跨重启保留）、安装来源详情、npm 更新检查与一键更新、卸载、搜索与加载失败标识。

plugins.name: OzzyDeng-JunDeng/dsh-keyless-search
plugins.descEn: 'Registers a keyless search provider for the built-in web_search tool so it works without an API key, failing over between the documented no-key tiers of Tavily and Firecrawl; a TAVILY_API_KEY or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY is picked up automatically when present. Two Bing scrape backends are included but off by default.'
plugins.descZh: '为内置 web_search 工具注册免密钥搜索提供方：无需 API Key 即可使用，在 Tavily 与 Firecrawl 官方免密钥通道之间自动降级；若设置了 TAVILY_API_KEY 或 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 会自动采用。另含两个 Bing 抓取后端，默认关闭。'

plugins.name: Paimonshen/dsh-coding-plugin
plugins.descEn: 'Coding-learn floating panel: edits and runs Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell with exit code and timing, grades JSON course lessons with progress export, keeps Markdown notes and snippet library, and sends code plus a question into the current conversation for the main model to answer.'
plugins.descZh: '编程学习悬浮面板：编辑并运行 Python/JavaScript/TypeScript/PowerShell（含退出码与耗时），JSON 课程包关卡自动评判并可导出进度，提供 Markdown 笔记与代码片段库；代码分析以用户消息直投当前对话，由对话主模型直接输出。'

plugins.name: Palaiologos1453/dsh-worktree-studio
plugins.descEn: Human-operated Git worktree task board for DeepSeek Harness with validation-bound merge delivery.
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的人工 Git worktree 任务工作台，将验证结果绑定到合并交付。

plugins.name: pan17/dsh-minimax-usage
plugins.descEn: Shows MiniMax Token Plan usage beside the DSH Web UI model selector with compact 5h/7d bars, click-to-refresh, automatic idle and heartbeat refreshes, and endpoint fallback. Reuses subscription keys configured under Settings → Model and appears only for MiniMax Token Plan providers.
plugins.descZh: 在 DSH Web UI 模型选择器旁显示 MiniMax Token Plan 用量，以紧凑的 5h/7d 进度条展示，支持点击刷新、空闲与心跳自动刷新及接口回退；复用「设置 → 模型」中的订阅 Key，且仅在 MiniMax Token Plan provider 下显示。

plugins.name: pan17/dsh-wechat
plugins.descEn: Bridges WeChat private chats into DeepSeek Harness as an in-process plugin over Tencent's iLink bot protocol, with two-way text, image, file and voice messaging, in-WeChat slash commands resolved through the native command registry, WeChat-side handling of approvals and agent questions, and proactive push through a send_wechat tool.
plugins.descZh: 以进程内 Cordis 插件的形式，通过腾讯 iLink bot 协议把微信私聊桥接到 DeepSeek Harness——双向收发文本、图片、文件与语音，微信内 slash 命令经原生命令注册中心解析（DSH 新增命令零改动可用），支持在微信端处理审批与提问，并提供 send_wechat 工具主动推送。

plugins.name: PangXitong/dsh-restart-button
plugins.descEn: Power button in the DSH Web UI session header that lets you close or restart the whole DSH process.
plugins.descZh: DSH Web UI 会话头部的关机按钮，点击可关闭或重启整个 DSH 进程。

plugins.name: PaoMoXML/dsh-paste-names
plugins.descEn: Paste non-image files or folders into the chat composer as native @path references, or drag them in as absolute paths, instead of the images-only error.
plugins.descZh: 将非图片文件或文件夹以原生 @path 引用粘贴进聊天输入框，或拖放插入绝对路径，替代仅支持图片的报错。

plugins.name: Pappet/dsh-tool-imagegen
plugins.descEn: "Text-to-image and image-to-image generation via OpenRouter's unified Image API: configurable model aliases with parameters gated against the live model capability listing, reference-image inputs, a settings card, and inline chat display of results."
plugins.descZh: "通过 OpenRouter 统一 Image API 的文生图与图生图：以别名配置模型，参数按实时模型能力列表校验，支持参考图输入、设置卡片与对话内联展示结果。"

plugins.name: ParticleLight/dsh-browser-plus
plugins.descEn: 'Visible Electron browser for DSH with one shared BrowserWindow, isolated task views, explicit human-Agent handoff, snapshot-reference and native navigation tools, operation trails, demand-driven page thumbnails, keyed session recovery for reliable tab switching and closing, and site-scoped cookie clearing for login maintenance.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 DSH 的可见 Electron 浏览器：共享一个 BrowserWindow，提供隔离任务视图、显式人机交接、快照引用与原生导航工具、操作轨迹、按需页面缩略图、可靠标签页切换与关闭的 keyed session 恢复，以及按站点清理 Cookie 的登录态维护能力。'

plugins.name: PartinGQAQ/dsh-web-search-zhipu
plugins.descEn: 'GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider - routes ctx.web search through Zhipu''s Anthropic-compatible endpoint with the native web_search server tool, billing your existing GLM quota or Coding Plan instead of the DeepSeek platform. Includes a translation layer for Zhipu''s non-standard tool_result response layout.'
