plugins.descZh: 'GLM(智谱)网页搜索 provider——把 web_search 后端切到智谱 Anthropic 兼容端点的服务端搜索工具,直接复用你现有的 GLM 额度或 Coding Plan,替代 DeepSeek 官方搜索通道,并内置智谱私有响应格式的翻译层。'

plugins.name: passingby000/dsh-nl-model-switch
plugins.descEn: Switch the current DSH session's model with a natural-language sentence, on web, TUI, or IM bridges (WeChat, Feishu), without touching the panel.
plugins.descZh: 用一句自然语言切换当前 DSH 会话模型，可在 Web、TUI 及 IM 桥接的微信、飞书等对话框中使用，无需操作面板。

plugins.name: Pasumao/dsh-plugin-dev-kb
plugins.descEn: 'Offline mirror of the official DeepSeek Harness documentation as a dsh skill: 168 site pages (EN/zh) plus 52 repository-only reference docs, with topic navigation and a full-text search index for plugin development.'
plugins.descZh: '以 dsh-plugin-dev-kb 技能内置 DeepSeek Harness 官方文档离线镜像：站点中英 168 页 + 仓库补充文档 52 篇，带主题导航与全文检索，编写插件时随时查阅。'

plugins.name: Pasumao/dsh-plugin-notify
plugins.descEn: 'Adds Windows-native toast notifications and a system tray icon to dsh: alerts when the agent finishes, stops, or errors, with a tray menu to reopen the web page or quit the background process.'
plugins.descZh: 为 dsh 添加 Windows 原生 Toast 通知与系统托盘图标：agent 完成、停止或出错时弹通知，托盘菜单可重新打开网页或退出后台进程。

plugins.name: Pasumao/dsh-plugin-workbench
plugins.descEn: 'Adds a VS Code-style workspace file explorer to the dsh web GUI: file tree, editable preview with syntax highlighting, tabs, line numbers, right-click file operations, and inline image preview.'
plugins.descZh: 为 dsh 网页添加 VS Code 风格工作区文件浏览器：文件树、可编辑预览（语法高亮、标签页、行号）、右键文件操作与图片内联预览。

plugins.name: patrick1099/dsh-claude-plugin-loader
plugins.descEn: 'Loads Claude-style plugins into DeepSeek Harness (dsh): discovers skills, commands and optional SessionStart hooks from Claude plugin directories, with hot command reload and uninstall cleanup.'
plugins.descZh: '把 Claude 风格的插件加载进 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）：扫描 Claude 插件目录，接入 skills、commands 与可选的 SessionStart hooks，支持命令热更新与卸载清理。'

plugins.name: pavangupta352/stalegreen#dsh-plugin-stalegreen
plugins.descEn: 'Freshness gate for the agent''s test, typecheck, lint and build claims: each verification run becomes a receipt on tools/post-execute, file edits are tracked, and on agent/turn-stopping a claim whose latest receipt is stale, failed or has no readable result steers one more step naming the receipt and the files edited since.'
plugins.descZh: '为智能体的测试、类型检查、lint 与构建结论提供新鲜度检查：每次验证运行在 tools/post-execute 上记录为凭据，文件修改被跟踪；在 agent/turn-stopping 时，若结论对应的最新凭据已过期、失败或没有可读结果，则引导再走一步，并指出凭据与其后被修改的文件。'

plugins.name: pbwheel/dsh-workbuddy-expert
plugins.descEn: 'Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app experts into DSH: a settings-page market scans the local WorkBuddy expert directory (experts land there after you summon them in WorkBuddy) read-only for browsing, search and category filtering, with one-click install (exported to ~/.dsh/experts/ as role prompt + skills + avatar), update and uninstall; a picker capsule next to the input box switches the current session''s expert — swapping role prompt, skills and an optional tool whitelist wholesale while keeping full session history, applied at the next model-request boundary.'
plugins.descZh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面端召唤落盘的本地专家带进 DSH：设置页市场只读扫描本地专家目录，卡片浏览/搜索/分类，一键安装（导出到 ~/.dsh/experts/，含角色描述、skills 与头像）、更新与卸载；输入框旁的专家胶囊为当前会话切换专家——整组替换角色描述与 skills（可选工具白名单），保留全部会话历史，在下一个模型请求边界生效。

plugins.name: pc439527/dsh-model-provider
plugins.descEn: 'Provider-first three-level model selector for the DSH Web model seat: pick a provider, then a model from that provider, with inline search on both levels, failed-provider retry rows, and a Model · Provider trigger.'
plugins.descZh: 'Provider-first 三级模型选择器：先选供应商再选模型，两级均可行内搜索，失败供应商以可重试行展示，触发器显示 Model · Provider。'

plugins.name: pearjelly/deep-blend#bundle
plugins.descEn: 'Render and iterate on Blender scenes from DSH: 16 tools for scene specs, previews, visual review and delivery renders, with immutable revisions and an approval gate.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH 里渲染并迭代 Blender 场景：16 个工具覆盖场景规格、预览、视觉评审与交付渲染，带不可变 revision 与审批闸门。'

plugins.name: penguin-oo/dsh-delegate-router
plugins.descEn: 'Automatic Flash/Pro routing for DeepSeek Harness subagent calls: light tasks run on a cheap model (e.g. V4 Flash), heavy tasks stay on the strong model — with per-call overrides and /delegate session modes.'
plugins.descZh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的子代理调用做 Flash/Pro 自动分派：轻任务自动用便宜模型、重任务留在强模型，支持手动覆盖与 /delegate 会话模式。

plugins.name: PensiveFei/deep-read-summarize
plugins.descEn: 'Deep reading & summarization for DSH: books/papers/videos/web into structured Obsidian notes via plugin parsers, MapReduce parallel deep-read subagents, JSON Schema outputs and an idempotent cache.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 精读与摘要：书籍/论文/视频/网页经可插拔解析器转成结构化 Obsidian 笔记，MapReduce 并行精读子代理、JSON Schema 输出与幂等缓存。'

plugins.name: PensiveFei/dsh-secure-audit
plugins.descEn: 'Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness: prompt-injection detection, Chinese-PII redaction, and a local configuration audit with redacted, reproducible reports.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 只读安全合规插件：提示注入检测、中文 PII 脱敏、本机配置安全审计，输出脱敏且可复现的报告。'

plugins.name: PensiveFei/dsh-voice-scribe
plugins.descEn: 'Voice input for the web UI: tap Alt (or Alt+Space) to start/stop dictation, browser Web Speech (zero-config) or OpenAI-compatible cloud ASR, optional polish through DSH-configured LLM, settings UI.'
plugins.descZh: '面向 Web UI 的语音输入插件：点按 Alt（或 Alt+空格）开始/停止听写，支持浏览器内置 Web Speech（零配置）或 OpenAI 兼容云端 ASR，可选经 DSH 已配置模型润色，带设置页。'

plugins.name: perdakovich/dsh-prompt-edit
plugins.descEn: 'In-place prompt editing in the web chat: cleanly forks session history at the edited turn, preserves image and file attachments, and auto-archives the superseded branch.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 聊天就地编辑历史提示词：在目标轮次干净分叉会话历史，原样保留图片与附件，并自动归档旧会话。'

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-autotier
plugins.descEn: 'Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.'
plugins.descZh: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-budget
plugins.descEn: 'Per-plugin usage budgets and cost caps on the llm/stream waterfall: per-model usage accounting, session and monthly budgets with warn/block transitions, latency windows, and a carbon-footprint estimate.'
plugins.descZh: '在 llm/stream 瀑布上做按插件粒度的用量预算与费用上限：按模型用量记账、会话与月度预算的预警/阻断、延迟窗口与碳足迹估算。'

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-cert-mcp
plugins.descEn: Read-only MCP server over the DSH plugin-certification registry, exposing a plugin certification grade, its snapshot and the five-dimension evidence behind it.
plugins.descZh: '基于 DSH 插件认证登记的只读 MCP 服务，对外提供插件的认证等级、其快照以及支撑它的五维证据。'

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-click
plugins.descEn: 'Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.'
plugins.descZh: 'Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。'

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-data-quality
plugins.descEn: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的数据质量检查：数据画像、清洗与验证流水线，产出结构化报告。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-defend
plugins.descEn: Detects prompt-injection, jailbreak, and secret-leak patterns on the agent/pre-step, tools/pre-execute, and tools/post-execute seams with allow/ask/block tiers, sanitized defend/detection audit events, a defend_report tool, and a destructive-delete command guard.
plugins.descZh: 在 agent/pre-step、tools/pre-execute、tools/post-execute 三个接缝检测提示词注入、越狱与密钥泄露，按 allow/ask/block 分层拦截，附脱敏 defend/detection 审计事件、defend_report 工具与危险删除命令门禁。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-draw
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.'
plugins.descZh: '多引擎文生图（OpenAI Images 与智谱 CogView 预设）：按会话配额、引擎故障切换、凭证安全配置，结果卡片支持重新生成。'

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-fast
plugins.descEn: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness — context engineering, latency profiling, and cache behavior reports.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的性能剖析与 LLM 缓存诊断：上下文工程、延迟剖析与缓存行为报告。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-fund-research
plugins.descEn: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
plugins.descZh: 中国公募基金确定性研究报告：采集天天基金/东方财富公开数据，纯函数计算业绩拆解、持仓穿透、风格归因与经理画像，输出带逐数字可溯源快照附录的版本化报告。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-industry-research
plugins.descEn: Deterministic industry research reports for DeepSeek Harness — company and industry research flows produce structured, verifiable reports from staged evidence.
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性行业研究报告：公司与行业研究流程基于分阶段证据产出结构化、可核验的报告。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-laya
plugins.descEn: 'Laya typed decisions (`noul` yes/no, `choice`, `score`) as a first-class Cordis service (`ctx.laya`) plus the model-visible `laya_ask` and `laya_plan` tools. The plugin itself installs and downloads nothing: it is a client of a `laya-mcp serve` sidecar you start yourself, and it reports that the sidecar is not running instead of failing obscurely at the first tool call.'
plugins.descZh: 把 Laya 的有类型决策（`noul` 是/否、`choice`、`score`）接成一等 Cordis 服务（`ctx.laya`）与两个模型可见工具 `laya_ask`、`laya_plan`。插件自身不安装也不下载任何东西：它是你自己启动的 `laya-mcp serve` 边车的客户端，边车未运行时会明确报出，而不是在首次工具调用时隐晦失败。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-local-ai
plugins.descEn: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing, and cloud fallback.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama 接入：模型管理、健康检查、基于规则的本地路由与云端回退。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-mask
plugins.descEn: PII masking for DeepSeek Harness — anonymizes names, phones, emails, ids, and keys before requests and restores them at the display layer, keeping plaintext out of session logs.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的 PII 脱敏：请求前匿名化姓名、电话、邮箱、证件与密钥，展示层还原，明文不进入会话日志。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-plugin-doctor
plugins.descEn: 'Zero-dependency static and sandbox smoke detector for DSH plugins: package-structure gates, cordis contract scans, keyless headless smoke, and ecosystem-listing checks.'
plugins.descZh: '零依赖的 DSH 插件静态检查与沙箱冒烟检测器：包结构门禁、cordis 契约扫描、无密钥无头冒烟，以及生态收录校验。'

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-plugin-kit
plugins.descEn: 'Shared toolkit for authoring DeepSeek Harness plugins, published as @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit: a pluggable provider registry seam, fail-closed approval and session-event gates, shared sanitize/pricing/judge modules and a new-plugin skeleton.'
plugins.descZh: '编写 DeepSeek Harness 插件的共享工具包，发布为 @perrylink/dsh-plugin-kit：可插拔的 Provider 注册表接缝、失败即拒绝的审批与会话事件门、共享的脱敏/计价/裁决模块，以及新插件骨架。'

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-plugin-upgrade-015
plugins.descEn: 'Merged, version-locked plugin upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness (0.1.3-alpha.1 to 0.1.5-rc.1 as two closed legs): an evidence-bound version card plus a zero-dependency 20-seam scanner, shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.'
plugins.descZh: 合并后的版本锁定插件升级技能（0.1.3-alpha.1 → 0.1.5-rc.1，两条闭环腿）：证据绑定版本卡 + 零依赖 20 接缝扫描器，以 bundle 技能 + npx CLI 两种形态发布。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-plugin-upgrade
plugins.descEn: 'Plugin-author upgrade skill for DeepSeek Harness: one package carrying a corridor index, which detects the caller peer band and routes to the closed corridor card that matches it (0.1.3-alpha.1 -> 0.1.5-rc.1 as legs A+B, 0.1.5-rc.2 -> 0.1.6-alpha.2 as leg C), plus a zero-dependency seam scanner shipped as a bundle skill and an npx CLI.'
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件作者的升级技能：一个包只放一份走廊索引，自动识别调用方的 peer 区间并路由到对应已封版的升级卡片（0.1.3-alpha.1 至 0.1.5-rc.1 为 A+B 两条腿，0.1.5-rc.2 至 0.1.6-alpha.2 为 C 腿），并附带以 bundle 技能与 npx CLI 两种形态提供的零依赖接缝扫描器。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-reach
plugins.descEn: Pushes DSH approval and question cards to IM channels (WeChat first) and answers them from chat, with a session console, per-channel security, and an open push service.
plugins.descZh: 把 DSH 的审批卡与提问卡推送到 IM 渠道（先支持微信），可在聊天里直接作答，带会话控制台、逐渠道安全与开放推送服务。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-research-report
plugins.descEn: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-score
plugins.descEn: Multi-dimensional quality scoring for DeepSeek Harness plugins that scores a repo or npm package across install success, maintenance activity, documentation completeness, security scan, and protocol compliance using real CLI evidence, and produces a JSON or Markdown leaderboard report.
plugins.descZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供多指标质量评分：基于真实的 CLI 证据对某个仓库或 npm 包在安装成功率、维护活跃度、文档完整度、安全扫描和协议合规五个维度打分，并生成 JSON 或 Markdown 排行榜报告。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-session-sync
plugins.descEn: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-talk
plugins.descEn: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入输出：麦克风语音转文字与文字转语音。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-team-rooms
plugins.descEn: Persistent, cross-session multi-agent team rooms for DeepSeek Harness — members, a message bus, a shared task board, and a shared timeline that survive restarts.
plugins.descZh: 持久化、跨会话的多 Agent 团队房间：成员、消息总线、共享任务板与共享时间线，重启后仍然保留。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-ticktick
plugins.descEn: 'TickTick (Dida365) task bridge: a session-header task panel and curated agent tools over the official TickTick MCP endpoint.'
plugins.descZh: TickTick（滴答清单）任务桥：会话页头部任务面板与精选代理工具，走官方 TickTick MCP 端点。

plugins.name: PerryLink/dsh-translate
plugins.descEn: Tool-output repair layer for DeepSeek Harness — JSON schema enforcement, parameter mapping, and JSON repair for tool calls.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具输出修复层：JSON Schema 校验、参数映射与 JSON 修复。

plugins.name: PetCT/dsh-plugin-marketplace
plugins.descEn: Browse, search, star-sort, favorite and one-click download community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings.
plugins.descZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置页内浏览、搜索、星标排序、收藏并一键下载社区插件。

plugins.name: pg527322814/dsh-bayes-predict
plugins.descEn: Bayesian stock prediction plugin that fuses MACD, RSI, moving-average, volume and other technical signals into an up-move posterior probability with multi-horizon comparison, trend-state classification and position risk metrics for A-share and US stocks.
plugins.descZh: 贝叶斯个股预测插件：多指标信号融合的上涨概率估计、趋势状态识别与持仓风险度量（A 股 + 美股）。

plugins.name: pgjh/dsh-model-metadata
plugins.descEn: 'DSH plugin: matches a model you declared on a custom gateway to the capability metadata it should have — context window, output cap, reasoning levels and image support — by looking the bare model name up at runtime; the plugin never writes your settings document.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 插件：按模型名在运行时查一次目录，把你在自定义网关上声明的模型该有的能力元数据补上——上下文长度、输出上限、推理等级、能否看图；插件自己不写你的设置文档。'

plugins.name: pgmi-builds/better-dsh#better-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Make your dsh ready for serious coding. (Tools x Schemas)^REPL. `skill://`, `ctx://`, `agent://`, `dvc://`, `dsh://`, IPython REPL, Context as Variables, cross compactions recallable, full context revive. `hash-edit`, `dvc://browser`, subagent as function, workflow as function.'
plugins.descZh: '能胜任严肃编程任务的 dsh。（Tools x Schemas）^REPL。`skill://`，`ctx://`，`agent://`，`dvc://`，`dsh://`，IPython REPL，Context as Variables，抗压缩可回溯、完整上下文重构。`hash-edit`、`dvc://browser`、subagent as function、workflow as function。'

plugins.name: ph4310822/dsh-edex-jarvis-ui#bundle
plugins.descEn: 'JARVIS-style sci-fi HUD shell over the DSH web GUI: electric-cyan VITAL SIGNS / RT-MONITOR / RT-LOG left bar, POWER CORE gauges and a rotating RADAR scan disc on the right with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer with a JARVIS header strip that follows the active workspace.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 JARVIS 风格科幻 HUD 外壳：电光青色 VITAL SIGNS 生命体征 / RT-MONITOR 实时监控 / RT-LOG 事件日志左栏，右侧 POWER CORE 能源核心仪表、旋转扫描的 RADAR 雷达盘与上下行流量图，左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及带 JARVIS 头部横幅、跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。'

plugins.name: ph4310822/dsh-edex-ui#bundle
plugins.descEn: 'eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI: system-telemetry left bar with per-core CPU sparklines, encom-globe world-map right bar with up/down traffic chart, filesystem browser with file preview, and a terminal-styled composer that follows the active workspace.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DSH Web 界面上叠加 eDEX-UI 风格外壳：左侧系统遥测栏（含每核 CPU 迷你趋势图）、右侧 encom-globe 世界地图与上下行流量图、左下文件系统浏览器（带文件预览），以及跟随当前工作区的终端风格输入框。'

plugins.name: ph4310822/dsh-edex-xry-ui#bundle
plugins.descEn: 'eDEX-UI-style shell over the DSH web GUI themed as an XRY/B1 medical HUD: ECG heartbeat waveform and a rotating radar scan disc on the right bar, power-gen energy-cell meters on the left bar, a DATA TIMELINE scan-log table on the bottom, all in a cyan-on-near-black CRT skin around the original UI.'
plugins.descZh: '以 XRY/B1 医疗 HUD 为主题色的 eDEX-UI 风格 DSH 外壳：右侧 ECG 心电波形与旋转雷达扫描盘、左侧能量条仪表、底部 DATA TIMELINE 扫描日志表，青蓝近黑 CRT 皮肤包裹原始界面。'

plugins.name: Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-cachebilling
plugins.descEn: 'Per-round cache billing inside the composer context-meter popover: what the current call spends on cache hits, misses, and output in CNY, with automatic official peak/off-peak and per-model pricing; hidden on non-official DeepSeek routes.'
plugins.descZh: '点开输入框旁的上下文圆环即见本轮账单：缓存命中/未命中/输出各花多少钱（¥），官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定；非 DeepSeek 官方路由不显示。'

plugins.name: Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-smooth
plugins.descEn: 'Mobile-first UX polish for the DSH Web UI: composer auto-fold, enter-as-newline on phones, compact sidebar/header/settings, zoom and overscroll lock, plus approval/question/completion notifications via in-page cards, Web Push, and webhook — zero dsh changes.'
plugins.descZh: '手机优先的 DSH 前端体验优化：输入框自动折叠、手机回车换行、侧边栏/顶部栏/设置页压缩、禁缩放回弹，以及审批/提问/任务完成通知（页面卡片、Web Push、webhook）；零 dsh 本体改动。'

plugins.name: philmingdao/anno#dsh-native
plugins.descEn: 'Local-first HTML review and annotation workspace for coding agents: opens an isolated copy of a file in a browser editor, collects text edits, format changes and element/area comments, and returns a durable handoff the agent can claim and resolve.'
plugins.descZh: '面向编码代理的本地优先 HTML 审阅与标注工作区：在浏览器编辑器中打开文件的隔离副本，收集文本修改、格式调整与元素/区域评注，并把持久的交接（handoff）交还给代理认领和落实。'

plugins.name: phungthien269/dsh-token-stats
plugins.descEn: Token usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI — today/week/month totals, per-model breakdown and a stacked 30-day chart, with a 4-language UI.
plugins.descZh: DSH Web GUI 的 Token 用量仪表盘 — 今日/本周/本月/累计汇总、按模型明细和堆叠柱状图，界面支持中/英/越/日。

plugins.name: PhysicalAI-0/dsh-paperforge
plugins.descEn: 'Paper reading workbench: a paper library, the PDF beside Markdown notes and one dedicated AI session per paper. Highlights and region screenshots go straight into notes; select-to-ask sends the passage with its page; notes are editable in place with autosave; sessions can be combined into a Summary.'
plugins.descZh: '论文阅读工作台：论文库、PDF 与 Markdown 笔记并排、每篇论文一个专属 AI 会话。高亮与框选截图自动写入笔记；划词 Ask AI 附带页码与选段；笔记可原地编辑、自动保存；多个会话可汇总成 Summary。'

plugins.name: Physicolor/dsh-lifeline
plugins.descEn: 'Right-side message navigation rail for DeepSeek Harness: per-message tick marks, hover-to-expand preview drawer, smooth jump to any historical message, star bookmarks, realtime slide animation with interrupt support, full session index with virtualization, dynamic panel avoidance, official --dsw-* token styling.'
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧消息导航轨道：逐条消息刻度、悬浮预览抽屉、平滑跳转、星标回看、实时平移动画（可打断）、完整会话索引与虚拟化、面板动态避让、官方 --dsw-* token 样式。

plugins.name: Physicolor/dsh-ui-harmonizer
plugins.descEn: 'UI harmonizer for DeepSeek Harness: normalizes unfinished or self-contradictory official UI, reconciles style conflicts between installed plugins, and unifies the visual language via official design tokens — with live-customizable chat width, markdown font size, workspace scale, UI font stack and a rounded center-column card from Settings → General; client-only dsh bundle, zero model cost, no host side, removable without residue.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness UI 协调器：规范化官方未完善、自相矛盾的界面，协调已装插件间的样式冲突并统一视觉语言（全部遵循官方设计令牌）——支持实时自定义对话宽度、markdown 字号、工作区缩放、UI 字体栈，并在设置页提供圆角中栏卡片；纯客户端 dsh bundle，零模型开销，无 host 端，可无残留移除。'

plugins.name: Physicolor/dsh-widgets
plugins.descEn: 'Right-hand widget rail for DeepSeek Harness Web UI: live session stats, task/context/heatmap/quote widgets, OpenCode Go quota, multi-column grid layouts (1/2/4 columns) with 2x4 long tiles, a continuous magnification wave, and per-instance sizing; widgets are installable, reorderable and resizable from Settings > Components.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness Web UI 右侧部件栏：实时会话统计、任务/上下文/热力图/引用部件、OpenCode Go 用量、多列网格布局（1/2/4 列）与 2x4 长切片、连续放大波浪与逐实例尺寸；部件可在设置页安装、排序与调整大小。'

plugins.name: PianoPrince/dsh-workspace-mover
plugins.descEn: "Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback."
plugins.descZh: "拖拽跨工作区真迁移会话，找回失联与未记账会话，文件夹改名后一键原地重定向工作区；ID 与历史原样保留，步步备份回滚。"

plugins.name: piaobo123/dafeiyu-buchibaifan
plugins.descEn: 'Desktop BigFish companion for DSH: real-time balance, out-of-browser desktop Q&A, 7 custom animations, 53 meme lines.'
plugins.descZh: '桌面大肥鱼增强版桌宠：点击实时显示 DeepSeek 余额，浏览器外桌面问答，7 套专属动作，53 条玩梗。'

plugins.name: picsky/dsh-pocket-console
plugins.descEn: 'Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run''s tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.'
plugins.descZh: '把无人值守运行时 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问推送到手机飞书卡片。桌面 GUI 优先作答——只有在 `delaySeconds`（默认 120 秒）内无人应答时才发出卡片——手机上的批准等同于 `allowed-once`，因此不会在手机上累积任何权限。仅一条到飞书的出站 WebSocket 长连接：不需要公网 IP、域名、隧道或中继。'

plugins.name: PiedPiper911/dsh-video-tools
plugins.descEn: Browser-local audio/video toolkit for DSH — extract frames, capture thumbnails, compress images, and convert clips to GIF with FFmpeg.wasm.
plugins.descZh: 基于 FFmpeg.wasm 的浏览器端音视频工具集，支持抽帧、截图、图片压缩与视频转 GIF。

plugins.name: PiedPiper911/dsh-workflow-canvas
plugins.descEn: Visual drag-and-drop workflow builder for DSH — orchestrate tool calls, sub-agents, and conditional branches on a React Flow canvas.
plugins.descZh: DSH 可视化工作流编排画布，基于 React Flow 拖拽编排工具调用、子智能体与条件分支。

plugins.name: pingg02/dsh-plugins#dsh-desktop-entry
plugins.descEn: Creates a Windows desktop shortcut that starts DeepSeek Harness when needed and opens the Web UI in a Chrome or Edge app window.
plugins.descZh: 创建 Windows 桌面快捷方式，必要时启动 DeepSeek Harness，并用 Chrome 或 Edge 应用窗口打开 Web UI。

plugins.name: pingg02/dsh-plugins#dsh-quote-selection
plugins.descEn: Lets users quote selected conversation text with optional notes, then attaches the references to their next message.
plugins.descZh: 引用选中的对话文本并添加可选备注，在发送下一条消息时自动附带引用内容。

plugins.name: Pingze-github/dsh-cost-audit
plugins.descEn: Shows token and CNY cost per turn and per session in the harness's own statistics form, a whole-account bill over 1/7/30-day windows with cost-per-unit-of-work trends, and an advisor that re-measures its own suggestions after you adopt them.
plugins.descZh: 以 harness 自己的统计形态显示每轮与会话的 token 与人民币花费，提供 1/7/30 天窗口的全账号账单与「单位工作量花费」趋势，并给出会在你采纳后重新测量效果的建议。

plugins.name: pinzza/dsh-git-statusline
plugins.descEn: 'Compact Git status line for DSH Web: the current branch, staged and unstaged line changes, ahead/behind commit counts against upstream, and a clean-worktree marker — placeable in the sidebar footer, the session header, or above/below the composer, with the position switched on the settings page.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 的紧凑 Git 状态行：显示当前分支、已暂存与未暂存的行数改动、相对 upstream 的领先/落后提交数以及工作区干净标记；可放在侧边栏底部、会话标题栏或输入框上方/下方，位置在设置页切换。'

plugins.name: pipipigu/dsh-workspace-tree
plugins.descEn: Virtual session folders, click-to-move menu, and active task banner for DSH sidebar.
plugins.descZh: DSH 侧边栏虚拟会话分类树、点击式移动菜单与任务状态胶囊。

plugins.name: PKUfudawei/dsh-capability-menu
plugins.descEn: 'Prevents request context bloat in DeepSeek Harness: catalogs MCP tools and skills under ctx.capability, exposes them in exposed/progressive/blocked tiers, and invokes low-frequency ones on demand via meta_search/meta_invoke, with a visual settings tab.'
plugins.descZh: 解决海量 MCP 工具/技能塞满请求、挤占上下文的问题：统一编目能力（ctx.capability），以常驻/按需/禁用三档控制暴露与执行，低频能力按需经 meta_search/meta_invoke 检索执行，并附可视化「能力菜单」设置页。

plugins.name: plastic-labs/dsh-honcho
plugins.descEn: 'Honcho memory plugin by Plastic Labs: injects the user profile, session summary and relevant conclusions at session start, uploads each turn to Honcho in the background with secrets redacted, and adds honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember tools plus a /honcho status command; configured through the ~/.honcho/config.json shared with the other Honcho integrations, against hosted honcho.dev or a self-hosted instance.'
plugins.descZh: '由 Plastic Labs 维护的 Honcho 记忆插件：会话启动时注入用户画像、会话摘要与相关结论，后台脱敏后逐轮上传对话到 Honcho，提供 honcho_search / honcho_chat / honcho_remember 工具及 /honcho 状态命令；通过与其他 Honcho 集成共用的 ~/.honcho/config.json 配置，支持托管的 honcho.dev 或自建实例。'

plugins.name: platonai/dsh-browser4
plugins.descEn: 'Installs the browser4-cli runtime and registers the Browser4 skills (browser4-cli, browser4-experience, browser4-plugin, scent-miner) into the DSH skill registry, providing an AI-native browser engine for autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.'
plugins.descZh: '安装 browser4-cli 运行时，并将 Browser4 技能集（browser4-cli、browser4-experience、browser4-plugin、scent-miner）注册到 DSH 技能库，提供面向自主 Agent、智能提取与大规模网页自动化的 AI 原生浏览器引擎。'

plugins.name: Player-MINEPIG/dsh-tavern
plugins.descEn: 'SillyTavern-compatible roleplay with character cards, presets, world books, and swipe branches that restore their continuations alongside native DSH conversations.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DSH 提供兼容 SillyTavern 的角色扮演，支持角色卡、预设、世界书及保留后续对话的 swipe 分支，并可切回原生会话视图。'

plugins.name: plolpl789/dsh-raw-html
plugins.descEn: Renders agent HTML output as real UI in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with visual cards, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, built-in open-source fonts, and design-spec injection.
plugins.descZh: 让 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 把 agent 输出的 HTML 渲染成真实界面，支持视觉卡片、KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图表与内置开源字体，并向 agent 注入设计规范。

plugins.name: pn1024/dsh-ppt-master
plugins.descEn: 'AI-driven presentation workflow packaged as a dsh skill: generates editable PPTX decks and SVG snapshots from PDF, DOCX, URLs or Markdown, fills native PPTX templates, and enhances finished presentations.'
plugins.descZh: 'AI 驱动的演示文稿工作流：从 PDF、DOCX、网址或 Markdown 生成可编辑 PPTX 与 SVG 快照，支持原生 PPTX 模板填充与成品演示文稿增强。'

plugins.name: pn1024/dsh-skill-market
plugins.descEn: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.
plugins.descZh: 技能市场插件，聚合 SkillHub 与 ClawHub 双源搜索，支持站内 README 预览、一键安装与卸载、已装技能列表，以及聊天栏技能选择器。

plugins.name: po-et/dsh-http-probe
plugins.descEn: 'Adds an http_probe tool for endpoint health checks: status code, latency and key response headers, using HEAD with GET fallback; response bodies are never downloaded.'
plugins.descZh: 为 agent 增加 http_probe 工具：探测 HTTP(S) 端点的状态码、延迟与关键响应头，HEAD 被拒时自动降级 GET，不下载响应体。

plugins.name: po-et/dsh-session-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Prevents concurrent-write session corruption: takes a per-session advisory lock on session start and every step, so a second dsh process fails loudly instead of writing a duplicate-seq gap; dead owners are taken over automatically.'
plugins.descZh: 预防并发写导致的会话损坏：在会话开始及每一步获取按会话的咨询锁，第二个 dsh 进程会明确报错而非写出重复 seq 断层；死进程持有的锁自动接管。

plugins.name: po-et/dsh-session-snapshot
plugins.descEn: 'Rolling, integrity-verified backups of each session at turn boundaries: verifies the log still loads before promoting a snapshot, never overwrites the last good one when a turn ends corrupt, and restores in one command even when dsh will not boot.'
plugins.descZh: 在每个回合边界为会话滚动保留校验过的备份：提升快照前先确认日志仍可加载，回合结束时若已损坏则绝不覆盖上一份好副本，dsh 启动不了时也能一条命令恢复。

plugins.name: PolinniZhong/dsh-knit
plugins.descEn: "Lists the Markdown documents, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace in the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation: recent messages are matched locally against document title, summary and body with IDF weighting, with no model calls and no network. Because the list is scanned from the workspace instead of remembered, restarting DSH or starting a new session does not empty it. Images and video preview in place, with relative-path images resolved and video streamed over HTTP Range. A references bar under the preview header shows which documents cite the one being previewed and which it cites, with one click to jump between them. The same ranking is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool, which returns the most relevant documents along with the passage that matched in each, where one is found."
plugins.descZh: "把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序：用最近几条消息在本地与文档标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 权重的匹配，不调用模型，也没有网络出口。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。图片与视频可就地预览，相对路径图片真实渲染，视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。预览头下方的引用条显示当前这篇被哪些文档引用、又引用了哪些，点一项即可跳过去。同一份排序也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent：它返回最相关的若干篇，并附上每篇里命中的那段原文（有命中时才附）。"

plugins.name: PolinniZhong/dsh-omi-voice
plugins.descEn: 'In-chat read-aloud for DeepSeek Harness: tap to read, pause and resume AI replies with natural Doubao TTS voices (BYOK), reading only the final answer with code, tables and diagrams filtered; local engine, plugin keeps no API key.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 对话内朗读：点一下即可朗读、暂停、继续 AI 回复，豆包 TTS 自然音色（BYOK），只读最终回答并过滤代码、表格与图形，本地引擎，插件零 Key。'

plugins.name: PolinniZhong/dsh-personal-center
plugins.descEn: 'Personal center for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session usage statistics, per-model cost estimation, global custom instructions, a global font-size adjuster, a data-driven desktop pet with bitmap & vector skins, and a conversation status overview, all local and offline.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 个人中心：跨会话用量统计、按模型成本估算、全局自定义指令、外观全局字号、数据驱动的桌面宠物（位图/矢量皮肤）与会话状态概览，纯本地离线运行。'

plugins.name: PolinniZhong/dsh-session-workbench
plugins.descEn: 'Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).'
plugins.descZh: '会话工作台：全文搜索历史会话、一键 @引用 召回最多 3 个，并管理会话视图标签栏（显示/隐藏 + 拖拽排序）。'

plugins.name: polohot/dsh-adrian-inject-context
plugins.descEn: Injects your own saved context entries as a Remember row after each user message, per turn or once per session, with a Settings editor and a manager page.
plugins.descZh: '把你保存的上下文条目以「Remember」行的形式注入到每条用户消息之后，可按轮或按会话一次；带设置编辑器与管理页。'

plugins.name: poplarity/dsh-science-workbench
plugins.descEn: 'Reproducible science workbench: agent-driven cells, inline figures with feedback/rerun, manifest provenance, environment snapshots, and publication-grade figure skills (9 bio_* tools + workbench UI).'
plugins.descZh: '可复现科学分析工作台：agent 驱动的 cell、内联图形与反馈重画、manifest 溯源、环境快照与出版级出图技能（9 个 bio_* 工具 + 工作台界面）。'

plugins.name: popu2do/dsh-call-session
plugins.descEn: In-process cross-session communication, peer session creation, and shared blackboard for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.descZh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的进程内跨会话通信、对等会话创建与公共黑板插件。

plugins.name: PPawnsir/dsh-notes-plugin#dsh-notes-plugin
plugins.descEn: "Session-aware local notes for DeepSeek Harness: capture notes and page selections in a floating Apple Notes style panel, let the LLM classify topics, auto-inject convention notes into the system prompt, and dispatch todos with recall context to active sessions."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 的会话感知本地笔记：在 Apple Notes 风格浮窗里快速记录与选区摘录，由 LLM 自动分类主题，把约定类笔记自动注入系统提示，待办可携带召回上下文派发到活跃会话执行。"

plugins.name: PPawnsir/task-board-plugin#dsh-agent-board
plugins.descEn: "Kanban task board for DeepSeek Harness sessions: the main agent dispatches coding tasks to one-shot worker/verifier subagents, with dependency scheduling, pipeline tiers, escalation handling, and file/notes context injection."
plugins.descZh: "DeepSeek Harness 会话任务看板：主窗口把任务派发给一次性 Worker/Verifier 子代理执行与验收，支持依赖调度、管线分档、歧义上报裁决与预研上下文注入。"

plugins.name: ppy-web/dsh-plugin-xiaomi-mimo-tts
plugins.descEn: Adds Xiaomi MiMo text-to-speech to DSH Web with assistant-message read-aloud, PCM streaming, preset and custom voice design, browser speech fallback, playback controls, and optional UI sounds.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 添加 Xiaomi MiMo 语音朗读，支持助手消息朗读、PCM 流式播放、预置与自定义音色、浏览器语音兜底、播放控制和可选 UI 音效。

plugins.name: project-hy/dsh-claude-delegate
plugins.descEn: "Delegates self-contained coding subtasks to the local Claude Code subscription through the official Agent SDK and returns the result to the host session. Nineteen per-call parameters control model, thinking effort, permission mode, allowed tools, turn count and budget cap; background jobs return a jobId immediately and stream incremental output; the result carries a session handle that can be passed back as resume to continue the same conversation; commands expected to run past ~20 seconds go through the built-in mcp__dsh__shell channel, which streams output line by line without consuming model context; a Claude Code monitor panel in the session lists jobs, renders the structured process, shows live output blocks and cancels a run; the delegation procedure ships as a runtime-registered skill, so installing the plugin installs the skill."
plugins.descZh: "把自包含的编码子任务委派给本机 Claude Code（官方 Agent SDK 驱动），结果回传主会话：19 个参数可按次控制模型、思考强度、权限模式、允许工具、轮次与预算上限；后台作业立即返回 jobId 并支持增量读取；结果附会话句柄，传回 resume 即可在同一会话续跑；预计超过 20 秒的命令经内置 mcp__dsh__shell 通道逐行实时输出，不占用模型上下文；会话内附 Claude Code 监控面板（任务列表、结构化过程视图、实时输出块、一键取消）；委派规程以运行时技能注册，安装插件即安装技能。"

plugins.name: psychiiii/dsh-three-window#personal-web
plugins.descEn: 'Three-window workbench for dsh web: chat, construct, and a read-only review window side by side for each workspace, per-window hooks, and an anonymous multi-model review that asks before it runs, groups findings by issue, and reports in Markdown.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh web 的三窗工作台：每个工作区并排显示聊天、施工和只读审核三个窗口，各窗口独立配置 hook；审核窗提供匿名多模型评审，先确认再运行，按同一件事归组，报告为 Markdown。'

plugins.name: Pudge1996/dsh-composer-stretch
plugins.descEn: Expand button for the DSH Web UI composer — appears at 3+ lines, stretches to near-fullscreen height, auto-collapses on send, and Enter inserts newlines in expanded mode.
plugins.descZh: 输入框全屏扩展按钮——内容达 3 行以上时出现，点击扩展至全屏高度，发送后自动折叠，扩展模式下 Enter 换行。

plugins.name: Pudge1996/dsh-task-feedback
plugins.descEn: Live session status on the browser tab favicon with sound notifications for pending input and completed tasks.
plugins.descZh: 浏览器标签页 Favicon 实时回显会话状态，并支持需介入/已完成时的音效提示。

plugins.name: Pummelchen/TinyTitan#dsh-tinytitan
plugins.descEn: 'Keeps a local TinyTitan model server reachable from the harness: refreshes the llm-pi-ai route from the installed models and mounts a compaction backend that does not think.'
plugins.descZh: '把本机 TinyTitan 模型服务接入 Harness：按已安装模型刷新 llm-pi-ai 路由，并挂载一个不做思考的压缩后端。'

plugins.name: Punky971210/dsh-punky-swarm#dsh-punky-swarm
plugins.descEn: 'Engine-enforced guardrails for DeepSeek Harness agent swarms: quality gates reject half-done work, crash-safe checkpoints resume in place — keeps AI teams from breaking, not just running.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh 单机多子 Agent 集群治理：引擎级质量门禁拒收半成品、崩溃断点续跑不重来——给 AI 团队装上"跑不坏"的工程护栏。'

plugins.name: pure-craft/dsh-actions
plugins.descEn: 'Deterministic project actions shared by people and agents: one actions.json, a right-sidebar run panel, and agent tools.'
plugins.descZh: '人与 Agent 共用的确定性项目任务：一份 actions.json，右侧栏运行面板与 Agent 工具双入口。'

plugins.name: pure-craft/dsh-capability-panel
plugins.descEn: 'Manage MCP servers, skills, and tools for your agent — true in-context state (loaded/truncated/evicted) and per-session switches.'
plugins.descZh: '一站式管理 MCP 服务器、技能与工具——真实的在上下文状态(已加载/已截断/已挤出),并按会话开关。'

plugins.name: pure-serendipity-five/dsh-liquid-glass-studio
plugins.descEn: 'iOS 26 style liquid glass theme for DeepSeek Harness: a fully transparent workspace, layered glass panels, a built-in wallpaper gallery, and a control center for workspaces and plugins.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 的液态玻璃主题：工作区全透明、分层玻璃面板、内置壁纸库，外加一个管工作区与插件的控制中心。'

plugins.name: pwping/moyu_games
plugins.descEn: Five casual mini-games (sliding-number puzzle, Sudoku, snake, Schulte grid, number memory) that pop up when a turn starts, with auto-saved progress across sessions.
plugins.descZh: 任务开始时自动弹出的 5 个休闲小游戏（数字华容道、数独、贪吃蛇、舒尔特方格、数字记忆），支持跨会话自动保存进度。

plugins.name: PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-mcp-context7
plugins.descEn: 'Context7 MCP bridge: gives the model up-to-date, version-specific library documentation and code examples through the Context7 MCP server, keyless by default.'
plugins.descZh: '接入 Context7 托管 MCP 服务，为 agent 提供随版本更新的库文档查询；默认免密钥可用。'

plugins.name: PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-mcp-firecrawl
plugins.descEn: 'Firecrawl MCP bridge: hosted Firecrawl MCP server with keyless search, scrape and parse; an API key unlocks the full tool surface including crawl and map.'
plugins.descZh: '接入 Firecrawl 托管 MCP 服务：免密钥即可使用搜索、抓取与解析（有每日额度），配置 API Key 后解锁完整工具集，含爬取与站点地图。'

plugins.name: PyModel/dsh-research-plugins#dsh-tavily
plugins.descEn: 'Tavily Search API as a web search provider (settings toggle with DeepSeek fallback, keyless search) plus a Tavily MCP bridge: keyless search and extract tools, crawl and map with an API key.'
plugins.descZh: 'Tavily 网页搜索：设置页开关，关闭时回落到 DeepSeek 内置搜索；免密钥可用搜索与内容提取，配置 API Key 后解锁爬取与站点地图等 MCP 工具。'

plugins.name: q862877400-ux/dsh-fuhuobi
plugins.descEn: 'Backs up DSH profiles and mints a desktop "revival coin" that restores the harness after a failed boot or install: a boot guard runs a two-phase health check (HTTP 200 plus client render), marks good boots, isolates or rolls back bad ones, and keeps 3 rotating snapshots. Cross-platform.'
plugins.descZh: '备份 DSH 环境，启动或安装失败时通过桌面"复活币"一键恢复：内置启动守卫做两阶段健康检查（HTTP 200 + 客户端渲染），标记正常启动、隔离或回滚异常启动，并轮换保留 3 份快照。跨平台。'

plugins.name: qaz040619/dsh-bluefatfish
plugins.descEn: 'Deep-sea skin for the DSH Web UI: an 80-token light/dark theme layer, a two-layer background, a gradient sidebar with a whale sticker, a wordmark that doubles as the skin switch, and a rotating turn-status line.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 深海皮肤：80 条明暗双值令牌、背景两层、渐变侧栏与鲸鱼娘贴纸；左上角大字标就是皮肤开关，运行中的状态文案每 6 秒轮播。'

plugins.name: qcsjjjjj/dsh-hero-rightbar
plugins.descEn: Adds the right sidebar's expand trigger on pages with no conversation, matching the product's own control.
plugins.descZh: 在没有对话的页面上补回右侧栏的展开入口，位置与外观对齐产品自带控件。

plugins.name: qcsjjjjj/dsh-planner
plugins.descEn: 'A planner board as a third tab beside chat and trajectory: a Monday-first month calendar above per-day cards holding title, note, times, three importance levels and a completion checkbox. Plans repeat daily, weekly or on weekdays with an optional end date; editing or deleting asks this occurrence versus the whole series; completion is tracked per day; one button clears a day while only skipping recurrent series. Five model tools let the agent read, write, delete, clear and undo plans in conversation.'
plugins.descZh: '在中间栏加一个“计划”标签（对话、轨迹的右侧）：周一起始的月历用于选日期，下方是当天的计划卡片，含标题、备注、起止时间、三档重要度与完成勾选框。计划可按每天、每周或工作日重复并带可选截止日期；编辑与删除会询问“仅此一次”还是“整个系列”；完成状态按天独立；一键躺平只跳过重复系列的当天。五个模型工具让 Agent 能在对话里读取、写入、删除、清空与撤销计划。'

plugins.name: qgx1992/dsh-ui-tools
plugins.descEn: 'Five web UI tools in one plugin: a provider + model two-button selector with reasoning-level control, collapse/expand-all for sidebar workspace groups, a session tab listing the files the session changed (needs kernel 0.1.2-alpha.1+, silently absent on older kernels), a workspace badge next to the session title, and a settings page that toggles them.'
plugins.descZh: '一个插件装五个 Web UI 工具：供应商 + 模型双按钮选择器（含推理等级调节）、侧边栏工作区折叠/展开全部、会话「修改的文件」选项卡（需内核 0.1.2-alpha.1+，旧内核上静默缺席）、会话标题旁的工作区徽章，以及集中开关这些功能的设置页。'

plugins.name: QianLuo-Ly/dsh-weather
plugins.descEn: 'Top-centered weather bar for the DSH Web UI: geolocation, current conditions, 12h/7d forecasts and severe-weather notifications via Open-Meteo (free, no API key).'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 顶部居中的天气栏：定位 + 当前天气 + 未来 12 小时/7 天预报与恶劣天气提醒，数据来自 Open-Meteo（免费、无需 API key）。'

plugins.name: qianyuan-ltd/dsh-qianyuan
plugins.descEn: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the QianYuan MCP server, a shared record of pitfalls other agents already hit and results they already produced, plus capability lookup. Exposes 13 tools named mcp__qianyuan__*. Reads are open and need no key.
plugins.descZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入乾元 MCP 服务器——其中存着其他 Agent 已经踩过的坑与已经跑出的结果，并提供能力检索。共暴露 13 个工具，名为 mcp__qianyuan__*。读取开放，无需密钥。

plugins.name: qikairo7/dsh-gemini-pool
plugins.descEn: 'Multi-account Google Gemini provider: picks the account with the most remaining quota, fails over on 429 with exponential cooldown, probes disabled accounts in the background, and ships a Chinese/English settings page.'
plugins.descZh: '多账号 Google Gemini 提供商：按剩余额度挑选账号，遇 429 指数退避切换，后台探活已禁用账号，附中英双语设置页。'

plugins.name: qimen039-code/dsh-consumer-audit
plugins.descEn: 'Audits a DSH profile for capabilities nothing consumes: inventories the declared composition rows, counts how often each registered tool and skill is actually called in the session logs, separates calls that were made from calls that returned a result, and reports the ones with no observed consumer. Ships a skill that fixes the evidence-chain format for completion claims.'
plugins.descZh: '审计 DSH profile 里没有消费者的能力：清点已声明的组成行，统计每个已注册工具与 skill 在会话日志里真正被调用的次数，把「发起过调用」与「返回了结果」分开，报告没有观察到消费者的那些；并附一份固定「完成声明」证据链格式的 skill。'

plugins.name: qingmomo233/dsh-thinking-language
plugins.descEn: 'Switch the language of the agent''s thinking/reasoning process (chain-of-thought): 简体中文, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, 日本語, 한국어 and more, or auto-follow the system locale. Adds a Settings → General row, a system-prompt instruction (per-prompt assembly, applies to new sessions), and the /thinking-language command.'
plugins.descZh: 切换智能体思考过程（推理/链式思考）的语言：支持简体中文、英文、俄语、法语、德语、西班牙语、日语、韩语等，或跟随系统界面语言（自动）。新增「设置 → 通用」中的思考语言选择行、系统提示词注入（每次组装提示词时求值，新会话生效）与 /thinking-language 命令。

plugins.name: qingyou002/dsh-git-commit
plugins.descEn: 'DSH slash command /commit: stages all changes, summarizes the staged diff with the session model, and commits; no browser UI required, with a local fallback when the model call fails.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 斜杠命令 /commit：暂存全部更改，用会话当前模型总结暂存区 diff 后提交；不依赖浏览器界面，模型调用失败时回退到本地规则生成提交信息。'

plugins.name: Qinling-Melon-Farmers/dsh-memoir
plugins.descEn: 'Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.'
plugins.descZh: '仅本地运行、零捆绑运行时依赖（仅使用 DSH 宿主 peer）且不调用外部服务的项目记忆：以 JSON 为单一事实源并自动生成 PROJECT_MEMORY.md、按 token 有界且按会话冻结的 Hot Memory 以保持 prompt-prefix cache 稳定、带查询缓存的跨项目 BM25 召回、可信 session/turn 溯源、可解释的写前重复/冲突治理、可编辑的重要度/置顶/标签/supersede/归档生命周期、可配置的顶层回合自动蒸馏，以及支持搜索、检查、诊断和实时设置的中英双语 Web GUI。'

plugins.name: QinpanWan/dsh-doc-quick
plugins.descEn: Drag documents into the dsh web chat; the agent reads them directly from the local filesystem and the right sidebar lists the outputs and file paths.
plugins.descZh: 拖拽文档进 dsh Web 对话框，Agent 直读本地文件处理，右侧侧栏展示产出与文件路径。

plugins.name: QinpanWan/dsh-hiboard-push
plugins.descEn: 'Huawei HarmonyOS assistant-today (负一屏) task-completion push for DeepSeek Harness: hiboard_push / hiboard_verify tools post Markdown task results to the phone card feed, wire-compatible with the OpenClaw today-task skill, with the authCode managed from the dsh settings panel.'
plugins.descZh: '华为鸿蒙负一屏（智慧助手·今天）任务完成推送：hiboard_push / hiboard_verify 工具把 Markdown 任务结果推送到手机卡片流，与 OpenClaw today-task 技能线级兼容，授权码可在 dsh 设置面板配置。'

plugins.name: QinpanWan/dsh-prompt-antivirus
plugins.descEn: 'Global prompt-injection / context-virus defense for DeepSeek Harness: scans tool arguments, tool results, pre-model messages and the outbound stream; quarantine/block/monitor modes, canary trap, and an evolvable on-disk signature library with learn/import/export.'
plugins.descZh: '全局提示注入 / 上下文病毒防御：扫描工具参数、工具结果、进模型前消息与出站流；隔离/阻断/监控三模式、金丝雀陷阱、可演进磁盘签名库（学习/导入/导出）。'

plugins.name: QinpanWan/dsh-sky-skin
plugins.descEn: "Sky: Children of the Light skin for the dsh web UI - light children on a glowing star map, candlelight gold and starry night."
plugins.descZh: 光遇·遇境主题皮肤：星盘之上的光之子，烛火暖金与深蓝星空双主题，为 dsh WebUI 定制。

plugins.name: qinpeizhan77/deepseek-harness-novel-studio
plugins.descEn: Local-first fiction workspace that links outlines, chapters, characters, timelines, writing rules, and continuity checks to the conversation.
plugins.descZh: 本地优先的小说创作工作台，将大纲、章节、人物、时间线、写作规则与一致性检查联动到对话。

plugins.name: qinyre/dsh-plugin-archive-manager
plugins.descEn: 'Settings section for archived sessions: browse by workspace, search, batch unarchive with the sidebar updating live, and optional auto-archive rules (idle days, keep-last-N per workspace) with a dry-run preview — plus a left-edge turn rail for jumping between turns of long conversations and ↑/↓ input history in the composer.'
plugins.descZh: 设置页的归档会话分区：按工作区分组浏览、搜索、批量取消归档，侧边栏实时恢复；自动归档规则（不活跃天数、每工作区保留条数）可选，执行前可试运行预览。另含长会话的左缘轮次刻度尺（悬停预览、点击跳转、Alt+↑/↓ 逐轮移动）与输入框 ↑/↓ 历史翻找。

plugins.name: qinyre/dsh-plugin-capabilities
plugins.descEn: 'Skills & MCP section in Settings: browse, create, edit and delete skills with live directory watching, toggle loading of any on-disk skill through frontmatter policy keys, register local folders or GitHub repos as extra skill scan roots, edit the MCP server rows in the profile patch, import MCP config from Claude Code or Codex, and install from a curated market of skill repos and MCP servers.'
plugins.descZh: 设置页的「技能与 MCP」分区：技能目录实时监听，可浏览、新建、编辑、删除技能，用 frontmatter 策略键开关任何落在磁盘上的技能；本地目录或 GitHub 仓库可注册为额外技能扫描根；profile 的 MCP 服务器行在页面上编辑，可从 Claude Code / Codex 配置导入；另带精选技能仓库与 MCP 服务器的市场。

plugins.name: qinyre/dsh-plugin-install
plugins.descEn: 'Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.'
plugins.descZh: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

plugins.name: qiqibabyy/dsh-pet-desktop
plugins.descEn: 'Desktop companion pet in its own always-on-top window: imports Codex pet folders from ~/.codex/pets as-is, with affinity ranks, session-linked activity bubbles, snap-to-edge dragging, a right-click-reachable smart click-through mode and a daily token meter that mirrors the dsh-usage ledger when installed.'
plugins.descZh: '独立置顶窗口的桌面宠物：直接导入 ~/.codex/pets 的 Codex 宠物，含亲密度段位、会话活动气泡、贴边吸附拖拽、右键可达的智能鼠标穿透；已装 dsh-usage 时自动对齐其当日 token 台账。'

plugins.name: qishuilalala/dsh-voice-mode#dsh-voice-mode
plugins.descEn: 'Full-duplex voice mode for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: toggle (2s-pause auto-send) or hold-to-talk dictation into an editable draft with zipformer2 streaming ASR, optional wake word; sentence-by-sentence Edge TTS read-aloud with live captions, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). On-device ASR, no API key.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness Web UI 全双工语音对话：按钮或 Ctrl+Shift+V 进入，持续聆听（停顿自动发送）或按住说话，zipformer2 流式识别入可编辑草稿、可选唤醒词；回复按句 Edge TTS 朗读并显示实时字幕，开口即打断播放与回合（真 barge-in）；识别模型本地推理、Edge TTS 在线合成，无需 API Key。'

plugins.name: qixin-ai-data/dsh-qixin-insight-mcp-oauth
plugins.descEn: 'Connects the Qixin Insight MCP server over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE as a single plugin entry, mounting its tools as mcp__qixin_insight__* with automatic token refresh and revocation on disconnect.'
plugins.descZh: '通过 OAuth 2.1 + PKCE 授权接入启信慧眼 MCP 服务，以单条插件条目把它的工具挂载为 mcp__qixin_insight__*，token 到期前自动刷新，断开时吊销。'

plugins.name: qiyu166/dsh-client-ui-session-mention
plugins.descEn: 'Type @ in the composer to reference another conversation: pick a historical session and inject its compacted context into the current prompt.'
plugins.descZh: '输入 @ 引用另一个对话：选择历史会话，将其压缩总结注入当前提示词。'

plugins.name: qjf44/dsh-plugin-thinking-api
plugins.descEn: 'One-click OpenAI-compatible API (CodeBuddy/vLLM/proxies) with thinking mode, avoiding developer-role content_filter rejection.'
plugins.descZh: '一键接入 OpenAI 兼容 API（CodeBuddy、vLLM、各类代理）并开启思考模式，绕开第三方端点以 content_filter 拒绝 developer 角色的问题。'

plugins.name: qkycir-123/dsh-run2skill
plugins.descEn: Turns explicit DSH session experience into reviewable native Skill drafts that are saved only after user approval.
plugins.descZh: 将 DSH 会话中明确表达的经验整理为可审核的原生 Skill 草稿，并仅在用户确认后保存。

plugins.name: qphotoai/dsh-computer-use-windows
plugins.descEn: 'Windows-only Computer Use plugin for DeepSeek Harness with UIA, cua-driver, and optional GLM vision.'
plugins.descZh: '适用于 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness Computer Use 插件，支持 UIA、cua-driver 和可选 GLM 视觉。'

plugins.name: changmodel
plugins.descEn: "Model switching, model capability configuration, fixed compaction models, subagent routing, and input history enhancement."
plugins.descZh: "模型切换、模型能力配置、固定摘要模型、子 agent 角色路由与输入历史增强。"

plugins.name: qtaik/dsh-noname-kit
plugins.descEn: Noname (Sanguosha-like game) extension workshop. AI writes skill and card extensions behind confirmation gates, static validation and block-based safe writes.
plugins.descZh: 无名杀扩展开发工坊。AI 在确认协议、校验门禁与区块化写入的保护下编写武将技能与卡牌扩展。

plugins.name: quaner1234-cmd/dsh-subagent-watchdog
plugins.descEn: Automatically continues a native continuable DSH subagent once when it ends with explicit max-tokens termination, then stops.
plugins.descZh: 当原生可续接 DSH 子代理因明确的 max-tokens 终止时自动续接一次，然后停止介入。

plugins.name: quaner1234-cmd/DSH-THEME-KAMI
plugins.descEn: Kami-inspired editorial skin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with a warm parchment canvas, ink-blue accent, serif typography and hairline borders in light and dark palettes.
plugins.descZh: 基于 Kami 视觉风格的 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 皮肤；暖羊皮纸画布、墨蓝强调色、衬线字形与发丝线边框，提供浅色与深色两套配色。

plugins.name: QuantumKuba/dsh-continuum
plugins.descEn: 'Persistent project memory, event-sourced task lifecycle, context budgeting, and cooperative multi-agent handoffs.'
plugins.descZh: '持久化项目记忆、事件溯源的任务生命周期、上下文预算控制与多智能体协作交接。'

plugins.name: QuantumKuba/dsh-graphify-plugin
plugins.descEn: "Native Graphify knowledge graph plugin providing 10 code intelligence tools, topological search, god nodes discovery, and PR blast radius triage."
plugins.descZh: "为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生 Graphify 知识图谱支持，包含 10 个代码智能工具、拓扑搜索、核心节点发现与 PR 影响分析。"

plugins.name: QuantumKuba/dsh-webstack
plugins.descEn: 'SearXNG search and Scrapling multi-tier fetch provider bundle for DeepSeek Harness ctx.web with SSRF protection and markdown conversion.'
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web) 提供 SearXNG 搜索与 Scrapling 多级抓取 Provider，支持 SSRF 防护与 Markdown 格式转换。'

plugins.name: que3sui/dsh-darwin#forge
plugins.descEn: 'Self-evolution actuator: consumes problem tickets mined from session logs, synthesizes skill candidates (zero-code tiers by default) behind an eval gate with hold-out canaries, then promotes to project .dsh/skills with human confirm and deterministic rollback.'
plugins.descZh: '自进化执行器：消费会话日志挖掘出的问题工单，在评测门（hold-out canary 防作弊）下合成技能候选，人工确认晋级到项目 .dsh/skills 并支持确定性回滚。'

plugins.name: que3sui/dsh-darwin#sentinel
plugins.descEn: 'Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.'
plugins.descZh: '会话体检：基于官方 session-query 接缝，机械挖掘会话日志为结构化问题工单（重试环/工具错误簇/中断回合/Token 浪费）；可独立安装使用。'

plugins.name: Quinn2006/dsh-guise
plugins.descEn: 'Persona wardrobe for DeepSeek Harness: save multiple personas, apply them globally or per workspace, with a master switch, an adjustable API balance guard, and a lazy token-loving tired mode that speaks on the agent''s behalf when quota runs out. Files-as-config, hot reload, zero dependencies.'
plugins.descZh: '给 DSH 的 agent 穿上主人钦定的人设：多套人格随心换，全局或按工作区生效，内置人设库、总开关、余额预警与没电模式（80 句随机话术）。文件即配置、保存即生效、零依赖。'

plugins.name: Qulierm/dsh-macos-settings-shortcut
plugins.descEn: Restores Cmd+, to open the existing Settings dialog in DeepSeek Harness on macOS.
plugins.descZh: 为 macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 恢复 Cmd+, 设置快捷键。

plugins.name: Qulierm/orbital-agents
plugins.descEn: Persistent Endeavour and Challenger peer sessions for DeepSeek Harness that plan, execute sequential tasks, and verify reported results.
plugins.descZh: '为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻的 Endeavour 与 Challenger 对等会话：负责规划、按序执行任务，并核验汇报的结果。'

plugins.name: qvsix/dsh-antigravity-bridge
plugins.descEn: 'Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.'
plugins.descZh: '在 DeepSeek Harness 里读取 Google Antigravity 的 SQLite 会话并导入为原生侧栏会话，提供 list／read／import 工具与斜杠命令。'

plugins.name: QWE13-ART/dsh-skill-folder
plugins.descEn: 'Folds the DSH skill catalog prompt surface with KV-cache-stable rendering, BM25/bge-m3 hybrid skill search, and optional auto route hints.'
plugins.descZh: '折叠 DSH 技能目录提示面：KV 缓存稳定渲染 + BM25/bge-m3 混合技能检索 + 可选自动路由提示。'

plugins.name: QWE13-ART/dsh-tool-folder
plugins.descEn: 'Folds the tool-definition prompt surface when many MCP servers are installed: a static KV-cache-stable catalog plus BM25/bge-m3 hybrid tools_search and batch tools_schema expansion, so hundreds of tools stay discoverable without spending their full schemas every turn.'
plugins.descZh: '装了大量 MCP 时折叠工具定义提示面：KV 缓存稳定的静态目录 + BM25/bge-m3 混合 tools_search + tools_schema 批量展开，几百个工具仍可检索，但不必每轮都付完整 schema 的 token。'

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-auto-translate
plugins.descEn: 'Full-pipeline Chinese translation for the dsh web GUI: live translation of the model reasoning as it streams, in-place Chinese below each English reply, and one-line Chinese summaries for tool outputs and tool-call glosses — a standalone provider request that never enters the session transcript.'
plugins.descZh: dsh 网页端全链路中文翻译：思考过程实时翻译、英文回复就地中文、工具输出中文摘要与工具调用注释；翻译为独立提供方请求，不进入会话上下文。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-commander
plugins.descEn: 'Commander mode for the dsh web GUI: a one-click session header button injects a protocol brief into the session, then parses and auto-executes task blocks in the model reply — separating the strategist loop from worker loops via a visible badge.'
plugins.descZh: dsh 网页端指挥官模式：会话标题栏一键注入协议简报，解析模型回复中的任务块并自动执行，让策略层与执行层分离；通过徽章按钮激活/停用。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-context-compressor
plugins.descEn: 'One-click context compression for the dsh web GUI: a 压缩 button on the session title bar summarizes the whole conversation into a few lines, opens a new session in the same workspace seeded with the summary, and switches to it — the original session stays untouched.'
plugins.descZh: dsh 网页端一键上下文压缩：会话标题栏「压缩」按钮把整段对话总结成几句话，新建同工作区会话以摘要为第一条消息并自动切换，原会话原样保留。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-continue-on-limit
plugins.descEn: 'Auto-continue for the dsh web GUI: when a local model hits its output-token cap and the max-tokens notice appears, the plugin automatically queues a short continue message so the reply keeps flowing — dual-source truncation detection, loop protection, and no UI.'
plugins.descZh: dsh 网页端输出上限自动继续：本地模型输出到上限出现提示时，自动发送「继续」让回复接上；双源截断检测、防死循环保护，完全无 UI。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-memory
plugins.descEn: 'Project+global long-term memory for the dsh web GUI: split POST /items endpoints, tool-call context merged into memory items as compact summaries, with deduplication and session-scoped persistence.'
plugins.descZh: dsh 网页端项目级+全局长期记忆：分拆 POST /items 路由避免路径冲突，多轮工具调用上下文压缩后存入记忆项，去重与会话级持久化。

plugins.name: qwert702/dsh-token-viewer
plugins.descEn: 'CC Switch-style token consumption statistics for the dsh web GUI: per-request usage log, real-consumption hero, request-time-bucketed trend chart, per-model peak/off-peak list pricing, per-project and per-model stats, and account balance.'
plugins.descZh: dsh 网页端 CC Switch 风格 Token 消耗统计：按请求的用量日志、真实消耗 Hero、按请求提交时间分桶的趋势图、按模型峰谷牌价计费、项目/模型统计与账户余额。

plugins.name: qwerty-k-de/dsh-attach-picker
plugins.descEn: 'Toolbar picture button in the DSH Web composer: click to pick multiple images through the native file dialog — they join the same draft-image rail as drag-and-drop and paste, with the host image-format, per-message-count and per-image-size limits enforced inline.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 输入框工具栏图片按钮：点击调用系统文件选择器直接多选取图，进入与拖拽/粘贴相同的草稿图片栏，并内联校验宿主的图片格式、单条张数与单张大小限制。'

plugins.name: qys0012/dsh-hotspots
plugins.descEn: 'Real-time hot topics panel for the DSH web GUI: AI news and engineering news, each item with a distilled summary and the source link, shown from a sidebar entry with three views, keyword/source filters, read-state marking and hotkeys.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 时事热点面板：AI 大事与工科热点实时聚合，每条含要点提炼与来源链接；侧边栏入口、三视图、关键词与来源筛选、已读标记与快捷键。'

plugins.name: R-LEI2536/dsh-more-agent-presets
plugins.descEn: More agent presets for DSH, derived from other coding agents such as Qwen Code and iFlow.
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH 提供更多智能体预设，衍生自其他编程智能体（例如 Qwen Code、iFlow）。

plugins.name: Rabbit-bot-No-002/dsh-chat-avatar
plugins.descEn: Adds an avatar to the left of each turn's final AI reply and to the right of each user message; upload your own image and set its size and circle or square frame.
plugins.descZh: 在每轮 AI 回复左侧与你的每条输入右侧各显示一个头像，可上传自己的图片并设置尺寸与圆形/方形头像框。

plugins.name: RadicalGitter/dsh-ui-translate
plugins.descEn: Translates visible Chinese UI and content in DeepSeek Harness Web, using a browser-local OPUS-MT model for session titles, workspace names, messages, search results, and opted-in plugin prose while keeping remote translation limited to allowlisted UI labels.
plugins.descZh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中翻译可见的中文界面与内容：会话标题、工作区名称、消息、搜索结果和插件主动标记的正文使用浏览器本地 OPUS-MT，远程翻译仅限白名单界面标签。

plugins.name: Rainier-Z/dsh-workspace-monitor
plugins.descEn: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that periodically detects added, modified, and deleted files in a workspace and reports the changes.
plugins.descZh: 一个适配 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区监测插件，按周期检测并报告文件的新增、修改和删除。

plugins.name: rainow/dsh-simple-wiki-memory
plugins.descEn: 'A super-simplified LLM-wiki memory plugin: one index document (auto-loaded) + one markdown file per topic (read only when needed) — no dumping everything into the context and burning tokens. Simple and lightweight, painless to install/uninstall, and freely editable however you like.'
plugins.descZh: '超级简化版 llm-wiki 记忆插件：一个索引文档（自动加载）+ 每个主题一个 md 文件（需要时才读）——不会把所有东西塞进上下文烧 token。简单轻量，安装卸载无压力，想怎么改就怎么改。'

plugins.name: Raiyan007-gb/dsh-remote-tunnel-easy
plugins.descEn: Scan a QR code in Settings to open the DeepSeek Harness web UI on your phone inside the active session via a cloudflared quick tunnel.
plugins.descZh: 在设置中扫描二维码，通过 cloudflared 快速隧道在手机上于当前会话中打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端。

plugins.name: rakibulrocky14/dsh-cli
plugins.descEn: Full-screen terminal TUI for DeepSeek Harness with Web-GUI parity, live streaming, agent presets, and DeepSeek blue styling.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 全屏终端 TUI 界面，具备 Web GUI 级对齐能力，支持实时流式输出、智能体预设与经典蓝配色。

plugins.name: rand0wn/dsh-malware-audit
plugins.descEn: Real AST-based scan of installed plugins for malicious-intent patterns (dynamic eval, cross-plugin writes, exfiltration-shaped network calls), with an optional periodic schedule and auto-quarantine on critical findings.
plugins.descZh: '基于 AST 的已装插件恶意行为扫描：识别动态 eval、跨插件写入、外泄型网络调用等模式，并给出可复核的报告。'

plugins.name: rand0wn/dsh-minimal-anchor
plugins.descEn: Prunes the tool schema to a whitelist and injects a structural preamble on a session's first turn only, then passes every later turn through untouched.
plugins.descZh: 只在会话首轮把工具清单裁剪到白名单并注入一段结构化前言，之后每一轮原样放行。

plugins.name: rand0wn/dsh-wrapped
plugins.descEn: Registers /wrapped, which reads the session's own stats and renders a shareable dark SVG summary card — tool vs. thinking time, decode speed, and a tool/thinking-ratio verdict.
plugins.descZh: '注册 /wrapped 命令，读取会话自身的统计数据，渲染成一张可分享的深色 SVG 总结卡：工具耗时与思考耗时对比、解码速度，以及工具/思考占比的评语。'

plugins.name: randomix777/dsh-image-gen
plugins.descEn: 'Optimized fork of dsh-image-gen with batch generation (count), gallery pagination, lazy loading, fetch retry/timeout, and 7 providers: Gemini/OpenAI/Seedream/DashScope/Agnes/GLM-Image/Stability AI.'
plugins.descZh: 'dsh-image-gen 优化版：支持批量生图（count 参数）、画廊分页懒加载、请求超时/重试，兼容 7 个提供商：Gemini/OpenAI/Seedream/通义万相/Agnes/智谱 GLM/Stability AI。'

plugins.name: randomix777/dsh-opencode-zen
plugins.descEn: 'Bring OpenCode Zen free models to DSH: 8 live-discovered providers with zero config, no API key; includes persistent quota tracker with rate-limit detection and reset countdown.'
plugins.descZh: '把 OpenCode Zen 免费模型接入 DSH：8 个实时发现的免费模型，零配置无需 API key；内置持久化额度检测器，自动追踪 429 限流并显示重置倒计时。'

plugins.name: randomix777/dsh-plugin-subs
plugins.descEn: OAuth sign-in for 9 subscription LLM providers (Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity, OpenRouter, Agnes AI, Qwen, Spark, ERNIE) with zero-config login and usage dashboards.
plugins.descZh: 支持 Claude、Codex、Grok、Antigravity、OpenRouter、Agnes AI、Qwen、星火、文心一言共 9 个订阅账号的 OAuth 登录，零配置直连，内置用量看板。

plugins.name: Rannist/balance-dsh
plugins.descEn: Shows DeepSeek account balance and current-session token and cost usage in the sidebar footer and composer dock, including peak and off-peak billing and subagent consumption.
plugins.descZh: 在侧边栏底部和输入框上方显示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额与当前会话 token 及费用消耗，支持高峰/空闲峰谷计费与子代理消耗统计。

plugins.name: ranxianglei/billion-context
plugins.descEn: 'The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).'
plugins.descZh: 'billion-context官方版：上下文压缩插件，兼顾小窗口(100k上下文足矣)省token(省5倍token)和超长会话(数月级别几十亿token单会话)。'

plugins.name: Raphaelutumn/dsh-mood
plugins.descEn: A tiny behavioral mood ring for AI coding agents — folds session behavior (consecutive failures, repeated calls, activity) into a four-state Mood (GOOD / CONFUSED / FRUSTRATED / OVERWHELMED) shown as a low-friction session-header status light.
plugins.descZh: 给 AI 编程 Agent 的轻量心情指示器——把会话行为（连续失败、重复调用、活动强度）折叠成四态 Mood（顺利 / 困惑 / 受挫 / 过载），以低干扰的会话头部状态灯呈现。

plugins.name: Ratevoid/dsh-aseprite
plugins.descEn: "A browser pixel-art and sprite animation editor with Aseprite-compatible files, local crop/outline blueprints, and optional LLM workflow nodes."
plugins.descZh: "浏览器像素画与精灵动画编辑器，支持兼容 Aseprite 的文件、本地裁剪/描边蓝图和可选的 LLM 工作流节点。"

plugins.name: RaulLazaro/dsh-jev-plugin
plugins.descEn: "A `jev` tool that asks Jev (TypeSafe System One) typed yes/no, choice and score questions about one block of text and returns probabilities and confidence, with the provider and API key configured per user in Settings, a judgment ledger with its spend, and daily call and token caps."
plugins.descZh: "为 DSH 增加 `jev` 工具：就同一段文本向 Jev（TypeSafe System One）提出是/否、选择和评分问题，返回概率与置信度；provider 与 API key 在设置中按用户配置，并带判定账本、花费统计以及每日调用与 token 上限。"

plugins.name: RaulLazaro/dsh-preview-plugin
plugins.descEn: "Live preview tab for DSH — embed any dev server in an iframe with transparent SPA proxying."
plugins.descZh: "DSH 实时预览标签页：把任意 dev server 嵌入 iframe，透明代理 SPA 路由。"

plugins.name: RaulLazaro/dsh-pwa-plugin
plugins.descEn: "PWA plugin for DSH — adds offline support, service worker caching, and install-as-app capability."
plugins.descZh: "DSH 的 PWA 插件：离线支持、Service Worker 缓存，并可作为应用安装。"

plugins.name: Ray144165154/dsh-memory-loom
plugins.descEn: 'Cross-session long-term memory: captures durable facts from each turn, auto-associates them by shared entity and tag, and recalls with BM25 plus spreading activation over the link graph.'
plugins.descZh: '跨会话长期记忆：从每轮对话抽取持久事实、按共享标签与实体自动建立联想关联，并以 BM25 加关联图激活传播进行召回；提供六个模型可调用工具与一张设置卡片。'

plugins.name: rayadesune/DeepSeek-Harness-chat-billing
plugins.descEn: DeepSeek account balance, this session's billed spend, and today's total spend in the session-header badge; a turn-cost row in the message actions strip, a detail panel with per-model pricing and a today session-spend ranking. Official peak/off-peak pricing; balance from the real /user/balance API.
plugins.descZh: 会话头部徽标显示 DeepSeek 账户余额、本轮对话花费与今日全部会话总花费；每轮消息操作行前置本轮花费，详情面板含按模型计价与今日会话消费排行。官方峰谷定价，余额取自 /user/balance API。

plugins.name: rayafriandion/dsh-oc-tui
plugins.descEn: An opencode-inspired terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness that boots as a dsh profile app plugin, with a session sidebar, streaming chat, markdown tool cards, todo lists, slash-command suggestions, a telemetry footer with a context meter and inline approval prompts.
plugins.descZh: 受 opencode 启发的 DeepSeek Harness 终端界面，以 dsh profile 应用插件形式启动，提供会话侧栏、流式聊天、markdown 工具卡片、待办列表、斜杠命令建议、带上下文用量表的遥测底栏与内联审批提示。

plugins.name: rayzhu1109/dsh-balance
plugins.descEn: Real-time DeepSeek account balance in the sidebar footer with a 5-day spending chart.
plugins.descZh: 在侧边栏底部实时显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，点击展开最近 5 天消费柱状图。

plugins.name: RCYD857/857-dsh-file-attach
plugins.descEn: Drag or paste files or pictures into the DSH Web composer as one scrolling row of chips, sent as @path references.
plugins.descZh: 把文件或图片拖进 DSH Web 输入框，以一排小卡片展示，发送时以 @path 引用传给模型。

plugins.name: readfish/dsh-client-theme-cyber
plugins.descEn: Dark navy glass theme for DeepSeek Harness Web with a cyber-city background and holographic-cube cyan accents.
plugins.descZh: 深海军蓝半透明面板承载赛博城市夜景背景、全息立方体青色辉光作为点缀的暗色主题。

plugins.name: realhacker/dsh-theme-colorizer
plugins.descEn: A Deepseek Harness plugin that gives its UI color themes.
plugins.descZh: Deepseek Harness 的一款插件，可为其用户界面添加颜色主题。

plugins.name: reatcat/l123-harness
plugins.descEn: 'Three-tier agent memory harness: L1 always-on CLAUDE.md, L2 index, L3 detail skeleton with templates, a gate that blocks writes to protected files without a one-time approval token, zero-judgement event logging, weekly distillation, and a TDD execution-loop skill.'
plugins.descZh: 三级记忆 agent 底座：L1 常驻层、L2 索引、L3 详情骨架与模板，受保护文件门禁（一次性审批令牌），零判断事件日志，周审提炼与 TDD 执行流技能。

plugins.name: rebornace/dsh-tracescope#dsh-tracescope
plugins.descEn: 'DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task attachments, and defect submission to Yunxiao, GitHub, GitLab, or a webhook.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 右侧栏插件：对比两个 git 提交，根据影响面生成手测清单，支持失败备注、截图、任务附件，以及向云效 / GitHub / GitLab / Webhook 提交缺陷。'

plugins.name: rebron1900/dsh-mnemosyne
plugins.descEn: 'Mnemosyne memory for DeepSeek Harness: remember / recall / forget / stats / sleep tools, embedded skill, auto-setup, optional auto-sync/prefetch, and a Settings panel. Data lives under ~/.dsh/mnemosyne.'
plugins.descZh: 'Mnemosyne 记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness：提供 remember / recall / forget / stats / sleep 工具、内嵌技能、Settings 面板和可选的自动记忆功能。'

plugins.name: rebron1900/dsh-web-search-9router
plugins.descEn: '9router-backed web search + fetch providers for DeepSeek Harness (ctx.web). Wires the native web_search/web_fetch tools to 9router''s /v1/search and /v1/web/fetch endpoints.'
plugins.descZh: '9router 网页搜索与网页抓取 provider，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索和抓取能力。'

plugins.name: recoluan/recowork#recowork-dsh
plugins.descEn: 'Creates and inspects RecoWork local-agent-project workspaces through two bounded DSH tools and a web workspace card.'
plugins.descZh: '通过两个受限的 DSH 工具和网页工作区卡片，创建并检查 RecoWork local-agent-project 工作区。'

plugins.name: redfox-data/redfox-skill-gallery
plugins.descEn: Adds a sidebar entry that opens a card gallery of all Red Fox Community skills from the redfox-community-dsh plugin.
plugins.descZh: 在侧边栏底部加入「红狐 Skills」入口，点击后切换为卡片式技能画廊，集中展示 redfox-community-dsh 插件内的红狐社区技能。

plugins.name: reisen-ww/dsh-bonk-pet
plugins.descEn: 'Whale-girl desk pet in the corner of the DSH Web GUI. It sings along to a bundled track while the agent works; when a tool call fails a steel pipe falls on its head. Click it to bonk the basin it wears, which costs 12 rice — knock enough and it gets hungry and wanders off to beg, and rice appears somewhere on the page for it to dash across and eat. Draggable within the viewport, wriggles and complains if grabbed mid-dash, volume and behaviour configurable from Settings. All artwork, sound effects and the song ship inside the package.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web GUI 角落里的悬浮鲸鱼娘。agent 干活时它跟着内置歌曲唱歌；工具报错时天上掉钢管砸它脑袋。点它敲头上的铁盆，每敲一次扣 12 米饭——敲多了就饿，饿了会去讨饭，米饭随机出现在页面某处，它咻地冲过去吃掉。可拖动且始终留在视口内，吃米途中被抓住会挣扎，音量与玩法在设置里可调。全部素材、音效与歌曲都打包在插件内。'

plugins.name: Relethe/dsh-brief-session-title
plugins.descEn: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.
plugins.descZh: 把 DSH 会话标题从一句话精简为不含动词的短语，目标五个词以内。

plugins.name: RempleXI/word-docx-writer
plugins.descEn: 'Generate and format Chinese Word (.docx) documents from a simple markup file, using built-in heading styles, SimSun and Times New Roman fonts, and per-chapter figure and table captions.'
plugins.descZh: 用简单标记稿生成并排版中文 Word（.docx）文档，使用内置标题样式、宋体与 Times New Roman 字体，图表题注按章自动编号。

plugins.name: renchengxiang/dsh-web-search-tavily
plugins.descEn: Tavily-backed search provider for native web_search, with a Settings → Plugins card for API key management and toggling DeepSeek replacement.
plugins.descZh: 为原生 web_search 提供 Tavily 搜索后端，并在设置 → 插件中提供 API Key 管理与是否替换 DeepSeek 的开关。

plugins.name: Renji004/dsh-omni-vision
plugins.descEn: 'Local eyes for text-only models: eyes_render draws text/shapes/Mermaid onto a canvas in the Web GUI, eyes_paste captures pasted images, eyes_ocr reads text via the built-in Windows OCR (offline), and eyes_analyze inspects pixels as structured data — no vision model required.'
plugins.descZh: '为纯文本模型装上本地眼睛：eyes_render 在 Web 界面画布上绘制文字/图形/Mermaid，eyes_paste 接收用户粘贴的图片，eyes_ocr 用 Windows 自带 OCR 离线读文字，eyes_analyze 把像素解析成结构化数据，全程无需视觉模型。'

plugins.name: Renzic-Stone/DSH-EasyRewrite
plugins.descEn: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.
plugins.descZh: 在 dsh web 中内联编辑与撤回自己的消息——惰性、无痕，带版本翻页器与会话级草稿持久化。

plugins.name: rex178178/dsh-turnbar
plugins.descEn: 'Video-style turn navigation for the Web UI: full-map progress bar with hover preview cards (tools/files/tokens), drag scrub, ⌘K in-conversation search, ⌘↑/⌘↓ stepping, Esc-return. Event-log powered — works beyond the loaded window. Dual-half plugin on the official composer.dock slot.'
plugins.descZh: '会话内轮次导航视频进度条：全图分段、悬停富元信息卡（工具/文件/token）、拖动 scrub、⌘K 全会话搜索、⌘↑/⌘↓ 逐轮跳转、Esc 返回原位——基于会话事件日志，超出已加载窗口仍可用。'

plugins.name: RexYoung000/rex-harness#ui-workflow
plugins.descEn: Turns a product or UI request into an implementation-ready design spec with /ui-workflow and /ui-rerun. Analysts run through a read-only ui_analyst tool, and the lead agent writes docs/ui-workflow reports.
plugins.descZh: 把产品或界面需求编排成可落地的设计规格，提供 /ui-workflow 与 /ui-rerun。分析师通过只读 ui_analyst 运行，主控把报告写入 docs/ui-workflow。

plugins.name: rezon-aki/dsh-streamfold
plugins.descEn: 'Streaming-transcript fold for the DSH web UI: thinking and tool rows fold away while the newest thinking window opens itself; a finished turn scrolls back to your question, which also stays pinned at the top while you read; blue sparks fly from the thinking window edge and the answer writing head.'
plugins.descZh: '流式折叠：思考与工具行自动折起、最新思考小窗自动展开；一轮结束平滑回到你提的那句话（读到哪一问就钉在顶部）；思考小窗滚动时底边溅蓝色火星，正文写头向四周飘火星。'

plugins.name: RGarvel/dsh-channel-view
plugins.descEn: "Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation."
plugins.descZh: "侧边栏注入的按渠道分组会话视图——工作区/Channels 双标签、运行中绿点、归档折叠与孤儿工作区标注，完全基于官方扩展面实现，兼作 RFC-0001（discussion #3897）的参考实现。"

plugins.name: rice-awa/dsh-lan-gateway
plugins.descEn: "Publishes the DSH Web GUI to LAN or internet with dsh kept on loopback. Every source must sign in for an HMAC session cookie unless passwordless LAN is opted into. Adds self-signed or custom TLS, a secureCookies override for plaintext-HTTP proxies, and a UUID shim for plain-HTTP origins."
plugins.descZh: "把 DSH Web GUI 发布到局域网/公网，dsh 仍只绑定回环。除显式开启局域网免密外，所有来源均须登录换取 HMAC 会话 Cookie。提供自签名或自定义 TLS、用于明文 HTTP 代理的 secureCookies 覆盖项，以及让局域网纯 HTTP 来源正常打开工作区的 UUID shim。"

plugins.name: Rice00/dsh-job-progress
plugins.descEn: 'Live progress for long-running background jobs in the DSH web GUI: a draggable floating ball in the session that owns the job, expanding into a panel with done/total, speed and ETA.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH Web 界面中长时间后台任务的实时进度：有任务的会话里浮着一个小球，可拖动，点开是含已完成/总量、速度与剩余时间的面板。'

plugins.name: Rice00/dsh-loupe
plugins.descEn: 'Explain a selected word or sentence from a DSH conversation in a floating window: a channel of its own that leaves the session untouched, and the answer can be pinned to a session of its own.'
plugins.descZh: '在浮窗里解释 DSH 对话中选中的词或句子：走独立通道、不污染当前会话，解答可以固定成独立会话。'

plugins.name: Rice00/dsh-tree-view
plugins.descEn: 'Tree view of a DSH conversation: editing an old message forks the thread, every version lives in one tree while the sidebar keeps a single entry, branches can be renamed, and a branch can be promoted to a session of its own.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 会话的树形视图：编辑一条旧消息即从那一刻分叉，所有版本住进同一棵树、侧栏始终只有一条，分支可以改名，也可以把某个分支提升为独立会话。'

plugins.name: Ricketts-Guo/dsh-off-peak-message#dsh-offpeak-send
plugins.descEn: 'Off-peak message scheduler: turn on valley mode and the composer queues your messages until DeepSeek off-peak hours (half price), then auto-injects them into the session and gets replies. Native-look composer, hotkeys (Enter queue / ⌘+Enter send now / Esc exit), per-session toggle persisted across restarts.'
plugins.descZh: '谷时发送调度器：开启谷时模式后输入框消息排队至 DeepSeek 谷时窗口（半价）自动注入会话并得到回复。原生外观输入条、快捷键（Enter 入队 / ⌘+Enter 立即发送 / Esc 退出）、按会话记忆的开关，重启不丢。'

plugins.name: riesbri/dshline#dshline
plugins.descEn: Terminal-native TUI frontend for DeepSeek Harness that presents sessions, models, plugins, jobs, subagents, todos, and provider configuration through Harness capabilities while preserving real terminal scrollback.
plugins.descZh: DeepSeek Harness 的终端原生 TUI 前端，通过 Harness 能力提供会话、模型、插件、任务、子代理、待办事项和 Provider 配置，并保留真实的终端滚动历史。

plugins.name: rinDBeans/codex-ui
plugins.descEn: 'Codex-style appearance for the DSH Web interface: window edge hairlines and shadows, sidebar colours and row alignment, a model picker with a reasoning-effort power rail, composer and right-panel geometry, a full-page settings-modal pass, a Trajectory view exit, and a settings card for theme, accent, background, foreground, fonts, sidebar translucency and contrast.'
plugins.descZh: 为 DSH Web 界面复刻 Codex 外观：窗口边缘发丝线与阴影、侧栏配色与行对齐、带推理强度功率轨的模型选择器、输入区与右栏几何、设置模态框全页改造、轨迹视图退出出口，以及可调主题、强调色、背景、前景、字体、侧栏半透明与对比度的设置卡。

plugins.name: Roarpeng/GraphFlow
plugins.descEn: 'Local-first code knowledge graph for coding agents: 10 MCP tools for layered context compression, DAG planning, incremental AST indexing, a cross-session skill flywheel, diagnostics, and graph artifact import/export.'
plugins.descZh: 面向编程 Agent 的本地代码知识图谱：提供 10 个 MCP 工具，覆盖分层上下文压缩、DAG 规划、增量 AST 建图、跨会话技能飞轮、诊断与图谱产物导入导出。

plugins.name: robbywang25/dsh-codex-pins
plugins.descEn: Splits the DeepSeek Harness sidebar into independently scrollable Pinned and Recents panes, and hides pinned sessions from Recents.
plugins.descZh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏分成可独立滚动的置顶栏和最近栏，置顶过的会话不再出现在最近列表里。

plugins.name: robbywang25/dsh-llm-mlx
plugins.descEn: Use local MLX-LM or MLX-VLM models in DeepSeek Harness through a loopback OpenAI-compatible provider, with optional DSH-owned server startup.
plugins.descZh: 通过回环 OpenAI-compatible 提供方在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用本机 MLX-LM 或 MLX-VLM 模型，并可选由 DSH 托管模型服务进程。

plugins.name: robin421/dsh-html-inspector
plugins.descEn: 'Selection mode for HTML preview and browser tabs: click any element in a locally served demo page and its locator (selector, text, HTML snippet) is written into the chat input for precise AI editing.'
plugins.descZh: 'HTML 选区模式：点选本机 demo 页面中的任意元素，定位信息（选择器、文本、HTML 片段）自动写入对话输入框，供 AI 精准修改。'

plugins.name: "robiteame/dsh-session-tree-extension"
plugins.descEn: "Pi-style append-only multi-branch session trees: fork or jump to any historical node without deleting history, clone a branch into a new session, and browse the tree in a WebUI panel. Works on stock Harness via graceful degradation."
plugins.descZh: "Pi 风格的追加式多分支会话树:在任意历史节点开分支或跳转而不删除旧历史,可将分支克隆为新会话,并在 WebUI 树面板中浏览(明暗主题)。在原版 Harness 上优雅降级运行。"

plugins.name: RockingSisyphus/dsh-focus-supervisor#dsh-plugin
plugins.descEn: DSH self-discipline companion with recurring tasks, a gaze-tracking desktop mascot, evidence logs, final AI review, reminders, and window intervention on Windows and GNOME Wayland.
plugins.descZh: 大肥鱼监工是 DSH 自制力助手：支持单次与循环预约、会看鼠标的桌面角色、采集证据与诊断日志、到点后的 AI 末轮验收，以及原生提醒和窗口干预；支持 Windows 与 GNOME Wayland。

plugins.name: roclee2692/dsh-model-groups
plugins.descEn: 'Grouped provider and manufacturer model selector for DeepSeek Harness, preserving provider/model routes and reasoning levels.'
plugins.descZh: 'DeepSeek Harness 的平台与厂家折叠模型选择器，保留 provider/model 路由与思考等级。'

plugins.name: rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance
plugins.descEn: 'One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.'
plugins.descZh: '输入框一键提示词增强——把草稿改写为结构化提示词（角色与目标、可执行步骤、输出格式、验收标准、边界条件），支持前后对比、回填与一键撤销；不改变原意、不凭空编造需求。'

plugins.name: Roykf/dsh-tool-weather
plugins.descEn: Model-facing weather tool that queries current conditions and 7-day forecasts from public Open-Meteo APIs, with no API key required.
plugins.descZh: 面向模型的天气工具，基于公开 Open-Meteo API 查询当前天气与 7 天预报，无需 API Key。

plugins.name: roymina/dsh-cad
plugins.descEn: "Read-only CAD tools that inspect, extract and export DWG/DXF drawings, including SVG and PNG previews and DXF conversion."
plugins.descZh: "只读 CAD 工具：查看、提取 DWG/DXF 图纸，导出 SVG/PNG 预览或转换 DXF。"

plugins.name: RrcoVer0/dsh-webnovel-writer
plugins.descEn: Adds file-backed Chinese web-fiction planning, chapter writing, consistency review, rollback, and style-profile skills.
plugins.descZh: 为现有 Agent 添加基于文件记忆的中文网文策划、逐章写作、一致性审校、回滚与文风画像技能。

plugins.name: ruanhaodong-tt/dsh-security-guard
plugins.descEn: 'Runtime security guard for DSH: loader import confinement, HTTP Host header validation, and source patch for VM sandbox escapes (4 CVEs). AI-assisted.'
plugins.descZh: 'DSH 运行时安全守卫：配置加载导入约束、HTTP Host 头校验、附带 VM 沙箱逃逸源码补丁（4 个 CVE）。AI 辅助制作。'

plugins.name: Rudyy898/dsh-drag-path
